model_requirements.description: travel hospitality industry enterprise data model.

_vibe_session_metadata.summary: Model quality: 74.05/100 (29 warnings, 0 errors). 361 tables across 17 domains.

model.name: Travel_Hospitality
model.description: Travel and Hospitality is a global industry operating hotels, resorts, and vacation properties across luxury, premium, and select-service segments, providing loyalty programs, event spaces, and curated guest experiences.
model.core_business_processes: Reservation and Booking Management, Revenue Management and Yield Optimization, Guest Check-In and Check-Out Operations, Housekeeping and Room Maintenance Scheduling, Loyalty Program Administration and Rewards Fulfillment, Food and Beverage Operations Management, Event and Conference Sales and Coordination, Property Development and Renovation Planning, Guest Experience and Service Recovery Management, Channel Distribution and OTA Partnership Management
model.data_domains: Guest, Reservation, Property, Room Inventory, Revenue Management, Loyalty, Food and Beverage, Events and Meetings, Workforce, Housekeeping, Finance, Channel Distribution, Procurement, Marketing
model.common_business_jargons: ADR (Average Daily Rate), RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room), OCC (Occupancy Rate), GOP (Gross Operating Profit), TRevPAR (Total Revenue Per Available Room), GOPPAR (Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room), OTA (Online Travel Agency), GDS (Global Distribution System), CRS (Central Reservation System), PMS (Property Management System), RMS (Revenue Management System), F&B (Food and Beverage), MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions), FIT (Free Independent Traveler), BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), DRR (Dynamic Rate Rule), LOS (Length of Stay), ALOS (Average Length of Stay), NPS (Net Promoter Score), GSS (Guest Satisfaction Score), CSAT (Customer Satisfaction), LTV (Lifetime Value), POS (Point of Sale), BEO (Banquet Event Order), STR (Smith Travel Research), STAR Report (Smith Travel Accommodations Report), RGI (Revenue Generation Index), MPI (Market Penetration Index), ARI (Average Rate Index), FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment), CapEx (Capital Expenditure), OpEx (Operating Expenditure), USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), BI (Business Intelligence), ETL (Extract Transform Load), API (Application Programming Interface), SLA (Service Level Agreement), KPI (Key Performance Indicator), EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization), NOI (Net Operating Income), GRR (Guest Recovery Rate), DOR (Daily Operations Report), SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking), PIP (Property Improvement Plan), ROI (Return on Investment), CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room)
model.operational_systems_of_records: Oracle OPERA PMS (Front Desk; Reservations; Cashiering; Housekeeping; Guest Profiles; AR), IDeaS G3 RMS (Pricing; Forecasting; Inventory Controls; Group Evaluation), Salesforce CRM (Guest Profiles; Marketing Campaigns; Loyalty Management; Case Management), Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS (Restaurant POS; Bar POS; Banquet POS; Inventory), Delphi by Amadeus (Event Sales; Catering; BEO Management; Group Blocks), SAP S/4HANA (Finance GL/AP/AR; Procurement MM; HR HCM; Asset Management), Sabre SynXis CRS (Central Reservations; Channel Management; Rate Distribution), Oracle HCM Cloud (Workforce Management; Payroll; Talent Acquisition; Learning), Medallia (Guest Feedback; NPS Surveys; Service Recovery; Experience Analytics), Infor EzRMS (Demand Forecasting; Competitive Benchmarking; Revenue Strategy)
model.industry_governing_body: American Hotel and Lodging Association (AHLA), World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC), International Hotel and Restaurant Association (IH&RA), Hotel Technology Next Generation (HTNG) - now AHLA Technology, STR (Smith Travel Research) - industry benchmarking standards, PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard), GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) - guest data privacy, CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - financial reporting standard, ISO 22000 (Food Safety Management), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) - accessibility compliance, IFRS/GAAP (International Financial Reporting Standards / Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - financial controls for publicly traded companies, Local fire safety and building codes

domains.name: guest
domains.description: Single source of truth for guest identity, profiles, preferences, contact information, demographics, stay history, and segmentation across all properties and brands. Manages individual travelers, corporate accounts, group contacts, and VIP profiles. Supports FIT, corporate, and group guest types. Integrates with CRM (Salesforce) and loyalty platforms for unified guest view and lifetime value tracking.

products.name: profile
products.description: Single source of truth for guest identity and master profile data across all properties and brands. Captures individual traveler identity including full name, date of birth, nationality, passport/ID details, gender, language preference, and VIP status flag. Stores profile source system origin, creation property, last-updated timestamp, merge survivor status, and active/inactive lifecycle state. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS (Guest Profiles) and Salesforce CRM. Serves FIT, corporate, and group guest types. The authoritative golden record for all guest identity resolution, cross-property recognition, and lifetime value tracking. All other guest-domain products reference this entity as their parent.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guest master profile record in the lakehouse silver layer. This is the primary key and golden record anchor for all guest identity resolution across properties and brands. Role: MASTER_PARTY.

attributes.name: merged_into_profile_id
attributes.description: When profile_status = 'merged', this field references the survivor profile_id into which this record was consolidated. Enables audit trail of merge lineage and supports identity resolution queries across the guest domain.

attributes.name: accessibility_needs
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the guest's accessibility requirements (e.g., wheelchair accessible room, roll-in shower, hearing loop, visual impairment aids). Drives ADA-compliant room assignment and service delivery. Treated as sensitive personal data.

attributes.name: address
attributes.description: The address of the profile.

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: The guest's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, birthday recognition programs, loyalty tier benefits, and regulatory identity verification at check-in.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or corporate account associated with this guest profile. Used for corporate rate eligibility, billing to master accounts, and corporate segment analytics. Applicable primarily to CORPORATE guest type.

attributes.name: country_of_residence_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guest Country of Residence Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)
attributes.description: The guest's country of permanent residence as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Distinct from nationality; used for geographic segmentation, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and source market analytics.

tag_set.value: Guest Country of Residence Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the guest master profile record was first created in the source system of record (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for MASTER_PARTY role.

attributes.name: creation_property_code
attributes.description: The property code (hotel/resort identifier) at which this guest profile was originally created in the PMS. Used for cross-property profile governance, data stewardship assignment, and origin analytics.

attributes.name: crm_contact_reference
attributes.description: The native contact identifier assigned by Salesforce CRM for this guest. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the PMS golden record and the CRM guest profile for marketing, loyalty, and case management workflows.

attributes.name: data_privacy_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest provided or last renewed their data privacy consent. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trails, consent expiry management, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: The primary email address for the guest used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival communications, loyalty program notifications, and post-stay surveys via Medallia. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent management.

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Granular consent flag specifically for email marketing communications, separate from the overall marketing opt-in. Supports channel-specific consent management as required by GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM regulations.

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The guest's legal family name (surname) as captured at check-in or profile creation. Used for identity verification, folio generation, and cross-property guest recognition.

attributes.name: gdpr_erasure_requested
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR Right to Erasure Request Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has submitted a GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) request. True = erasure request received and pending or in-process. Triggers data suppression workflows and prevents further marketing processing.

tag_set.value: GDPR Right to Erasure Request Flag

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The guest's self-identified gender code: M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Other, U=Undisclosed. Used for personalization, regulatory reporting in certain jurisdictions, and demographic analytics.

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The guest's legal given name (first name) as captured at check-in or profile creation. Used for personalized guest recognition, folios, and correspondence across all properties.

attributes.name: guest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guest by travel purpose and booking relationship: FIT (Free Independent Traveler), CORPORATE (business traveler under corporate account), GROUP (group block participant), CREW (airline/transport crew), TRAVEL_AGENT, VIP. Drives rate eligibility, service protocols, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIT|CORPORATE|GROUP|CREW|TRAVEL_AGENT|VIP|WHOLESALE|GOVERNMENT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_merge_survivor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profile record is the surviving (golden) record following a guest profile merge operation. True = this is the authoritative survivor record; False = this is a source or non-survivor record. Critical for identity resolution and deduplication governance.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The professional job title of the guest as provided during profile creation or CRM synchronization. Supports corporate account management, MICE event coordination, and personalized service delivery for business travelers.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the guest profile record in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate member tenure, tier qualification windows, and anniversary recognition benefits.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program membership number assigned by the central loyalty platform (Salesforce CRM / loyalty engine). The primary identifier linking the guest profile to loyalty tier, points balance, and rewards history.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The guest's current loyalty program tier level, determining benefit eligibility, upgrade priority, and service recognition protocols. Tiers progress from NONE (non-member) through SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, to DIAMOND (highest).

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, direct mail). True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance in marketing campaign execution.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The guest's middle name or initial as provided. Supports full legal name matching for identity verification, passport validation, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: The guest's mobile/cell phone number in E.164 format. Used for SMS pre-arrival messaging, mobile check-in notifications, and digital key delivery.

attributes.name: name_prefix
attributes.description: Honorific or salutation prefix for the guest (e.g., Mr, Mrs, Dr). Used in personalized correspondence, folio headers, and VIP recognition communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss|Dr|Prof|Sir|Rev — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix for the guest (e.g., Jr., Sr., III, PhD). Supports full legal name representation for identity documents and formal correspondence.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: The guest's nationality expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for regulatory reporting, visa compliance, and international guest analytics.

attributes.name: opera_profile_reference
attributes.description: The native guest profile identifier assigned by Oracle OPERA Property Management System (PMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation and source-system traceability back to the PMS guest profile record.

attributes.name: passport_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the guest's passport document. Used to validate document currency at check-in and for regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring valid travel document verification.

attributes.name: passport_issuing_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guest Passport Issuing Country Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the authority that issued the guest's passport. Required for immigration compliance and international guest regulatory reporting.

tag_set.value: Guest Passport Issuing Country Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The guest's passport document number as presented at check-in. Required for international guest identity verification, regulatory reporting to local authorities, and compliance with immigration laws in applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: The primary contact phone number for the guest in E.164 international format. Used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival contact, and service recovery outreach.

attributes.name: preferred_bed_type
attributes.description: The guest's preferred bed configuration for room assignment: KING, QUEEN, DOUBLE, TWIN, or SINGLE. Used during pre-arrival room blocking and at check-in to maximize guest satisfaction.

attributes.name: preferred_floor
attributes.description: The guest's preferred floor level or floor range for room assignment (e.g., high floor, low floor, specific floor number). Captured from guest preferences in OPERA PMS and used during pre-arrival room blocking.

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: The guest's preferred communication language expressed as an ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, fr, de, zh). Drives language selection for folios, correspondence, digital communications, and on-property service delivery.

attributes.name: preferred_room_type
attributes.description: The guest's stated or historically derived preferred room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Suite, Double Queen). Stored as a room type code from the PMS room type configuration. Used by front desk for pre-arrival room assignment and upsell targeting.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guest master profile: active (in use), inactive (dormant, no recent stays), merged (absorbed into a survivor record), suspended (temporarily blocked), deceased (confirmed deceased, retained for audit). Governs record visibility and processing eligibility.

attributes.name: smoking_preference
attributes.description: The guest's smoking preference for room assignment: NON_SMOKING, SMOKING (where available), or NO_PREFERENCE. Used during pre-arrival room blocking and check-in assignment to comply with guest preferences and property smoking policies.

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Granular consent flag specifically for SMS/text message marketing communications. Supports channel-specific consent management as required by GDPR, CCPA, and TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) regulations.

attributes.name: vip_status
attributes.description: The VIP designation level assigned to the guest in Oracle OPERA PMS, indicating the tier of elevated service protocols to apply at check-in and throughout the stay. NONE=standard guest, VIP1-VIP3=escalating VIP tiers, VVIP=highest recognition, BLACKLIST=do-not-accommodate flag.

products.name: contact_info
products.description: Authoritative repository of all guest contact details and postal addresses associated with a guest profile. Stores email addresses, phone numbers, mailing/billing/home addresses (with full international address structure including city, state, postal code, country per ISO 3166), and digital contact channels (social handles, messaging IDs). Supports multiple records per guest with type classification (primary, secondary, work, home), opt-in/opt-out flags for marketing communications, address validation status, and geocoordinates. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: contact_info_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each guest contact information record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the contact_info data product. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Oracle OPERA PMS guest profile modules.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest profile record to which this contact information belongs. Supports multiple contact records per guest (primary, secondary, work, home). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS guest profile and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the guest's mailing, billing, or home address. Includes street number and street name. Used for billing correspondence, loyalty program mailings, and address validation. Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line for the guest's postal address. Captures apartment number, suite, floor, building name, or other secondary address components. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the postal address indicating its purpose: home residence, billing address for invoices and folios, mailing address for correspondence, or work/corporate address. Determines which address is used for loyalty program mailings and billing statements.

attributes.name: address_validated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the postal address was last validated against an authoritative address verification service. Used to determine whether re-validation is required based on data freshness policies and returned mail events.

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the postal address validation check performed against authoritative address databases (e.g., USPS, Royal Mail, Canada Post). Validated addresses improve direct mail deliverability and reduce returned loyalty program correspondence.

attributes.name: bounce_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why a contact record has been marked as bounced or undeliverable. Hard bounces indicate permanent delivery failures (invalid email/address); soft bounces indicate temporary failures. Used to maintain list hygiene and comply with email deliverability best practices.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the guest's postal address. Used for geographic segmentation, demand forecasting by feeder market, and targeted marketing campaigns. Part of the full international address structure.

attributes.name: contact_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel category this contact record represents: email, phone, postal address, social media handle, or digital messaging platform. Enables multi-channel guest communication strategy and analytics.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this contact record. Active records are used for communications; bounced or undeliverable records indicate failed delivery attempts; suppressed records are excluded from all outbound communications per regulatory or guest request. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact record indicating its role relative to the guest profile. Determines which record is used for reservation confirmations, marketing communications, billing, and emergency notifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|work|home|billing|emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the guest's address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for international address formatting, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, feeder market analytics, and channel distribution reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact information record was first created in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, GDPR consent audit trails, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record is scheduled for deletion or anonymization per the applicable data retention policy. Calculated based on the last guest interaction date plus the retention period defined by GDPR, CCPA, or local data protection regulations. Supports automated data lifecycle management.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly requested no contact via this channel, regardless of opt-in status. Overrides all marketing and transactional communication flags. Must be honored immediately upon receipt per GDPR Article 21 (right to object) and CCPA.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Guest email address used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival communications, loyalty program notifications, and marketing campaigns. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS. Subject to GDPR, CCPA opt-in/opt-out controls.

attributes.name: email_type
attributes.description: Classification of the email address indicating whether it is a personal, work/corporate, or other email account. Supports segmentation for FIT versus corporate guest communications and loyalty program targeting.

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which this contact record is processed. Required for all guest contact data belonging to EU/EEA residents. Consent is the most common basis for marketing; contract is the basis for transactional communications related to reservations.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record is the designated primary contact for the guest within its channel type. Only one record per guest per channel should be flagged as primary. Used by CRS and PMS for reservation confirmations and pre-arrival communications.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record has been verified through a confirmation process (e.g., email verification link, phone OTP, address validation). Verified contacts have higher data quality confidence and are preferred for critical communications such as reservation confirmations.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag indicating the guest's preferred language for communications sent to this contact address (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, zh-CN). Drives localized email templates, pre-arrival messaging, and loyalty program communications.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the guest's postal address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Supports geocoded feeder market analysis, drive-time radius marketing campaigns, and property proximity analytics for targeted offers.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the guest's postal address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used in conjunction with latitude for geocoded feeder market analysis, proximity-based marketing, and demand origin mapping.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications via this contact channel. True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance. Drives suppression lists in Salesforce CRM marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications via this contact channel. Required for GDPR audit trail and consent management. Stored to demonstrate lawful basis for processing under GDPR Article 6.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest withdrew consent or opted out of marketing communications via this contact channel. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trail. Once set, this contact record must be excluded from all outbound marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: messaging_handle
attributes.description: Guest's account identifier or phone number on the specified digital messaging platform. Used to initiate pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay communications via messaging channels. Subject to GDPR and CCPA as a digital contact identifier.

attributes.name: messaging_platform
attributes.description: Digital messaging platform through which the guest can be contacted (e.g., WhatsApp, WeChat, LINE, SMS). Supports pre-arrival messaging, in-stay service requests, and post-stay follow-up communications per guest opt-in preferences.

attributes.name: opt_in_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the guest provided their marketing or transactional communication consent. Used for consent audit trails and channel attribution analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|front_desk|call_center|ota|loyalty_enrollment|other — promote to reference product if additional sources are required]

attributes.name: phone_country_code
attributes.description: International dialing country code prefix for the guest phone number (e.g., +1 for USA, +44 for UK). Stored separately to support international call routing and country-level analytics. Conforms to ITU-T E.164 country code standards.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Guest phone number in E.164 international format. Used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival calls, service recovery, and emergency contact. Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM. Subject to GDPR and CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the phone number indicating whether it is a mobile, home, work, or fax number. Determines eligibility for SMS marketing communications and pre-arrival text notifications per guest opt-in preferences.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the guest's address. Supports address validation, geographic clustering for feeder market analysis, and targeted direct mail campaigns. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).

attributes.name: social_handle
attributes.description: Guest's username or handle on the specified social media platform. Used for social CRM engagement, service recovery via social channels, and digital marketing personalization. Subject to GDPR and CCPA as a digital identifier.

attributes.name: social_platform
attributes.description: Name of the social media platform associated with the guest's social handle or digital identity record. Used for social CRM integration, guest experience personalization, and digital marketing channel attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: twitter|instagram|facebook|linkedin|wechat|line|tiktok|other — promote to reference product if additional platforms are required]

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this contact record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Contact ID, OPERA profile contact sequence number). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer lakehouse and source systems for reconciliation and data quality audits.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the guest's postal address per ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes. Used for regional marketing segmentation, tax jurisdiction determination, and CCPA compliance scope identification.

attributes.name: transactional_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has consented to receive transactional communications (reservation confirmations, folio receipts, check-in instructions) via this contact channel. Distinct from marketing opt-in; transactional messages may have a separate legal basis under GDPR.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact information record was last modified in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and data freshness monitoring in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record was last verified through a confirmation process. Used to assess data freshness and trigger re-verification workflows when contact data exceeds the data quality policy threshold.

products.name: preference
products.description: Guest preference records capturing stated and inferred preferences across all hospitality touchpoints. Includes room preferences (floor level, bed type, smoking/non-smoking, view type), pillow type, amenity preferences, F&B dietary restrictions and allergies, newspaper preferences, housekeeping schedule preferences, temperature settings, and special accommodation needs (ADA requirements). Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM. Critical for personalized service delivery and pre-arrival preparation.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a guest preference record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the preference data product within the guest domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who captured or last updated this preference record. Supports accountability tracking and training analytics for preference capture quality.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile to whom this preference record belongs. Links the preference to the unified guest identity in the guest domain.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this preference was captured or is applicable. A null value indicates the preference applies globally across all properties for the guest.

attributes.name: stay_history_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific stay or reservation during which this preference was captured or last confirmed. Enables preference-to-stay linkage for analytics on preference fulfillment rates and guest satisfaction correlation.

attributes.name: allergy_detail
attributes.description: Specific description of the guest's food or environmental allergy (e.g., 'severe peanut allergy - anaphylactic', 'shellfish allergy', 'latex allergy'). Classified as restricted health information under GDPR and CCPA. Triggers mandatory F&B and housekeeping alerts. Only populated when is_allergy = True.

attributes.name: amenity_preferences
attributes.description: Guest's stated preferences for in-room amenities and welcome items (e.g., 'extra towels', 'foam bath products', 'specific brand toiletries', 'fruit basket', 'champagne on arrival'). Free-form text to accommodate the wide variety of amenity requests. Communicated to housekeeping and concierge for pre-arrival setup.

attributes.name: bed_type_preference
attributes.description: Guest's stated preference for bed configuration in their room. Sourced from OPERA PMS guest profile and used during room assignment to match available inventory. Supports pre-arrival preparation and upsell opportunity identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: king|queen|double|twin|single|rollaway|no_preference — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of guest preference. Drives routing to the appropriate operational team (e.g., housekeeping, F&B, front desk). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room|bed|pillow|amenity|dietary|housekeeping|temperature|newspaper|accessibility|fnb|transportation|communication|loyalty|spa — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the preference value as defined in the Property Management System (OPERA PMS) preference code table. Used for system-to-system integration and operational workflow routing (e.g., 'KGBED', 'NONSM', 'OCNVW', 'VEGAN').

attributes.name: communication_channel_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preferred channel for receiving hotel communications including pre-arrival messages, in-stay notifications, and post-stay follow-up. Drives marketing and operational communication routing in Salesforce CRM. Supports GDPR and CCPA consent management.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest provided consent for collection and use of this preference data. Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails. Null if consent_given is False or consent was not explicitly recorded.

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided explicit consent for the collection and use of this preference data (True). Required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance. Preferences captured without consent must not be used for marketing personalization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this preference record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities compliance.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Data governance classification level for this preference record, aligned with the enterprise data classification policy. 'restricted' for health/allergy data, 'confidential' for personal preferences, 'internal' for operational preferences. Drives access control and data handling policies.

attributes.name: dietary_restriction
attributes.description: Guest's stated dietary restriction or special dietary requirement (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'halal', 'kosher', 'gluten-free', 'lactose-free', 'diabetic'). Communicated to F&B operations via MICROS POS and Delphi for event catering. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vegetarian|vegan|halal|kosher|gluten_free|lactose_free|diabetic|low_sodium|nut_free|shellfish_free — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fulfillment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from operational staff regarding the fulfillment of this preference, including reasons for non-fulfillment, substitutions made, or special circumstances. Supports service recovery workflows and guest history documentation.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Operational status indicating whether this preference was fulfilled during the most recent stay. 'pending' = not yet actioned; 'fulfilled' = successfully delivered; 'partially_fulfilled' = partially met; 'not_available' = could not be accommodated (e.g., room type unavailable); 'waived' = guest waived the preference on arrival.

attributes.name: housekeeping_schedule_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preferred timing and frequency for housekeeping service. Communicated to the housekeeping management system to schedule room servicing. 'do_not_disturb' and 'checkout_only' options support sustainability programs and guest privacy preferences.

attributes.name: is_ada_requirement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Requirement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference represents an ADA-mandated accessibility accommodation (True), such as roll-in shower, hearing-accessible room, visual alert devices, or accessible room location. ADA requirements carry legal compliance obligations and must be fulfilled without substitution.

tag_set.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Requirement Flag

attributes.name: is_allergy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record represents a food or environmental allergy (True). Allergy records trigger mandatory F&B and housekeeping alerts and are subject to heightened fulfillment controls per ISO 22000 food safety standards.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference is a hard requirement that must be fulfilled (True) or a soft preference that should be accommodated when possible (False). Mandatory preferences include ADA accessibility requirements, severe food allergies, and medically necessary accommodations.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preferred language for communications, in-room materials, and staff interactions. Stored as BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es', 'zh-CN', 'de'). Used to personalize pre-arrival communications, in-room collateral, and staff greeting protocols.

attributes.name: last_confirmed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest most recently confirmed this preference remains accurate and current. Used to identify stale preferences that may need re-validation during pre-arrival contact or check-in. Supports GDPR data accuracy principle.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_capture
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program tier at the time this preference was captured (e.g., 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum', 'Diamond'). Provides context for preference prioritization and fulfillment SLA — higher-tier guests may receive elevated preference fulfillment commitments.

attributes.name: newspaper_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preferred newspaper or publication for complimentary delivery (e.g., 'The Wall Street Journal', 'The New York Times', 'Financial Times', 'USA Today', 'local paper'). Used by front desk and concierge for pre-arrival preparation and morning delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: pillow_type_preference
attributes.description: Guest's stated preference for pillow type and firmness. Sourced from OPERA PMS guest profile and communicated to housekeeping for pre-arrival room preparation. Hypoallergenic pillow requests may overlap with allergy flags. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: firm|soft|medium|feather|hypoallergenic|foam|no_preference — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the preference record. 'active' indicates the preference is valid and should be honored; 'inactive' indicates it has been withdrawn or expired; 'pending_verification' indicates it requires staff confirmation; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by a newer preference record.

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: Specific type of preference within the category (e.g., 'floor_level', 'bed_type', 'smoking_status', 'view_type', 'pillow_firmness', 'dietary_restriction', 'allergy', 'newspaper_title', 'housekeeping_time', 'room_temperature'). Provides granular classification for operational fulfillment and personalization analytics.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the relative importance of this preference when multiple preferences of the same type exist for a guest. Lower values indicate higher priority (1 = highest). Used by pre-arrival preparation workflows to resolve conflicts.

attributes.name: room_floor_preference
attributes.description: Guest's stated preference for the floor level of their room assignment. Used by front desk and room assignment workflows in OPERA PMS to optimize room allocation during check-in and pre-arrival room blocking.

attributes.name: room_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Guest's preferred room temperature setting in degrees Celsius. Used for pre-arrival room preparation and smart room automation where available. Stored in Celsius for standardization; display conversion to Fahrenheit handled at the presentation layer.

attributes.name: smoking_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preference for smoking or non-smoking room designation. Critical for room assignment compliance and property policy adherence. Most properties are entirely non-smoking; this field captures exceptions and guest-stated preferences for reporting.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Indicates how the preference was captured: 'stated' (guest explicitly requested), 'inferred' (derived from stay history patterns), 'observed' (noted by staff during stay), 'crm_imported' (sourced from Salesforce CRM), 'loyalty_profile' (from loyalty program record), 'survey' (from Medallia feedback), 'service_recovery' (captured during a service recovery interaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stated|inferred|observed|crm_imported|loyalty_profile|survey|service_recovery — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this preference record in the originating source system (e.g., OPERA PMS preference record ID, Salesforce CRM preference object ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this preference record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which this preference record expires and should no longer be honored. Null indicates the preference is open-ended with no expiry. Supports GDPR data minimisation requirements by enabling automatic expiry of time-limited preferences.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The stated or inferred value of the preference (e.g., 'high floor', 'king bed', 'non-smoking', 'ocean view', 'firm pillow', 'vegetarian', 'gluten-free', 'The Wall Street Journal', 'do not disturb before 10am', '72°F'). Free-form string to accommodate the wide variety of preference types.

attributes.name: view_type_preference
attributes.description: Guest's stated preference for the type of view from their room. Used during room assignment and pre-arrival blocking to enhance guest satisfaction. Supports upsell workflows when preferred view type is available at a premium. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ocean|pool|garden|city|mountain|courtyard|no_preference — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this preference record is effective and should be honored during guest stays. Supports time-bound preferences (e.g., a temporary dietary restriction during a medical recovery period) and preference versioning.

products.name: corporate_account
products.description: Corporate client account master representing companies and organizations that negotiate rates and manage employee travel programs with the hotel group. Captures company name, industry classification (SIC/NAICS), negotiated rate codes, credit terms, billing instructions, account manager assignment, annual room night production targets, contract validity periods, and preferred properties. Links to individual guest profiles via corporate affiliation for rate eligibility verification. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS AR module.
products.reference: OPERA PMS AR Account / Salesforce Account

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the corporate account record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_account. Business justification: Corporate accounts often have both transient room business (guest domain) and MICE business (event domain). Account managers need unified view of total account revenue, consolidated billing, and integ

attributes.name: account_manager_email
attributes.description: Internal email address of the hotel group's account manager assigned to this corporate account. Used for escalation routing, contract renewal notifications, and CRM workflow automation.

attributes.name: account_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the hotel group's internal account manager or sales manager responsible for managing the corporate relationship, contract renewals, and production performance.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the corporate account. Controls rate eligibility, direct billing access, and CRM engagement workflows. Active accounts are eligible for negotiated rates and direct billing.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the corporate account by the nature of the client relationship. Drives rate eligibility, billing rules, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|government|consortium|travel_management_company|wholesale|other — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target
attributes.description: Target total revenue (rooms, Food and Beverage (F&B), events) expected from this corporate account in the contract year. Used for account manager performance tracking and revenue budget planning per USALI standards.

attributes.name: annual_room_night_target
attributes.description: Contracted or projected annual room night volume committed by the corporate client. Used for account tiering, rate negotiation leverage, and production performance tracking against actuals.

attributes.name: billing_address_city
attributes.description: City component of the corporate client's billing address. Used for invoice generation, tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic segmentation reporting.

attributes.name: billing_address_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the corporate client's billing address. Drives tax treatment, currency defaults, and regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR for EU entities).

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the corporate client's official billing address used for invoice generation and accounts receivable correspondence in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: billing_instruction
attributes.description: Free-text billing instruction specifying which charges (room, tax, incidentals, F&B) are to be direct-billed to the corporate account versus charged to the individual guest. Applied automatically at check-in in OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: blackout_dates_policy
attributes.description: Description or reference code for blackout date restrictions applicable to this corporate account's negotiated rates. Specifies periods (e.g., peak demand, special events) when contracted rates are not available.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the corporate client organization as it appears on contracts, invoices, and billing documents.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the negotiated rate agreement and corporate account contract expires. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Rate eligibility ceases after this date unless renewed.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the negotiated rate agreement and corporate account contract becomes effective. Reservations made on or after this date are eligible for contracted rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the corporate account record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit and billing amounts are denominated for this corporate account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance permitted on the corporate account's direct billing (city ledger) facility in the OPERA AR module. Enforced at check-in and during reservation creation to prevent credit overexposure.

attributes.name: crm_account_reference
attributes.description: External account identifier from Salesforce CRM, used to cross-reference the corporate account record with the CRM system of record for guest profiles and marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: data_privacy_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corporate contact has provided consent for processing of their personal data in accordance with GDPR and CCPA requirements. Required for marketing communications and data sharing with third-party partners.

attributes.name: direct_billing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corporate account is approved for direct billing (city ledger) to the hotel group. When true, eligible charges are posted to the AR account rather than requiring individual guest payment at checkout.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount off the Best Available Rate (BAR) or rack rate granted to this corporate account under the negotiated agreement. Used by the Revenue Management System (RMS) for displacement analysis and yield optimization.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_subject_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Subject Region
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction applicable to the corporate contact's personal data. Determines which privacy regulations govern data handling, retention, and subject rights requests (GDPR for EU/UK, CCPA for California).

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Subject Region

attributes.name: industry_naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code providing a more granular industry classification for the corporate client, used alongside SIC for regulatory reporting, procurement analysis, and revenue segmentation.

tag_set.value: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code

attributes.name: industry_sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code identifying the primary industry sector of the corporate client. Used for market segmentation, demand analysis, and MICE opportunity targeting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the corporate account record in the source system. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: los_minimum_nights
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) requirement in nights applicable to this corporate account's negotiated rate. A value of 1 indicates no minimum stay restriction.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual travelers booking under this corporate account are eligible to earn loyalty program points. Some negotiated rate codes exclude loyalty accrual per program terms.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment code assigned to this corporate account in the Revenue Management System (RMS) and PMS. Used for STR benchmarking, RevPAR analysis, and demand forecasting segmentation (e.g., CORP, GOVT, CONSOR).

attributes.name: mice_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corporate account is eligible for MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) group rates and event space allocations managed through Delphi by Amadeus.

tag_set.value: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: negotiated_rate_code
attributes.description: Primary negotiated rate code assigned to this corporate account in the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS). Used for Best Available Rate (BAR) eligibility verification and rate distribution across channels. Natural key normalized; resolve via revenue.rate_plan reference.

attributes.name: opera_ar_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle OPERA Accounts Receivable (AR) Account Number
attributes.description: Accounts Receivable account number assigned in Oracle OPERA PMS AR module, used for direct billing, city ledger management, and credit limit enforcement at the property level.

tag_set.value: Oracle OPERA Accounts Receivable (AR) Account Number

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment terms for direct billing invoices issued to this corporate account. Determines invoice due dates and triggers accounts receivable aging in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: preferred_property_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hotel property codes (from OPERA PMS) designated as preferred properties for this corporate account. Drives rate availability, inventory allocation, and channel distribution priority.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary corporate contact. Used for contract communications, rate confirmations, and program updates. Subject to GDPR and CCPA data subject rights.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary travel coordinator or procurement contact at the corporate client organization responsible for managing the hotel program and employee travel bookings.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary corporate contact. Used for urgent communications regarding reservations, billing disputes, and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_program_type
attributes.description: Type of negotiated rate program governing this corporate account. LRA (Last Room Availability) guarantees rate access even at high occupancy. NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) offers deeper discounts with cancellation restrictions. Drives Revenue Management System (RMS) displacement analysis.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_status
attributes.description: Tax exemption classification for this corporate account. Government and qualifying non-profit accounts may be fully or partially exempt from occupancy and sales taxes. Drives tax posting rules in OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate
attributes.description: Official tax exemption certificate number issued by the relevant tax authority for this corporate account. Required for audit compliance when applying tax-exempt billing. Stored for SOX and USALI audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Doing-business-as (DBA) or brand name of the corporate client if different from the legal registered company name. Used for correspondence and guest-facing communications.

attributes.name: vip_tier
attributes.description: VIP tier classification assigned to this corporate account based on production volume, strategic importance, and revenue contribution. Drives service recovery priority, amenity entitlements, and account manager assignment level.

products.name: guest_group_block
products.description: Single source of truth is reservation.reservation_group_block. Group guest block master representing organized group travel parties (tour groups, corporate meetings, wedding parties, sports teams, airline crew). Captures group name, group type classification, group leader/contact profile reference, contracted room block size, pickup rate tracking, group code, cut-off date, billing master folio instructions, rooming list status, group coordinator assignment, and wash/attrition percentage thresholds. Distinct from MICE event management in the event domain — this focuses on room block allocation, guest-facing group identity, and rooming list management. Sourced from OPERA PMS Group Blocks and Delphi/Salesforce. SSOT: defers to reservation.reservation_group_block (MVM).reservation_group_block as single source of truth]event_group_block. [SSOT:group_block] Domain-specific specialization of the 'group_block' concept; canonical SSOT owner is event.event_group_block. SSOT: defers to canonical reservation.reservation_group_block (MVM cross-domain dedup).

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guest group block record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a contracted room block allocation binding the property to a group organizer for a defined stay window.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Group blocks are frequently generated by marketing campaigns (wedding packages, conference promotions, corporate incentive programs). Group sales teams track campaign attribution for ROI measurement,

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounts receivable (AR) master account or corporate billing account to which the group master folio charges are posted. Sourced from OPERA PMS AR module.

attributes.name: group_leader_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile of the primary group leader or organizer responsible for the block. Sourced from OPERA PMS guest profile or Salesforce CRM contact.

attributes.name: primary_guest_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal hotel employee or sales coordinator assigned to manage this group block from the property side.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which the group room block is contracted. Links to the property master in the property domain.

attributes.name: accessible_rooms_requested
attributes.description: Number of ADA-compliant accessible rooms requested within the group block. Tracked for ADA compliance and pre-assignment planning.

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: The first date of the contracted room block period — the date the group is scheduled to begin checking in. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this agreement.

attributes.name: attrition_pct
attributes.description: Contractual minimum pickup percentage the group must achieve to avoid attrition penalties. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 80.00 means the group must pick up at least 80% of contracted rooms). Aligns with revenue.wash_factor domain.

attributes.name: billing_master_folio_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions governing how charges are routed and settled for the group block master folio (e.g., 'Room and tax to master; incidentals to individual guest folio', 'All F&B charges to master account'). Sourced from OPERA PMS cashiering module.

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the group room block. 'Tentative' indicates a hold pending contract execution; 'Definite' indicates a signed/confirmed block; 'Cancelled' indicates the block was released; 'Closed' indicates the group has departed and the block is reconciled. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group block was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active or closed blocks. Used for attrition penalty calculation and revenue recovery tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation and penalty policy applicable to this group block contract. Governs financial penalties if the group cancels after the cutoff date.

attributes.name: complimentary_rooms_contracted
attributes.description: Number of complimentary (comp) rooms included in the group block contract, typically awarded on a ratio basis (e.g., 1 comp per 40 paid rooms). Tracked separately for revenue accounting under USALI.

attributes.name: contracted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group block contract was formally executed and the block status moved to 'Definite'. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the agreement lifecycle.

attributes.name: contracted_rate_amount
attributes.description: Negotiated room rate per night per room agreed in the group block contract. Expressed in the property's operating currency. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: contracted_room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights committed in the group block contract across all room types and all nights of the block period. Primary quantitative measure of block size.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the group block record was first created in the source system (OPERA PMS or Delphi). Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this group block record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which individual reservations must be made against the block at the contracted group rate. Rooms not picked up by this date are released back to general inventory per the attrition policy.

attributes.name: delphi_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Delphi by Amadeus event sales platform linking this group block to the originating sales opportunity or group proposal. Enables cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The last date of the contracted room block period — the date the group is scheduled to check out. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this agreement.

attributes.name: deposit_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group deposit must be received to maintain the block in 'Definite' status.

attributes.name: deposit_received_amount
attributes.description: Actual deposit amount received from the group organizer to date. Compared against deposit_required_amount to determine outstanding deposit balance.

attributes.name: deposit_required_amount
attributes.description: Contractual deposit amount required from the group to confirm the block. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code used to identify the group block across systems (OPERA PMS, CRS, OTA channels). Used by guests and agents to associate individual reservations to the block. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the group (e.g., 'Smith Wedding Party', 'Acme Corp Q3 Sales Conference', 'Chicago Bulls Away Team'). Displayed on folios, rooming lists, and internal reports.

attributes.name: group_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and special instructions for the group block (e.g., VIP handling requirements, early check-in requests, amenity preferences, security arrangements). Sourced from OPERA PMS group block notes field.

attributes.name: group_rate_code
attributes.description: Rate plan code applied to individual reservations made under this group block. Links to the negotiated group rate in the revenue rate plan. Sourced from OPERA PMS and distributed via SynXis CRS. Natural key normalized; resolve via revenue.rate_plan reference. Denormalized natural key normalized via FK relationship.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the group travel party type. Drives billing rules, rate eligibility, and operational handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tour|corporate|wedding|sports_team|airline_crew|government|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the group block record in the source system. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Used for incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Revenue management market segment classification assigned to this group block (e.g., GRP-CORP, GRP-LEISURE, GRP-CREW). Used for USALI-compliant revenue reporting and STR benchmarking segmentation.

attributes.name: opera_block_reference
attributes.description: Native block identifier from Oracle OPERA PMS Group Blocks module. Used for reconciliation and lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.

attributes.name: peak_block_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms blocked on any single night within the group block period. Used for capacity planning, displacement analysis, and revenue management evaluation.

attributes.name: repeat_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group has stayed at the property in a prior year or period. Used for loyalty recognition, preferential rate negotiation, and retention analytics.

attributes.name: rooming_list_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the group organizer must submit the complete rooming list with individual guest names and room type preferences.

attributes.name: rooming_list_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rooming list submission for this group block. Tracks whether the group organizer has provided individual guest names and room assignments required for pre-arrival processing.

attributes.name: rooms_picked_up
attributes.description: Current count of individual reservations made against the group block (actual pickup). Compared against contracted_room_nights to calculate pickup rate and attrition exposure.

attributes.name: source_of_business_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the channel or origin through which the group business was sourced (e.g., direct sales, GDS, OTA, travel agent, repeat group). Used for channel contribution analysis.

attributes.name: suite_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of suite-category rooms included in the contracted block. Tracked separately from standard rooms for inventory management and upsell reporting.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this group block has been designated as VIP, triggering elevated service protocols, dedicated concierge assignment, and executive-level attention.

attributes.name: wash_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of contracted rooms expected to be released back to general inventory based on historical pickup patterns for this group type. Used by revenue management for net block sizing and forecasting.

products.name: vip_designation
products.description: VIP classification and designation records for high-value guests requiring elevated service protocols. Captures VIP level/tier (VIP1 through VIP5, Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, Board Member), designation reason (revenue threshold, corporate relationship, public figure status), assigned property host or butler, special handling instructions (amenity setup, GM greeting, airport transfer), amenity entitlements per tier, privacy flags (do-not-disturb, incognito check-in, no-photo policy), and designation validity period. One guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level + Celebrity at property level). Sourced from OPERA PMS VIP codes and Salesforce CRM. Drives pre-arrival preparation checklists, room assignment priority, upgrade eligibility, and service recovery escalation paths.

attributes.name: vip_designation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the vip_designation data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code assignments and Salesforce CRM VIP profile records.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account record when the VIP designation is granted based on a corporate relationship (e.g., key account executive, contracted corporate partner). Null for individual leisure VIP guests. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account object.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership record associated with this VIP guest. Links VIP designation entitlements with loyalty tier benefits to ensure non-duplication and correct benefit stacking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module.

attributes.name: primary_vip_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee record for the dedicated property host, butler, or guest relations manager assigned to personally manage this VIP guest's experience. Drives pre-arrival communication and on-property service coordination.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record for whom this VIP designation is assigned. Links to the master guest profile in the guest domain. A single guest may hold multiple concurrent VIP designations across brand and property levels.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this VIP designation applies. A designation may be property-specific (e.g., Celebrity at a single resort) or brand-wide (null indicates brand-level designation). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.

attributes.name: tertiary_vip_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the senior leader (e.g., General Manager, Regional VP) who provided final approval for this VIP designation. May differ from designated_by_employee_id when a two-step approval workflow is required for high-tier designations.

attributes.name: airport_transfer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complimentary or arranged airport transfer service is required for this VIP guest as part of their designation entitlements. Triggers coordination with the concierge and transportation team during pre-arrival preparation.

attributes.name: alias_name
attributes.description: Pseudonym or alias name used for incognito check-in and reservation bookings to protect the identity of high-profile guests. Used in place of the guest's legal name on folios, room assignments, and staff communications when incognito_checkin is true.

attributes.name: amenity_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the amenity entitlement package associated with this VIP level. Determines the standard amenity setup (e.g., welcome fruit basket, champagne, floral arrangement, personalized stationery) to be prepared prior to guest arrival. Sourced from OPERA PMS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: concurrent_designation_count
attributes.description: Number of active VIP designations currently held by this guest across all scopes (brand and property level). Supports operational awareness that a guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level and Celebrity at property level) and ensures all applicable protocols are honored.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VIP designation record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.

attributes.name: designation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this VIP designation record, as assigned in Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code table (e.g., VIP1, VIP3, CELEB, ROYAL, OWNER). Used for cross-system reference and pre-arrival checklist triggers.

attributes.name: designation_notes
attributes.description: Internal narrative notes providing additional context about the VIP designation, such as the relationship history, specific events that triggered the designation, or instructions for the guest relations team. Visible only to authorized staff. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes.

attributes.name: designation_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for granting the VIP designation. Revenue threshold indicates the guest meets a minimum annual spend threshold. Corporate relationship indicates a key account or contracted corporate partner. Public figure, diplomatic, and celebrity reasons trigger additional privacy protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_threshold|corporate_relationship|public_figure|loyalty_elite|owner|board_member|celebrity|diplomatic|media|government — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: designation_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VIP designation applies across the entire brand portfolio, is restricted to a specific property, or applies to a regional cluster of properties. Drives which properties must honor the designation during pre-arrival preparation.

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VIP designation record. Active designations drive pre-arrival checklists and upgrade eligibility. Suspended designations are temporarily paused. Revoked designations have been withdrawn due to policy violation or relationship change.

attributes.name: do_not_disturb
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has a standing do-not-disturb preference that must be honored by housekeeping, engineering, and all operational departments unless a safety emergency arises. Overrides standard housekeeping scheduling in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation becomes active and service protocols are triggered. Used to schedule pre-arrival preparation and amenity entitlements. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity start date.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation expires and service protocols are deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended designation with no planned expiry. Annual review cycles typically reset this date. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity end date.

attributes.name: gm_greeting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the General Manager (GM) or designated senior property leader is required to personally greet this VIP guest upon arrival. Triggers a GM greeting task in the pre-arrival preparation checklist within Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: incognito_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest requires a discreet, incognito check-in process to protect their identity and privacy. When true, the front desk must use a private check-in area, suppress the guest name from public-facing displays, and limit staff awareness of the guest's presence. Critical for celebrity and diplomatic guests.

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the guest's most recent completed stay at any property under this VIP designation's scope. Used during annual VIP review cycles to assess continued eligibility based on recency of engagement. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS reservation history.

attributes.name: media_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates that all media inquiries, press requests, and social media references related to this guest's stay must be suppressed and escalated to the Director of Communications. Distinct from no_photo_policy as it governs external communications rather than on-property photography.

attributes.name: no_photo_policy
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly prohibited photography, video recording, or any visual documentation of their presence on property. Staff must be briefed on this restriction during pre-arrival preparation. Applies to celebrity, royalty, and diplomatic designations.

attributes.name: pre_arrival_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code identifying the standardized pre-arrival preparation checklist template to be activated for this VIP designation. Templates define the sequence of tasks (amenity setup, room inspection, GM briefing, transportation coordination) required before the guest's arrival.

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue contribution (in USD) that qualified this guest for the VIP designation based on the revenue threshold reason. Used for annual VIP eligibility reviews and LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis. Sourced from OPERA PMS revenue history and SAP S/4HANA financial records.

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue_threshold_amount field. Ensures correct currency context for multi-currency properties and international guests. Defaults to USD for US-based properties.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this VIP designation to confirm continued eligibility based on revenue thresholds, relationship status, or public figure standing. Supports annual VIP audit processes managed by the guest relations team.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a VIP designation was revoked or suspended. Populated only when designation_status is revoked or suspended. Supports audit trail requirements and VIP eligibility governance reviews. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case closure reason.

attributes.name: room_assignment_priority
