attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (lower value = higher priority) used by the front desk and revenue management systems to sequence room assignment and upgrade eligibility for this VIP guest relative to other arriving guests. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: security_escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated security escort or personal protection detail coordination is required for this VIP guest during their stay. Triggers security briefing and coordination protocols with the property security team and any external protection services.

attributes.name: service_recovery_escalation_level
attributes.description: Defines the escalation path and response urgency for service recovery incidents involving this VIP guest. Immediate_gm requires the General Manager to be notified within minutes of any complaint. Drives Medallia case routing and Salesforce CRM service recovery workflows.

attributes.name: source_system_vip_code
attributes.description: The native VIP code or identifier as stored in the originating source system (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Retained for traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: special_handling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing bespoke service instructions specific to this VIP designation, such as preferred room temperature, dietary restrictions for amenity setup, security escort requirements, or specific staff interaction protocols. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes and OPERA PMS profile remarks.

attributes.name: total_stays_in_period
attributes.description: Count of completed stays by the guest within the current designation validity period (effective_from to effective_until). Used to validate continued VIP eligibility at review date and to support LTV (Lifetime Value) reporting. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS stay history.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Tracks changes to designation status, special handling instructions, privacy flags, or host assignments. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this VIP designation entitles the guest to complimentary room category upgrades subject to availability at check-in. When true, the front desk system surfaces upgrade options during the check-in workflow in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: vip_level
attributes.description: Tiered classification of the VIP designation indicating the service protocol level assigned to the guest. VIP1 is entry-level recognition; VIP5 is the highest standard tier. Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, and Board Member are special-class designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VIP1|VIP2|VIP3|VIP4|VIP5|Celebrity|Royalty|Owner|Board Member — promote to reference product]

products.name: stay_history
products.description: Consolidated historical record of all completed guest stays across all properties and brands. Captures arrival date, departure date, property, room type, room number, rate plan, ADR, total revenue (rooms + F&B + ancillary), LOS, number of guests, booking channel, and stay outcome (completed, early departure, extended). Sourced from OPERA PMS post-checkout records. Foundational for LTV calculation, segmentation, and personalization. Distinct from active reservations managed in the reservation domain. ADR (RevPAR lives in revenue domain) measure removed/renamed: prior definition divided room_revenue by occupied room nights which yields ADR not ADR (RevPAR lives in revenue domain); canonical ADR (RevPAR lives in revenue domain) is owned by the revenue domain. The ECM ADR (RevPAR lives in revenue domain) measure that divided room revenue by occupied room nights was actually ADR; it has been renamed/removed because true ADR (RevPAR lives in revenue domain) is owned by the revenue domain. RevPAR measure removed from guest metrics (was actually ADR = revenue / occupied room nights); canonical RevPAR lives in the revenue domain. Incorrect RevPAR measure removed; correct RevPAR lives in revenue domain.

attributes.name: stay_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each completed guest stay record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the stay_history data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS post-checkout records.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'corporate'. Links to negotiated rate agreements and corporate travel program tracking. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS accounts receivable module.

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group block associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'group'. Links to group contract, pickup tracking, and group revenue attribution. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS group module.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record representing the primary registered guest for this stay. Supports Lifetime Value (LTV) calculation, segmentation, and personalization across all properties.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the stay occurred. Enables property-level performance analytics including ADR, RevPAR, and OCC reporting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating reservation record from which this stay history was created upon checkout. Links stay history back to the reservation domain for full booking-to-stay traceability.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the stay, calculated as total room revenue divided by the number of occupied room nights. A primary KPI per USALI and STR STAR Report standards. Expressed in the property's local currency. Used for RevPAR computation and competitive benchmarking via STR. [v2 note: this is ADR not RevPAR; canonical RevPAR is in the revenue domain.]

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue
attributes.description: Total ancillary charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including spa, parking, laundry, telephone, and other non-room, non-F&B charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Contributes to TRevPAR and GOPPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked in to the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved arrival date in cases of early arrival or late arrival. Used as the principal business event date for stay analytics and STR benchmarking.

attributes.name: booking_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the distribution channel through which the reservation was originally made (e.g., direct_web, ota, gds, voice, walk_in, corporate_direct). Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel mapping. Used for channel contribution and OTA partnership analysis.

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reservation was originally created (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate booking lead time (days between booking_date and arrival_date), a key input for demand forecasting and pickup report analysis.

attributes.name: checkin_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the check-in process at the front desk or via mobile/digital check-in (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS front desk module. Used for operational SLA tracking and guest experience analytics.

attributes.name: checkout_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the checkout process (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Marks the point at which the stay record is finalized and posted to the stay history.

attributes.name: complimentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay was provided on a complimentary (no-charge) basis (True = complimentary; False = revenue-generating stay). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for USALI complimentary room reporting and GOP calculation.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric confirmation number assigned by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS) at time of booking. Used by guests and agents to reference the stay. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS or Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse, typically upon post-checkout processing from Oracle OPERA PMS (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this stay record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency properties and international financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked out of the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved departure date in cases of early departure or extended stay. Used in conjunction with arrival_date to compute Length of Stay (LOS).

attributes.name: do_not_disturb_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest activated Do Not Disturb (DND) status during the stay (True = DND activated at any point; False = DND not activated). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS housekeeping module. Used for housekeeping scheduling and guest preference analytics.

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total Food and Beverage (F&B) charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including restaurant, bar, room service, and minibar charges. Sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS. Contributes to TRevPAR calculation.

attributes.name: gss_score
attributes.description: Overall Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) for the stay as captured by Medallia post-stay survey, typically on a scale of 1-10 or 1-100 depending on survey instrument. Distinct from NPS; measures overall satisfaction rather than likelihood to recommend. Used for Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking (SALT) reporting.

attributes.name: guest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guest stay by traveler category. 'fit' (Free Independent Traveler) indicates leisure individual; 'corporate' indicates business traveler under a negotiated account; 'group' indicates part of a group block; 'crew' indicates airline or transport crew; 'complimentary' indicates no-charge stay. Drives segmentation and LTV modeling.

attributes.name: length_of_stay
attributes.description: The length of stay for stay history in the guest domain.

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Actual number of nights the guest stayed at the property, computed as departure_date minus arrival_date. A core metric for Average Length of Stay (ALOS) analysis, revenue management, and demand forecasting in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program membership number associated with the guest for this stay. Used to post loyalty points, track qualifying nights, and calculate tier status. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module. Subject to GDPR and CCPA privacy regulations.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the guest for this stay, based on the applicable earning rate for the rate plan, room type, and member tier. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management. Used for loyalty program liability accrual and member engagement analytics.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_stay
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program tier level at the time of the stay (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captured as a snapshot to preserve historical tier context for LTV analysis and personalization, independent of the guest's current tier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as tiers vary by brand]

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment classification assigned to the stay per USALI and STR reporting standards (e.g., transient, group, contract, wholesale). Used for Revenue Management System (RMS) demand forecasting and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the guest for this stay, on a scale of 0-10. Sourced from Medallia post-stay survey. Used for Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) tracking, service recovery identification, and experience analytics. Null if guest did not respond to survey.

attributes.name: num_adults
attributes.description: Count of adult guests (18 years and older) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for occupancy reporting, F&B revenue forecasting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: num_children
attributes.description: Count of child guests (under 18 years) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for family segment analytics, amenity planning, and F&B revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: original_arrival_date
attributes.description: The arrival date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to measure early arrival or late arrival deviations and to support wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: original_departure_date
attributes.description: The departure date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to identify early departure and extended stay patterns for demand forecasting and wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used to settle the guest folio at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Used for payment mix analysis and PCI DSS compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|cash|direct_bill|loyalty_points|bank_transfer|voucher|cryptocurrency — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualifying_nights
attributes.description: Number of nights from this stay that count toward the guest's loyalty program tier qualification. May differ from los_nights if the rate plan is non-qualifying (e.g., wholesale, complimentary). Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rate plan under which the stay was booked (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate negotiated, package). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. Critical for revenue management analysis and channel contribution reporting.

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Physical room number assigned to the guest for the duration of the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Supports housekeeping scheduling, maintenance tracking, and room-level revenue attribution.

attributes.name: room_revenue
attributes.description: Total room charges posted to the guest folio for the entire stay, excluding taxes, fees, and ancillary charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Core component of RevPAR and TRevPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the room type category occupied during the stay (e.g., KING, DBLQ, SUITE, DLXK). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS room inventory. Used for room type mix analysis, upsell tracking, and RevPAR decomposition. [v2 note: this is ADR not RevPAR; canonical RevPAR is in the revenue domain.]

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold recorded in the guest stay history.

attributes.name: service_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a service recovery action was initiated during or after this stay (True = service recovery case opened; False = no service recovery). Sourced from Medallia or Salesforce CRM case management. Used for Guest Recovery Rate (GRR) calculation and experience analytics.

attributes.name: stay_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the guest stay upon checkout processing. 'completed' indicates normal checkout on scheduled departure date; 'early_departure' indicates guest checked out before scheduled departure; 'extended' indicates stay was prolonged beyond original departure date; 'no_show' indicates reservation was not cancelled but guest never arrived; 'cancelled' indicates reservation was cancelled post-check-in processing.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the guest folio for the stay, including occupancy tax, VAT, city tax, and other applicable levies. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering. Required for IFRS/GAAP financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: total_folio_amount
attributes.description: Total amount charged to the guest folio for the entire stay, inclusive of room revenue, F&B revenue, ancillary revenue, and taxes. Represents the gross billing amount settled at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Captures post-checkout adjustments such as folio corrections, survey score updates, or loyalty point recalculations. Used for data lineage and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vip_code
attributes.description: VIP designation code assigned to the guest for this stay in Oracle OPERA PMS (e.g., VIP1, VIP2, VVIP, CELEB). Drives special handling, amenity delivery, and management attention protocols. Null if guest has no VIP designation.

products.name: note
products.description: Freeform and structured notes and alerts attached to guest profiles by property staff. Captures note type (preference, complaint, compliment, alert, trace), note text, authoring department, property scope (property-specific vs. chain-wide), expiry date, and priority flag. Sourced from OPERA PMS Guest Traces and Alerts. Enables cross-property service continuity and pre-arrival briefing. Distinct from formal service recovery cases managed in the experience domain.

attributes.name: note_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each guest note or alert record in the system. Primary key for the guest_note data product.

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Guest notes frequently reference event-related special requests, VIP event attendee handling instructions, or event-specific service recovery issues. Front desk, concierge, and event coordinators need

attributes.name: linked_case_service_case_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier to a formal service recovery case in Salesforce CRM or the experience domain, if this note escalated into a tracked case. Null if no formal case was raised. Provides cross-domain traceability between informal notes and formal service recovery.

attributes.name: primary_note_assigned_staff_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific staff member assigned to action or follow up on this note. Null if assigned to a department rather than an individual.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile to which this note is attached. Links the note to the unified guest identity record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this note was created. Used to determine property-specific vs. chain-wide scope of the note.

attributes.name: tertiary_note_resolved_by_staff_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who marked the note as resolved. Enables accountability and service recovery performance measurement.

attributes.name: action_date
attributes.description: The specific hotel business date on which the note action or trace is scheduled to be executed (e.g., the date a pre-arrival amenity should be placed). Distinct from expiry_date which governs visibility.

attributes.name: assigned_department
attributes.description: The department responsible for actioning this note. May differ from the authoring department (e.g., Front Desk authors a note assigned to Housekeeping). Drives departmental task routing in OPERA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front_desk|housekeeping|food_and_beverage|concierge|security|guest_relations|reservations|engineering|spa — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: authoring_department
attributes.description: The hotel department that created the note (e.g., Front Desk, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage, Concierge, Revenue Management, Security, Guest Relations). Used for departmental accountability and routing of action items. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front_desk|housekeeping|food_and_beverage|concierge|revenue_management|security|guest_relations|reservations|engineering — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: note_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer-grained grouping within a note type (e.g., Room Preference, Dietary Restriction, Billing Alert, VIP Protocol, Housekeeping Instruction, Security Alert). Sourced from OPERA trace/alert category codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_preference|dietary|billing|vip_protocol|housekeeping|security|loyalty|accessibility|transport — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the note record was first created in the system. Provides precise audit trail for note origination.

attributes.name: data_retention_category
attributes.description: Classification governing how long this note record must be retained per data governance policy. Standard follows default retention schedules; extended applies to VIP or legal-relevant notes; legal_hold prevents deletion during litigation; purge_eligible marks records ready for deletion.

attributes.name: display_on_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be automatically surfaced to front desk staff during the guest check-in process. True = display at check-in; False = do not auto-display. Supports pre-arrival briefing and service personalization.

attributes.name: display_on_checkout
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be surfaced to front desk staff during the guest check-out process. True = display at check-out; False = do not auto-display. Useful for billing alerts or follow-up actions at departure.

attributes.name: display_on_reservation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should be surfaced to reservations agents when a new booking is made for this guest. True = display during reservation creation; False = do not auto-display. Supports proactive service planning.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the note is no longer considered active or actionable. Null indicates the note has no expiry and remains permanently active. Used to auto-expire time-bound traces and alerts.

attributes.name: extracted_topics
attributes.description: The extracted topics for the note record in the guest domain.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided consent for this type of personal preference data to be stored and processed under GDPR Article 6. True = consent obtained; False = consent not obtained or withdrawn. Critical for EU/EEA guest data compliance.

attributes.name: guest_segment
attributes.description: The guest segment classification at the time the note was created. Free Independent Traveler (FIT), corporate, group, VIP, loyalty elite, or airline crew. Supports segment-specific service delivery and analytics.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note content is restricted to management-level staff only and should not be visible to all front-line employees. True = management-only visibility; False = visible to all authorized staff.

attributes.name: is_vip_alert
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note is specifically flagged as a VIP protocol alert requiring elevated service standards. True = VIP alert; False = standard note. Drives VIP pre-arrival briefing workflows.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the note text was authored (e.g., en, fr, de, zh-CN). Supports multilingual property operations and translation workflows.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the note was most recently updated by any staff member. Supports audit trail and change detection in the Silver layer ETL pipeline.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_number
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program membership number at the time the note was created. Captured denormalized to support loyalty-aware pre-arrival briefing and cross-property service continuity without requiring a join to the loyalty profile.

attributes.name: note_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the note was created, aligned to the hotel operational date (which may differ from the calendar date for overnight shifts). Used for daily operations reporting (DOR) and pre-arrival briefing.

attributes.name: note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the note. Active notes are visible and actionable; resolved notes have been actioned; expired notes have passed their expiry date; cancelled notes were voided by staff; pending notes are awaiting review or approval.

attributes.name: note_type
attributes.description: Classification of the note indicating its business purpose. Preference captures guest likes/dislikes; complaint records a service failure; compliment records positive feedback; alert flags an operational action required; trace is a time-bound task or follow-up; general is unclassified. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preference|complaint|compliment|alert|trace|general — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: opera_trace_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle OPERA PMS (Property Management System) Trace ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for the trace or alert record as assigned by Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for reconciliation and lineage tracing back to the operational system of record.

tag_set.value: Oracle OPERA PMS (Property Management System) Trace ID

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note is marked as high priority, requiring immediate staff attention or pre-arrival action. True = high priority; False = standard priority.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Graduated priority ranking of the note for staff triage and pre-arrival briefing. Critical notes require immediate escalation; high notes require same-day action; medium notes are addressed during the stay; low notes are informational.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note should automatically recur on every future stay for this guest (True) or is a one-time note (False). Supports persistent preference management for repeat guests.

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: Defines the frequency at which a recurring note is re-activated. Every_stay applies on each new reservation; annual applies once per calendar year; seasonal applies during defined seasonal periods; one_time applies only once. Null if recurrence_flag is False.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Freeform text describing the action taken to resolve or address the note. Captures what was done, by whom, and any follow-up required. Classified as confidential as it may contain sensitive guest interaction details.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the note was marked as resolved or actioned by staff. Null if the note has not yet been resolved. Supports service recovery tracking and staff performance analytics.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Defines whether the note is visible only at the originating property (property) or across all properties in the chain (chain). Chain-wide notes support cross-property service continuity for loyalty and VIP guests.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the note was originally captured (e.g., PMS front desk terminal, CRM, mobile app, web portal, voice call, email, in-person interaction). Supports omnichannel guest profile analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pms|crm|mobile_app|web|voice|email|in_person — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stay_date_context
attributes.description: The specific stay date or arrival date to which this note is contextually relevant. Used for time-bound notes that apply only during a particular stay window rather than the guest's entire profile history.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Full freeform text body of the note or alert as entered by property staff. Contains the detailed narrative, instruction, or observation. Classified as confidential as it may contain sensitive guest behavioral or preference information.

products.name: communication_consent

products.name: corporate_property_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between corporate_account and property. It captures property-specific negotiated rate agreements, billing arrangements, and room night commitments that exist only in the context of a specific corporate account contracting with a specific hotel property. Each record links one corporate account to one property with contract terms, performance targets, and payment arrangements that are negotiated and managed independently per property.. Existence Justification: Corporate accounts negotiate independent contracts with each property in the hotel portfolio. A national corporate account (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte) contracts with 50+ properties across the portfolio, and each property has contracts with dozens of local, regional, and national corporate accounts. Each contract is negotiated separately with property-specific rate codes, discount levels, room night targets, payment terms, and blackout dates. Sales teams manage these contracts property-by-property, and revenue management systems track pickup against contracted room nights per property.

products.name: group_function_space_booking
products.description: This association product represents the event booking relationship between guest group blocks and meeting spaces. It captures the operational assignment of specific function spaces to group events, including setup requirements, attendance guarantees, rental charges, and catering commitments. Each record links one guest group block to one meeting space for a specific event or function within the group's stay, enabling detailed function space inventory management and BEO (Banquet Event Order) execution.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, group blocks routinely reserve multiple meeting spaces for their events (e.g., a corporate conference books a ballroom for general sessions plus three breakout rooms and a boardroom for executive meetings). Simultaneously, high-demand meeting spaces like ballrooms host dozens of different group blocks throughout the year. Event coordinators actively manage these bookings in Delphi/OPERA with detailed function-specific data including setup type, timing, attendance guarantees, AV needs, and rental charges that belong to neither the group block nor the meeting space alone.

products.name: guest_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between a guest profile and a loyalty promotion. It captures the member's participation lifecycle in a specific promotional offer, including enrollment channel, progress toward qualifying criteria, completion status, and bonus award fulfillment. Each record links one guest profile to one promotion with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality loyalty programs, promotion enrollments represent a true many-to-many operational relationship. A single guest profile enrolls in multiple active promotions simultaneously (e.g., Double Points Summer, Stay 3 Get Bonus, Birthday Bonus), and each promotion has thousands of enrolled members. The business actively manages these enrollments as distinct entities, tracking enrollment-specific data such as progress toward qualifying criteria, completion status, and bonus award fulfillment that belongs neither to the profile nor the promotion alone.

Each record links one profile to one segment with assignment metadata including confidence scores, effective dates, assignment methods (rule-based vs ML-predicted), and reason codes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship.. Marketing teams actively manage these multi-segment memberships with assignment confidence scores, effective dates, assignment methods (rule-based vs ML-predicted), and reason codes. domains.name: reservation
domains.description: Core transactional domain managing the full booking lifecycle from inquiry through confirmation, modification, cancellation, and no-show management. Handles individual reservations, group blocks, and corporate bookings across all channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS). Tracks booking status, arrival/departure dates, room types, rate codes, special requests, and guarantee methods. Integrates with Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

products.name: reservation_booking
products.description: Core master record for an individual guest reservation across all booking channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS via Sabre SynXis). Captures the full booking lifecycle from inquiry through confirmation, modification, cancellation, and no-show. Stores arrival/departure dates, LOS (Length of Stay), room type requested, rate code, BAR/LRA/NRR rate plan, guarantee method, booking status, source channel, CRS confirmation number, OPERA PMS reservation ID, number of adults/children, and special request flags. products.name: booking_status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of all reservation lifecycle events including status transitions (Inquiry → Tentative → Confirmed → Modified → Cancelled → No-Show → Checked-In → Checked-Out) and all booking modifications. For status changes, captures previous status, new status, transition timestamp, triggering agent/system, and reason code. For modifications (the SSOT for all amendment records), captures amendment type (date change, room type upgrade/downgrade, rate plan switch, occupancy change, special request update), original values, new values, modification channel, modification timestamp, agent ID, and any associated rate difference or penalty fee. Enables lifecycle analytics, SLA compliance tracking, revenue impact analysis, dispute resolution, and guest service recovery workflows. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS status change and modification events.

products.name: cancellation
products.description: Transactional record capturing all reservation non-fulfillment events including guest cancellations, property-initiated cancellations, OTA-initiated cancellations, and no-show (non-arrival) events. For cancellations: records event date/time, reason code, applicable cancellation policy, penalty/fee amount, cancellation window evaluation, refund eligibility, and processing channel. For no-shows: records no-show date, no-show fee charged, guarantee method used for charge, automatic guarantee charge processing, and OTA chargeback eligibility. products.name: reservation_rate_plan

Includes BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate negotiated rates, package rates, and promotional rates. attributes.description: Number of days in advance that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Common for promotional and non-refundable rates (e.g., 7-day, 14-day, 21-day advance purchase). Null or 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement.

attributes.name: booking_window_end_days
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival when this rate plan is no longer available for booking. Used to close last-minute bookings for certain rate plans. Null indicates no end restriction.

attributes.name: booking_window_start_days
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival when this rate plan becomes available for booking. Used to control early booking windows for promotional rates. Null indicates no start restriction.

attributes.name: channel_corporate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through corporate direct billing channels. Requires corporate account setup and negotiated rate agreement.

attributes.name: channel_direct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through direct channels (property website, call center, front desk). True for most rate plans; false for channel-exclusive rates.

attributes.name: channel_gds_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through GDS channels (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, Worldspan). Typically used for corporate and travel agent bookings.

attributes.name: channel_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for group block bookings through MICE and event sales channels. Managed via Delphi by Amadeus for group inventory allocation.

attributes.name: channel_ota_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is available for booking through OTA channels (Expedia, Booking.com, etc.). Subject to rate parity agreements and channel management rules.

attributes.name: commission_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the room rate paid as commission to the booking channel or agent. Typically 10-25% for OTAs, 10% for travel agents. Null if commissionable_flag is false.

attributes.name: commissionable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings under this rate plan are eligible for travel agent or OTA commission. True for most OTA and GDS rates; false for net rates and direct promotional rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this rate plan should be displayed to guests and agents in the booking interface. Lower numbers appear first. Used to prioritize high-value or strategic rate plans.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this rate plan is no longer available for booking or stay dates. Nullable for evergreen rate plans like BAR. Used for promotional and seasonal rate plan expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this rate plan becomes available for booking and stay dates. Aligns with revenue management strategy and seasonal pricing windows.

attributes.name: guarantee_method
attributes.description: The method by which the reservation must be guaranteed. Credit card: hold on card; Deposit: partial payment required; Prepayment: full payment required; Direct bill: corporate account billing; None: no guarantee required.

attributes.name: guarantee_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment guarantee (credit card, deposit, or prepayment) is required at the time of booking for this rate plan. True for most rate plans; false for select corporate or group rates with direct billing arrangements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: loyalty_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stays booked under this rate plan are eligible for loyalty program points accrual and elite benefits. True for most direct and qualified rates; false for opaque and deeply discounted rates.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to base loyalty points earned for stays under this rate plan. Standard rates typically have 1.0x; promotional rates may have 0.5x or 2.0x multipliers. Null if loyalty_eligible_flag is false.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the market segment this rate plan targets. Examples: TRAN (transient), CORP (corporate), GROUP (group), LEISURE (leisure). Used for revenue reporting and STR benchmarking.

attributes.name: maximum_length_of_stay
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. Used to prevent long-stay bookings from blocking high-value short-stay demand. Null indicates no maximum restriction.

attributes.name: member_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is exclusively available to loyalty program members. True for member-exclusive rates; false for public rates.

attributes.name: minimum_length_of_stay
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a booking under this rate plan. Used for revenue optimization during high-demand periods. Null or 1 indicates no minimum restriction.

attributes.name: package_description

attributes.name: package_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan includes bundled amenities, services, or F&B components (e.g., breakfast included, spa credit, parking). True for package rates; false for room-only rates.

attributes.name: rate_plan_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the rate plan type for segmentation and reporting. Standard includes BAR and rack rates; corporate includes negotiated business rates; promotional includes limited-time offers; package includes bundled F&B or amenities; group includes MICE block rates; wholesale includes tour operator allotments; opaque includes non-branded OTA rates; member includes loyalty program rates; government includes public sector rates. attributes.name: rate_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the rate plan, including terms, conditions, restrictions, and benefits. Used for guest communication and agent training.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan displayed to guests and agents. Examples: Best Available Rate, Corporate Negotiated Rate, AAA Member Rate, Romance Package, Non-Refundable Rate.

attributes.name: rate_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate plan. Active: available for booking; Inactive: not available for new bookings; Suspended: temporarily disabled; Pending: awaiting approval or activation; Expired: past effective end date.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: deposit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total reservation value required as deposit when deposit_required is true. Value stored as decimal (e.g., 100.00 for full prepayment).

attributes.name: target_fulfillment_date

products.name: deposit_ledger
products.description: Transactional ledger tracking all advance deposits collected, applied, or refunded against a reservation. Records deposit amount, due date, payment method, payment reference, status (pending/received/applied/refunded/forfeited), and posting date. Supports pre-arrival cashiering, revenue recognition compliance (ASC 606), and guest folio reconciliation. Distinct from the finance domain's general ledger — this is the reservation-scoped deposit lifecycle record.

attributes.name: deposit_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the deposit ledger entry. Primary key for the deposit ledger transaction record.

attributes.name: ar_payment_id

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the booking channel through which the reservation and deposit were made. Supports channel performance analysis and commission tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the staff member who processed the deposit transaction. Supports audit trails and operational accountability.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Deposits post to specific GL accounts (advance deposits liability, forfeited deposits revenue). Required for nightly audit GL reconciliation, balance sheet accuracy, and SOX compliance for cash handli

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest who made the deposit payment. Links deposit to guest profile for reconciliation and loyalty tracking.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the reservation and deposit are recorded. Supports multi-property operations.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservation against which this deposit is recorded. Links the deposit to the booking lifecycle.

attributes.name: applied_to_folio_date
attributes.description: The date when the deposit was applied to the guest folio. Marks the transition from advance deposit liability to revenue or accounts receivable offset.

attributes.name: booking_source
attributes.description: The originating source of the reservation booking. Used for channel attribution, commission calculation, and marketing ROI analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|ota|gds|crs|corporate|group|travel_agent|wholesaler — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the cancellation policy governing deposit refund or forfeiture. Linked to rate plan and booking channel terms.

attributes.name: card_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card used for the deposit. Stored for guest reference and dispute resolution while maintaining PCI compliance.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The externally-known confirmation number for the reservation. Used for guest communication and deposit tracking across channels.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deposit ledger record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deposit amount. Supports multi-currency operations and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the deposit collected or due. Represents the base deposit amount before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: deposit_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the deposit payment is required. Used for payment reminders, cancellation policy enforcement, and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: deposit_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the deposit policy applied to this reservation. Determines deposit amount, due date, and cancellation terms.

attributes.name: deposit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deposit. Tracks progression from due through collection, application to folio, or refund/forfeiture.

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deposit based on its business purpose. Determines handling rules, refund policies, and revenue recognition treatment.

attributes.name: folio_number
attributes.description: The guest folio number to which this deposit was applied. Links deposit to final billing and checkout reconciliation.

attributes.name: forfeiture_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the deposit that was forfeited due to cancellation policy or no-show. Recognized as revenue per cancellation terms.

attributes.name: forfeiture_date
attributes.description: The date when the deposit was forfeited. Triggers revenue recognition and updates reservation status to cancelled or no-show.

attributes.name: forfeiture_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for deposit forfeiture. Used for policy compliance tracking, revenue analysis, and guest communication.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding the deposit transaction. Captures special circumstances, guest requests, or operational exceptions.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date when the deposit payment was actually received by the property. Critical for cash flow tracking and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value refunded to the guest if the deposit was returned. May differ from original deposit amount due to cancellation fees or partial refunds.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: The date when the deposit refund was processed. Used for cash flow tracking and guest satisfaction monitoring.

attributes.name: refund_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number for the refund transaction from the payment processor. Used for refund reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the deposit is recognized as revenue per ASC 606 guidelines. May differ from payment received date based on performance obligation fulfillment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deposit ledger record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.

products.name: travel_agent
products.description: Master record for travel agencies and travel management companies (TMCs) authorized to book on behalf of guests, including IATA/ARC number, agency name, agency type, commission rate, preferred payment method, GDS identifier, and active status. Manages the agency relationship for commission processing, booking attribution, and channel performance reporting. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS travel agent profile module.
products.reference: Oracle OPERA PMS Travel Agent Profile

attributes.name: travel_agent_id
attributes.description: Primary key for travel_agent

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_payment. Business justification: Links agent commission payments to travel agent records for payment tracking, dispute resolution, and commission expense reconciliation. Required for agent relationship management and accurate commiss

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the travel agency or travel management company (TMC). Primary human-readable identifier.

attributes.name: agency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the travel agency business model. Retail agencies serve individual travelers, corporate TMCs manage business travel programs, OTAs operate online platforms, tour operators package travel products, consortiums are agency networks, and wholesalers distribute bulk inventory.

attributes.name: arc_number
attributes.description: Seven or eight-digit ARC accreditation number for US-based travel agencies. Used for commission processing and booking attribution in the North American market.

attributes.name: booking_volume_tier
attributes.description: Tiered classification based on the travel agent's historical booking volume or revenue contribution. Higher tiers may receive preferential commission rates, priority support, or marketing benefits.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the travel agency is located.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Default commission percentage paid to the travel agent on qualifying bookings. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). May be overridden by specific rate plans or negotiated contracts.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the travel agency contact. Used for booking confirmations, commission statements, and operational notifications.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the travel agency for operational communication, booking inquiries, and relationship management.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the travel agency contact. Used for urgent booking issues, reservation modifications, and relationship management.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the travel agent contract expires or was terminated. Null for open-ended relationships. Used to enforce commission eligibility windows.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the travel agent relationship or contract became effective. Marks the beginning of the commission-earning period.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the travel agency's location (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this travel agent record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for the travel agent on direct bill or net remit payment terms. Expressed in the property's base currency. Used for credit risk management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for commission payments and credit limits (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: gds_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier or pseudo city code (PCC) assigned to the travel agent within the Global Distribution System (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo, Worldspan). Used to attribute bookings originating from GDS channels.

attributes.name: iata_number
attributes.description: Eight-digit IATA accreditation number assigned to the travel agency by the International Air Transport Association. Primary industry identifier for accredited travel agencies.

attributes.name: last_booking_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent reservation created by this travel agent. Used to identify inactive agents and trigger re-engagement campaigns.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, relationship history, or internal comments about the travel agent. Used by sales and reservations teams.

attributes.name: onboarding_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the travel agent completed all onboarding requirements (contract signing, profile setup, training, system access). Marks readiness to begin booking.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the travel agency's address.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the travel agent's preferred communication language (e.g., en, es, fr, de).

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: Default payment instrument used by the travel agent for booking guarantees and deposits. Credit card for immediate authorization, bank transfer for wire payments, check for paper payments, direct bill for invoiced accounts, virtual card for single-use card numbers, net remit for commission offset against payment.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the travel agency is located.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (TIN, EIN, VAT number) for the travel agency. Used for commission payment reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: total_bookings_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of all reservations created by this travel agent since relationship inception. Used for performance reporting and tier qualification.

attributes.name: total_revenue_generated
attributes.description: Cumulative room revenue generated by all bookings attributed to this travel agent since relationship inception. Expressed in the property's base currency. Used for tier qualification and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: travel_agent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the travel agent relationship. Active agents can make bookings and earn commissions. Inactive agents are temporarily disabled. Suspended agents are under review. Pending approval agents await onboarding completion. Terminated agents have ended their relationship. Blacklisted agents are permanently banned.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this travel agent record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this travel agent record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the travel agency. Used for agency verification and marketing partnership opportunities.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that created this travel agent record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: waitlist
products.description: Transactional record managing reservation waitlist entries when requested room types or dates are unavailable. Captures waitlist position, requested arrival/departure dates, requested room type, rate plan, guest priority (loyalty tier, corporate account), waitlist status (active, converted, expired, cancelled), and conversion timestamp if fulfilled. Supports inventory optimization and guest recovery when rooms become available through cancellations.

attributes.name: waitlist_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the waitlist entry. Primary key.

attributes.name: booking_source_id

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corporate account associated with this waitlist entry, if applicable. Used for priority handling of corporate bookings.

attributes.name: guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest profile requesting the waitlist entry.

attributes.name: primary_waitlist_converted_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property where the waitlist entry was created.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reservation that was converted from this waitlist entry, if applicable. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: tertiary_waitlist_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified the waitlist entry.

attributes.name: auto_convert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the system should automatically convert this waitlist entry to a confirmed reservation when inventory becomes available (True) or require manual confirmation (False).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason the waitlist entry was cancelled. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the waitlist entry was cancelled by the guest or system. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the booking channel through which the waitlist request was received (e.g., DIRECT, OTA, GDS, CRS).

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the guest for waitlist status notifications and conversion opportunities.

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: converted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the waitlist entry was converted to a confirmed reservation. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the waitlist entry was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the quoted rate amount.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the waitlist entry will automatically expire if not converted. Typically set to the requested arrival date or a configured number of days after creation.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External identifier from the originating system or channel, used for cross-system reconciliation and tracking.

attributes.name: guarantee_type_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the guarantee method provided by the guest for the waitlisted reservation.

attributes.name: guest_priority_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty tier or priority classification of the guest, used to determine waitlist position and conversion priority.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the market segment classification for this waitlist entry (e.g., LEISURE, CORPORATE, GROUP).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the waitlist entry was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal staff notes regarding the waitlist entry, conversion attempts, or guest communication history.

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Guest's preferred method for receiving waitlist status updates and conversion notifications.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Numeric position of this entry in the waitlist queue for the requested room type and dates. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: quoted_rate_amount
attributes.description: The room rate amount quoted to the guest at the time of waitlist creation, in the property's base currency.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rate plan the guest requested for the waitlisted reservation (e.g., BAR, CORP, AAA).

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason the guest was placed on the waitlist rather than confirmed immediately.

attributes.name: requested_arrival_date
attributes.description: The arrival date requested by the guest for the waitlisted reservation.

attributes.name: requested_departure_date
attributes.description: The departure date requested by the guest for the waitlisted reservation.

attributes.name: requested_nights
attributes.description: Number of nights requested by the guest, calculated as departure date minus arrival date.

attributes.name: requested_room_count
attributes.description: Number of rooms requested by the guest on the waitlist.

attributes.name: requested_room_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the room type requested by the guest (e.g., KING, SUITE, DELUXE).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that originated this waitlist entry.

attributes.name: special_requests
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special requests or preferences noted by the guest at the time of waitlist creation (e.g., high floor, near elevator, accessible room).

attributes.name: waitlist_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the waitlist entry, typically formatted as WL followed by numeric sequence.

attributes.name: waitlist_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the waitlist entry. Active indicates the guest is still waiting; converted means a reservation was created; expired means the requested dates have passed; cancelled means the guest withdrew; fulfilled means inventory was allocated.

products.name: room_assignment

products.name: booking_package

products.name: program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a guest reservation and a wellness program. It captures the guest's participation in structured multi-day wellness programs, including medical clearances, dietary customizations, program scheduling, and completion tracking. Each record links one reservation to one wellness program with enrollment-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In resort and destination spa operations, guests frequently enroll in multiple wellness programs during a single stay (e.g., a 7-night stay might include a 3-day detox program followed by a 2-day fitness bootcamp), and each wellness program cohort has multiple concurrent participants each with their own reservation. The enrollment itself is an actively managed business entity with program-specific data including medical clearances, dietary customizations, progress tracking, waitlist management, and completion status that belongs to neither the reservation nor the program master record alone.

products.name: group_spa_package_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between reservation_group_block and spa_package. It captures the negotiated spa package offerings included in group room blocks for events, corporate retreats, weddings, and conferences. Each record links one group block to one spa package with contracted pricing, advance booking requirements, billing arrangements, and coordinator details that exist only in the context of this group-specific spa offering.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, group blocks for weddings, corporate retreats, and conferences routinely contract multiple spa packages as part of their amenity offerings (bride/groom packages, team wellness sessions, VIP treatments). Simultaneously, popular spa packages are offered across multiple concurrent group blocks with different negotiated terms. The relationship represents an operational contract that sales coordinators actively create and manage, with group-specific pricing, booking deadlines, billing arrangements, and customization requirements that belong to neither the block definition nor the package catalog alone.
