attributes.business_glossary_term: Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS) Property ID
attributes.description: The property identifier assigned within Sabre SynXis CRS used for central reservations, channel management, and rate distribution. Required for reconciling CRS bookings to the property master record.

tag_set.value: Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS) Property ID

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier for the property's local time zone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Critical for accurate check-in/check-out timestamp processing, night audit scheduling, and revenue management rate activation timing.

attributes.name: total_floor_count
attributes.description: The total number of floors in the main hotel tower or building. Used for housekeeping scheduling, elevator capacity planning, and emergency evacuation planning per local fire safety and building codes.

attributes.name: total_meeting_space_sqft
attributes.description: The total square footage of all meeting, conference, and event spaces within the property. Key metric for MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) sales, group evaluation, and event revenue forecasting in Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.name: total_room_count
attributes.description: The total number of guest rooms and suites in the property inventory. This is the denominator for RevPAR, OCC (Occupancy Rate), and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) calculations. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS room inventory configuration.

attributes.name: total_suite_count
attributes.description: The number of suite-category rooms within the total room inventory. Used for premium inventory management, upsell strategy, and suite-specific RevPAR reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the property master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental load processing, and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the organizational and operational hierarchy of properties including corporate portfolio, regional divisions (e.g., Americas, EMEA, APAC), area offices, and property clusters. Captures parent-child relationships with hierarchy level, node name, node code, responsible executive, and effective date. Supports multi-property consolidated reporting with KPI roll-ups (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP) across geographic and organizational tiers. Aligned with STR geographic hierarchy and internal management reporting structures.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each node in the property organizational and operational hierarchy. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each hierarchy node reports in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent node in the hierarchy tree. Null for the corporate root node. Enables recursive parent-child traversal for consolidated reporting of RevPAR, ADR, OCC, and GOP across organizational tiers.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: A hierarchy node CAN represent a single property (leaf node) or a grouping (branch node). Link leaf nodes to their property master record. This FK will be nullable - branch nodes (regions, portfolios)

attributes.name: brand_portfolio
attributes.description: Name of the brand portfolio or brand family associated with this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Luxury Collection', 'Premium Brands', 'Select Service'). Applicable to division and region nodes that manage a specific brand segment. Supports brand-level performance reporting and portfolio analytics.

attributes.name: chain_scale
attributes.description: STR-defined chain scale classification for this hierarchy node, indicating the service and price tier of properties within this node. Used for competitive benchmarking, STR STAR Report alignment, and brand portfolio segmentation. Values align with STR's standard chain scale categories.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the geographic location of this hierarchy node (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP). Applicable primarily to property and cluster nodes. Used for regulatory compliance reporting, tax jurisdiction mapping, and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SOX compliance for financial reporting hierarchy changes.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this hierarchy node and its parent-child relationship became operationally effective. Used for point-in-time hierarchy reconstruction and historical reporting aligned with management reporting periods.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this hierarchy node or its parent-child relationship ceases to be effective. Null for currently active nodes. Supports temporal hierarchy versioning for historical consolidated reporting and audit compliance.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) indicating the start of the fiscal year for this hierarchy node. Supports USALI-aligned financial period reporting and SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant configuration for nodes that operate on non-calendar fiscal years.

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Chain code used to identify this portfolio or brand in Global Distribution Systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport. Applicable to corporate and brand-level hierarchy nodes. Supports channel distribution management and GDS booking analytics.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Major geographic region classification for this hierarchy node, aligned with STR geographic hierarchy and internal management reporting structures. Used for regional KPI roll-ups and competitive benchmarking via STR STAR Reports. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Americas|EMEA|APAC|GREATER_CHINA|MEA|EUROPE|NORTH_AMERICA|LATIN_AMERICA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_reporting_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is designated as a formal reporting node for consolidated KPI roll-ups (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP). True for nodes that appear in management reporting packages; False for intermediate structural nodes used only for hierarchy traversal.

attributes.name: is_str_market_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node corresponds to a defined STR competitive market for benchmarking purposes. True for nodes that are directly mapped to an STR market for RGI, MPI, and ARI reporting via STR STAR Reports.

attributes.name: kpi_rollup_method
attributes.description: Method used to aggregate KPIs (RevPAR, ADR, OCC, GOP) from child nodes to this parent node. 'sum' for absolute metrics (room revenue, GOP); 'weighted_average' for rate-based metrics (ADR, RevPAR) weighted by available rooms; 'simple_average' for index metrics; 'none' for leaf nodes with no children.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this node within the organizational hierarchy tree, starting at 1 for the corporate root. Enables efficient tree traversal, level-based filtering, and KPI aggregation at each tier (e.g., Level 1 = Corporate, Level 2 = Region, Level 3 = Division, Level 4 = Area Office, Level 5 = Cluster, Level 6 = Property).

attributes.name: management_type
attributes.description: Operational management structure classification for this hierarchy node. 'owned' indicates company-owned assets; 'managed' indicates third-party owner with management contract; 'franchised' indicates franchise agreement; 'leased' indicates leasehold arrangement; 'joint_venture' indicates shared ownership structure. Critical for financial consolidation and USALI reporting.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy node across systems (e.g., CRS, PMS, ERP). Used as the business key for cross-system integration and reporting roll-ups. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA profit center codes and Oracle OPERA PMS property codes.

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about this hierarchy node, including its geographic scope, strategic purpose, or operational characteristics. Used for documentation, onboarding, and BI tool tooltips.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node (e.g., 'Americas Region', 'EMEA Division', 'Southeast Asia Cluster', 'Grand Hyatt New York'). Used in management reporting, dashboards, and consolidated KPI roll-ups.

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy node. 'active' indicates the node is operational and included in reporting; 'inactive' indicates it has been decommissioned; 'pending' indicates a newly created node awaiting activation; 'dissolved' indicates a node that has been merged or restructured out of the hierarchy.

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy node indicating its organizational level. 'corporate' is the top-level portfolio node; 'region' represents major geographic divisions (Americas, EMEA, APAC); 'division' is a sub-regional grouping; 'area_office' is a local management unit; 'cluster' is a grouping of nearby properties; 'property' is an individual hotel or resort asset.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Materialized full path string from the root node to this node using delimiter-separated node codes (e.g., 'CORP/AMER/USEAST/NYC-CLUSTER'). Enables efficient subtree queries and breadcrumb navigation in BI tools without recursive joins.

attributes.name: property_count
attributes.description: Number of individual property assets directly or indirectly under this hierarchy node. Maintained as a denormalized count for reporting efficiency. Applicable to corporate, region, division, area office, and cluster nodes. Used in portfolio-level KPI reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: reporting_segment_code
attributes.description: Internal financial reporting segment code assigned to this hierarchy node, aligned with SAP S/4HANA profit center and segment reporting structures. Used for USALI-compliant financial consolidation, EBITDA and NOI reporting, and SOX-compliant segment disclosures.

attributes.name: responsible_executive
attributes.description: Name of the senior executive accountable for this hierarchy node (e.g., Regional Vice President, Area General Manager, General Manager). Used for management reporting accountability, escalation routing, and organizational governance.

attributes.name: responsible_executive_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the executive accountable for this hierarchy node. Used for automated reporting distribution, escalation notifications, and governance communications.

attributes.name: responsible_executive_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the executive accountable for this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Senior Vice President - Americas', 'Area General Manager - Southeast Asia'). Supports organizational chart generation and governance documentation.

attributes.name: restructure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for any hierarchy restructuring event affecting this node (e.g., regional reorganization, brand portfolio realignment, merger, acquisition, or divestiture). Supports audit trail and change management documentation.

attributes.name: sap_profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA profit center code mapped to this hierarchy node for financial consolidation, USALI-aligned P&L reporting, and management accounting. Enables direct linkage between the property hierarchy and SAP financial reporting structures for EBITDA, NOI, and GOPPAR analysis.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display order for this node among its siblings within the same parent node. Controls the sequence in which nodes appear in management reports, dashboards, and organizational charts. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: str_geographic_code
attributes.description: STR-assigned geographic market code for this hierarchy node, used to align internal organizational hierarchy with STR competitive benchmarking markets. Enables direct mapping to STR STAR Report data for Revenue Generation Index (RGI), Market Penetration Index (MPI), and Average Rate Index (ARI) benchmarking.

attributes.name: str_market_name
attributes.description: Human-readable STR market name corresponding to the STR geographic code (e.g., 'New York City', 'London', 'Singapore'). Used in competitive benchmarking reports and STR STAR Report alignment for RevPAR and ADR market comparisons.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the primary geographic location of this hierarchy node (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Singapore'). Used for scheduling, reporting period alignment, and operational communications across multi-property portfolios.

attributes.name: total_room_count
attributes.description: Aggregate number of guestrooms across all properties under this hierarchy node. Used for portfolio-level RevPAR and OCC calculations, capacity planning, and STR competitive set benchmarking. Maintained as a denormalized aggregate for reporting performance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this hierarchy node record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this hierarchy node record, incremented each time the node's attributes or parent-child relationship is modified. Supports temporal versioning, audit compliance, and point-in-time hierarchy reconstruction for historical reporting.

products.name: property_facility
products.description: Catalog of physical facilities and amenities available at each property, including pools, spas, fitness centers, business centers, parking structures, restaurants, bars, meeting spaces, and recreational areas. Captures facility name, facility type, capacity, operating hours, accessibility (ADA compliance), seasonal availability, renovation status, and associated outlet codes. Supports guest-facing amenity display and operational scheduling.

attributes.name: property_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical facility or amenity record within the property domain. Primary key for the facility data product.

attributes.name: cleaning_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to housekeeping.cleaning_standard. Business justification: Facilities (pools, spas, fitness centers) require specific cleaning protocols defined by brand standards. Operations managers assign cleaning standards to facilities to ensure compliance with health c

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Facilities (pools, fitness centers, spas) are cost centers for expense allocation in USALI. Real operations track maintenance, utilities, and labor costs by facility for departmental profitability ana

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each facility usage fee is denominated in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Facilities (pools, spas, fitness centers) operate as distinct organizational units with dedicated staff, labor budgets, and scheduling. Required for labor cost allocation, productivity tracking, and o

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent property at which this facility is located. Links the facility to its owning hotel or resort asset in the property master.

attributes.name: property_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property_outlet. Business justification: A facility CAN be associated with a revenue-generating outlet (e.g., restaurant facility linked to restaurant outlet). This FK will be nullable - not all facilities are outlets (e.g., pool, gym). Remo

attributes.name: ada_features
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Accessibility Features
attributes.description: Descriptive text listing specific ADA-compliant accessibility features available at the facility (e.g., 'Wheelchair ramp, pool lift, accessible restroom, braille signage'). Supports guest accessibility requests and ADA compliance audit documentation.

tag_set.value: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Accessibility Features

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age-based access restriction for the facility. Adults_only applies to facilities such as adult pools, bars, and certain spa areas; minimum_age values apply to facilities with safety or legal age requirements. Used for guest communication, liability management, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: area_sqft
attributes.description: Total floor area of the facility measured in square feet. Used for event space marketing, FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) planning, CapEx budgeting, and PIP documentation. Meeting and event spaces use this for per-square-foot revenue analysis.

attributes.name: av_equipment_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether built-in audio-visual equipment (projectors, screens, microphones, video conferencing systems) is available in the facility. Primarily relevant for meeting rooms, ballrooms, and business centers. Used in MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) event sales and BEO configuration.

attributes.name: building_wing
attributes.description: Named wing, tower, or zone of the property building where the facility is physically located (e.g., 'North Tower', 'Pool Deck', 'Conference Level'). Supports wayfinding, housekeeping scheduling, and multi-building resort navigation.

attributes.name: capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests or persons the facility can accommodate simultaneously under normal operating conditions. For meeting rooms this is the maximum seating capacity; for pools it is the maximum bather load; for restaurants it is the total cover count. Used in event sales, operational scheduling, and safety compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the facility record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance with SOX financial controls and GDPR data management requirements.

attributes.name: property_facility_description
attributes.description: Long-form marketing and operational description of the facility for use in guest-facing channels, OTA listings, and property websites. Describes the facility's features, ambiance, services offered, and unique selling points. Managed in Sabre SynXis CRS for channel distribution.

attributes.name: dress_code
attributes.description: Required dress code for guests accessing the facility. Relevant for restaurants, bars, spas, and pool areas. Used in guest-facing amenity descriptions and front desk communication to set expectations and enforce property standards.

attributes.name: facility_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the facility into a business category for reporting and guest-facing amenity segmentation. Recreation covers pools, gyms, and sports; food_beverage covers restaurants and bars; meetings_events covers ballrooms and conference rooms; wellness covers spas and health centers; business_services covers business centers; transportation covers parking and valet. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recreation|food_beverage|meetings_events|wellness|business_services|transportation|retail|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the facility within the property management and channel distribution systems (e.g., POOL-01, SPA-MAIN, GYM-24H). Used in OTA feeds, PMS configuration, and guest-facing amenity display.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the facility as presented to guests and staff (e.g., 'Infinity Pool', 'The Serenity Spa', 'Grand Ballroom'). Used in guest-facing amenity listings, housekeeping schedules, and event coordination.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the facility by its primary function (e.g., pool, spa, fitness_center, restaurant, bar, meeting_room, ballroom, business_center, parking, recreational_area, retail_outlet). Drives amenity display grouping, operational scheduling, and ADA compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pool|spa|fitness_center|restaurant|bar|meeting_room|ballroom|business_center|parking|recreational_area|retail_outlet|lounge — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor level within the property building where the facility is located. Used for wayfinding, housekeeping zone assignment, and emergency evacuation planning. Negative values indicate below-grade levels (e.g., basement parking).

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent regulatory or safety inspection for this facility. Pass indicates full compliance; pass_with_conditions indicates compliance with minor corrective actions required; fail indicates non-compliance requiring closure or remediation; pending indicates inspection scheduled but not yet completed.

attributes.name: is_24_hour
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility operates continuously 24 hours per day without a defined closing time (e.g., fitness centers, parking structures, business centers). When True, operating_hours_open and operating_hours_close are informational only.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility meets ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility requirements including wheelchair access, accessible entrances, accessible restrooms, and assistive equipment. Critical for regulatory compliance reporting and guest accessibility communication.

tag_set.value: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliance Flag

attributes.name: is_fee_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility charges a separate usage fee beyond the room rate (e.g., resort fee, spa access fee, parking fee). When True, the associated outlet_code links to POS revenue tracking.

attributes.name: is_reservation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests must make a prior reservation to use the facility (e.g., spa treatment rooms, cabanas, private dining rooms). Drives guest-facing booking prompts and operational capacity management.

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is only available during specific seasons of the year (e.g., outdoor pools, ski facilities, beach clubs). When True, seasonal_open_date and seasonal_close_date define the operational window.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or safety inspection conducted for this facility (yyyy-MM-dd). Covers health department inspections for F&B outlets, pool safety inspections, fire safety checks, and ADA compliance audits. Supports regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility's operating license or permit (yyyy-MM-dd). Triggers renewal workflows to ensure continuous regulatory compliance. Critical for F&B outlets, spas, and pool facilities subject to periodic licensing.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued operating license or permit number for regulated facilities such as restaurants (food service license), bars (liquor license), spas (cosmetology license), and pools (health department permit). Required for regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: max_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Regulatory or operational maximum occupancy threshold expressed as a percentage of total capacity (e.g., 80.00 means 80% of capacity). Used for fire safety compliance, COVID-era capacity restrictions, and operational safety management.

attributes.name: natural_light
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has access to natural daylight through windows or skylights. A key selling attribute for meeting and event spaces, as natural light is a premium feature in MICE sales. Also relevant for wellness facilities and restaurants.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled regulatory or safety inspection for this facility (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for compliance calendar management and proactive maintenance scheduling to ensure facilities pass inspections without operational disruption.

attributes.name: operating_hours_close
attributes.description: Standard daily closing time of the facility in HH:MM (24-hour) format. For facilities operating past midnight, this may be 23:59 with a separate overnight flag. Used alongside operating_hours_open for guest-facing display and staffing.

attributes.name: operating_hours_open
attributes.description: Standard daily opening time of the facility in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used for guest-facing amenity display, operational staffing schedules, and housekeeping preparation windows. For 24-hour facilities, set to 00:00.

attributes.name: outdoor_indoor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is located indoors, outdoors, or in a semi-outdoor (covered but open-air) environment. Affects seasonal availability, weather contingency planning for events, and guest-facing amenity descriptions.

attributes.name: property_facility_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the facility indicating its operational availability. Active means fully operational; seasonal means available only during defined seasonal periods; under_renovation means temporarily closed for PIP (Property Improvement Plan) works; closed means permanently decommissioned; pending_opening means approved but not yet operational.

attributes.name: renovation_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual completion date of the most recent or current PIP (Property Improvement Plan) renovation for this facility (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for return-to-service planning, guest communication, and CapEx project closure.

attributes.name: renovation_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date of the most recent or current PIP (Property Improvement Plan) renovation for this facility (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for operational impact planning, guest communication, and CapEx project tracking in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: renovation_status
attributes.description: Current PIP (Property Improvement Plan) renovation status of the facility. Planned indicates approved but not yet started; in_progress indicates active construction or refurbishment; completed indicates renovation finished and facility returned to service. Supports CapEx tracking and operational impact planning.

attributes.name: seasonal_close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which a seasonal facility closes at the end of the season (yyyy-MM-dd). Applicable only when is_seasonal is True. Used for operational planning and guest communication regarding amenity availability.

attributes.name: seasonal_open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which a seasonal facility opens for the current or upcoming season (yyyy-MM-dd). Applicable only when is_seasonal is True. Used for operational planning, guest-facing amenity availability display, and housekeeping preparation scheduling.

attributes.name: seating_configuration
attributes.description: Default or primary seating arrangement style for the facility, particularly relevant for meeting rooms and event spaces. Theater style is rows facing a stage; banquet is round tables; boardroom is a single conference table. Used in BEO (Banquet Event Order) management and event sales in Delphi by Amadeus. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: theater|classroom|banquet|reception|boardroom|u_shape|cabaret|open_plan|not_applicable — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: smoking_policy
attributes.description: Smoking policy applicable to this specific facility. Non_smoking indicates a fully smoke-free environment; smoking_permitted indicates smoking is allowed; designated_area indicates a specific smoking zone exists within the facility. Supports guest communication and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of facilities within a category on guest-facing amenity listings and property websites. Lower numbers appear first. Managed by property marketing teams to prioritize premium or signature facilities.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the facility record was most recently modified (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in ETL pipelines, data lineage tracking, and audit compliance under SOX and GDPR.

attributes.name: usage_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard per-use or per-day fee charged to guests for accessing the facility, expressed in the property's local currency. Applicable only when is_fee_based is True. Used for revenue forecasting and guest billing configuration in PMS.

products.name: franchise_agreement
products.description: Records of franchise and management contract agreements governing each property's brand affiliation and operational model. Captures franchisor entity, franchisee entity, agreement type (franchise, management contract, lease, owner-operated), effective date, expiration date, renewal terms, royalty fee structure, PIP obligations, brand standard compliance requirements, and termination clauses. Supports portfolio governance and brand compliance management.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the franchise or management contract agreement record in the property domain. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each franchise agreement is denominated in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Franchise agreements impose specific compliance obligations (brand standard audits, quality assurance score minimums, PIP requirements). Linking franchise agreements to their mandated compliance oblig

attributes.name: ownership_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.ownership_entity. Business justification: Each franchise agreement has ONE franchisor entity. Normalize franchisor reference to ownership_entity master. This is the first of two FKs to ownership_entity (franchisor and franchisee). Remove fran

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property governed by this franchise or management contract agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the franchisor or legal department. Used for cross-referencing with SAP S/4HANA contract management and legal document repositories. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the franchise or management contract agreement. Active: agreement is in force. Pending: executed but effective date not yet reached. Expired: term ended without renewal. Terminated: early termination invoked. Suspended: temporarily inactive due to breach or force majeure. Under_Renewal: renewal negotiation in progress. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual relationship governing the property's brand affiliation and operational model. Franchise: brand license with owner-operated management. Management Contract: brand operates the property on behalf of owner. Lease: brand leases the physical asset. Owner-Operated: independent ownership and operation. License: limited brand usage rights. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Standardized brand identifier code assigned by the franchisor representing the hotel brand under which the property operates (e.g., HH for Hilton Hotels, MC for Marriott Courtyard). Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS brand configuration and STR benchmarking brand classification.

attributes.name: brand_segment
attributes.description: Market segment classification of the brand under which the property operates per STR chain scale segmentation. Drives competitive benchmarking, RevPAR analysis, and STR STAR Report peer group assignment.

attributes.name: brand_standard_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the franchisor's brand standards manual applicable to this agreement at time of execution. Brand standards govern FF&E specifications, service delivery, guest experience requirements, and quality assurance audit criteria.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR data processing records. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: crs_connectivity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement mandates connectivity to the franchisor's CRS (Central Reservation System) for rate and inventory distribution. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS integration requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the franchise or management contract agreement becomes legally binding and operational. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for portfolio governance, brand compliance tracking, and financial reporting under USALI.

attributes.name: exclusive_territory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement grants the franchisee an exclusive geographic territory within which the franchisor agrees not to license competing properties under the same brand. Impacts competitive set analysis and new property development decisions.

attributes.name: executed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the franchise or management contract agreement was fully executed (signed by all parties). May differ from effective_date if there is a gap between signing and commencement. Used for legal document management and audit trails.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the franchise or management contract agreement is scheduled to expire if not renewed. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Critical for portfolio renewal pipeline management.

attributes.name: fdd_registration_number
attributes.description: Registration number of the Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) filed with applicable state regulatory authorities. Required in registration states under the FTC Franchise Rule and state franchise laws. Supports regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: ff_and_e_reserve_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) Reserve Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue required to be set aside in a FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment) reserve fund for ongoing property maintenance and capital replacement. Mandated under most franchise and management contract agreements per USALI standards.

tag_set.value: Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) Reserve Percentage

attributes.name: franchisee_entity_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the franchisee or property owner entity entering into the franchise or management contract agreement. Used for ownership structure tracking, portfolio governance, and SAP S/4HANA vendor/partner master alignment.

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this agreement. Critical for cross-border portfolio legal compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: State or province within the governing law country whose laws apply to this agreement. Relevant for US-based agreements where state franchise disclosure laws (FDD requirements) apply.

attributes.name: initial_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of the initial franchise or management contract term as specified in the agreement. Typically ranges from 10 to 30 years for franchise agreements. Used for portfolio lifecycle planning and IFRS 16 lease accounting where applicable.

attributes.name: last_brand_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent brand standards quality assurance audit conducted by the franchisor at this property. Used to track compliance status and schedule next audit cycle per agreement requirements.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_amount
attributes.description: Pre-agreed liquidated damages amount payable upon early termination of the agreement by the franchisee or property owner. Expressed in agreement currency. Critical for portfolio risk assessment and financial exposure reporting under SOX.

attributes.name: loyalty_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue from loyalty member stays payable to the franchisor for loyalty program administration, points redemption funding, and member benefits. Tracked in Salesforce CRM loyalty management and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: management_fee_base_pct
attributes.description: Base management fee as a percentage of total gross revenue payable to the management company under a management contract agreement. Applicable only when agreement_type is management_contract. Reported under USALI management fee accounting.

attributes.name: management_fee_incentive_pct
attributes.description: Incentive management fee as a percentage of GOP (Gross Operating Profit) or NOI (Net Operating Income) payable to the management company when performance thresholds are exceeded. Applicable for management contract agreements. Aligns with USALI GOP reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross room revenue payable to the franchisor's brand marketing fund. Covers national and global advertising, loyalty program marketing, and brand awareness campaigns. Reported under USALI franchise cost accounting.

attributes.name: next_brand_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next brand standards quality assurance audit. Supports proactive compliance management and operational readiness planning.

attributes.name: pip_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved CapEx (Capital Expenditure) budget for PIP (Property Improvement Plan) obligations under this agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Tracked in SAP S/4HANA asset management and reported under USALI FF&E accounting.

attributes.name: pip_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractually required completion date for all PIP (Property Improvement Plan) obligations specified in the franchise or management contract agreement. Null if pip_required is false. Tracks CapEx compliance milestones.

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIP (Property Improvement Plan) is mandated as a condition of this franchise or management contract agreement. PIP obligations are typically triggered at agreement signing, renewal, or brand standard compliance review.

attributes.name: pms_system_required
attributes.description: Name or code of the Property Management System (PMS) mandated by the franchisor as a brand standard technology requirement under this agreement (e.g., Oracle OPERA PMS). Supports technology compliance tracking and integration planning.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_score_min
attributes.description: Minimum quality assurance (QA) inspection score the property must maintain to remain in compliance with brand standards under this agreement. Failure to meet this threshold may trigger a cure period or termination clause.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by the franchisee to exercise a renewal option before the agreement expiration date. Supports portfolio renewal pipeline management and prevents inadvertent agreement lapse.

attributes.name: renewal_option_count
attributes.description: Number of renewal option periods available to the franchisee or property owner upon expiration of the initial term. Supports portfolio renewal pipeline management and long-term asset planning.

attributes.name: renewal_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of each renewal option period as specified in the agreement. Combined with renewal_option_count to determine maximum potential agreement duration for portfolio planning.

attributes.name: reservation_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross room revenue or per-reservation fee payable to the franchisor for CRS (Central Reservation System) and GDS (Global Distribution System) distribution services. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS fee structures.

attributes.name: royalty_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross room revenue payable to the franchisor as a royalty fee under the franchise agreement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Core financial obligation tracked in SAP S/4HANA AP and reported under USALI franchise cost accounting.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated, if applicable. Null for active or pending agreements. Distinct from expiration_date (scheduled end) — this captures early or involuntary termination events.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by either party to invoke termination of the agreement without cause. Supports legal compliance tracking and portfolio risk management.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for agreement termination. Used for portfolio analytics, brand exit tracking, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|franchisee_default|franchisor_default|brand_exit|sale_of_property|force_majeure|non_renewal — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the exclusive or protected geographic territory granted under this agreement, if applicable. May reference radius in miles/kilometers, zip codes, or defined market boundaries. Null if exclusive_territory is false.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, data lineage, and audit compliance.

products.name: pip_plan
products.description: Property Improvement Plan (PIP) and capital project records for each property, serving as the single source of truth for ALL capital improvement work. Covers brand-mandated PIPs triggered by ownership transitions or periodic brand reviews, owner-initiated renovations (soft goods refresh, full renovation, infrastructure upgrade, technology upgrade), and infrastructure capital projects. Captures project reference number, project type discriminator (brand_pip, owner_renovation, infrastructure, technology), triggering event, total estimated CapEx, approved budget, actual spend to date, scope of work summary, impacted areas, rooms out of service, project manager, brand standard compliance deadline, scheduled start date, projected completion date, actual completion date, completion percentage, and project status (draft, approved, in-progress, completed, waived). Critical for brand compliance, CapEx planning, revenue displacement forecasting, and OpEx impact analysis. This is the SSOT for all capital improvement tracking — no separate renovation tracking exists.

attributes.description: Estimated date for project completion, used for operational planning and room inventory availability forecasting.

attributes.name: revenue_displacement_estimate

attributes.name: triggering_event

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which this PIP line item was fully completed, inspected, and accepted. Used for brand compliance verification, final cost reconciliation, asset capitalization triggering in SAP, and PIP progress reporting to ownership and brand.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The actual invoiced and posted cost in the property's functional currency for this PIP line item upon completion or at current spend date. Compared against estimated_cost for budget variance reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA AP invoice postings against the PIP work order.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which work for this PIP line item commenced on-site. Compared against scheduled_start_date to identify schedule slippage and its downstream impact on brand compliance deadlines and hotel operations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the ownership, asset management, or corporate authority who approved the CapEx budget for this PIP item. Required for SOX financial controls documentation and CapEx authorization audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CapEx budget for this PIP item was formally approved by the designated authority. Required for SOX financial controls audit trail and for establishing the authorized spend baseline.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA fixed asset number assigned to the asset created or replaced by this PIP item upon capitalization. Links the PIP line item to the property's fixed asset register for depreciation scheduling and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: brand_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PIP item is mandated by the brand franchisor as a condition of franchise agreement compliance (True) or is an ownership-initiated discretionary improvement (False). Brand-required items carry compliance deadlines and potential franchise termination risk if not completed.

attributes.name: capex_budget_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA internal order or WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) element code to which this PIP item's costs are allocated. Enables precise CapEx budget tracking, cost center assignment, and financial reporting per USALI and SOX requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which this PIP item must be completed to satisfy brand franchisor compliance requirements. Failure to meet this deadline may result in franchise agreement penalties, brand standard deficiency notices, or franchise termination proceedings.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The procurement contract or purchase order number in SAP S/4HANA governing the contractor's engagement for this PIP item. Used for invoice matching, lien waiver tracking, and contract compliance verification.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contractor or vendor responsible for executing the work scope for this PIP item. Used for contractor performance tracking, lien waiver management, and procurement compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PIP item record was first created in the data platform. Provides audit trail for record provenance and supports data lineage requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: deferral_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why this PIP item has been deferred beyond its original scheduled completion date. Required for brand franchisor approval of deferrals and for ownership reporting on PIP execution delays. Populated only when item_status is 'deferred'.

attributes.name: deferred_completion_date
attributes.description: The revised target completion date approved by the brand franchisor for a deferred PIP item. Replaces the original scheduled_completion_date as the binding compliance deadline when a deferral has been formally granted.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The budgeted or estimated cost in the property's functional currency for completing this PIP line item, as approved in the CapEx budget. Used for budget variance analysis, ownership reporting, and CapEx authorization tracking per USALI and SAP S/4HANA project accounting.

attributes.name: ffe_category
attributes.description: Classification of the PIP item into the FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment) taxonomy per USALI and brand standards. Determines CapEx vs OpEx treatment, depreciation schedule, and procurement channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: furniture|fixtures|equipment|soft_goods|technology|signage|artwork|building_infrastructure|os_and_e — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code for posting costs associated with this PIP item. Determines whether the expenditure is capitalized (balance sheet) or expensed (P&L) per USALI and IFRS/GAAP accounting treatment.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the brand quality assurance inspector conducted or is scheduled to conduct the formal inspection of this completed PIP item. Required for brand compliance certification and franchise agreement documentation.

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the brand quality assurance inspection for this PIP item. A failed or conditional pass outcome triggers a punch list of remediation items that must be resolved before the item can be closed for brand compliance purposes.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PIP item requires a formal brand quality assurance inspection upon completion (True) before it can be marked as accepted and closed. Brand-mandated items typically require inspector sign-off as a condition of compliance certification.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific work scope for this PIP line item, including materials, finishes, quantities, and brand standard requirements (e.g., 'Replace all guestroom soft goods including headboards, drapery, and carpet per brand standard BS-2024-GR-07').

attributes.name: item_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this PIP line item, typically matching the numbering scheme in the brand-issued PIP document or SAP work order. Used for cross-referencing with brand inspectors, contractors, and CapEx approval documentation.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this PIP line item within the execution workflow. Tracks progression from initial identification through approval, active construction, and final completion or deferral. Used for PIP compliance reporting to brand and ownership.

attributes.name: life_safety_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PIP item addresses a life safety, fire code, ADA accessibility, or OSHA regulatory compliance requirement (True). Life safety items are treated as critical priority and may not be deferred without regulatory authority approval.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Brand-assigned or ownership-assigned priority ranking for this PIP item. Critical items typically represent brand standard violations or life-safety issues requiring immediate remediation. Drives sequencing of work execution and resource allocation.

attributes.name: property_area
attributes.description: The physical area or zone of the property affected by this PIP line item. Drives scheduling coordination with hotel operations to minimize guest impact. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: guestroom|lobby|corridor|exterior|food_and_beverage|meeting_space|fitness_center|pool|back_of_house|spa|parking|landscaping — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: punch_list_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting outstanding deficiencies, remediation requirements, or conditional items identified during brand inspection or internal quality review. Captures specific corrective actions required before final acceptance of this PIP item.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units, rooms, fixtures, or items covered by this PIP line item's work scope (e.g., 120 guestrooms, 45 chairs, 3 elevators). Used for unit cost benchmarking, procurement quantity planning, and cost-per-unit analysis.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_order
attributes.description: The number of guestrooms placed out of order (OOO) in the PMS as a direct result of this PIP item's work scope. Critical input for RevPAR impact modeling in IDeaS G3 RMS and for coordinating room inventory availability in Oracle OPERA PMS during renovation.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which this PIP line item is expected to be fully completed and ready for inspection. Used for milestone tracking, brand compliance deadline management, and rooms-out-of-order (OOO) planning to minimize RevPAR impact.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which work for this PIP line item is scheduled to commence. Used for construction phasing, contractor mobilization planning, and coordination with hotel operations to manage guest impact and room inventory availability.

attributes.name: sustainability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PIP item contributes to the property's sustainability or energy efficiency program (True), such as LED lighting upgrades, low-flow plumbing fixtures, or HVAC efficiency improvements. Supports ESG reporting and green certification tracking.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field on this PIP item (e.g., each, room, sqft, sqm, linear_ft, lot). Required for accurate cost-per-unit benchmarking and procurement specification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PIP item record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: work_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of work required for this PIP item. Distinguishes between full replacement, renovation/refresh, new installation, repair, technology upgrade, or regulatory compliance work. Drives cost estimation methodology and contractor selection.

Banquet and conference services depend on this link to sche

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: adjacent_prefunction_space

attributes.name: capacity_classroom

attributes.name: climate_control_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dedicated_wifi_bandwidth_mbps

attributes.name: divisible

attributes.name: emergency_exit_count

attributes.name: entrance_width_inches

attributes.name: floor_level

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: loading_dock_access

attributes.name: meeting_space_status

attributes.name: minimum_catering_spend
attributes.description: Minimum food and beverage spend required when booking this space. Null if no minimum or catering not required.

attributes.name: minimum_rental_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the space must be rented for a single event. Used for revenue management and booking policies.

attributes.name: natural_light_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has windows or skylights providing natural daylight. Important for guest experience and event ambiance.

attributes.name: number_of_sections
attributes.description: Number of separate sections the space can be divided into when partitions are deployed. Null if space is not divisible.

attributes.name: rental_rate_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for the meeting space rental. Actual rates are managed in rate tables and vary by season, day of week, and booking terms.

attributes.name: space_code

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total area of the meeting space measured in square feet. Critical for capacity planning and event layout design.

attributes.name: wifi_available

attributes.name: delivery_service_available_flag

products.name: gds_profile

Captures GDS property code, chain code, CRS property code (Sabre SynXis), property display name, short description, long description, hero image URL, amenity flags, and last sync timestamp. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration. Supports channel distribution and OTA partnership management.
products.reference: GDS Property Profile / CRS Property Listing (Sabre SynXis)

attributes.name: gds_profile_id

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each GDS profile displays rates in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the property as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Used by guests and travel agents for navigation and correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: amadeus_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Amadeus GDS network. May differ from the Sabre GDS property code. Used for Amadeus channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Amadeus platform.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: The brand identifier code as registered in the GDS and CRS systems. Identifies the hotel brand (e.g., luxury, premium, select-service) under which the property is marketed in distribution channels. Used for brand-level filtering in GDS searches.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The full marketing name of the hotel brand as displayed in GDS and OTA channels (e.g., 'Luxury Collection', 'Marriott Hotels', 'Hilton Garden Inn'). Supports brand-level reporting and channel distribution analytics.

attributes.name: chain_code
attributes.description: The hotel chain or brand code registered with the GDS networks identifying the parent brand or management company. Used by GDS systems to group properties under a common brand umbrella for travel agent searches and loyalty program linkage.

attributes.name: check_in_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-in time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set arrival expectations.

attributes.name: check_out_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-out time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set departure expectations.

attributes.name: city_code
attributes.description: The IATA or GDS city/airport code associated with the property location (e.g., 'NYC', 'LON', 'PAR'). Used by GDS systems to associate the property with a travel destination for search and booking purposes.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: The full city name of the property location as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Supports geographic search and filtering in distribution channels.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the property location as registered in the GDS profile. Used for geographic filtering in GDS and OTA search results and for regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GDS profile record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and profile lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: crs_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier assigned within the Central Reservation System (CRS), specifically Sabre SynXis CRS. This code is the primary key used for rate distribution, inventory allocation, and booking transactions flowing through the CRS. Distinct from the GDS property code.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The property name as it appears in GDS and CRS search results and booking screens. This is the consumer-facing name used by travel agents and OTA partners. May differ from the legal property name or internal operating name.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary distribution channel scope this profile record covers. 'gds' = GDS-only profile (Sabre/Amadeus/Galileo); 'crs' = CRS direct booking profile; 'ota' = OTA partner profile; 'direct' = brand.com direct booking; 'all' = unified profile across all channels.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The fax number for the property as listed in GDS channel profiles. Used by travel agents and corporate accounts for reservation confirmations and group booking correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: floor_count
attributes.description: The total number of floors in the main hotel building as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Used by travel agents and guests for property orientation and accessibility planning.

attributes.name: galileo_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Galileo/Travelport GDS network. Used for Travelport channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Galileo platform.

attributes.name: gds_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned within the GDS network (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport). This code is used by travel agents and OTA partners to look up and book the property across GDS channels. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration.

attributes.name: has_airport_shuttle
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers complimentary or paid airport shuttle service as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by transportation amenities.

attributes.name: has_fitness_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a fitness center or gym as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by wellness amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: has_meeting_facilities
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has meeting rooms or conference facilities (MICE — Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by corporate travel agents and event planners to filter properties for group and event bookings.

attributes.name: has_parking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers on-site parking (self-park or valet) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by parking availability.

attributes.name: has_pool
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a swimming pool as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by recreational amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: hero_image_url
attributes.description: The URL of the primary hero/banner image displayed on GDS and OTA property listing pages. This is the main visual asset representing the property in channel distribution. Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL conforming to OTA image specification standards.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements as published in GDS and OTA profiles. Used by travel agents and guests requiring accessible accommodations. Supports ADA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: is_pet_friendly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property accepts pets as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by pet policy. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent successful synchronization of this property profile from the Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration to the GDS networks and downstream distribution channels. Used to monitor data freshness and identify stale profiles requiring re-sync.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for map-based search and proximity filtering in GDS, OTA, and direct booking channels. Supports geo-analytics and competitive set mapping.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: The full marketing narrative for the property displayed on GDS detail screens and OTA property pages. attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for map-based search and proximity filtering in GDS, OTA, and direct booking channels. Supports geo-analytics and competitive set mapping.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The primary reservations or front desk phone number for the property as listed in GDS and OTA channels. Used by travel agents and guests to contact the property directly. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the property location as registered in the GDS profile. Used for geographic proximity searches in GDS and OTA platforms. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GDS/CRS property profile version became active and live for distribution across GDS and OTA channels. Used for profile versioning, content audit trails, and channel distribution management.

attributes.name: profile_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GDS/CRS property profile version expires or is scheduled for deactivation. Nullable for open-ended active profiles. Used for profile lifecycle management and scheduled content refresh cycles.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GDS/CRS property profile. Controls whether the property is actively distributed and bookable across GDS channels. attributes.name: exchange_rate_update_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which exchange rates are refreshed for this currency. attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this currency configuration expires or is no longer valid for new transactions. Nullable for currencies with indefinite validity. Used for managing currency transitions and ensuring historical data integrity.

attributes.name: is_base_currency

Typically one currency per enterprise (e.g., USD for US-headquartered companies). Used for Gross Operating Profit (GOP), Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA), and consolidated financial statements under Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI).

attributes.name: is_crypto_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum) rather than a traditional fiat currency. Used for special handling in payment processing, regulatory compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: minor_unit
attributes.description: The relationship between the major currency unit and its minor unit (e.g., 100 cents = 1 dollar). Defines the subdivision of the currency for precise financial calculations in Property Management System (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro, British Pound Sterling, Japanese Yen). Used for display purposes in financial reports and guest-facing materials.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this currency. May include information about currency restrictions, regulatory requirements, or system-specific configuration details.

attributes.name: numeric_code

attributes.name: payment_processing_enabled

attributes.name: pms_currency_code

attributes.name: rounding_method

Standard follows mathematical rounding rules; up always rounds up; down always rounds down; nearest rounds to nearest value; bankers rounding (round half to even) minimizes cumulative rounding errors in large transaction volumes. products.name: vendor_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between property and vendor. It captures the negotiated commercial terms, service-level agreements, and relationship parameters that govern procurement relationships between individual hotel properties and their suppliers. Each record links one property to one vendor with property-specific pricing, delivery terms, payment conditions, and local contact arrangements that exist only in the context of this specific property-vendor relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, each hotel property maintains procurement relationships with multiple vendors across different supply categories (food & beverage suppliers, FF&E vendors, housekeeping suppliers, maintenance contractors), and each vendor serves multiple properties across the portfolio. Each property-vendor relationship has negotiated commercial terms including property-specific discount rates, delivery lead times, minimum order values, payment term overrides, and dedicated local vendor contacts that vary by property. The business actively manages these relationships for vendor performance evaluation, contract compliance monitoring, and procurement optimization.

products.name: property_space_allocation
products.description: Single source of truth is event.event_space_allocation. This association product represents the allocation of a specific meeting space to an event booking for a defined time period. It captures the operational assignment of physical function space to MICE events, including setup configuration, timing, attendance guarantees, and rental charges. Each record links one meeting_space to one event_booking with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific space-time allocation.. Existence Justification: In MICE operations, a single multi-day conference event booking routinely requires multiple meeting spaces (e.g., main ballroom for general sessions, multiple breakout rooms for concurrent workshops, boardroom for VIP meetings). Conversely, a high-demand meeting space hosts multiple different event bookings across days and time slots. The allocation itself is an operational entity that event coordinators actively create, modify, and track, with specific attributes like time slots, setup configurations, guaranteed attendance per space, and individual rental charges that belong to neither the space nor the event alone.property_space_allocation]event_space_allocation. products.name: channel_connection
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between property and channel. It captures the commercial and technical relationship governing how a specific property distributes inventory through a specific distribution channel. Each record links one property to one channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship: activation dates, connectivity configuration, commission overrides, rate loading protocols, and inventory allocation rules.. Existence Justification: In the travel hospitality industry, properties distribute inventory through multiple distribution channels simultaneously (GDS networks, OTA platforms, direct web, wholesalers), and each channel serves multiple properties across the portfolio. The business actively manages these property-channel connections as operational entities with specific configuration, activation dates, connectivity protocols, and property-specific commission overrides that cannot be stored on either the property or channel master records alone.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Real-time room inventory management including room types, physical room attributes, availability, room status, housekeeping status, out-of-order designations, and inventory controls. Manages room blocks, allotments, overbooking limits, and LRA (Last Room Availability). Integrates with PMS (Oracle OPERA) and RMS (IDeaS G3) for dynamic inventory allocation across distribution channels. Tracks OCC and supports LOS-based controls.

products.name: room_type
products.description: Master catalog of room types defined per property, including physical configuration (bed type, bed count, view category, square footage), maximum occupancy, accessibility features, ADA compliance status, connecting room eligibility, and suite classification. Serves as the foundational classification entity for all inventory management — availability, controls, blocks, allotments, channel distribution, and demand forecasting all reference room type as their primary dimension. Defined and maintained in Oracle OPERA PMS across luxury, premium, and select-service segments.
