attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Rule Reference ID
attributes.description: Native rule identifier assigned by the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) for this Dynamic Rate Rule. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational RMS.

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Rule Reference ID

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the Dynamic Rate Rule within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used for cross-system reference between IDeaS G3 RMS, Infor EzRMS, and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the Dynamic Rate Rule's business purpose, pricing logic, and intended yield optimization outcome.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the Dynamic Rate Rule, used by revenue managers to identify and manage pricing strategies within the RMS dashboard.

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking that determines the order of evaluation when multiple Dynamic Rate Rules are eligible to fire simultaneously for the same property, room type, and rate plan. Lower numeric values indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority).

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the Dynamic Rate Rule governing whether it is eligible to trigger automated pricing adjustments. Active rules are evaluated by the RMS engine; draft rules are under configuration; suspended rules are temporarily disabled; archived rules are retained for historical audit.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Dynamic Rate Rule by the trigger mechanism driving automated pricing adjustments. Occupancy-based rules fire on OCC thresholds; pickup-based on booking velocity; competitive-based on RGI/ARI/MPI benchmarks from STR STAR Report; event-based on MICE or local demand events; LOS-based on Length of Stay (LOS) restrictions; forecast-based on RMS demand forecasts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: occupancy_based|pickup_based|competitive_based|event_based|los_based|forecast_based — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: trigger_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this Dynamic Rate Rule has been triggered and applied a pricing adjustment since its activation date. Used to assess rule utilization and yield optimization effectiveness.

attributes.name: trigger_threshold_operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator applied to the trigger threshold value to determine whether the rule condition is met. For example, 'greater_than' with a threshold of 0.80 means the rule fires when OCC exceeds 80%.

attributes.name: trigger_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the trigger threshold value. Percentage applies to OCC-based rules; room_count applies to pickup-based rules; index_value applies to competitive benchmarking rules (RGI, MPI, ARI); currency_amount applies to ADR-based triggers; nights applies to LOS-based rules.

attributes.name: trigger_threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold at which this Dynamic Rate Rule fires. For occupancy-based rules, this is the OCC percentage (e.g., 0.80 = 80%). For pickup-based rules, this is the number of rooms picked up within the pickup window. For competitive-based rules, this is the RGI or ARI index value.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Dynamic Rate Rule record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer ETL pipeline.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version counter tracking the number of times this Dynamic Rate Rule configuration has been modified. Supports audit trail and change management for pricing strategy governance.

products.name: pricing_override
products.description: Transactional record of manual pricing overrides applied by revenue managers to supersede system-generated rates from IDeaS G3 RMS. Captures original system-recommended rate, override rate, override reason code (competitive pressure, group wash, event demand, error correction), approving revenue manager, property, room type, rate plan, effective date range, and override status (pending, approved, expired, reversed). Provides audit trail for manual revenue management interventions and supports override frequency analysis for RMS tuning.

attributes.name: pricing_override_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each manual pricing override record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the pricing_override data product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically a Director of Revenue Management or VP Revenue) who formally authorized the pricing override. May differ from revenue_manager_id when a second-level approval is required for large rate variances.

attributes.name: banquet_event_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Banquet Event Order Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.banquet_event_order. Business justification: Manual rate overrides for groups tied to F&B minimum spend commitments from banquet events. Required for group contract evaluation, displacement analysis that includes total property spend, not just r

tag_set.value: Related Banquet Event Order Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Manual rate overrides are sometimes applied to honor campaign promises or fix campaign-related pricing errors. Tracking the campaign context is essential for audit, reconciliation, and campaign cost a

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Manual rate overrides often apply to specific channels (e.g., override OTA rate due to parity issue, adjust GDS rate for corporate segment). Revenue managers need to track which channel triggered over

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Dynamic Rate Rule (DRR) that was in effect and being superseded by this manual override. Enables analysis of how frequently manual overrides conflict with automated DRR logic and supports RMS rule tuning.

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific event, conference, or MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) event that triggered the pricing override when override_reason_code is 'event_demand'. Links to the event master record in Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.name: primary_pricing_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the revenue manager employee who applied or approved the pricing override. Used for accountability tracking and override frequency analysis per individual manager.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which the pricing override was applied. Links to the property master record in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: reservation_group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group room block associated with this pricing override when override_reason_code is 'group_wash'. Links to the group block record in Oracle OPERA PMS or Delphi by Amadeus for group displacement analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate, group) against which the pricing override is applied. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS rate plan catalog.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Suite, Standard Double) to which the pricing override applies. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS room type configuration.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing override required formal approval before activation, based on the rate variance threshold or property-level governance policy. True = approval workflow triggered; False = auto-approved within tolerance.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The rate variance percentage threshold (as a decimal, e.g., 0.2000 = 20%) that triggered the approval requirement for this override. Captures the governance rule in effect at the time of submission for audit purposes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the pricing override was formally approved by the authorizing revenue manager or director. Null if override is still pending or was reversed without approval.

attributes.name: channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies which distribution channels the overridden rate is published to. 'all_channels' = no restriction; 'direct_only' = hotel direct and brand website only; 'ota_excluded' = all channels except Online Travel Agencies (OTA); 'gds_only' = Global Distribution System (GDS) only; 'brand_website_only' = brand.com only.

attributes.name: closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether the overridden rate includes a Closed to Arrival (CTA) restriction, preventing new reservations with an arrival date falling within the override effective window. True = CTA restriction active; False = arrivals permitted.

attributes.name: closed_to_departure
attributes.description: Indicates whether the overridden rate includes a Closed to Departure (CTD) restriction, preventing check-outs on specific dates within the override window. True = CTD restriction active; False = departures permitted.

attributes.name: competitive_rate_reference
attributes.description: The competitor or market reference rate (in property local currency) that informed the override decision, particularly when override_reason_code is 'competitive_pressure'. Sourced from STR STAR Report, OTA rate shopping, or RMS competitive benchmarking module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording when the pricing override record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rates captured in this override record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures multi-currency properties report rates in the correct denomination.

attributes.name: day_of_week_mask
attributes.description: Seven-character binary string (1=active, 0=inactive) representing the days of the week the override applies to, ordered Monday through Sunday (e.g., '1111100' = Mon–Fri only). Applicable when override_scope is 'day_of_week'.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date on which the pricing override rate becomes active and is applied to reservations. Defines the start of the override window in the property's local time zone.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date on which the pricing override rate remains active. After this date, the override status transitions to 'expired' and the RMS-recommended rate is reinstated. Nullable for open-ended overrides.

attributes.name: inventory_rooms_affected
attributes.description: Number of room inventory units to which the pricing override applies. Null or zero indicates the override applies to all available inventory for the specified room type and date range.

attributes.name: is_bar_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this override specifically targets the Best Available Rate (BAR) — the lowest publicly available rate for a given date. True = BAR is being overridden; False = override applies to a non-BAR rate plan.

attributes.name: los_restriction_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay under the overridden rate. Null if no maximum LOS restriction is applied. Used in conjunction with los_restriction_min to define the eligible stay window.

attributes.name: los_restriction_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to qualify for the overridden rate. A Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applied alongside the rate override to manage demand patterns and prevent single-night bookings during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: override_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the revenue manager explaining the business rationale for the override, particularly when override_reason_code is 'other' or when additional context is required for audit purposes.

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: The manually set rate (in property local currency) applied by the revenue manager, superseding the RMS-recommended rate. This is the Best Available Rate (BAR) or specific rate plan rate that will be published to distribution channels.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code classifying why the revenue manager overrode the system-generated rate. 'competitive_pressure' = OTA/competitor rate response; 'group_wash' = group block displacement adjustment; 'event_demand' = MICE or local event surge; 'error_correction' = RMS data or configuration error fix; 'distressed_inventory' = last-minute unsold inventory; 'other' = non-standard reason documented in override_notes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: competitive_pressure|group_wash|event_demand|error_correction|distressed_inventory|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: override_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to the pricing override for audit trail, cross-system reconciliation, and revenue manager communication. Format: PO- followed by 6–20 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: override_scope
attributes.description: Defines the temporal scope of the pricing override. 'single_date' = applies to one specific stay date; 'date_range' = applies across a contiguous range from effective_date to expiry_date; 'day_of_week' = applies to specific days of the week within the effective window.

attributes.name: override_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing override. 'pending' = submitted awaiting approval; 'approved' = authorized and scheduled; 'active' = currently in effect; 'expired' = past effective end date; 'reversed' = manually cancelled or rolled back.

attributes.name: rate_variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary difference between the override_rate and the rms_recommended_rate (override_rate minus rms_recommended_rate). Positive value indicates override is above RMS recommendation; negative indicates below. Used for override impact analysis.

attributes.name: rate_variance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of the override_rate from the rms_recommended_rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Calculated as (override_rate - rms_recommended_rate) / rms_recommended_rate. Supports threshold-based alerting and RMS calibration.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why the pricing override was reversed. Populated only when override_status is 'reversed'. Supports post-mortem analysis of override quality and revenue impact of reversals.

attributes.name: reversed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the pricing override was reversed or cancelled, restoring the RMS-recommended rate. Null for overrides that have not been reversed.

attributes.name: rms_forecast_demand_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Forecast Demand Level
attributes.description: The demand level classification (low, medium, high, very_high) as forecasted by the RMS at the time the override was submitted. Provides context for evaluating whether the override was aligned with or contrary to demand signals.

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Forecast Demand Level

attributes.name: rms_recommended_rate
attributes.description: The original rate (in property local currency) recommended by the automated Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) prior to the manual override. Baseline for override variance analysis and RMS tuning.

attributes.name: rms_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the Revenue Management System (RMS) that generated the original recommended rate being overridden. 'ideas_g3' = IDeaS G3 RMS; 'infor_ezrms' = Infor EzRMS; 'manual' = no RMS recommendation existed (fully manual rate entry).

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the revenue manager submitted the pricing override request for approval. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording the most recent modification to the pricing override record in the data platform. Supports change detection and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.

products.name: rate_availability
products.description: Daily rate and availability snapshot per property, room type, and rate plan combination as managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Captures open/closed status, available inventory count, current BAR, minimum and maximum rates, and last-updated timestamp. Represents the real-time pricing grid used for reservation fulfillment and channel distribution.

attributes.name: rate_availability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each daily rate and availability snapshot record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the rate_availability data product.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation_policy. Business justification: Rate availability snapshots distributed to OTAs and GDS must include the specific cancellation policy for rate shopping compliance and guest transparency. Channel managers need this link to ensure acc

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Rate/availability snapshots are channel-specific - each channel sees different rates and inventory based on connectivity and contracts. Core distribution management requires tracking what each channel

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Dynamic Rate Rule (DRR) applied by IDeaS G3 RMS to derive the current BAR for this snapshot. DRRs define the algorithmic pricing logic (demand-based adjustments, day-of-week factors, lead-time curves) that drive dynamic pricing decisions.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Rate availability changes drive revenue recognition patterns and require GL account mapping for channel-specific revenue tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property (hotel, resort, or vacation property) for which this rate and availability snapshot applies. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate, package) governing the pricing for this snapshot. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS rate plan catalog.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard, Suite) for which this rate and availability snapshot is captured. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS room type configuration.

attributes.name: updated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Revenue managers update rate availability controls; employee tracking required for operational audit trail, override authority validation, and accountability for daily inventory and pricing distributi

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan on the snapshot date (e.g., 7-day advance purchase, 21-day advance purchase for NRR rates). A key rate restriction parameter managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current open/closed availability status for this property, room type, rate plan, and date combination as managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. 'open' = bookable; 'closed' = inventory blocked; 'stop_sell' = yield-driven closure; 'on_request' = requires manual confirmation; 'min_stay_restriction' = LOS restriction active; 'closed_to_arrival' = no new arrivals permitted on this date.

attributes.name: available_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms of this room type available for sale on the snapshot date at this property. Represents net sellable inventory after deducting out-of-order, out-of-service, and already-committed rooms. Core input for OCC (Occupancy Rate) and RevPAR calculations.

attributes.name: bar_rate
attributes.description: The Best Available Rate (BAR) for this room type, property, and stay date — the lowest publicly available non-restricted rate as determined by IDeaS G3 RMS dynamic pricing engine. BAR is the anchor rate from which other rate plans are derived and is the primary rate distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS and OTA channels.

attributes.name: closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether new arrivals are blocked on the snapshot date for this room type and rate plan. When True, guests cannot check in on this date but may continue an existing stay through it. A yield management restriction used to optimize multi-night booking patterns.

attributes.name: closed_to_departure
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked on the snapshot date for this room type and rate plan. When True, guests cannot check out on this date, forcing stays to extend through it. Used in conjunction with CTA restrictions to shape booking patterns during peak periods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate and availability snapshot record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and ETL pipeline tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all rate amounts (BAR, min, max, rack) for this record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency properties and international channel distribution via Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_level
attributes.description: Demand forecast classification for the snapshot date as generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Drives dynamic pricing decisions and inventory restriction strategies. Levels range from very_low (deep discounting warranted) to very_high (maximum rate and stop-sell controls active).

attributes.name: effective_from_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time from which this rate and availability record became active and was distributed to booking channels. Used for bi-temporal modeling of rate history and supports point-in-time rate reconstruction for revenue audits and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: effective_until_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time until which this rate and availability record remains active. Null indicates the record is currently active. Used for bi-temporal modeling and historical rate reconstruction. When a new rate update is received, the prior record's effective_until_timestamp is set to the new record's effective_from_timestamp.

attributes.name: gds_rate_code
attributes.description: The rate code as published on GDS (Global Distribution System) platforms (Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport) via Sabre SynXis CRS. GDS rate codes follow standardized formats required for travel agent booking systems and corporate travel management programs.

attributes.name: group_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms on the snapshot date allocated to group blocks (MICE, corporate groups, tour operators) as managed in Oracle OPERA PMS and Delphi by Amadeus. Group block inventory is excluded from transient availability and tracked separately for yield optimization.

attributes.name: is_package_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan includes bundled package components (e.g., breakfast, spa credit, parking, airport transfer) beyond the base room charge. Package rates require component-level revenue allocation across USALI departments in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate and availability record was last modified in the source system (IDeaS G3 RMS or Sabre SynXis CRS). Represents the business event timestamp of the most recent pricing or availability change. Critical for real-time channel distribution synchronization and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: los_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted under this rate plan for the snapshot date. Used to prevent long-stay bookings at promotional rates during high-demand periods. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS as an upper LOS (Length of Stay) restriction.

attributes.name: los_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to qualify for this rate plan on the snapshot date. A key yield optimization restriction managed in IDeaS G3 RMS. LOS (Length of Stay) restrictions are used to maximize revenue during high-demand periods by requiring multi-night commitments.

attributes.name: max_rate
attributes.description: The ceiling rate (maximum sellable rate) for this room type, property, rate plan, and stay date as configured in IDeaS G3 RMS. Caps pricing during peak demand periods to maintain guest trust and brand integrity, and supports rate parity compliance across channels.

attributes.name: meal_plan_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the meal plan inclusion for this rate plan (RO = Room Only; BB = Bed and Breakfast; HB = Half Board; FB = Full Board; AI = All Inclusive). Affects rate composition, F&B revenue allocation, and package pricing in Oracle OPERA PMS and MICROS POS.

attributes.name: min_rate
attributes.description: The floor rate (minimum sellable rate) for this room type, property, rate plan, and stay date as configured in IDeaS G3 RMS. Represents the lowest price at which the room may be sold under any circumstance, enforcing revenue floor controls and preventing rate erosion.

attributes.name: occupancy_forecast_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted occupancy rate (OCC%) for the property on the snapshot date as projected by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS at the time of this snapshot. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Used to validate pricing decisions and benchmark against STR STAR Report actuals.

attributes.name: ota_rate_code
attributes.description: The rate identifier as assigned by the primary OTA (Online Travel Agency) partner (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com) for this rate plan and property combination. Used for rate parity monitoring, OTA reconciliation, and channel performance reporting.

attributes.name: out_of_order_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms of this room type that are out of order (OOO) on the snapshot date due to maintenance, renovation, or damage. Out-of-order rooms are excluded from sellable inventory and impact OCC denominator calculations per USALI standards.

attributes.name: pickup_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms booked (picked up) for the snapshot date since the previous snapshot capture. Pickup velocity is a key revenue management signal used in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS to detect demand acceleration and trigger dynamic rate adjustments.

attributes.name: pricing_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current rate for this snapshot was manually overridden by a revenue manager, superseding the automated recommendation from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Manual overrides are tracked for revenue strategy audit and RMS model calibration.

attributes.name: pricing_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the revenue manager when manually overriding the RMS-recommended rate. Populated only when pricing_override_flag is True. Used for revenue strategy review, RMS model improvement, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: rack_rate
attributes.description: The published full undiscounted rate (rack rate) for this room type and stay date. Serves as the reference rate for discount calculations, loyalty redemption valuations, and walk-in pricing. Typically the highest rate tier and the baseline for USALI revenue reporting.

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate record is subject to rate parity obligations with OTA (Online Travel Agency) partners. When True, the rate must match or be lower than rates published on OTA channels. Critical for OTA contract compliance and channel distribution management.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the rate plan as distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS and IDeaS G3 RMS (e.g., BAR, CORP01, PKG_BB, NRR_ADV21). Used for channel distribution, GDS mapping, and OTA rate loading.

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate plan governing this availability record. Determines pricing logic, cancellation policy, and channel eligibility. BAR (Best Available Rate) = dynamic public rate; LRA (Last Room Availability) = guaranteed availability; NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) = prepaid non-cancellable; corporate = negotiated account rate; package = bundled inclusions; group = block rate; loyalty = member rate; promotional = limited-time offer; wholesale = OTA/tour operator net rate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bar|lra|nrr|corporate|package|group|loyalty|promotional|wholesale — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revenue_management_system
attributes.description: Identifies the Revenue Management System (RMS) that generated or last updated the pricing recommendation for this snapshot record. Supports data lineage tracking and system-of-record attribution for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The stay date (arrival night) for which this rate and availability record applies. Represents the business event date — the night a guest would occupy the room at the stated rate. Core dimension for RevPAR and ADR reporting.

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (IDeaS G3 RMS or Sabre SynXis CRS) for this rate and availability record. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation, reprocessing, and audit purposes.

attributes.name: stop_sell
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type and rate plan combination has been closed to all new bookings on the snapshot date regardless of available inventory. A hard yield management control applied in IDeaS G3 RMS to protect inventory for higher-value bookings or group blocks.

attributes.name: total_rooms
attributes.description: Total physical room count for this room type at the property on the snapshot date. Used as the denominator for occupancy rate (OCC) and RevPAR calculations. Reflects the property's sellable capacity before any restrictions.

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: Forward-looking demand forecast records generated by IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS at the property, room type, and market segment level. Captures forecast date, forecast horizon, unconstrained demand, constrained demand, projected occupancy, projected ADR, projected RevPAR, forecast confidence interval, and forecast model version. Used to drive pricing decisions, inventory controls, and group evaluation.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each demand forecast record generated by IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Primary key for the demand_forecast data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Demand forecasts incorporate expected lift from planned marketing campaigns. Forecasters link campaigns to forecast assumptions for post-campaign variance analysis and to refine future campaign lift m

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Revenue analysts generate demand forecasts; employee attribution required for forecast accuracy tracking, performance evaluation, and accountability for override decisions in revenue management foreca

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Demand forecasts incorporate known definite event bookings as constrained demand drivers. Critical for pickup forecasting, unconstrained vs constrained demand modeling, and event impact analysis in re

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Demand forecasts are reconciled against financial budgets for variance analysis, reforecasting cycles, and board reporting on revenue performance vs plan.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_segment. Business justification: Demand forecasting incorporates loyalty segment behavior patterns (booking lead time, LOS, spend). Business process: segment-specific demand modeling for accurate revenue forecasts, essential for hote

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment (e.g., Transient, Group, Corporate, Leisure, OTA) for which the demand forecast is generated. Null when the forecast is at the property or room-type level only.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which this demand forecast was generated. Aligns with the Oracle OPERA PMS property master.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard, Suite) for which the demand forecast is generated. Null when the forecast is at the property or market-segment level only.

attributes.name: ari_forecast
attributes.description: Forecasted Average Rate Index (ARI), representing the property's projected ADR relative to the competitive set's projected ADR. An ARI above 1.0 indicates the property is expected to achieve a rate premium over its competitive set.

attributes.name: booking_pace_index
attributes.description: Ratio of current bookings on-hand for the forecast date compared to the same point in time in the prior year or baseline period. A value above 1.0 indicates ahead-of-pace demand; below 1.0 indicates behind-pace. Used by revenue managers to assess demand trajectory.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the statistical confidence interval for the unconstrained demand forecast. Represents the pessimistic demand scenario used for risk-adjusted pricing and inventory control decisions in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the statistical confidence interval for the unconstrained demand forecast. Represents the optimistic demand scenario used for overbooking strategy and group evaluation in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level (e.g., 90.00, 95.00) associated with the forecast confidence interval. Indicates the probability that actual demand will fall within the lower and upper confidence bounds.

attributes.name: constrained_demand
attributes.description: The forecasted room demand (in room-nights) after applying available inventory capacity constraints. Represents the demand the property can actually accommodate. Used for occupancy projection and revenue optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this demand forecast record was first captured and written to the Silver Layer data product. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary forecast values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures multi-currency properties report revenue in the correct denomination.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the forecast date. Used for day-of-week demand pattern analysis, weekend vs. weekday segmentation, and pricing strategy differentiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: demand_segment_mix_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted percentage share of total demand attributed to the specific market segment in this record. For example, if the Transient segment is expected to represent 65% of total demand on the forecast date, this field holds 65.00. Populated only for market-segment-level forecasts.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_mape
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forecast Accuracy Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of the forecast model for this property-segment-horizon combination, based on historical back-testing. Lower values indicate higher model accuracy. Used to weight forecast confidence and flag low-accuracy forecasts for revenue manager review.

tag_set.value: Forecast Accuracy Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The stay date (arrival date) for which the demand forecast values apply. Represents the future date being predicted, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: forecast_granularity
attributes.description: The dimensional level at which this forecast record is generated. 'property' is the highest level; 'room_type_segment' is the most granular, combining room type and market segment dimensions as supported by IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the forecast run date to the forecast date, representing how far into the future this forecast projects. For example, a forecast run on 2024-01-01 for a stay date of 2024-04-01 has a horizon of 90 days. Used to assess forecast accuracy by horizon bucket.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: Classification of the algorithmic approach used to generate the forecast. 'time_series' uses historical booking patterns; 'regression' uses demand drivers; 'machine_learning' uses ML-based models; 'hybrid' combines multiple approaches; 'manual_override' indicates a revenue manager manually adjusted the system forecast.

attributes.name: forecast_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the demand forecasting model or algorithm used to generate this forecast record (e.g., 'IDeaS-G3-v8.2', 'EzRMS-v5.1'). Enables model performance tracking, A/B comparison, and audit of forecast methodology changes.

attributes.name: forecast_run_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the Revenue Management System (RMS) to the specific forecast generation run that produced this record. Enables traceability back to the originating RMS batch or on-demand run.

attributes.name: forecast_run_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast record was generated by the Revenue Management System. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this forecast record. 'active' indicates the current operative forecast; 'superseded' indicates a newer run has replaced it; 'draft' indicates a preliminary run not yet published to pricing decisions; 'published' indicates the forecast has been released to the Revenue Management System for pricing action; 'archived' indicates historical retention only.

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast methodology or purpose. 'unconstrained' reflects true market demand without inventory limits; 'constrained' reflects demand limited by available inventory; 'group_evaluation' is used for group block assessment in IDeaS G3 RMS; 'pickup' reflects incremental booking pace; 'budget' reflects the annual budget forecast baseline.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the forecast date falls on a public or national holiday in the property's market. Used to apply holiday demand adjustment factors in the forecasting model.

attributes.name: is_override
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a revenue manager manually overrode the system-generated forecast values for this record. When true, the forecast reflects human judgment rather than pure algorithmic output. Used to track override frequency and assess model trust.

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the forecast date coincides with a special event (e.g., conference, concert, sporting event, public holiday) that is expected to materially impact demand. When true, the forecast may incorporate event-specific demand uplift factors.

attributes.name: mpi_forecast
attributes.description: Forecasted Market Penetration Index (MPI), representing the property's projected occupancy share relative to the competitive set's projected occupancy. An MPI above 1.0 indicates the property is expected to capture more than its fair share of market demand.

attributes.name: projected_adr
attributes.description: Forecasted Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's local currency for the forecast date. Represents the expected average revenue per occupied room. Core revenue management KPI used to drive pricing strategy.

attributes.name: projected_cancellations
attributes.description: Forecasted number of room-nights expected to cancel from the current on-books position before the forecast date. Used to calculate net demand and inform overbooking strategy.

attributes.name: projected_no_shows
attributes.description: Forecasted number of room-nights expected to result in no-show arrivals on the forecast date. Used alongside cancellation forecasts to calibrate overbooking levels and protect revenue.

attributes.name: projected_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Forecasted occupancy rate expressed as a percentage of available rooms expected to be sold on the forecast date. Calculated as constrained demand divided by total available rooms. Key input to RevPAR and yield optimization decisions.

attributes.name: projected_pickup
attributes.description: Forecasted incremental room-nights expected to be booked between the forecast run date and the forecast date. Represents the additional demand the RMS expects to materialize beyond rooms already on books.

attributes.name: projected_revpar
attributes.description: Forecasted Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's local currency for the forecast date. Derived as projected ADR multiplied by projected occupancy rate. Primary yield optimization metric used by Revenue Management.

attributes.name: projected_room_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted total room revenue in the property's local currency for the forecast date. Calculated as projected rooms sold multiplied by projected ADR. Used for budget variance analysis and revenue strategy.

attributes.name: projected_rooms_available
attributes.description: Forecasted number of rooms available for sale on the forecast date after accounting for out-of-order, out-of-service, and maintenance blocks. Denominator for occupancy and RevPAR calculations.

attributes.name: projected_rooms_sold
attributes.description: Forecasted number of rooms expected to be sold (occupied) on the forecast date. Used for housekeeping scheduling, staffing planning, and inventory control decisions.

attributes.name: rgi_forecast
attributes.description: Forecasted Revenue Generation Index (RGI), representing the property's projected RevPAR relative to the competitive set's projected RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is expected to outperform its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report benchmarking data integrated into Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: rooms_on_books
attributes.description: Number of rooms already confirmed (on books) for the forecast date at the time the forecast was generated. Represents the definite demand component; the RMS adds pickup forecast to arrive at total projected demand.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the special event influencing demand on the forecast date (e.g., 'Super Bowl LIX', 'New Year Eve', 'City Marathon'). Populated only when is_special_event is true.

attributes.name: unconstrained_demand
attributes.description: The total forecasted room demand (in room-nights) without any inventory capacity constraints applied. Represents true market demand as estimated by the RMS model. Used to identify demand compression and inform inventory control decisions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this demand forecast record was last modified in the Silver Layer, such as when a revised forecast supersedes a prior run for the same forecast date and segment.

products.name: inventory_control
products.description: Inventory control records managing the complete room availability and pricing grid as applied in IDeaS G3 RMS. Encompasses hurdle rates, sell limits, overbooking levels, room type allotments, group blocks, and the resulting daily rate availability state per property, room type, and rate plan combination. Captures control type, room type, stay date, control value, system-recommended value, override indicator, overbooking policy parameters (max overbooking percentage, absolute cap, walk policy, compensation type, partner hotel agreements, approval authority), and real-time availability state (open/closed status, available inventory count, current BAR, minimum/maximum rates, last-updated timestamp). This is the SSOT for all inventory control decisions, overbooking policy configuration, and the rate/availability grid distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS for reservation fulfillment and channel distribution.

attributes.name: inventory_control_id
attributes.description: Primary key for inventory_control

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Inventory controls (sell limits, hurdles, stop-sells) vary by channel. Revenue managers allocate inventory differently across direct, OTA, GDS channels based on profitability and strategy. Fundamental

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Dynamic Rate Rule (DRR) applied to derive the current_bar for this room type and stay date. Links to the pricing strategy configuration governing automated rate adjustments in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Inventory controls (sell limits, hurdle rates, overbooking caps) are adjusted based on event booking displacement analysis. Essential for inventory optimization around events and group block allocatio

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Inventory control decisions (stop-sell, hurdle rates, overbooking) impact revenue posting and require GL mapping for revenue optimization tracking and financial analysis.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property (hotel, resort, or vacation property) to which this inventory control record applies. Aligns with Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration and IDeaS G3 RMS property setup.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate, package) associated with this inventory control record. Determines the pricing tier and restrictions applied to the available inventory.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard, Suite) for which this inventory control record is defined. Aligns with Oracle OPERA PMS room type configuration and IDeaS G3 RMS room class setup.

attributes.name: updated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Revenue managers set inventory controls; tracking updater essential for override authority validation, compliance audit trails, and accountability for sell limits, hurdle rates, and overbooking decisi

attributes.name: allotment_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms of this room type on the stay date allocated to contracted allotments (OTA allotments, wholesale, tour operator contracts). Managed via Sabre SynXis CRS channel management and reduces the freely-sellable transient inventory.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Designates the level of authority required to approve the overbooking level for this inventory control record. Ensures governance and accountability for overbooking decisions per property SOPs and SOX internal control requirements.

attributes.name: available_room_count
attributes.description: Real-time count of rooms available for sale for this property, room type, stay date, and rate plan combination at the time of last update. Reflects physical inventory minus confirmed reservations, group blocks, and out-of-order rooms. Distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS for reservation fulfillment.

attributes.name: control_record_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this inventory control record as referenced in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this inventory control record indicating whether the room type/rate plan combination is open for sale, closed, restricted, pending review, or subject to a manual override. This is the real-time availability state distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classifies the category of inventory control applied to this record. Determines how the control_value is interpreted and enforced by the Revenue Management System. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurdle_rate|sell_limit|overbooking_level|los_restriction|cta_restriction|ctd_restriction|allotment|group_block — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_value
attributes.description: The operative value for this control record as applied by the Revenue Management System. Interpretation depends on control_type: for hurdle_rate it is the minimum acceptable rate in local currency; for sell_limit it is the maximum rooms to sell; for overbooking_level it is the number of rooms above physical capacity authorized to sell.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory control record was first created in the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary rate fields in this record (current_bar, min_rate, max_rate, hurdle_rate). Ensures multi-currency properties report rates in the correct denomination.

attributes.name: current_bar
attributes.description: The current Best Available Rate (BAR) in local currency for this room type and stay date as published via Sabre SynXis CRS and channel distribution. Represents the lowest publicly available non-restricted rate and is the primary pricing signal for transient demand.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_rooms
attributes.description: IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS demand forecast for unconstrained room demand for this room type on the stay date at the time this control record was generated. Used to contextualize the control_value against projected demand and support RevPAR optimization.

attributes.name: effective_from_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time from which this inventory control record's control_value and restrictions became operative in the Revenue Management System. Supports temporal validity tracking and historical rate/availability grid reconstruction.

attributes.name: effective_until_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this inventory control record's control_value and restrictions ceased to be operative. Null for currently active records. Enables point-in-time historical analysis of the rate/availability grid.

attributes.name: group_block_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms of this room type on the stay date allocated to group blocks (MICE, tour groups, corporate groups). Reduces the transient sell limit and is managed via Delphi by Amadeus group block management and IDeaS G3 RMS group evaluation.

attributes.name: hurdle_rate
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable rate (in local currency) below which a reservation for this room type on the stay date should not be accepted, as determined by the Revenue Management System. Used in displacement analysis and group evaluation in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked for this room type and rate plan on the stay date (Closed to Arrival / CTA restriction). When True, guests may not check in on this date but may stay through it as part of a longer booking.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_departure
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked for this room type and rate plan on the stay date (Closed to Departure / CTD restriction). When True, guests may not check out on this date, requiring stays to extend beyond it.

attributes.name: is_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applied control_value represents a manual override of the system_recommended_value. True when a revenue manager has manually intervened; False when the system recommendation was accepted as-is. Critical for RMS model performance auditing.

attributes.name: last_distributed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory control record's rate and availability state was last successfully distributed to Sabre SynXis CRS and downstream channels (OTA, GDS). Critical for SLA monitoring and channel distribution reconciliation.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay when booking this room type at this rate plan on the stay date. Used to prevent long-stay displacement of higher-value transient demand during peak periods.

attributes.name: max_rate
attributes.description: The ceiling rate in local currency above which no rate plan for this room type and stay date may be sold. Used to enforce rate integrity, prevent rate gouging, and comply with local pricing regulations during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible to book this room type at this rate plan on the stay date. A Length of Stay (LOS) restriction used to optimize revenue during high-demand periods by requiring longer stays.

attributes.name: min_rate
attributes.description: The absolute floor rate in local currency below which no rate plan for this room type and stay date may be sold, regardless of channel or negotiated agreement. Enforced as a hard constraint in the Revenue Management System and CRS.

attributes.name: occupancy_on_books
attributes.description: Current confirmed occupancy rate (OCC) percentage for this room type on the stay date at the time of last update, calculated as confirmed reservations divided by physical_room_count. Key input to dynamic pricing and sell limit decisions in the Revenue Management System.

attributes.name: out_of_order_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms of this room type on the stay date designated as out of order (OOO) due to maintenance, renovation, or FF&E replacement. These rooms are excluded from sellable inventory and occupancy calculations per USALI standards.

attributes.name: overbooking_absolute_cap
attributes.description: Hard ceiling on the absolute number of rooms that may be overbooked above physical capacity for this room type on the stay date, regardless of the overbooking_pct calculation. Prevents excessive walk exposure during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Maximum authorized overbooking level expressed as a percentage above physical room capacity for this room type on the stay date. Defined in the overbooking policy and used by IDeaS G3 RMS to set the sell limit above physical_room_count.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded justification provided by the revenue manager when is_override is True. Documents the business rationale for deviating from the system recommendation (e.g., local event, competitive action, group displacement). Required for audit and RMS calibration.

attributes.name: physical_room_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical rooms of this room type at the property, representing the hard capacity ceiling before overbooking allowances are applied. Used as the denominator for occupancy rate (OCC) calculations.

attributes.name: rate_availability_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or process that set the current rate and availability state for this control record. Supports data lineage, audit, and reconciliation between IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, and Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: sell_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms authorized to be sold for this room type on the stay date, inclusive of overbooking allowance. Set by the Revenue Management System and may exceed physical_room_count when overbooking is authorized. Enforced at the CRS and PMS booking engine.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date (night of stay) for which this inventory control record applies. Represents the primary dimension of the rate/availability grid alongside property, room type, and rate plan.

attributes.name: system_recommended_value
attributes.description: The value recommended by the Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) prior to any manual override. Enables comparison between algorithmic recommendation and the applied control_value for yield optimization analysis and RMS model performance tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory control record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: walk_compensation_type
attributes.description: Type of compensation offered to a walked guest when the walk_policy requires compensation. Governs the financial and loyalty implications of overbooking execution and is tracked for Guest Recovery Rate (GRR) and CPOR reporting.

attributes.name: walk_policy
attributes.description: Defines the operational procedure to follow when a guest with a confirmed reservation cannot be accommodated due to overbooking (a 'walk'). Determines whether the guest is walked to a partner hotel, upgraded, or compensated per AHLA guest relocation standards.

products.name: performance_actuals
products.description: Daily revenue performance actuals at the property level capturing all revenue streams aligned to USALI departmental reporting. Includes room revenue metrics (ADR, OCC, RevPAR, rooms sold, rooms available, total room revenue) and total property revenue metrics (F&B revenue, spa revenue, parking, other operated departments, miscellaneous income, ancillary revenue, TRevPAR, GOPPAR, CPOR, GOP, EBITDA contribution). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA, reconciled against USALI standards. This is the single authoritative record for all daily revenue performance — both rooms and total revenue — used for the Daily Operations Report (DOR), ownership reporting, TRevPAR/GOPPAR calculation, and variance analysis against budget.

attributes.name: performance_actuals_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_actuals

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: RevPAR and room revenue actuals are tracked by cost center for departmental P&L, USALI reporting, and operational performance management.

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Daily actuals track which room nights and revenue came from specific event bookings for segment reporting. Required for event contribution analysis, MICE segment performance reporting, and group vs tr

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Actuals are compared against financial budgets for variance reporting, board presentations, and management performance evaluation against approved financial plans.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal calendar period (month/quarter/year) to which this performance date belongs, enabling USALI-aligned financial period reporting and variance analysis against budget.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Actual revenue performance posts to specific GL accounts for financial statement preparation, revenue recognition, and external financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Performance reporting breaks down revenue contribution by member tier for loyalty program ROI analysis. Business process: tier-level revenue attribution reporting required for evaluating loyalty progr

attributes.name: primary_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Daily actuals track outlet-level F&B revenue for TRevPAR calculation and USALI reporting. Required for total property revenue reporting, GOP analysis, outlet performance attribution in consolidated fi

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Property performance actuals roll up to profit centers for consolidated financial reporting, ownership reporting, and portfolio-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this daily revenue performance record is captured. Links to the property master entity in the Property domain.

attributes.name: reconciled_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Finance/revenue analysts reconcile daily actuals; employee attribution required for data quality accountability, reconciliation workflow tracking, and performance evaluation of financial reporting acc

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate in the property's operating currency, calculated as total room revenue divided by rooms sold (excluding complimentary). Core KPI for STR STAR Report benchmarking, RGI, ARI, and MPI calculations.

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue
attributes.description: Total ancillary revenue on the performance date from upsells, packages, resort fees, and add-on services not captured in departmental revenue lines. Supports total revenue and TRevPAR reporting.

attributes.name: ari
attributes.description: Average Rate Index representing the property's ADR performance relative to its competitive set, sourced from STR STAR Report. ARI > 1.0 indicates the property is achieving a rate premium over its comp set.

attributes.name: budget_adr
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Daily Rate for the performance date. Used for ADR variance analysis against actuals in the DOR, revenue management reporting, and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: budget_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Budgeted occupancy rate for the performance date as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75.00%). Used for occupancy variance analysis against actuals in the DOR and revenue management reporting.

attributes.name: budget_room_revenue
attributes.description: Budgeted room revenue for the performance date as approved in the annual operating budget. Used for variance analysis against actual room revenue in the DOR and ownership reporting.

attributes.name: budget_total_revenue
attributes.description: Budgeted total property revenue for the performance date as approved in the annual operating budget. Used for total revenue variance analysis in the DOR and ownership reporting.

attributes.name: channel_direct_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold through direct channels (brand website, call center, walk-in) on the performance date. Supports direct vs. indirect channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: channel_ota_rooms
attributes.business_glossary_term: Online Travel Agency (OTA) Channel Rooms Sold
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold through Online Travel Agency (OTA) channels (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com) on the performance date. Supports channel distribution mix analysis and OTA commission cost management.

tag_set.value: Online Travel Agency (OTA) Channel Rooms Sold

attributes.name: cpor
attributes.description: Cost Per Occupied Room on the performance date, calculated as total rooms department operating expenses divided by rooms sold. Measures operational efficiency of the rooms department per USALI.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance actual record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this performance record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency property portfolio reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_rooms
attributes.description: Forecasted number of rooms to be sold on the performance date as generated by the Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Used for variance analysis between forecast and actual rooms sold.

attributes.name: ebitda_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution
attributes.description: Property-level EBITDA contribution on the performance date, representing operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. Used for ownership reporting, asset valuation, and management contract performance measurement.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total Food and Beverage revenue generated on the performance date across all F&B outlets (restaurants, bars, banquets, in-room dining). Sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS and reconciled against SAP S/4HANA. Included in TRevPAR calculation per USALI.

attributes.name: gop
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit on the performance date, calculated as total operated department revenue minus total operated department expenses per USALI. Key profitability metric for ownership reporting and management contracts.

attributes.name: goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as GOP divided by rooms available. Measures overall property profitability efficiency. Core KPI for ownership reporting and management fee calculations.

tag_set.value: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this daily performance actual record has been reconciled between Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA General Ledger. True = reconciled and approved for reporting; False = pending reconciliation. Supports financial close and SOX controls.

attributes.name: miscellaneous_income
attributes.description: Total miscellaneous and rental income on the performance date including rentals, commissions, and other non-departmental income per USALI non-operating income classification.

attributes.name: mpi
attributes.description: Market Penetration Index representing the property's occupancy performance relative to its competitive set, sourced from STR STAR Report. MPI > 1.0 indicates the property is capturing more than its fair share of market occupancy.

attributes.name: occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Daily occupancy rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8250 = 82.50%), calculated as rooms sold divided by rooms available. Core KPI for the STR STAR Report, DOR, and ownership reporting. Stored as a raw ratio; display layer applies percentage formatting.

attributes.name: other_operated_dept_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue from all other operated departments on the performance date (e.g., golf, retail, recreation, business center) excluding rooms, F&B, spa, and parking. Classified per USALI other operated departments schedule.

attributes.name: parking_revenue
attributes.description: Total parking revenue generated on the performance date from valet, self-park, and garage operations. Classified under other operated departments per USALI and included in TRevPAR.

attributes.name: performance_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (business date) for which this revenue performance actual record applies. Represents the stay date or operating day used in the Daily Operations Report (DOR) and all KPI calculations.

attributes.name: prior_year_revpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)
attributes.description: RevPAR for the same calendar date in the prior year. Used for year-over-year (YOY) variance analysis in the DOR, STR STAR Report benchmarking, and ownership reporting.

tag_set.value: Prior Year Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this performance actual record indicating whether figures are preliminary (intra-day), final (end-of-day close), adjusted (post-close correction), or closed (period-locked). Supports audit and reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: revpar
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as ADR multiplied by occupancy rate (or total room revenue divided by rooms available). Primary rooms revenue KPI for ownership reporting, STR STAR Report, and RGI benchmarking.

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: Revenue Generation Index representing the property's RevPAR performance relative to its competitive set, sourced from STR STAR Report. RGI > 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its comp set. Core competitive benchmarking KPI.

attributes.name: rooms_available
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale on the performance date after deducting out-of-order (OOO) and out-of-service (OOS) rooms. Denominator for Occupancy Rate (OCC) and RevPAR calculations per USALI and STR STAR Report standards.

attributes.name: rooms_complimentary
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied on a complimentary (no-charge) basis on the performance date. Tracked separately per USALI for accurate ADR and revenue reporting, as complimentary rooms are excluded from ADR calculation.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_order
attributes.description: Number of rooms designated as out-of-order (OOO) on the performance date due to maintenance, renovation, or damage. Excluded from rooms available per USALI inventory standards.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Total number of rooms occupied (sold) on the performance date, including complimentary rooms. Used to calculate Occupancy Rate (OCC) and Average Daily Rate (ADR) per USALI standards.

attributes.name: segment_contract_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold under negotiated contract rates (airline crew, long-stay corporate contracts) on the performance date. Supports contract segment revenue analysis and channel mix reporting.

attributes.name: segment_group_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold to group accounts (MICE, corporate groups, tour groups) on the performance date. Supports group vs. transient mix analysis and group revenue contribution reporting per USALI.

attributes.name: segment_transient_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold to transient (individual/FIT) guests on the performance date. Supports segment-level revenue analysis and channel mix reporting per USALI market segmentation standards.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this performance actual record was sourced or reconciled (e.g., Oracle OPERA PMS for rooms data, SAP S/4HANA for financial totals). Supports data lineage and reconciliation audits.

attributes.name: spa_revenue
attributes.description: Total spa and wellness revenue generated on the performance date. Included in total property revenue and TRevPAR calculation per USALI other operated departments classification.

attributes.name: total_property_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue across all operated departments and income streams on the performance date (rooms + F&B + spa + parking + other operated departments + miscellaneous + ancillary). Denominator basis for TRevPAR. Reconciled against SAP S/4HANA GL per USALI.

attributes.name: total_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross room revenue generated on the performance date across all rate plans and channels, before deductions. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and reconciled against SAP S/4HANA GL. Numerator for ADR and RevPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: trevpar
attributes.description: Total Revenue Per Available Room in the property's operating currency, calculated as total property revenue divided by rooms available. Measures total revenue productivity of the property beyond rooms. Core KPI for ownership and management reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance actual record was last modified, including post-close adjustments or reconciliation corrections. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: market_segment
products.description: Master classification of revenue market segments used for demand analysis, pricing strategy, and performance reporting. Defines segment code, segment name, segment category (transient, group, contract, wholesale, OTA, corporate, government, leisure, crew, airline), contribution margin profile, booking behavior characteristics, average lead time, and cancellation propensity. SSOT for market segment taxonomy aligned to STR segment definitions and used across revenue, reservation, and channel domains.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the market segment record. Primary key for the market_segment data product in the revenue domain. Role classification: MASTER_RESOURCE — this entity represents a classification resource used across revenue, reservation, and channel domains.

attributes.name: default_loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Market segments map to typical loyalty tiers for segmentation alignment and forecasting. Business process: aligning revenue management segments with loyalty tier definitions for consistent guest class

attributes.name: loyalty_member_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_segment. Business justification: Revenue market segments correlate with loyalty member segments for unified guest profiling. Business process: cross-domain segmentation mapping enables consistent guest targeting across revenue optimi

attributes.name: preferred_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Market segments have outlet preferences/restrictions (corporate guests → business center cafe, leisure → poolside bar). Required for outlet positioning strategy, menu design, targeted marketing, guest

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_typical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Typical
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests in this market segment typically require ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessible accommodations. Relevant for government, medical, and certain group segments. Informs room inventory allocation and accessibility compliance reporting.

tag_set.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Typical

attributes.name: avg_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days between booking date and arrival date for this market segment. Key input for demand forecasting in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS. Segments with short lead times (e.g., OTA last-minute) require different yield strategies than long-lead corporate or group segments. Represents the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this resource.

attributes.name: avg_length_of_stay_nights
attributes.description: Average number of nights guests in this segment stay per booking (ALOS — Average Length of Stay). Used in revenue management for LOS (Length of Stay) restriction optimization, demand forecasting, and RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) modeling in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: cancellation_propensity
attributes.description: Qualitative classification of the historical cancellation rate tendency for this market segment. Informs overbooking strategy, no-show reserve calculations, and revenue protection policies in IDeaS G3 RMS. High-propensity segments (e.g., OTA flexible rate) require higher overbooking buffers.

attributes.name: channel_affinity
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel through which this market segment predominantly books. Drives channel strategy, OTA (Online Travel Agency) commission management, and GDS (Global Distribution System) rate loading decisions in Sabre SynXis CRS. Used for channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|ota|gds|voice|group|wholesale|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings in this segment are subject to travel agent or OTA commission payments.
