attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale for the stay_date at the property (net of out-of-order and out-of-service rooms). Denominator for occupancy rate (OCC) calculation and RevPAR computation. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pickup report record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement.

products.name: revenue_overbooking_policy
products.description: Property-level overbooking policy configuration defining authorized overbooking levels by room type, day of week, and season. Captures maximum overbooking percentage, absolute overbooking cap, walk policy (compensation type, partner hotel agreements), and approval authority. Managed by revenue management and enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: revenue_overbooking_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the overbooking policy record. Primary key for the revenue_overbooking_policy data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who formally approved this overbooking policy. Links to the workforce/employee master record. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Overbooking practices must comply with consumer protection policies. Overbooking policy approval requires compliance review to ensure fair walk procedures and compensation. Essential for consumer prot

attributes.name: primary_revenue_property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this overbooking policy applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_register. Business justification: Overbooking carries operational and reputational risk requiring risk management oversight. Risk committee reviews overbooking policies and monitors walk incidents. Essential for enterprise risk manage

attributes.name: ada_room_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessible rooms are excluded from the overbooking pool under this policy. True = ADA rooms are never overbooked. Required for ADA compliance.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational authority level required to approve and activate this overbooking policy. Defines the governance hierarchy for policy authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_manager|director_of_revenue|gm|corporate_rm|vp_revenue|cro — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy was formally approved by the designated authority. Recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: auto_adjust_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS is authorized to automatically adjust the overbooking percentage within the defined min/max bounds without manual revenue manager intervention. True = dynamic auto-adjustment enabled.

attributes.name: cancellation_rate_assumption_pct
attributes.description: Historical or forecast cancellation rate percentage used as the actuarial basis for setting the overbooking level. Derived from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS demand forecasting models and reviewed periodically by revenue management.

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Distribution channel scope to which this overbooking policy applies. 'all' = all booking channels. 'direct' = brand.com and direct reservations. 'ota' = Online Travel Agency bookings. 'gds' = Global Distribution System bookings. 'voice' = call center. 'group' = group block reservations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy record was first created in the system, recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: day_of_week_mask
attributes.description: Seven-character binary string representing the days of the week this policy applies to, ordered Monday through Sunday (e.g., '1111100' = Mon–Fri only, '1111111' = all days). Enables granular day-of-week yield optimization.

attributes.name: demand_tier
attributes.description: Demand classification tier from the Revenue Management System that this policy is calibrated for. Aligns with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS demand forecasting segments to enable yield optimization by demand level.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this overbooking policy becomes active and enforceable in the Property Management System and Revenue Management System.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this overbooking policy ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no defined end date.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this overbooking policy was formally reviewed by the revenue management team. Used to track compliance with the defined review frequency.

attributes.name: los_restriction_min
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) in nights required for this overbooking policy to apply. Supports LOS-based yield optimization strategies in IDeaS G3 RMS. Null indicates no minimum LOS restriction.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_walk_bonus
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program bonus points awarded to walked guests as additional compensation under this policy. Integrates with Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management and the Loyalty domain for points fulfillment.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_exempt
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty program tier codes (e.g., 'PLATINUM,DIAMOND') whose members are exempt from being walked under this policy. Integrates with Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management.

attributes.name: min_overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Minimum overbooking level as a percentage below which the revenue management system should alert or auto-adjust. Supports dynamic overbooking optimization in IDeaS G3 RMS to prevent under-selling.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this overbooking policy by the revenue management team. Drives workflow alerts in the Revenue Management System.

attributes.name: no_show_rate_assumption_pct
attributes.description: Historical or forecast no-show rate percentage used as the actuarial basis for setting the overbooking level. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS historical data and IDeaS G3 RMS forecasting models.

attributes.name: overbooking_cap
attributes.description: Maximum absolute number of rooms that may be overbooked above physical inventory, regardless of the overbooking percentage. Acts as a hard ceiling to limit walk exposure. Enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: overbooking_pct
attributes.description: Maximum authorized overbooking level expressed as a percentage above the physical room inventory for the applicable room type (e.g., 5.00 = 5% above capacity). Core yield optimization parameter managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and enforced in OPERA PMS inventory controls.

attributes.name: pms_rule_code
attributes.description: Oracle OPERA PMS inventory control rule code corresponding to this overbooking policy. Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse and the operational PMS configuration.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for revenue management team annotations, special conditions, or contextual notes about this overbooking policy (e.g., 'Applies during citywide convention periods only', 'Reviewed post-Q3 STR STAR Report').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the overbooking policy. 'active' means the policy is enforced in OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS. 'draft' indicates pending approval. 'suspended' means temporarily disabled. 'archived' means retired from use.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the overbooking policy by reservation segment. 'standard' applies to general transient bookings. 'dynamic' indicates IDeaS G3 RMS auto-adjusts levels. 'group' applies to group blocks. 'guaranteed' applies to guaranteed reservation types only.

attributes.name: rate_plan_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate plan codes (BAR, NRR, LRA, corporate, etc.) to which this overbooking policy applies. Null indicates the policy applies to all rate plans. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS rate distribution configuration.

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this overbooking policy is reviewed and potentially recalibrated by the revenue management team. Supports governance and continuous optimization of overbooking levels.

attributes.name: rms_policy_reference
attributes.description: Native policy identifier or rule code as stored in IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS. Enables direct cross-system traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the source RMS configuration.

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: OPERA PMS room type code to which this overbooking policy applies (e.g., 'KING', 'DBLQ', 'SUITE'). A null or wildcard value indicates the policy applies to all room types at the property.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Revenue management season classification code (e.g., 'PEAK', 'SHOULDER', 'OFF') that scopes this overbooking policy. Aligns with IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting season definitions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this overbooking policy record was most recently modified, recorded in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: vip_reservation_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether VIP-flagged reservations (loyalty elite, corporate VIP, celebrity) are excluded from walk eligibility under this policy. True = VIP reservations are protected from walk. Integrates with Salesforce CRM guest profiles.

attributes.name: walk_alert_threshold

attributes.name: walk_transport_included

products.name: revenue_budget

Captures planning period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target and budgeted ADR/occupancy/RevPAR/TRevPAR, budgeted room revenue, key tactical actions and strategic initiatives, budget version (original, revised, reforecast), strategy status (draft, approved, active), planning horizon, and approving revenue director. This is the SSOT for all revenue planning governance — both strategic direction and financial targets — used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR, management reporting, owner presentations, and strategic revenue governance.finance_budget as single source of truth]finance_budget. attributes.name: competitive_set_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue budgets are allocated to cost centers for departmental planning, manager accountability, and USALI-compliant departmental budget reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: event_booking_id

attributes.name: finance_budget_id

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment (e.g., transient leisure, transient corporate, group, wholesale, OTA) for which this budget is defined. Enables segment-level revenue planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: property_id

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue director formally approved this budget version. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'approved' strategy status.

attributes.name: budgeted_available_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be available for sale during the planning period (capacity baseline). Used as the denominator for RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR calculations and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: budgeted_cpor
attributes.description: Budgeted Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) in the property's operating currency, representing the planned direct operating cost per occupied room night. Used for profitability planning and variance analysis against actuals.

attributes.name: budgeted_events_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted revenue from Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) and event spaces for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and event sales governance in Delphi by Amadeus.

attributes.name: budgeted_fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Supports TRevPAR planning and USALI departmental revenue reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_gop
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit (GOP) in the property's operating currency for the planning period, per USALI departmental and undistributed expense structure. Used for GOPPAR derivation and owner NOI reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_occupied_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights planned to be occupied (sold) during the planning period. Derived from budgeted available rooms × target OCC, stored as a planning target for demand forecasting and group block management.

attributes.name: budgeted_other_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted ancillary revenue (spa, parking, resort fees, retail, etc.) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Completes the TRevPAR revenue stack beyond rooms, F&B, and events.

attributes.name: budgeted_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total budgeted room revenue (in operating currency) for the planning period and market segment. The primary monetary commitment in the revenue budget, used for variance analysis against actuals in the DOR and management reporting. Classified confidential as a strategic financial target.

attributes.name: budgeted_total_revenue
attributes.description: Aggregate budgeted total revenue across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + events + other) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. The top-line financial commitment used in owner presentations and EBITDA planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue budget record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent multi-currency reporting across global properties.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_source
attributes.description: Identifies the system or method used to generate the demand forecast underpinning this budget: 'IDeaS_G3' (IDeaS G3 RMS automated forecast), 'Infor_EzRMS' (Infor EzRMS forecast), 'manual' (revenue manager manual input), or 'hybrid' (combination). Supports data lineage and forecast accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal month or period number (1–12) within the fiscal year for monthly budget granularity. Supports period-level variance analysis in the DOR and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this revenue budget belongs (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the property's USALI-compliant financial reporting calendar and SAP S/4HANA GL fiscal periods.

attributes.name: is_owner_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget has received formal approval from the property owner or ownership group (True = owner-approved; False = pending or not required). Relevant for managed properties where owner sign-off is contractually required.

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text description of the near-term tactical revenue actions planned for this budget period (e.g., BAR adjustments, LRA controls, OTA channel mix shifts, promotional rate activations). Captured from the revenue strategy narrative in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or commentary associated with this revenue budget record (e.g., macro-economic assumptions, renovation impact adjustments, force majeure notes). Supports management reporting and audit documentation.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the planning horizon for this budget record: 'annual' (full-year plan), 'quarterly' (90-day rolling), 'monthly' (period-level), or 'weekly' (short-term tactical). Determines the reporting cadence for variance analysis.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-12-31 for an annual plan). Defines the effective end of the budget period.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning horizon covered by this revenue budget (e.g., 2025-01-01 for an annual plan). Defines the effective start of the budget period for variance tracking against actuals.

attributes.name: property_segment
attributes.description: Brand/service tier of the property for which this budget applies: 'luxury', 'premium', 'select_service', or 'extended_stay'. Enables cross-segment benchmarking and portfolio-level revenue governance.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this budget record, used in management reports, owner presentations, and cross-system references (e.g., SAP S/4HANA GL budget entries). Format: RB-{PropertyCode}-{Year}.

attributes.name: strategic_initiatives
attributes.description: Free-text description of longer-horizon strategic revenue initiatives included in this budget (e.g., loyalty program rate strategy, new OTA partnership, dynamic pricing rule (DRR) rollout, group business development targets). Supports owner presentations and management reporting.

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this revenue budget and strategy record. 'draft' = under preparation; 'approved' = signed off by revenue director; 'active' = in-period execution; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'archived' = closed period record.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the revenue strategy scope covered by this budget: 'transient' (FIT/BAR-driven room revenue), 'group' (MICE and group block revenue), 'total_revenue' (TRevPAR-level all-revenue planning), 'food_and_beverage' (F&B revenue plan), 'events' (event/conference revenue), or 'other'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version was formally submitted for review and approval. Used for governance tracking and audit trail in owner presentations and management reporting.

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Represents the planned average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Core revenue KPI used in STR STAR Report, RGI, and MPI benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_alos
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Length of Stay (ALOS) in nights for the planning period and market segment. Supports LOS-based pricing strategy, minimum stay restrictions, and demand pattern planning in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: Budgeted Average Rate Index (ARI) target, representing the property's planned ADR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property ADR / comp set ADR). Supports rate strategy and competitive positioning planning.

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Budgeted Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) in the property's operating currency. Represents the profitability target per available room after operating expenses, used in owner presentations and GOP governance.

tag_set.value: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: Budgeted Market Penetration Index (MPI) target, representing the property's planned occupancy performance relative to its STR competitive set (property OCC / comp set OCC). Supports competitive benchmarking strategy.

attributes.name: target_occupancy_rate
attributes.description: Budgeted occupancy rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the planning period. Represents the planned proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core KPI input for RevPAR calculation and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the planning period. Calculated as ADR × OCC but stored as a strategic target for direct comparison against actuals and STR competitive set benchmarks (RGI).

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: Budgeted Revenue Generation Index (RGI) target, representing the property's planned RevPAR performance relative to its STR competitive set (property RevPAR / comp set RevPAR). RGI > 1.0 indicates planned market share gain.

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
attributes.description: Budgeted Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) in the property's operating currency, encompassing all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, events, spa, parking, etc.) per available room. Supports total revenue strategy planning beyond rooms-only RevPAR.

tag_set.value: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)

attributes.description: Average number of days in advance that reservations were made through this channel (booking lead time). Measures booking pace by channel and informs dynamic pricing and rate restriction strategies in the Revenue Management System.

attributes.name: channel_mix_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total property booking volume or room nights attributable to this distribution channel during the reporting period. Measures channel contribution to overall distribution mix. Used for channel optimization strategy and OTA dependency analysis.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Average commission rate (as a percentage of gross revenue) paid to the channel partner during the reporting period. Calculated as commission_amount / gross_revenue * 100. Used to benchmark OTA commission costs and negotiate channel agreements.

attributes.name: contribution_status

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: data_extract_timestamp

attributes.name: gds_transaction_fees

attributes.name: gross_revenue

attributes.name: is_direct_channel
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a direct booking channel (brand.com, loyalty app, call center, walk-in). Direct channels carry zero or minimal commission cost. Used to track direct booking share as a KPI for reducing OTA dependency.

attributes.name: is_ota_channel

attributes.name: net_revenue

attributes.name: no_show_count

attributes.name: nrr_bookings_count

attributes.name: occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Occupancy rate (OCC) attributable to this distribution channel, expressed as a percentage of available rooms occupied by channel-sourced bookings. Supports channel-level yield analysis and demand forecasting integration with IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel contribution record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and GDPR compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel contribution record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, restatements, or corrections to channel revenue data. Required for SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: reporting_granularity

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date

attributes.name: room_nights

attributes.name: total_distribution_cost
