tag_set.value: Estimated Transient Average Daily Rate (ADR) Displaced

attributes.name: estimated_transient_rooms_displaced
attributes.description: Estimated number of transient room-nights that would be displaced (lost) if the group block is accepted. Derived from IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecast for the stay period.

attributes.name: fb_revenue_contribution
attributes.description: Estimated Food and Beverage (F&B) revenue contribution from the group if accepted, including banquet, catering, and outlet spend. Part of the total spend analysis supporting TRevPAR-based evaluation.

attributes.name: forecast_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Projected occupancy percentage (OCC) for the property during the stay period at the time of analysis, as sourced from the demand forecast. Contextualizes the displacement risk — high OCC increases displacement cost.

attributes.name: group_room_revenue
attributes.description: Total projected room revenue from the group block if accepted, calculated as proposed_group_rate × room_block_size × los_nights. Represents the revenue inflow side of the displacement equation.

attributes.name: is_peak_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay dates fall within a designated peak demand period (e.g., major events, holidays, high-season). Peak periods carry higher displacement risk and typically require higher minimum acceptable rates.

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether a special event (concert, convention, sporting event, etc.) is occurring in the market during the stay period, which may elevate transient demand and increase displacement cost.

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Total number of nights in the proposed group stay period (LOS). Calculated as stay_date_to minus stay_date_from. Used in yield optimization and LOS restriction analysis.

attributes.name: min_acceptable_rate
attributes.description: The minimum per-room per-night rate at which accepting the group block would be revenue-neutral or accretive, as calculated by the displacement model. Used by sales teams as a negotiation floor.

attributes.name: net_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Net revenue impact of accepting the group business, calculated as total_group_spend minus transient_room_revenue_displaced. A positive value indicates the group is accretive; negative indicates displacement loss exceeds group gain.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or commentary entered by the revenue manager regarding special circumstances, negotiation history, or strategic context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: proposed_group_rate
attributes.description: The proposed per-room per-night rate offered to the group or contract client. Compared against estimated transient ADR (Average Daily Rate) to determine revenue opportunity cost.

attributes.name: recommendation_outcome
attributes.description: Revenue management recommendation resulting from the displacement analysis. 'accept' indicates the group is revenue-positive; 'reject' indicates displacement loss exceeds group value; 'accept_with_conditions' requires rate or block size negotiation; 'defer' awaits further demand data; 'counter_offer' proposes alternative terms.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or director who reviewed and acted upon the displacement analysis recommendation. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the revenue manager completed their review and recorded the final recommendation outcome. Distinct from created_timestamp and updated_timestamp; represents the business decision event time.

attributes.name: revpar_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) attributable to accepting the group block, expressed as a positive or negative dollar amount per available room. Key KPI for revenue management decision-making.

attributes.name: rms_evaluation_reference
attributes.description: Native evaluation or job identifier assigned by IDeaS G3 RMS when the group evaluation was executed. Enables traceability back to the source system run for audit and re-evaluation purposes.

attributes.name: room_block_size
attributes.description: Total number of rooms in the proposed group or contract room block being evaluated for displacement impact. Core input to the displacement calculation.

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the room type or category requested in the group block (e.g., STD, DLX, STE). Used to assess displacement impact at the room-type level.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the special event influencing demand during the stay period, when is_special_event is true. Provides context for the displacement risk assessment.

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First night of the proposed group or contract stay period being evaluated. Defines the start of the displacement window for transient demand comparison.

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last night of the proposed group or contract stay period being evaluated. Defines the end of the displacement window for transient demand comparison.

attributes.name: total_group_spend
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue from the group across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + ancillary). Used as the numerator in the full displacement value comparison to support TRevPAR-based decision-making.

attributes.name: transient_room_revenue_displaced
attributes.description: Total estimated transient room revenue that would be lost if the group block is accepted, calculated as estimated_transient_adr_displaced × estimated_transient_rooms_displaced × los_nights. Represents the revenue opportunity cost.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the displacement analysis record was last modified. Tracks revisions made by revenue managers or automated RMS re-evaluations.

products.name: revenue_negotiated_rate
products.description: Corporate and wholesale negotiated rate agreements defining contracted pricing for specific accounts, travel management companies (TMCs), and consortia. Captures account identifier, rate code, negotiated rate amount, LRA (Last Room Availability) obligation, blackout dates, minimum night commitment, contract period, and rate loading status in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. Distinct from public rate plans — these are account-specific contracted rates. [SSOT_OWNER] [SSOT MASTER for group revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate]channel_negotiated_rate. [SSOT:negotiated_rate] Domain-specific specialization of the 'negotiated_rate' concept; canonical SSOT owner is channel.channel_negotiated_rate.

attributes.name: revenue_negotiated_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the negotiated rate agreement record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_account. Business justification: Negotiated rates are contracted with specific event accounts (corporate, consortia, national accounts). Essential for contract rate management, event planner rate loading, and account-specific pricing

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates are loaded to specific channels (GDS with specific chain codes, OTA corporate programs, direct booking engines). Rate loading and distribution tracking requires knowing whic

attributes.name: included_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates include outlet benefits (breakfast at specific outlet, lounge access). Required for contract fulfillment, benefit tracking, outlet revenue attribution, guest entitlement ver

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Negotiated corporate rates post to specific GL accounts for contract revenue tracking, corporate account profitability analysis, and revenue recognition compliance.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Negotiated rates are classified by market segment (e.g., Corporate, Wholesale). revenue_negotiated_rate has market_segment_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N negotiated_rate records → 1

attributes.name: minimum_loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates often include tier-based eligibility or enhanced benefits. Business process: enforcing tier requirements for corporate rate access, common in negotiated contracts that offer

attributes.name: negotiated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sales/revenue managers negotiate corporate rates; contract owner tracking required for renewal workflow management, commission attribution, and performance evaluation of negotiated rate portfolio mana

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates must comply with anti-discrimination and contract policies. Contract approval process validates policy compliance before rate activation. Essential for corporate rate govern

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this negotiated rate agreement applies. A single negotiated rate may be scoped to one property or replicated per property for multi-property contracts.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent rate plan definition under which this negotiated rate is structured. Links to the rate plan master in Sabre SynXis CRS or Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type to which this negotiated rate applies. Null if the rate applies to all room types under the agreement.

attributes.name: advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance a reservation must be made to qualify for this negotiated rate. Zero indicates same-day booking is permitted.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The contracted nightly room rate (Average Daily Rate) agreed upon for this account. Represents the fixed or base rate per room per night in the specified currency. Core pricing field for revenue management and contract compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this negotiated rate agreement. Rates must be approved by revenue management leadership before loading into CRS/GDS channels.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue management leader or director who approved this negotiated rate agreement for distribution.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate agreement received final approval for loading and distribution.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or date range expressions representing dates on which this negotiated rate is not available (e.g., peak demand periods, holidays, special events). Stored as a structured string; detailed blackout records are managed in the rate_restriction product.

attributes.name: breakfast_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether breakfast is included in the negotiated rate. Affects F&B (Food and Beverage) revenue allocation and rate value proposition reporting.

attributes.name: commission_pct
attributes.description: Commission percentage payable to the TMC, travel agency, or consortia for reservations booked under this negotiated rate. Expressed as a percentage of the negotiated rate amount.

attributes.name: committed_room_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights the account has committed to book under this negotiated rate agreement for the contract period. Basis for volume discount qualification and contract performance tracking.

attributes.name: consortia_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the travel consortia (e.g., Virtuoso, Signature, Ensemble, Internova) under which this negotiated rate is offered. Null for direct corporate accounts not affiliated with a consortia.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the negotiated rate agreement expires and the rate is no longer available for booking. Null for open-ended agreements. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External contract or agreement reference number assigned by the account, TMC, or legal department. Used for contract management, audit, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the negotiated rate agreement becomes contractually binding and the rate is available for booking. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR/CCPA data lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the negotiated rate amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code used to identify the hotel brand/chain in Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, and Worldspan for rate loading and distribution of this negotiated rate.

attributes.name: iata_number
attributes.description: IATA-assigned numeric identifier for the Travel Management Company (TMC) or travel agency associated with this negotiated rate. Used for commission tracking and GDS rate access validation.

attributes.name: is_lra
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiated rate carries a Last Room Availability (LRA) obligation, requiring the property to honor the contracted rate as long as any room of the applicable type remains available, regardless of demand or yield management controls.

attributes.name: is_non_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether reservations booked under this negotiated rate are non-refundable (NRR). Affects cancellation policy enforcement and revenue recognition timing.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive nights allowed per reservation under this negotiated rate. Null if no upper limit is imposed.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of consecutive nights required per reservation to qualify for this negotiated rate. Enforced at booking in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: min_night_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of room nights the account is contractually committed to consume during the contract period. Used for volume tracking and contract compliance reporting.

attributes.name: negotiation_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or sales manager responsible for negotiating and managing this rate agreement. Used for accountability and performance tracking.

attributes.name: rate_bar_variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage discount or premium of this negotiated rate relative to the Best Available Rate (BAR) at time of contract negotiation. Used by revenue management to assess rate competitiveness and yield impact.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric rate code used to identify and load this negotiated rate in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. This is the externally-known business identifier referenced in GDS/CRS rate loading and reservation transactions.

attributes.name: rate_includes_tax
attributes.description: Indicates whether the negotiated rate amount is inclusive of applicable taxes. Critical for revenue recognition, financial reporting, and guest billing accuracy.

attributes.name: rate_loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the negotiated rate was successfully loaded into Sabre SynXis CRS and/or Oracle OPERA PMS for distribution. Null if loading has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: rate_loading_status
attributes.description: Current status of the rate loading process in Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS. Indicates whether the negotiated rate has been successfully distributed to all applicable booking channels.

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the negotiated rate agreement, typically referencing the account or program name (e.g., 'Acme Corp 2025 Corporate Rate'). Used in reporting and rate management dashboards.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the negotiated rate agreement. Controls whether the rate is bookable and distributed through CRS/GDS channels.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing structure for this negotiated rate. Fixed rates are static for the contract period; dynamic rates may fluctuate within agreed bounds; tiered rates vary by volume; per diem rates are government-mandated ceiling rates.

attributes.name: source_system_rate_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this negotiated rate record in the originating operational system (Oracle OPERA PMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, or Salesforce CRM). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this negotiated rate record was last modified in the source system. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental ETL processing.

products.name: strategy
products.description: Revenue strategy records documenting the approved pricing and inventory strategy for a property over a defined planning horizon. Captures strategy period, property, strategy type (transient, group, total revenue), target ADR, target occupancy, target RevPAR, key tactical actions, strategy status (draft, approved, active), and approving revenue director. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions.

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Primary key for strategy

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Revenue strategies often incorporate specific marketing campaigns as tactical levers (e.g., deploy summer family campaign to drive weekend occupancy). Strategy owners need this link for execution trac

attributes.name: competitive_set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive set definition used for benchmarking this strategy. The competitor set defines the peer properties against which RGI, MPI, and ARI targets are measured via STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue strategies are implemented at cost center level for tactical execution, departmental accountability, and operational performance management.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast record that informed and underpins this revenue strategy. Links to the revenue.demand_forecast product to provide the analytical basis for strategy targets and tactical decisions.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Revenue strategies are aligned with financial budgets for strategic planning, ensuring revenue tactics support approved financial targets and ownership expectations.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this revenue strategy applies. Links to the property master record in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: superseded_by_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer revenue strategy record that replaced this one when status is 'superseded'. Enables lineage tracking of strategy evolution and supports audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the strategy status transitioned to 'active' and began governing live pricing and inventory decisions. Distinct from approval timestamp — a strategy may be approved in advance and activated at a later point.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Revenue Director or authorized revenue management leader who formally approved this strategy. Provides governance and audit trail for strategic revenue decisions per SOX internal controls requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the revenue strategy was formally approved by the authorizing Revenue Director. Establishes the official approval event in the strategy lifecycle for governance and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: channel_focus
attributes.description: The primary distribution channel(s) this strategy targets for demand generation (e.g., 'Direct Web', 'GDS', 'OTA', 'Voice/CRS', 'Corporate Direct'). Informs channel mix optimization and OTA partnership management decisions. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS channel codes.

attributes.name: strategy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this revenue strategy record within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used for cross-system reference and audit trail. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS strategy identifiers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the strategy lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary target values in this strategy record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: horizon_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the temporal scope of the strategy planning horizon. 'weekly' for short-term tactical adjustments, 'monthly' for rolling monthly plans, 'quarterly' for seasonal strategies, 'annual' for full-year budget-aligned strategies, 'event_based' for strategies tied to specific demand events.

attributes.name: inventory_control_approach
attributes.description: The approved inventory management methodology for this strategy period. 'open' allows all bookings, 'hurdle_rate' applies minimum rate thresholds, 'length_of_stay' (LOS) enforces minimum/maximum stay restrictions, 'nested' uses tiered availability controls, 'closed' restricts availability for specific segments or channels.

attributes.name: key_tactical_actions
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the specific tactical actions approved as part of this strategy (e.g., 'Open BAR for all channels on shoulder nights', 'Apply 5-night minimum LOS restriction over peak weekend', 'Close OTA channels when occupancy exceeds 85%'). Provides governance documentation for revenue decisions.

attributes.name: strategy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the revenue strategy (e.g., 'Q3 2025 Transient Yield Push', 'Holiday Season Total Revenue Strategy'). Used for identification in reporting and governance workflows.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this revenue strategy. Drives workflow triggers in the revenue management calendar and ensures timely strategy adjustments based on actual vs. target performance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text commentary, rationale, or contextual notes provided by the revenue management team regarding this strategy. May include market intelligence, competitive observations, or risk considerations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Together with planning_horizon_start_date, defines the full strategy window for yield optimization and performance tracking.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this revenue strategy. Defines the beginning of the stay-date window over which the strategy governs pricing and inventory decisions.

attributes.name: pricing_approach
attributes.description: The approved pricing methodology governing rate-setting for this strategy period. 'bar_based' uses Best Available Rate (BAR) as the anchor, 'dynamic' applies algorithmic Dynamic Rate Rules (DRR), 'fixed' uses static rate plans, 'hybrid' combines approaches, 'competitive_parity' aligns rates to competitive set benchmarks.

attributes.name: primary_market_segment_focus
attributes.description: The primary guest market segment this strategy is designed to optimize (e.g., 'Corporate Transient', 'Leisure FIT', 'Group MICE', 'OTA Leisure', 'Government'). Aligns with market segment codes used in Oracle OPERA PMS and IDeaS G3 RMS segmentation.

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The approved cadence at which this strategy is scheduled for performance review and potential revision by the revenue management team. Governs the operational rhythm of the revenue management process.

attributes.name: rms_strategy_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Strategy Reference ID
attributes.description: The native strategy or scenario identifier from the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Enables traceability back to the originating RMS record for reconciliation and system-of-record alignment.

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Strategy Reference ID

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy was created in response to a specific demand-driving special event (e.g., major conference, sporting event, concert, holiday period). When True, the strategy may include event-specific pricing premiums and inventory controls.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name of the demand-driving special event associated with this strategy when special_event_flag is True (e.g., 'Super Bowl LX', 'Annual Medical Conference', 'New Year Holiday Period'). Provides context for strategy rationale and post-event performance analysis.

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue strategy record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress, 'pending_approval' awaits revenue director sign-off, 'approved' is authorized but not yet in effect, 'active' is currently governing pricing decisions, 'superseded' has been replaced by a newer strategy, 'archived' is retained for historical audit.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue strategy by business segment. 'transient' covers individual guest pricing, 'group' covers group block strategies, 'total_revenue' encompasses all revenue streams (TRevPAR focus), 'food_and_beverage' targets F&B revenue optimization, 'events' covers MICE and event revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transient|group|total_revenue|food_and_beverage|events|loyalty — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: target_adr
attributes.description: The approved target Average Daily Rate (ADR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. ADR is the primary pricing KPI representing average revenue earned per occupied room per night. Used to benchmark actual ADR performance against strategic intent.

attributes.name: target_ari
attributes.description: The approved target Average Rate Index (ARI) for the strategy period. ARI = Property ADR / Competitive Set ADR. Measures the property's rate positioning relative to its competitive set. Used alongside MPI and RGI for comprehensive competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR) for the strategy period. GOPPAR incorporates operating costs and provides a profitability-adjusted view of revenue performance, aligned with USALI GOP reporting standards.

tag_set.value: Target Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: target_mpi
attributes.description: The approved target Market Penetration Index (MPI) for the strategy period. MPI = Property Occupancy / Competitive Set Occupancy. Measures the property's occupancy share relative to its competitive set as defined in STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: target_occupancy_pct
attributes.description: The approved target Occupancy Rate (OCC) expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for the strategy period. Represents the proportion of available rooms expected to be sold. Core input to RevPAR calculation and yield optimization decisions.

attributes.name: target_revpar
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) in the property's operating currency for the strategy period. RevPAR = ADR × Occupancy Rate. The primary composite KPI for hotel revenue performance and competitive benchmarking via STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: target_rgi
attributes.description: The approved target Revenue Generation Index (RGI) for the strategy period. RGI = Property RevPAR / Competitive Set RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report benchmarking data.

attributes.name: target_trevpar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)
attributes.description: The approved target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) encompassing all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, spa, events, ancillary) per available room for the strategy period. Relevant for total revenue strategies beyond rooms-only yield optimization.

tag_set.value: Target Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR)

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the last person to modify this strategy record. Supports change management and audit trail for revenue governance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue strategy record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change event for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this strategy record. Increments each time the strategy is revised and re-approved. Supports audit trail and change management for revenue governance workflows.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue management professional who created this strategy record. Supports governance, accountability, and audit trail requirements.

products.name: wash_factor
products.description: Group block wash factor records defining the expected attrition (wash) percentage applied to group room blocks when forecasting net group pickup. Captures group type, booking lead time bucket, historical wash percentage, adjusted wash factor, effective date, and property. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS to constrain group demand in the forecast and avoid over-displacement of transient business.

attributes.name: wash_factor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each wash factor record in the revenue domain Silver layer. Primary key for the wash_factor data product.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the market segment associated with this wash factor record (e.g., corporate group, association, SMERF, leisure group). Supports segment-level attrition analysis and Revenue Management System (RMS) demand segmentation.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this wash factor record applies. Enables property-level group demand forecasting and displacement analysis within IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the room type to which this wash factor applies. Allows wash factor differentiation by room category (e.g., standard, suite, accessible) for granular group block attrition modeling.

attributes.name: adjusted_wash_pct
attributes.description: Revenue manager-adjusted wash factor applied to group block forecasting after applying business judgment, seasonal adjustments, or RMS recommendations on top of the historical wash percentage. This is the operative value consumed by IDeaS G3 RMS for net group pickup forecasting and transient displacement calculations.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the revenue manager for any manual adjustment applied to the historical wash percentage to derive the adjusted wash percentage. Documents the business rationale for overrides (e.g., 'Adjusted upward due to new corporate account with unproven pickup history').

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the revenue manager or director who approved the adjusted wash percentage for use in RMS forecasting. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wash factor record was formally approved by the revenue manager for activation in the RMS. Provides a precise audit trail for governance and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: block_size_max_rooms
attributes.description: Maximum number of contracted group room nights that defines the upper bound of the block size tier. A null value indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., mega blocks with no ceiling).

attributes.name: block_size_min_rooms
attributes.description: Minimum number of contracted group room nights that defines the lower bound of the block size tier for this wash factor record.

attributes.name: block_size_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier representing the size of the group room block (e.g., small: 1–10 rooms, medium: 11–50 rooms, large: 51–200 rooms, mega: 200+ rooms). Block size is a significant predictor of wash behavior; larger blocks tend to exhibit higher attrition rates.

attributes.name: booking_lead_time_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical bucket representing the number of days between group block creation and the group arrival date. Lead time is a critical predictor of wash behavior; groups booked further in advance typically exhibit higher attrition rates. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS to apply the correct wash factor based on booking horizon.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel code associated with this wash factor (e.g., GDS, direct, OTA, voice). Group blocks sourced through different channels may exhibit distinct attrition patterns, warranting channel-specific wash factors.

attributes.name: wash_factor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this wash factor configuration within the Revenue Management System (RMS). Used as the business key for integration with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the historical wash percentage estimate, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Derived from the sample size and variance of historical group block attrition data. Informs revenue managers of the reliability of the wash factor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wash factor record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the record lifecycle in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer.

attributes.name: day_of_week_pattern
attributes.description: Day-of-week pattern for which this wash factor applies. Group attrition rates can differ between weekday and weekend arrivals. Used to apply day-of-week-sensitive wash adjustments in the RMS forecast.

attributes.name: displacement_impact_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of transient room revenue displaced by the group block after applying the wash factor. Quantifies the opportunity cost of accepting the group block versus holding inventory for transient demand. Used in group displacement analysis within IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this wash factor record becomes active and is applied by the Revenue Management System (RMS) for group demand forecasting. Supports temporal versioning of wash factor configurations.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this wash factor record ceases to be active. A null value indicates the record is open-ended and remains in effect until superseded. Enables temporal management of wash factor versioning.

attributes.name: factor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wash factor record. Controls whether the record is actively consumed by the RMS for forecasting. 'Superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record; 'pending_review' indicates the record requires revenue manager approval before activation.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group business type to which this wash factor applies. Group type is a primary driver of attrition behavior; corporate groups typically wash differently than SMERF (Social, Military, Educational, Religious, Fraternal) or association groups. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|association|smerf|leisure|government|sports|tour_operator — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: historical_observation_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the historical data window used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Together with historical_observation_start_date, defines the precise lookback period for wash factor derivation.

attributes.name: historical_observation_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the historical data window used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Defines the lookback period for the statistical derivation of the wash factor.

attributes.name: historical_wash_pct
attributes.description: Observed historical attrition (wash) percentage derived from actual group block pickup data. Represents the proportion of contracted group room nights that were not consumed (i.e., rooms blocked but not picked up). Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Source data from Oracle OPERA PMS group block history.

attributes.name: is_default_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wash factor record serves as the default fallback when no more specific wash factor matches a group block's attributes (group type, lead time, block size, season). True = default factor; False = specific factor.

attributes.name: is_rms_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Revenue Management System (RMS) Active Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wash factor record is currently being consumed by the Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) for live group demand forecasting and transient displacement calculations. True = actively used in RMS; False = not currently applied.

tag_set.value: Is Revenue Management System (RMS) Active Flag

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this wash factor record was most recently reviewed and validated by the revenue management team. Used to identify stale wash factors that may require recalibration.

attributes.name: lead_time_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days before arrival that defines the upper bound of the booking lead time bucket. A null value indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., 365+ days). Together with lead_time_min_days, precisely defines the lead time window.

attributes.name: lead_time_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days before arrival that defines the lower bound of the booking lead time bucket. Together with lead_time_max_days, precisely defines the lead time window for this wash factor record.

attributes.name: wash_factor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for this wash factor configuration (e.g., 'Corporate Group 30-Day Lead Time — High Season'). Used by revenue managers to identify and manage wash factor rules.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review and recalibration of this wash factor record. Derived from last_reviewed_date and review_frequency. Supports proactive revenue management governance workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional revenue manager commentary, special conditions, or contextual information relevant to this wash factor record. May include references to specific group accounts, market events, or RMS configuration notes.

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Prescribed frequency at which this wash factor record should be reviewed and recalibrated by the revenue management team. Ensures wash factors remain statistically current and reflective of evolving group booking behavior.

attributes.name: rms_wash_factor_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Wash Factor ID
attributes.description: Native identifier for this wash factor record as stored in the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver layer data product and the operational RMS source system.

tag_set.value: Revenue Management System (RMS) Wash Factor ID

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of historical group block observations used to calculate the historical wash percentage. Indicates statistical reliability of the wash factor; low sample sizes may warrant wider confidence intervals or manual override.

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Seasonal classification for which this wash factor is applicable. Wash behavior varies significantly by season; peak season groups may exhibit lower attrition due to higher demand, while off-peak groups may wash more aggressively.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wash factor record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: wash_pct_variance
attributes.description: Difference between the adjusted wash percentage and the historical wash percentage (adjusted_wash_pct minus historical_wash_pct). Quantifies the degree of manual override applied by the revenue manager relative to historical norms. Positive values indicate a more conservative (higher attrition) assumption.

products.name: total_revenue_actuals
products.description: Daily total revenue actuals aggregated across all revenue streams (rooms, F&B, spa, parking, ancillary) at the property level, aligned to USALI departmental reporting. Captures stay date, property, rooms revenue, F&B revenue, other operated department revenue, miscellaneous income, total revenue, CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room), GOP (Gross Operating Profit), and EBITDA contribution. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA. Supports TRevPAR and GOPPAR calculation.

attributes.name: total_revenue_actuals_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each daily total revenue actuals record at the property level. Primary key for this Silver Layer data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Total revenue actuals are tracked by cost center for USALI departmental reporting, manager accountability, and departmental P&L preparation.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Total revenue actuals are compared against financial budgets for variance analysis, board reporting, and management performance evaluation against approved plans.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal calendar period (month/quarter/year) under which this stay date falls, enabling USALI-aligned financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Total revenue actuals post to GL accounts for financial statement preparation, revenue recognition, and external financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: primary_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Total revenue actuals aggregate outlet-level F&B for TRevPAR calculation and USALI reporting. Required for financial consolidation, total property performance reporting, outlet contribution analysis t

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Total revenue actuals roll up to profit centers for consolidated financial statements, ownership reporting, and portfolio-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which total revenue actuals are recorded. Aligns with Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.

attributes.name: reconciled_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Finance analysts reconcile total property revenue; employee attribution required for data quality accountability, GL posting workflow tracking, and performance evaluation of financial reporting accura

attributes.name: adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue actuals record contains a post-close adjustment or restatement to previously posted figures. When true, the adjustment_reason field provides context. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any post-close adjustment or restatement applied to this revenue actuals record. Populated only when adjustment_flag is true. Required for SOX audit trail and USALI financial controls.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate for the stay date, calculated as rooms revenue divided by rooms sold. Core KPI for revenue performance benchmarking against STR STAR Report and competitive set. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS daily actuals feed.

attributes.name: ari
attributes.description: Average Rate Index for the stay date, representing the property's ADR divided by the competitive set's ADR. Measures the property's pricing performance relative to its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: complimentary_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied on a complimentary basis (zero-rated) on the stay date. Tracked separately per USALI and STR reporting standards to distinguish from revenue-generating occupied rooms.

attributes.name: cpor
attributes.description: Total operating cost per occupied room for the stay date, calculated as total departmental operating expenses divided by rooms sold. Key efficiency metric per USALI and AHLA benchmarking standards. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue actuals record was first created in the Silver Layer data product, typically following the nightly ETL load from Oracle OPERA PMS and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week corresponding to the stay date. Used for day-of-week revenue pattern analysis, demand segmentation, and yield optimization in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ebitda_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution
attributes.description: EBITDA contribution for the stay date at the property level, representing GOP less management fees and other fixed charges but before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA. Required for SOX financial controls and IFRS/GAAP reporting.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total net Food and Beverage revenue for the stay date, aggregated across all F&B outlets (restaurant, bar, banquet, in-room dining) sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS and Delphi by Amadeus. Aligns with USALI Food and Beverage Department.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the revenue figures were posted to the General Ledger in SAP S/4HANA. May differ from stay date due to night audit timing or period-end adjustments. Required for USALI and SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: gop_amount
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit for the stay date, representing total revenue minus total departmental and undistributed operating expenses, before fixed charges. Core USALI profitability metric sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL.

attributes.name: goppar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)
attributes.description: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as GOP divided by rooms available. Measures overall property profitability efficiency per available room. Key executive KPI per USALI and AHLA standards.

tag_set.value: Gross Operating Profit Per Available Room (GOPPAR)

attributes.name: house_use_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied for internal hotel use (staff, management) on the stay date. Excluded from revenue-generating occupancy per USALI and STR standards.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date falls on a public or bank holiday in the property's market. Used for holiday demand uplift analysis and dynamic pricing strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: is_special_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date coincides with a special event (e.g., convention, concert, sporting event) that materially impacts demand and pricing. Used in IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting and revenue strategy.

attributes.name: is_weekend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay date falls on a weekend (Friday or Saturday night per hospitality convention). Used for weekend vs. weekday revenue segmentation and pricing strategy analysis.

attributes.name: miscellaneous_income
attributes.description: Total net miscellaneous and non-operating income for the stay date, including rental income, cancellation fees, and other non-departmental revenue lines per USALI Non-Operating Income and Expenses.

attributes.name: mpi
attributes.description: Market Penetration Index for the stay date, representing the property's occupancy rate divided by the competitive set's occupancy rate. Measures the property's fair share of market demand. Sourced from STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: occupancy_pct
attributes.description: Occupancy percentage for the stay date, calculated as rooms sold divided by rooms available, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Core KPI for yield optimization and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: other_operated_dept_revenue
attributes.description: Total net revenue from all other operated departments (e.g., golf, retail, recreation, business center) for the stay date, excluding rooms, F&B, spa, and parking. Aligns with USALI Other Operated Departments aggregate line.

attributes.name: out_of_order_rooms
attributes.description: Number of rooms designated as out-of-order (OOO) on the stay date due to maintenance, renovation, or damage. Deducted from available room count per STR and USALI standards.

attributes.name: parking_revenue
attributes.description: Total net parking and valet revenue for the stay date, classified under USALI Other Operated Departments.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the revenue actuals record indicating whether figures are preliminary, posted to the general ledger, adjusted, period-closed, or voided. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA GL posting workflow.

attributes.name: reporting_segment
attributes.description: Brand or service tier segment of the property for this revenue record (e.g., luxury, premium, select-service). Enables cross-segment revenue performance benchmarking and portfolio analytics aligned with AHLA and STR segmentation standards.

attributes.name: revpar
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as rooms revenue divided by rooms available (or ADR multiplied by occupancy rate). Primary yield optimization metric tracked in IDeaS G3 RMS and benchmarked via STR STAR Report.

attributes.name: rgi
attributes.description: Revenue Generation Index for the stay date, representing the property's RevPAR divided by the competitive set's RevPAR. An RGI above 1.0 indicates the property is outperforming its competitive set. Sourced from STR STAR Report and Infor EzRMS.

attributes.name: rooms_available
attributes.description: Total number of rooms available for sale on the stay date after deducting out-of-order and out-of-service rooms. Denominator for RevPAR and TRevPAR calculations. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS inventory.

attributes.name: rooms_revenue
attributes.description: Total net rooms revenue for the stay date at the property, sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering. Represents the primary revenue line under USALI Rooms Department. Used as the numerator in ADR and RevPAR calculations.

attributes.name: rooms_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Budgeted rooms revenue for the stay date as set in the annual operating plan. Enables variance analysis between actual and budgeted rooms revenue performance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA budgeting module.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Total number of rooms occupied (sold) on the stay date, excluding complimentary and house-use rooms unless otherwise configured. Used to compute ADR and Occupancy Rate (OCC). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., OPERA PMS daily revenue summary ID or SAP S/4HANA document number). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.

attributes.name: spa_revenue
attributes.description: Total net spa and wellness revenue for the stay date, classified under USALI Other Operated Departments. Includes treatments, retail, and membership fees.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which revenue actuals are reported. Represents the business date (night) in Oracle OPERA PMS, used as the primary time dimension for ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR calculations.

attributes.name: total_operating_expenses
attributes.description: Total departmental and undistributed operating expenses for the stay date, including labor, cost of goods sold, and other direct costs across all departments. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA cost accounting. Used to derive GOP.

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Total net revenue across all revenue streams (rooms + F&B + spa + parking + other operated departments + miscellaneous income) for the stay date. Primary metric for TRevPAR calculation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA daily revenue close.

attributes.name: total_revenue_budget
attributes.description: Budgeted total revenue for the stay date across all departments as set in the annual operating plan. Enables variance analysis between actual and budgeted total revenue. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA budgeting module.

attributes.name: trevpar
attributes.description: Total Revenue Per Available Room for the stay date, calculated as total revenue divided by rooms available. Captures full revenue contribution across all departments beyond rooms. Key metric for holistic revenue strategy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue actuals record was last modified in the Silver Layer, reflecting any adjustments, restatements, or corrections applied after initial load.

products.name: segment_program_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the eligibility configuration between market segments and experience programs. It captures which market segments are eligible for which experience programs, along with segment-specific enrollment rules, discounts, and priority rankings. Each record links one market segment to one experience program with attributes that exist only in the context of this eligibility relationship.. Existence Justification: Experience programs are configured to target multiple market segments with segment-specific eligibility rules, discounts, and priority rankings. For example, a Romance Package program may be eligible for Leisure, Couples, and Transient segments, each with different discount percentages and priority levels. Conversely, a single market segment like Transient participates in multiple programs (Romance, Spa, Golf packages) with different eligibility criteria and effective dates for each program.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Guest loyalty program management including membership enrollment, tier management, points accrual and redemption, elite status benefits, partner integrations, and rewards fulfillment. Tracks member activity, lifetime value (LTV), engagement metrics, SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking), and program economics. Supports personalized offers, tier upgrades, and retention campaigns.

products.name: member
products.description: Core master entity representing a guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures membership identity, enrollment date, current tier assignment (FK to tier), lifetime points balance, LTV metrics (total revenue, stays, nights), SALT scores, program opt-in preferences, communication consent, membership number, and account status (active, suspended, closed). This is the SSOT for loyalty membership identity and current member state — distinct from the guest profile in the guest domain, which owns PII and stay history. References guest_id as a foreign key to the guest domain. Also serves as the anchor for member segment assignments (segment memberships tracked temporally within member_segment).
products.reference: Loyalty Member / CRM Member Record (Salesforce CRM)

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program member. Primary key.

attributes.name: marketing_guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.guest_segment. Business justification: Members are assigned to marketing segments for targeted campaign delivery, personalization, and offer optimization. Essential for marketing operations to identify which loyalty members belong to which

attributes.name: member_guest_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to guest.profile.profile_id — MUST-HAVE: Loyalty member must resolve to guest identity for personalization, stay history correlation, and profile merge operations. Without this FK, loyalty benefits cannot be applied at check-in.

attributes.name: primary_member_enrollment_hotel_property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the property where the member enrolled in the loyalty program, if enrollment occurred at a physical location.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the loyalty tier product. Represents the current tier assignment (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Elite).

attributes.name: account_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the membership account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for membership account closure. Used for churn analysis and program improvement.

attributes.name: communication_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive marketing communications and promotional offers from the loyalty program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the member record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_preference
attributes.description: Member's preferred currency for displaying points value and pricing. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: Current available points balance that can be redeemed by the member. Reflects earned points minus redeemed and expired points.

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive email communications. Separate from general communication opt-in for channel-specific consent.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for channel effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Marks the beginning of the member lifecycle.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Member's preferred language for communications and service delivery. Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code.

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's most recent completed stay. Used for recency analysis and churn prediction.

attributes.name: lifetime_nights
attributes.description: Total number of room nights stayed by the member since enrollment. Used for tier qualification and LTV (Lifetime Value) calculation.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative points earned by the member since enrollment. Used for tier qualification and lifetime value tracking.

attributes.name: lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the member across all stays, F&B (Food and Beverage), and ancillary services since enrollment. Key LTV (Lifetime Value) metric.

attributes.name: lifetime_stays
attributes.description: Total number of completed stays by the member since enrollment. Key metric for member engagement and tier qualification.

attributes.name: membership_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique membership identifier assigned to the loyalty program member. Used for member recognition and program transactions.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loyalty membership account. Active members can accrue and redeem points; suspended or closed accounts have restricted access.

attributes.name: next_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the member's next confirmed reservation. Used for engagement tracking and personalized offers.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) rating provided by the member. Scale of -100 to 100, measuring likelihood to recommend the brand.

attributes.name: partner_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to share their data with loyalty program partners (airlines, car rentals, etc.) for cross-program benefits.

attributes.name: points_expired
attributes.description: Total cumulative points that have expired due to inactivity or program rules.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total cumulative points redeemed by the member for rewards, upgrades, or benefits since enrollment.

attributes.name: preferred_room_type
attributes.description: Member's preferred room type for reservations. Used for personalized booking experiences and upgrade offers.

attributes.name: salt_score
attributes.description: SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking) composite score measuring member satisfaction and loyalty. Proprietary metric combining multiple engagement and satisfaction indicators.

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has consented to receive SMS/text message communications.

attributes.name: tier_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the member's current tier status expires. Used for tier renewal campaigns and retention efforts.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the member qualified for their current tier. Used for tier anniversary tracking and benefit eligibility.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the member record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member is designated as a VIP for special recognition and service. May be based on tier, LTV (Lifetime Value), or manual assignment.

attributes.name: ytd_nights
attributes.description: Number of room nights stayed by the member in the current calendar year. Used for annual tier qualification.

attributes.name: ytd_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the member in the current calendar year. Used for tier qualification and annual performance tracking.

attributes.name: ytd_stays
attributes.description: Number of completed stays by the member in the current calendar year. Used for annual tier qualification.

products.name: tier
products.description: Reference master defining the loyalty program tier hierarchy (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captures tier name, tier code, qualification thresholds (nights, stays, points, spend), benefit entitlements, upgrade/downgrade rules, tier validity period, and display order. Governs tier assignment logic and benefit eligibility across the program.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.program_config. Business justification: Tier definitions are part of program configuration - the tier structure is defined at the program level. Adding program_config_id links tier definitions to their governing program, enabling program-le

attributes.name: breakfast_benefit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive complimentary breakfast during their stays.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier (e.g., SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, DIAMOND). Used for system integration and display.

attributes.name: color_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dedicated_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have access to a dedicated customer service line or concierge team.

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tier, including benefits summary and value proposition, used for member communications and marketing.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying tiers in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: downgrade_grace_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months of grace period provided before downgrading a member who no longer meets qualification thresholds.

attributes.name: early_checkin_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before standard check-in time that members at this tier are entitled to for early check-in (e.g., 2 for 1pm check-in when standard is 3pm).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier definition expires or was discontinued. Null for currently active tiers with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier definition became or will become active and available for member assignment.

attributes.name: guaranteed_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have guaranteed room availability when booking within specified advance notice periods.

attributes.name: icon_url
attributes.description: URL or path to the icon or badge image representing this tier in digital channels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: partner_code

attributes.name: points_rate

attributes.name: redemption_rule_status

attributes.name: rounding_method

attributes.name: rule_code

attributes.name: rule_direction

attributes.name: rule_name

attributes.name: rule_priority

attributes.name: rule_type

For burn rules: free_night, upgrade, statement_credit, merchandise, experience. attributes.name: cash_amount

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel

attributes.name: fulfillment_date

attributes.name: fulfillment_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: monetary_equivalent_value

attributes.name: property_code

attributes.name: redemption_number

products.name: loyalty_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the event of a guest enrolling in the loyalty program, including status match acquisitions. Captures enrollment date, enrollment channel (front desk, website, mobile app, OTA, call center, partner, status match), enrollment property, enrollment campaign or promotion code, initial tier assigned, welcome bonus points awarded, consent flags (email, SMS, push), enrollment agent, and for status match enrollments: source program, source tier claimed, documentation submitted, match tier granted, match expiry date, and requalification requirement. Enables enrollment funnel analysis, channel attribution, and competitive member acquisition tracking.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or agent who processed the enrollment. Null for self-service digital enrollments.

attributes.name: primary_loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest who enrolled in the loyalty program. Links to the guest master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the enrollment occurred. Null for digital enrollments not associated with a specific property.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Marketing campaign or promotion code associated with the enrollment. Used for campaign performance tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country from which the enrollment was initiated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to complete the enrollment. Used for channel and user experience analysis.

attributes.name: documentation_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member submitted proof of status from the competitor program. Populated only for status match enrollments.

attributes.name: email_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member consented to receive email communications at the time of enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Represents the business event date of program membership initiation.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique enrollment transaction number used for tracking and customer service reference.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the enrollment transaction. Tracks the lifecycle state of the enrollment record.

attributes.name: enrollment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the enrollment was completed, including timezone information. Used for operational tracking and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: initial_tier
attributes.description: The loyalty tier assigned to the member at enrollment. Typically base tier unless status match or promotional tier granted.

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: match_expiry_date

attributes.name: match_tier_granted
attributes.description: The tier level granted in our program as a result of the status match. Populated only for status match enrollments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the enrollment agent or system regarding special circumstances or details of the enrollment.

attributes.name: privacy_policy_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member accepted the privacy policy at enrollment. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: privacy_policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the privacy policy that the member accepted at enrollment. Used for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: push_notification_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member consented to receive mobile app push notifications at the time of enrollment.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Referral code used by the enrolling member if they were referred by an existing member. Used for member-get-member program tracking.

attributes.name: requalification_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member must meet standard tier qualification criteria to retain the matched tier after expiry. Populated only for status match enrollments.

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points

products.name: benefit_entitlement

Captures benefit type (complimentary breakfast, room upgrade, late checkout, lounge access, welcome amenity, bonus points multiplier), entitlement source (tier standard, status match, manual grant, promotion), effective date, expiry date, usage limit, and remaining usage count.
