attributes.description: Method by which the fraudulent activity was detected. Rule-based indicates detection by predefined business rules; ML model indicates detection by machine learning algorithm; manual report indicates detection by fraud analyst review; partner notification indicates alert received from partner program; member report indicates member-initiated fraud report.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraudulent activity was first detected by the system or reported. Represents the business event time of fraud discovery.

attributes.name: false_positive_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the fraud alert was determined to be a false positive. Documents legitimate business activity that triggered the alert. Null if alert was not classified as false positive.

attributes.name: geolocation_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from source IP address geolocation. Used to identify suspicious cross-border activity.

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_to
attributes.description: User identifier of the fraud analyst or investigator assigned to review and resolve the alert. Null if alert is unassigned.

attributes.name: investigation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the investigation process, findings, evidence reviewed, and analyst observations. Confidential operational information.

attributes.name: investigation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when investigation of the fraud alert was initiated by an analyst. Null if investigation has not yet started.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud alert record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_case_number
attributes.description: Case or reference number provided by law enforcement agency if fraud was reported. Null if not reported to authorities.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether law enforcement authorities were notified of the confirmed fraud. True if notification occurred; false otherwise.

attributes.name: member_notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to notify the member of the fraud alert. Email indicates electronic mail; SMS indicates text message; phone indicates voice call; mail indicates postal mail; in_app indicates mobile application notification.

attributes.name: member_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loyalty member was notified of the fraud alert. Null if member was not notified.

attributes.name: member_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty member was notified of the fraud alert and investigation. True if member was contacted; false otherwise.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the fraud detection model or rule set that generated the alert. Enables tracking of model performance and alert quality over time.

attributes.name: monetary_value_involved
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the fraudulent activity in the program's base currency. Calculated based on points value, cash redemptions, or other financial impact.

attributes.name: points_amount_involved
attributes.description: Total number of loyalty points involved in the suspected or confirmed fraudulent activity. Null if fraud does not involve points movement.

attributes.name: points_reversed_amount
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points reversed or clawed back from the member account as part of fraud resolution. Null if no points reversal occurred.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when regulatory report was submitted to authorities. Null if no regulatory reporting was required or report not yet submitted.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fraud alert meets thresholds requiring regulatory reporting to authorities or industry bodies. True if reporting is required; false otherwise.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve the fraud alert. Account freeze indicates temporary suspension of account activity; points reversal indicates fraudulent points removed from account; password reset indicates forced credential change; account closure indicates permanent account termination; no action indicates alert closed without intervention; member notification indicates member contacted regarding suspicious activity.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the resolution decision, actions taken, and final outcome. Confidential operational information.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud alert was resolved and final action taken. Null if alert remains open or under investigation.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00, with higher scores indicating greater fraud likelihood. Generated by rule-based engine or ML model.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Business channel through which the triggering transaction or activity occurred. Web indicates website; mobile_app indicates mobile application; call_center indicates phone reservation or service; property indicates on-property transaction; partner indicates partner program; API indicates system-to-system integration.

attributes.name: source_device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used for the triggering transaction or activity. Desktop indicates web browser on computer; mobile indicates smartphone; tablet indicates tablet device; API indicates programmatic access; unknown indicates device type could not be determined.

attributes.name: source_ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address associated with the triggering transaction or suspicious activity. Used for fraud pattern analysis and geolocation. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: triggering_transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of loyalty program transaction or activity that triggered the fraud alert. Identifies the specific action that raised suspicion.

products.name: package_purchase
products.description: This association product represents the transactional event of a loyalty member purchasing or redeeming a spa package. It captures purchase-specific data including purchase date, expiration, sessions tracking, redemption method, and pricing that exists only in the context of this specific purchase transaction. Each record links one member to one spa package purchase instance with temporal and financial attributes.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality loyalty programs, members purchase or redeem spa packages multiple times over their membership lifecycle, and each spa package catalog item is purchased by many different members. The business actively manages these purchase transactions as distinct operational records, tracking purchase-specific data such as purchase date, expiration, sessions remaining, redemption method (points vs. cash), and purchase price. This is not a reference relationship but a transactional event that creates an entitlement record.

attributes.name: package_purchase_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this package purchase transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty member who purchased or redeemed the spa package

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the spa package catalog item that was purchased

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property where this package was purchased or is valid for use. May differ from member's home property.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation code provided to the member for this package purchase. Used for lookup and verification at spa reception.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package purchase record was created. Used for audit and operational tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase price. Supports multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this package purchase expires and can no longer be used. Calculated based on package validity rules and purchase date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package purchase record was last updated. Tracks status changes and session usage updates.

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this package purchase. Tracks whether the entitlement is active, in use, exhausted, or no longer valid.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the member to purchase or partially pay for this package. Zero if purchased with cash only.

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member purchased this spa package. Used for channel attribution and member behavior analysis.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date when the member purchased or redeemed this spa package. Marks the beginning of the entitlement period.

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Actual price paid by the member for this package purchase. May differ from rack rate due to promotions, member discounts, or dynamic pricing.

attributes.name: sessions_included
attributes.description: Total number of spa sessions or treatments included in this package purchase. Defines the entitlement quantity.

attributes.name: sessions_used
attributes.description: Number of sessions or treatments from this package that the member has already consumed. Used to track remaining entitlement.

products.name: promotion_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution contract between loyalty promotions and distribution channels. It captures channel-specific promotion configuration, budget allocation, performance targets, and rate adjustments that exist only when a specific promotion is made available through a specific channel. Each record links one promotion to one distribution channel with attributes governing how that promotion is presented, priced, and tracked in that channel.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, loyalty promotions are strategically distributed across multiple channels with channel-specific configurations. A single promotion (e.g., 'Double Points Summer') is simultaneously available through direct web, mobile app, OTA partners, and GDS with different rate multipliers, budget allocations, and display priorities per channel. Conversely, each distribution channel carries multiple concurrent promotions targeting different segments and travel periods. Marketing teams actively manage these promotion-channel distributions as operational records with performance tracking, budget monitoring, and channel-specific start/end dates.

attributes.name: promotion_distribution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this promotion-channel distribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the distribution channel carrying this promotion

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty promotion being distributed through this channel

attributes.name: actual_bookings
attributes.description: Cumulative count of bookings generated by this promotion through this channel. Updated as bookings are attributed to the promotion-channel combination.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total promotion budget allocated specifically to this distribution channel. Sum of all channel allocations should not exceed promotion.budget_cap_amount. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: budget_consumed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the channel-specific budget consumed by bonuses awarded through this channel. Tracks against budget_allocation_amount.

attributes.name: channel_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank controlling the display priority of this promotion within this channel when multiple promotions are active. Lower numbers = higher priority. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion-channel distribution record was created in the system.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this promotion distribution in this channel. Values: scheduled (configured but not yet live), active (currently available), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended normally), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion becomes available for booking through this specific channel. May differ from promotion.start_date to support phased rollout strategies. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion is no longer available through this channel. May differ from promotion.end_date to support channel-specific campaign windows. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: performance_target_bookings
attributes.description: Target number of qualifying bookings expected from this promotion through this channel. Used for channel performance tracking and ROI analysis. Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: promotion_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Channel-specific adjustment multiplier applied to the base promotion bonus for this distribution channel. Allows different bonus rates by channel (e.g., 2.0x for direct web, 1.5x for OTA). Identified in detection phase.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing team member who configured this promotion for distribution through this channel.

products.name: promotion_treatment_rule
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between promotion and treatment. It captures the specific terms under which a loyalty promotion applies to a spa treatment, including bonus multipliers, discounts, spend thresholds, and redemption limits. Each record links one promotion to one treatment with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship. This enables the business to configure promotion-specific treatment rules that are neither promotion-global nor treatment-intrinsic.. Existence Justification: In the travel hospitality loyalty business, promotions are frequently designed to incentivize specific service categories, including spa treatments. A single promotion (e.g., 'Summer Wellness Bonus') applies to multiple spa treatments (massage, facial, body wrap), and a single treatment can be included in multiple concurrent or overlapping promotions (e.g., 'Double Points on Spa', 'Birthday Month 20% Off', 'Elite Member Spa Discount'). The business actively manages promotion-treatment rules with treatment-specific terms such as bonus multipliers, discount percentages, spend thresholds, and redemption caps that are neither global to the promotion nor intrinsic to the treatment.

attributes.name: promotion_treatment_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this promotion-treatment rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty promotion offering the bonus or discount

attributes.name: treatment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the spa treatment eligible under this promotion

attributes.name: bonus_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base loyalty points earned when this treatment is purchased under this promotion. Example: 2.0 means double points. This is promotion-treatment specific and may differ from the promotion's global multiplier.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion-treatment rule was created in the system.

attributes.name: current_redemptions
attributes.description: Running count of how many times this promotion-treatment combination has been redeemed to date. Updated at point-of-sale.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the treatment price when purchased under this promotion. Example: 15.00 means 15% off. This is specific to the promotion-treatment combination.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific promotion-treatment rule expires. May differ from the promotion's overall end date if treatments are removed early.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific promotion-treatment rule becomes active. May differ from the promotion's overall start date if treatments are added mid-campaign.

attributes.name: maximum_redemptions
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this promotion can be applied to this treatment across all members. Used to cap exposure on high-value treatments within a broader promotion.

attributes.name: minimum_spend
attributes.description: Minimum spend amount required on this specific treatment to qualify for the promotion bonus or discount. Treatment-specific threshold within the promotion.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current status of this promotion-treatment rule. Values: active (currently in effect), paused (temporarily disabled), expired (end date passed), removed (manually deactivated).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the loyalty marketing team member who configured this promotion-treatment rule.

domains.name: channel
domains.description: Distribution channel management including OTA partnerships, GDS connectivity, direct booking channels, CRS (Sabre SynXis) channel mapping, and rate parity monitoring. Manages channel performance, commission structures, connectivity fees, booking source attribution, and channel mix optimization. Tracks cost of acquisition and channel contribution to revenue.

products.name: channel
products.description: Master registry of all distribution channels through which Travel Hospitality properties sell inventory, including OTA platforms (Expedia, Booking.com), GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo), direct web/mobile, voice/call center, corporate direct, wholesalers, and metasearch engines. Captures channel type, connectivity method, commission tier, rate parity obligations, and channel-level SLA parameters. This is the SSOT for channel identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Primary key for channel

attributes.name: channel_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Channel managers are employees who own distribution channel relationships, manage OTA partnerships, and handle channel performance. Standard hospitality practice tracks which employee owns each channe

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Distribution channels incur operating costs (connectivity fees, commissions, marketing) that must be allocated to cost centers for USALI-compliant departmental P&L reporting and budget variance analys

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Many distribution channels are operated by OTA partners (e.g., Expedia operates multiple channels/brands). This FK establishes the ownership relationship. Removes redundant platform_name which can be

attributes.name: primary_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Distribution channels often have primary marketing campaigns driving bookings. This FK enables attribution analysis and campaign performance tracking by channel. Essential for marketing ROI measuremen

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was first activated and began accepting live bookings. Distinct from contract_start_date which reflects the commercial agreement date. Used for channel onboarding tracking and performance benchmarking from go-live.

attributes.name: bar_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is eligible to display and sell the Best Available Rate (BAR) — the lowest publicly available rate at the time of booking. True = BAR rates are distributed to this channel; False = channel receives only specific contracted or negotiated rates. Drives rate distribution strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: booking_fee_usd
attributes.description: Per-transaction booking fee charged by the channel in addition to or instead of a commission percentage, expressed in USD. Common in GDS channels (e.g., GDS segment fee per booking). Used in cost-of-acquisition and channel profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the default cancellation policy applied to bookings made through this channel (e.g., '24H_FREE', '48H_PENALTY', 'NON_REFUNDABLE'). Cancellation policies may differ by channel based on contractual agreements. Managed in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: channel_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the channel by booking relationship: DIRECT = guest books directly with the property (web, mobile, voice, corporate direct); INDIRECT = third-party intermediary involved (OTA, GDS, wholesaler, metasearch); OPAQUE = rate and property identity concealed until after booking (e.g., Hotwire, Priceline opaque). Drives cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel mix strategy.

attributes.name: channel_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the distribution channel. active = channel is live and accepting bookings; inactive = channel is configured but not currently selling; suspended = channel temporarily halted (e.g., rate parity violation, connectivity issue); pending_activation = channel onboarded but not yet live; decommissioned = channel permanently retired.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel by its market segment and technology interface. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo); DIRECT_WEB = brand.com web booking; DIRECT_MOBILE = brand mobile app; VOICE = call center reservations; CORPORATE_DIRECT = negotiated corporate accounts; WHOLESALER = tour operators and bed banks; METASEARCH = Google Hotel Ads, Trivago. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|DIRECT_WEB|DIRECT_MOBILE|VOICE|CORPORATE_DIRECT|WHOLESALER|METASEARCH — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the distribution channel across enterprise systems including Sabre SynXis CRS, Oracle OPERA PMS, and IDeaS G3 RMS. Used for channel mapping and cross-system reconciliation. [DQ: denormalized natural key flagged for normalization to SSOT FK]

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The commercial model under which commission is calculated for this channel. NET_RATE = channel marks up a net rate provided by the property; GROSS_RATE = commission deducted from the gross rate charged to the guest; MARKUP = channel applies a markup over the property's net rate; FLAT_FEE = fixed fee per booking regardless of rate. Critical for accurate revenue and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage charged by this distribution channel on each booking, expressed as a percentage of the room revenue (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Drives cost-of-acquisition calculations and net revenue reporting per USALI standards. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Annual or periodic connectivity/subscription fee charged by the channel or switch provider for maintaining the technical integration, expressed in USD. Included in total cost-of-acquisition analysis alongside commission. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: connectivity_method
attributes.description: Technical integration method used to connect the property management system or CRS to this distribution channel. API = RESTful or SOAP API integration; XML = XML-based messaging (e.g., OTA XML); SFTP = file-based batch transfer; DIRECT_CONNECT = proprietary direct connection; SWITCH = via a channel manager switch (e.g., SiteMinder, Channex); MANUAL = manually managed extranet updates. Impacts SLA and rate update latency.

attributes.name: content_distribution_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether property content (room descriptions, images, amenities, policies) is actively distributed to this channel via a content API or content management system. True = content is pushed/synced to this channel; False = content is managed manually or not distributed. Relevant for OTA and metasearch channels.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for evergreen/open-ended agreements. Used for contract renewal management and channel lifecycle planning. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel became effective. Used for contract lifecycle management, commission audit trails, and regulatory compliance. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: crs_channel_code
attributes.description: Channel identifier as configured in the Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the enterprise data lakehouse and the CRS source of record. Enables traceability of bookings back to the originating CRS channel configuration. [DQ: denormalized natural key flagged for normalization to SSOT FK]

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was deactivated or decommissioned. Null for currently active channels. Used for channel lifecycle management, historical reporting, and audit trails. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: channel_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the distribution channel, including its market positioning, target guest segment, special contractual terms, or operational notes. Used for channel management documentation and onboarding reference.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processor
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel acts as a GDPR data processor for guest personal data collected during the booking process. True = a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is in place with this channel; False = channel does not process personal data on behalf of the property. Required for GDPR compliance and data governance.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code assigned to the hotel brand or property group within Global Distribution Systems (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, Worldspan). Required for GDS-type channels to route availability and rate requests correctly. Null for non-GDS channels.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of this distribution channel. GLOBAL = channel operates worldwide; REGIONAL = channel serves a specific geographic region (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe); DOMESTIC = channel serves a single country; LOCAL = channel serves a specific city or metro area. Used for channel mix strategy and market segmentation analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which room inventory is allocated to this distribution channel. POOLED = channel draws from the shared central inventory pool (real-time); ALLOTMENT = a fixed block of rooms is pre-allocated to the channel; FREE_SALE = channel can sell without prior allocation up to a defined limit; ON_REQUEST = bookings require manual confirmation. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel has Last Room Availability (LRA) rights — meaning the property must make the last available room accessible through this channel at the contracted rate. LRA is a common contractual obligation in corporate and GDS agreements. True = LRA applies; False = LRA does not apply.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_bookings_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings made through this channel are eligible for loyalty program points accrual and redemption. True = loyalty points are awarded and redeemable; False = bookings through this channel do not qualify for loyalty benefits (common for opaque OTA channels). Managed in Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management.

attributes.name: mice_bookings_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel supports group and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) bookings in addition to transient reservations. True = MICE/group bookings can be sourced through this channel; False = transient bookings only. Relevant for event sales and Delphi by Amadeus integration.

tag_set.value: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag

attributes.name: channel_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the distribution channel (e.g., 'Expedia Partner Central', 'Booking.com Extranet', 'Sabre GDS', 'Direct Web', 'Voice Reservations'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: nrr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether Non-Refundable Rate (NRR) products are distributed through this channel. True = NRR fences are available on this channel; False = only flexible/refundable rates are distributed. Impacts revenue management yield strategy and cancellation policy enforcement.

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Defines who collects payment from the guest for bookings made through this channel. HOTEL_COLLECT = property collects payment directly at check-in/check-out; CHANNEL_COLLECT = the OTA or intermediary collects payment and remits net to the property; SPLIT = partial payment collected by each party. Impacts accounts receivable and revenue recognition per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: pci_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel is certified as compliant with PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) for handling cardholder data. True = channel holds current PCI DSS certification; False = channel is not PCI compliant or certification has lapsed. Required for risk management and payment security governance.

attributes.name: primary_market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market served by this distribution channel (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Used for geographic channel mix analysis, market penetration reporting, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR for EU-based channels).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the strategic priority of this channel in the distribution mix, where lower numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority, typically direct web). Used by revenue management to determine inventory release sequencing and rate strategy. Configured in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: rate_parity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel contractually requires rate parity — i.e., the property must offer the same or lower rates on this channel as on any other channel. True = rate parity clause is active in the channel agreement; False = no rate parity obligation. Critical for revenue management compliance and rate strategy.

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation for this channel. BROAD = property must match rates across all channels including direct; NARROW = property must match rates on other OTAs but may offer lower rates on direct channels (common post-EU regulatory changes); NONE = no rate parity obligation. Drives revenue management and direct booking strategy.

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel remits collected payments to the property for CHANNEL_COLLECT payment model bookings. Applicable only when payment_model is CHANNEL_COLLECT or SPLIT. Drives accounts receivable forecasting and cash flow management in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: sla_response_time_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable response time in seconds for availability and rate queries from this channel, as defined in the channel's Service Level Agreement (SLA). Used to monitor channel connectivity performance and enforce SLA compliance. Typical values: 3 seconds for OTA/GDS, 5 seconds for XML channels.

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)

attributes.name: sla_uptime_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually committed uptime percentage for this channel's connectivity, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.90 for 99.9% uptime). Used to monitor channel reliability and enforce SLA penalties. Managed against actual uptime metrics in channel performance reporting.

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage

attributes.name: supported_currencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes supported by this distribution channel for booking and payment (e.g., 'USD,EUR,GBP,JPY'). Relevant for multi-currency rate distribution and foreign exchange management. Managed in Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes supported by this channel for content display and guest communication (e.g., 'en,fr,de,zh,ja'). Relevant for content localization strategy and international market reach.

products.name: ota_partner
products.description: Master data for Online Travel Agency partners including Expedia, Booking.com, Agoda, Hotels.com, Airbnb, and regional OTAs. Captures partner legal entity, contract reference, commission rate tiers, connectivity protocol (XML/API/GDS), rate parity clause status, preferred partner designation, market coverage, and account management contacts. Distinct from the channel record — an OTA partner may operate multiple channels (desktop, mobile app, affiliate).

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the OTA partner record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the ota_partner master data product.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: OTA account managers are employees managing partner relationships, negotiating contracts, and resolving disputes. Essential for accountability in partnership management, performance tracking, and esca

attributes.name: third_party_due_diligence_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Third Party Due Diligence Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.third_party_due_diligence. Business justification: OTA partners are third-party processors of guest PII and payment data, requiring due diligence screening for GDPR compliance, sanctions screening, cybersecurity assessment, and financial stability. Re

tag_set.value: Third Party Due Diligence Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: affiliate_network
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner operates an affiliate or sub-distribution network through which third-party websites or agents can book on behalf of the OTA. True = affiliate network active; False = direct OTA platform only. Relevant for booking source attribution accuracy.

attributes.name: base_commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage charged by the OTA partner on each confirmed booking, expressed as a percentage of the gross booking value (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Foundational input for cost-of-acquisition (COA) and channel profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_type
attributes.description: Default cancellation policy type applied to bookings made through this OTA channel. Flexible = free cancellation up to 24-48 hours; Moderate = partial penalty; Strict = high penalty; Non_Refundable = NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) — no refund on cancellation. Impacts revenue management and guest experience.

attributes.name: channel_manager_platform
attributes.description: Name of the channel manager or switch platform used to manage the technical connectivity to this OTA partner (e.g., Sabre SynXis, Siteminder, Amadeus iHotelier, RateGain). Relevant when connectivity is not direct API-to-API.

attributes.name: commission_model
attributes.description: Commercial model governing how the OTA partner earns revenue. Net Rate = hotel sells at net, OTA marks up; Merchant = OTA collects full payment and remits net; Agency = OTA collects commission on hotel-collected payment; Retail = standard published rate with commission; Opaque = rate hidden from consumer until post-booking (e.g., Hotwire).

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the connectivity fee is billed by the OTA partner or channel manager. Annual = yearly flat fee; Monthly = recurring monthly; Per_Booking = transactional fee per confirmed booking; One_Time = setup/onboarding fee only.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Annual or per-transaction connectivity fee charged by the OTA partner or channel manager for maintaining the technical integration (API/XML/GDS switch). Expressed in USD. Used for total cost-of-acquisition (COA) calculation and channel profitability reporting per USALI.

attributes.name: connectivity_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol used for two-way inventory, rate, and availability (IRA) connectivity between the hotel's CRS/PMS and the OTA partner. XML = legacy XML push/pull; REST_API = modern RESTful API; GDS = Global Distribution System switch; SFTP = file-based batch; OTA_XML = OpenTravel Alliance XML standard; HTNG = HTNG web services.

attributes.name: content_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) representing the completeness and quality of the hotel's content (photos, descriptions, amenities) on the OTA partner's platform. Higher scores correlate with improved search ranking and conversion rates. Sourced from OTA partner reporting APIs.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master distribution agreement with the OTA partner becomes legally binding and operational. Governs the start of commission obligations and rate parity clauses.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master distribution agreement with the OTA partner expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null indicates an evergreen/open-ended contract. Used for contract renewal management and risk monitoring.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the master distribution agreement or contract executed with the OTA partner. Links to the contract management repository in SAP S/4HANA for financial and legal audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OTA partner record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement (DSA) is in place with the OTA partner governing the exchange of guest booking data, anonymised analytics, and performance reporting. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance when guest PII is transmitted.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner is formally designated as a GDPR Data Processor under Article 28, processing guest personal data on behalf of the hotel as Data Controller. True = Data Processing Agreement (DPA) executed; False = not designated as processor.

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter chain code assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) to identify the hotel brand/chain within GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Applicable only when connectivity_protocol is GDS. Null for non-GDS OTA partners.

attributes.name: hq_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the OTA partner's legal headquarters is registered. Used for tax treaty application, withholding tax determination, and regulatory jurisdiction identification.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_model
attributes.description: Model governing how room inventory is made available to the OTA partner. Free_Sell = real-time availability from CRS with no pre-allocated block; Allotment = pre-contracted room block allocated to the OTA; On_Request = bookings require manual confirmation. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner contract includes a Last Room Availability (LRA) clause, requiring the hotel to make its last available room accessible to this channel. LRA clauses impact revenue management inventory controls and are tracked in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the OTA partner organisation as it appears on the master distribution agreement (e.g., Expedia, Inc.; Booking Holdings B.V.). Used for contract management, AP reconciliation, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: market_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the primary geographic markets or regions where the OTA partner has significant consumer reach and booking volume (e.g., 'North America, Western Europe'; 'Asia-Pacific'; 'Global'). Used for channel mix optimisation and market-specific distribution strategy.

attributes.name: mobile_app_channel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner operates a dedicated mobile application channel through which bookings are made. True = mobile app channel is active and tracked separately for attribution; False = desktop/web only. Supports channel mix and mobile booking trend analysis.

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the OTA partner's designated account manager. Used for commercial communications, promotional campaign coordination, and escalation. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4.

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OTA partner's designated account manager or market manager assigned to the hotel account. Primary point of contact for commercial negotiations, promotional campaigns, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the OTA partner's designated account manager. Used for urgent escalations and commercial negotiations. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4.

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the OTA partner within the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS). Used for channel mapping, rate distribution, and booking source attribution in Sabre SynXis and Oracle OPERA.

attributes.name: partner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OTA partner relationship. Active = live and distributing inventory; Pending = contract under negotiation or connectivity setup in progress; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., rate parity breach); Terminated = contract ended.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution partner by channel category. OTA = Online Travel Agency (Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (Sabre, Amadeus); METASEARCH = price comparison engine (Google Hotel Ads, Trivago); DIRECT = brand.com or call centre; WHOLESALE = tour operator/bed bank; AFFILIATE = sub-affiliate network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|METASEARCH|DIRECT|WHOLESALE|AFFILIATE — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: payment_collection_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party collects payment from the guest. Hotel = property collects at check-in/check-out (agency model); OTA = OTA collects full payment and remits net to hotel (merchant model); Split = partial payment collected by each party.

attributes.name: preferred_commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate applicable when the property holds preferred partner or sponsored placement status with the OTA. Typically lower than the base rate in exchange for enhanced visibility or placement. Null if preferred status is not applicable.

attributes.name: preferred_partner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hotel or brand holds preferred partner or sponsored placement status with this OTA, typically in exchange for a higher commission rate or marketing investment. Preferred partners receive enhanced search ranking and visibility on the OTA platform.

attributes.name: primary_market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the OTA partner's primary consumer market or country of dominant booking volume (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP). Used for geographic channel attribution and market penetration analysis.

attributes.name: rate_parity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner contract includes a rate parity clause requiring the hotel to offer rates no lower on other channels than those offered on this OTA. True = rate parity clause is active; False = no rate parity obligation. Critical for revenue management and legal compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation. Broad = hotel cannot offer lower rates on ANY channel including its own website; Narrow = hotel cannot offer lower rates on OTHER OTAs but may offer lower rates on its own direct channels; None = no parity obligation. Relevant for EU regulatory compliance following rate parity investigations.

attributes.name: remittance_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the guest check-out date within which the OTA partner remits commission payments or net booking proceeds to the hotel. Used for cash flow forecasting and AP/AR reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 30 = net-30 terms).

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of guest reviews published on the OTA partner's platform for the hotel. Used alongside review_score to assess statistical significance and platform engagement. Sourced from OTA partner reporting APIs.

attributes.name: review_score
attributes.description: Average guest review score for the hotel as published on the OTA partner's platform (e.g., Booking.com score out of 10, Expedia score out of 5). Used for reputation management, competitive benchmarking, and NPS/GSS correlation analysis via Medallia.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT, GST, or equivalent tax registration number of the OTA partner's legal entity. Required for tax invoice processing, withholding tax compliance, and AP reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing brand name under which the OTA partner operates (e.g., Hotels.com, Agoda). May differ from the legal entity name when the OTA operates multiple consumer brands under one legal umbrella.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OTA partner record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: gds_connection
products.description: Master configuration record for each Global Distribution System connection (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, Worldspan). Captures GDS network identifier, property chain code, pseudo city code (PCC), connectivity status, rate loading protocol, availability sync method, segment fee structure, and GDS-specific rate plan mappings. Supports GDS segment fee tracking and connectivity health monitoring.

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each GDS connection configuration record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this master configuration entity.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: GDS connections are associated with specific booking source codes for attribution when reservations come through GDS channels. Many GDS connections per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent distribution channel record associated with this GDS connection, enabling channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: GDS connectivity fees (segment fees, monthly charges) are departmental operating expenses requiring cost center allocation for accurate distribution cost tracking and budget management per USALI stand

attributes.name: gds_account_manager_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gds Account Manager Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: GDS account managers are employees managing GDS connectivity, troubleshooting technical issues, and optimizing GDS performance. Critical for operational accountability, issue escalation, and performan

tag_set.value: Gds Account Manager Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this GDS connection is configured. Links the GDS connectivity record to the specific hotel or resort property.

attributes.name: third_party_due_diligence_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Third Party Due Diligence Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.third_party_due_diligence. Business justification: GDS providers are third-party data processors handling guest PII and payment data, requiring due diligence for data security, sanctions compliance, and financial stability. Real business process: tech

tag_set.value: Third Party Due Diligence Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GDS connection was first activated and made live for bookings. Used for contract term tracking, connectivity health history, and channel distribution reporting.

attributes.name: availability_sync_method
attributes.description: Method by which room availability is synchronized between the property management system and the GDS. Real-time provides instant updates; batch updates on a scheduled interval; on_request queries availability at booking time; seamless provides live two-way availability.

attributes.name: chain_code
attributes.description: Two- to four-character hotel chain code registered with the GDS network, identifying the hotel brand or management company within the GDS. Assigned by the GDS provider and used for inventory and rate loading.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage commission payable to travel agents or GDS intermediaries on bookings made through this GDS connection. Used for commission accrual, accounts payable processing, and channel cost analysis per USALI standards.

attributes.name: connection_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the GDS connection. Active indicates live booking capability; suspended indicates temporary halt; pending_activation indicates setup in progress; decommissioned indicates permanently retired.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_monthly_usd
attributes.description: Fixed monthly fee charged by the GDS provider or switch vendor for maintaining the technical connectivity of this GDS connection. Distinct from per-segment fees; used for OpEx budgeting and channel cost allocation.

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: Technical connectivity model used for this GDS connection. Direct connect provides real-time two-way communication; switch connect routes through a switch provider; seamless provides full availability and rate transparency; standard uses batch updates.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the GDS connectivity contract. Null for evergreen contracts. Used for renewal alerts, contract renegotiation planning, and channel distribution continuity management.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the GDS connectivity contract governing this connection. Used for contract lifecycle management, renewal planning, and financial obligation tracking.

attributes.name: corporate_rate_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether negotiated corporate rates are loaded and accessible through this GDS connection. Corporate rates are a primary revenue stream for GDS channels and require specific rate plan configuration in the CRS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GDS connection configuration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking in the silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: crs_interface_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the CRS-to-GDS interface configuration within Sabre SynXis CRS. Links the GDS connection to the specific CRS interface instance managing rate distribution and availability synchronization.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which rates are loaded and displayed to travel agents in this GDS connection. Ensures rate accuracy and currency consistency for international GDS distribution.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GDS connection was or is scheduled to be deactivated. Null for currently active connections. Used for contract lifecycle management and channel distribution planning.

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking that determines the property's display order in GDS search results for travel agents. Lower values indicate higher priority. Influenced by GDS tier, participation level, and performance metrics.

attributes.name: gds_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the GDS provider (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo, Worldspan, Travelport). Used for reporting, dashboards, and channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: gds_network_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard two-character GDS network identifier assigned by IATA/ARC. 1S=Sabre, 1A=Amadeus, 1G=Galileo/Travelport, 1P=Worldspan. Used for routing and segment fee attribution.

attributes.name: gds_tier
attributes.description: Participation tier level for this GDS connection, reflecting the level of GDS merchandising, display priority, and content features contracted. Preferred tier provides enhanced display and content capabilities; standard is base participation; basic is minimal listing.

attributes.name: health_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent automated health check for this GDS connection. Healthy indicates full two-way connectivity; degraded indicates partial functionality; failed indicates connectivity loss; unknown indicates health check has not been performed.

attributes.name: last_health_check_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last GDS Connectivity Health Check Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent automated connectivity health check performed for this GDS connection. Used for SLA monitoring, connectivity uptime reporting, and proactive issue detection.

tag_set.value: Last GDS Connectivity Health Check Timestamp

attributes.name: lra_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability (LRA) is enabled for this GDS connection, requiring the property to make the last available room accessible to GDS bookers. LRA is a contractual obligation with some GDS providers and corporate accounts.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment code assigned to bookings originating from this GDS connection in the PMS (e.g., TRAN for transient, CORP for corporate, LEIS for leisure). Used for USALI-compliant revenue segmentation and STR STAR Report benchmarking.

attributes.name: max_advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in advance that reservations can be booked through this GDS connection. Controls the booking window loaded to the GDS and aligns with the Revenue Management System (RMS) inventory control horizon.

attributes.name: min_advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance that reservations must be booked through this GDS connection. Supports Last Room Availability (LRA) and advance purchase rate controls managed by the Revenue Management System.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes regarding this GDS connection, including special configuration requirements, known issues, contractual exceptions, or migration history. Used by channel distribution and revenue management teams.

attributes.name: nrr_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether Non-Refundable Rates (NRR) can be loaded and booked through this GDS connection. NRR support is a key revenue management capability enabling advance purchase rate strategies via GDS.

attributes.name: property_code_gds
attributes.description: The unique property identifier as registered within the specific GDS network. May differ from the internal PMS property code. Used for inventory display and booking routing within the GDS.

attributes.name: pseudo_city_code
attributes.description: GDS-assigned Pseudo City Code (PCC) that identifies the travel agency or booking office within the GDS network. Used for commission tracking, segment attribution, and agency relationship management.

attributes.name: rate_loading_protocol
attributes.description: The technical protocol or standard used to load and update rate plans into the GDS. HTNG and OTA are XML-based standards; DHISCO is a switch-based protocol; manual indicates rates are loaded via GDS terminal; API indicates direct programmatic loading.

attributes.name: rate_parity_enforced
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity is contractually enforced for this GDS connection, requiring that rates loaded to the GDS match the Best Available Rate (BAR) offered on direct channels. Critical for OTA and GDS contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: rate_plan_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct rate plans currently loaded and active for this GDS connection. Used to monitor rate plan coverage, identify gaps in GDS rate distribution, and support rate parity audits.

attributes.name: rate_update_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which rate updates are pushed from the Revenue Management System (RMS) or CRS to this GDS connection. Real-time supports dynamic pricing; scheduled frequencies reflect batch update configurations.

attributes.name: segment_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the GDS segment fee. Enables multi-currency cost-of-acquisition reporting for properties operating in non-USD markets.

attributes.name: segment_fee_usd
attributes.description: Per-booking segment fee charged by the GDS provider in US dollars for each reservation booked through this GDS connection. A GDS segment is one hotel booking transaction. Used for cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel profitability reporting.

attributes.name: support_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the GDS provider's technical support team for this connection. Used for connectivity issue escalation, health check alerts, and SLA breach notifications.

attributes.name: switch_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party switch provider (e.g., DHISCO, TravelClick, Pegasus) used to route availability and rate data between the CRS and the GDS, when connectivity_type is switch_connect. Null for direct connect configurations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GDS connection configuration record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance in the silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: uptime_sla_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDS Connectivity Uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA) Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually agreed minimum uptime percentage for this GDS connection as specified in the GDS connectivity SLA. Used for vendor performance monitoring and contract compliance reporting.

tag_set.value: GDS Connectivity Uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA) Percentage

products.name: crs_channel_mapping
products.description: Mapping configuration between Sabre SynXis CRS and each distribution channel, defining how rate plans, room types, and inventory controls are translated and published per channel. Captures CRS property code, channel-specific rate plan codes, room type mapping, inventory allocation rules, sell limits, and last-room-availability (LRA) flags. Critical for ensuring accurate rate and availability distribution across all connected channels.

attributes.name: crs_channel_mapping_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Central Reservation System (CRS) Channel Mapping ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CRS-to-channel mapping configuration record in the Sabre SynXis CRS. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a configuration resource defining how a property's rates, room types, and inventory are translated and published to a specific distribution channel.

tag_set.value: Central Reservation System (CRS) Channel Mapping ID

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: CRS channel mappings define which booking source codes are used for reservations from each channel. Many mappings per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source_code which can be retrieved via F

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct, voice, etc.) to which this mapping applies. Identifies the connected channel partner in the channel master.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: CRS channel mappings define how rate plans map between Sabre SynXis CRS and distribution channels. The crs_channel_mapping table has crs_rate_plan_code and channel_rate_plan_code (STRING). Adding chan

attributes.name: inventory_room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: CRS channel mappings must link channel room type codes to physical inventory room types for rate loading, availability synchronization, and booking fulfillment. Essential for channel manager operation

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which this CRS channel mapping is configured. Links the mapping to the specific property in the property master.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the cancellation policy applied to bookings made through this channel mapping (e.g., 'FLEX24H' for 24-hour free cancellation, 'NRR' for non-refundable). Determines the terms communicated to guests at the point of booking on the channel.

attributes.name: channel_contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the commercial contract governing the distribution relationship with this channel (e.g., OTA master agreement number, GDS connectivity contract ID). Used for contract management, commission dispute resolution, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: channel_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier code as recognized by the distribution channel (e.g., Booking.com hotel ID, Expedia property ID, GDS chain/property code). Used to match the CRS property to the channel's own property record during rate and availability pushes.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel type. Determines the connectivity protocol, commission structure, and rate parity rules applicable to this mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota|gds|direct_web|voice|mobile|wholesaler|corporate|metasearch — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage charged by the distribution channel on bookings made through this mapping (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Used for cost-of-acquisition analysis, channel profitability reporting, and USALI-compliant distribution cost accounting. Classified as confidential due to contractual sensitivity.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Fixed or per-booking connectivity fee charged by the channel or GDS switch for maintaining the distribution connection, expressed in USD. Used in total cost-of-acquisition calculations and channel ROI analysis per USALI standards.

attributes.name: connectivity_protocol
attributes.description: The technical messaging protocol used for rate and availability distribution between Sabre SynXis CRS and the channel (e.g., OTA XML, HTNG, OpenTravel Alliance ARI). Determines the message format and integration method. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA_XML|HTNG|OpenTravel|ARI|TravelPort|Amadeus|direct_API — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: content_sync_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether property content (room descriptions, images, amenities) is synchronized to the channel through this mapping in addition to rates and availability. Relevant for OTA and metasearch channels that require content distribution alongside rate/inventory feeds.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CRS channel mapping configuration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance with GDPR data processing records requirements.

attributes.name: crs_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier code as registered in Sabre SynXis CRS. This is the CRS-side property reference used in all rate and availability distribution messages to channels. Distinct from the internal property_id.

attributes.name: crs_rate_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Central Reservation System (CRS) Rate Plan Code
attributes.description: The rate plan code as defined in Sabre SynXis CRS (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate rate codes). This is the source-side rate plan identifier that is translated and mapped to the channel-specific rate plan code for distribution.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which rates are distributed to this channel (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency of rate publication and commission calculation for this channel mapping.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this CRS channel mapping configuration becomes active and rates/availability begin distributing to the channel. Used to schedule future mapping activations and track the start of channel distribution periods.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this CRS channel mapping configuration expires and distribution to the channel ceases. Null indicates the mapping is open-ended with no scheduled end date. Used for contract-aligned channel distribution management.

attributes.name: guarantee_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the payment guarantee policy required for bookings through this channel mapping (e.g., 'CC_REQUIRED' for credit card guarantee, 'DEPOSIT' for advance deposit). Ensures PCI DSS-compliant payment handling requirements are communicated to the channel.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_type
attributes.description: Defines how room inventory is allocated to this channel. 'pooled' means the channel draws from the shared inventory pool; 'allotment' means a fixed block is reserved for the channel; 'free_sell' means unlimited sell without allocation; 'on_request' means availability must be confirmed manually.

attributes.name: is_mobile_optimized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel mapping is configured to distribute mobile-specific rates or content optimized for mobile booking platforms. Supports mobile channel performance analytics and targeted mobile rate strategy.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful rate and availability synchronization push from Sabre SynXis CRS to the distribution channel for this mapping. Used to monitor channel connectivity health, detect stale distributions, and support SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel mapping is configured with Last Room Availability (LRA), meaning the channel has access to the last available room in the property's inventory. LRA is typically granted to GDS corporate accounts and preferred OTA partners under contractual obligation.

attributes.name: mapping_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this CRS-to-channel mapping configuration within Sabre SynXis. Used as the business identifier for cross-system reference and audit. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: mapping_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for this CRS channel mapping configuration (e.g., 'Booking.com Standard Rate Mapping - NYC Midtown'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: mapping_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of this CRS channel mapping. 'active' means the mapping is live and distributing rates/availability; 'suspended' means temporarily halted; 'testing' means in QA validation. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: mapping_type
attributes.description: Classification of what this mapping configuration governs — whether it maps rate plans, room types, inventory controls, packages, or promotional offers to the channel. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: The market segment code assigned to bookings originating from this channel mapping (e.g., 'LEISURE', 'CORPORATE', 'WHOLESALE', 'OTA'). Used for USALI-compliant revenue segmentation, STR benchmarking, and RevPAR analysis by channel.

attributes.name: max_advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in advance that a booking can be made through this channel mapping (booking window). Controls how far into the future availability is published to the channel. Null indicates no maximum booking window restriction.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for a booking through this channel mapping. Null indicates no maximum stay restriction. Used to control long-stay bookings on specific channels as part of yield optimization strategy.

attributes.name: min_advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance that a booking must be made through this channel mapping. Used to enforce advance purchase restrictions (e.g., NRR non-refundable rates requiring 7-day advance booking) as distributed via the CRS.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a booking to be accepted through this channel mapping. A value of 1 means no minimum stay restriction. Used to enforce LOS (Length of Stay) controls as part of revenue management strategy distributed via the CRS.

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Classification of the rate type distributed through this channel mapping. Indicates whether the channel receives Best Available Rate (BAR), Last Room Availability (LRA) rates, Non-Refundable Rates (NRR), corporate negotiated rates, packages, promotional rates, or wholesale rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bar|lra|nrr|corporate|package|promotional|wholesale — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rate_offset_type
attributes.description: Defines whether a rate adjustment (offset) is applied to the CRS rate before distribution to this channel. 'none' means the CRS rate is published as-is; 'flat_amount' means a fixed currency amount is added or subtracted; 'percentage' means a percentage markup or markdown is applied.

attributes.name: rate_offset_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the rate offset applied to the CRS rate before distribution to this channel. Positive values indicate a markup; negative values indicate a markdown. Interpreted as a currency amount or percentage depending on rate_offset_type. Null when rate_offset_type is 'none'.

attributes.name: rate_parity_enforced
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity rules are enforced for this channel mapping, requiring that the rates distributed to this channel match the Best Available Rate (BAR) published on other channels. Critical for OTA contract compliance and rate integrity monitoring.

attributes.name: sell_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms that can be sold through this channel per night under the current allocation configuration. A null or zero value indicates no sell limit is applied (free sell). Used to control channel-level inventory exposure and prevent overbooking.

attributes.name: sync_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Configured frequency in minutes at which rate and availability updates are pushed from the CRS to this channel. Lower values indicate near-real-time distribution (e.g., 5 minutes for OTA partners); higher values indicate batch distribution schedules.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CRS channel mapping configuration record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Critical for detecting configuration drift in channel distribution settings.

products.name: channel_rate_plan
products.description: Single source of truth is revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Channel-specific rate plan configurations defining which rate plans (BAR, NRR, LRA, corporate, package) are published to which channels, with channel-specific pricing adjustments, markup/markdown rules, and rate loading schedules. Captures rate plan code, channel applicability, rate derivation method (flat, percentage, derived from BAR), advance purchase restrictions, and cancellation policy linkage. Supports rate parity compliance and channel-specific pricing strategy. SSOT: defers to revenue.revenue_rate_plan (MVM).revenue_rate_plan as single source of truth] [SSOT:rate_plan] Canonical single-source-of-truth for the 'rate_plan' concept; other domain variants are domain-specific specializations referencing this owner. SSOT: defers to canonical revenue.revenue_rate_plan (MVM cross-domain dedup).

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel-specific rate plan configuration record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_offer. Business justification: Promotional rate plans operationalize marketing offers; a "Summer Sale" campaign offer manifests as specific rate plans loaded into distribution channels. Linking rate plans to offers enables offer pe

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Each channel-specific rate plan configuration belongs to one distribution channel. Many rate plans per channel. Removes redundant channel_code, channel_name, and channel_type which can be retrieved vi

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property for which this channel rate plan configuration applies. Enables property-level rate plan and channel management across a multi-property portfolio.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: add column revenue_rate_plan_id (BIGINT) with FK to revenue.revenue_rate_plan.revenue_rate_plan_id - channel rate plans must derive from the revenue master rate plan to resolve SSOT duplicate.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance of arrival that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan on this channel. For example, a value of 7 means the guest must book at least 7 days before check-in. Supports advance purchase rate strategies and demand management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the revenue management or distribution team member who approved this channel rate plan configuration for publication. Supports governance, approval workflow tracking, and audit compliance for rate distribution decisions.

attributes.name: base_rate_amount
