attributes.description: The base room rate amount (in property currency) from which the channel-specific rate is derived. For BAR-derived plans, this is the current BAR value. For flat rates, this is the fixed rate. Expressed per room per night. Supports rate parity monitoring and channel pricing strategy analysis.

attributes.name: booking_window_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date on which bookings can be made for stays under this channel rate plan. Defines the closing of the booking window. Nullable if the rate plan remains bookable indefinitely until the stay date.

attributes.name: booking_window_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest calendar date on which bookings can be made for stays under this channel rate plan. Defines the opening of the booking window for this rate plan on this channel. Used for promotional and advance purchase rate plan management.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation and penalty policy linked to this channel rate plan. Examples: FLEX24H (free cancellation up to 24 hours), NRR-NOCANCEL (non-refundable, no cancellation), SEMI-FLEX48H (partial refund if cancelled 48+ hours prior). Critical for NRR and advance purchase rate plans.

attributes.name: channel_rate_amount
attributes.description: The final channel-specific rate amount (in property currency) published to this distribution channel after applying the rate derivation method and adjustment. This is the rate visible to consumers on the channel. Per room per night. Core metric for rate parity compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the channel rate plan configuration. Active = currently published and bookable on the channel; Inactive = deactivated and not available; Suspended = temporarily paused (e.g., rate parity violation); Pending = awaiting activation or approval; Expired = past effective end date; Draft = configured but not yet submitted for distribution.

attributes.name: close_out_days
attributes.description: Number of days before arrival after which this rate plan is closed out and no longer bookable on this channel. Complements advance_purchase_days to define the booking window. A value of 0 means the rate is bookable up to the day of arrival.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage payable to the distribution channel (e.g., OTA, GDS, travel agent) for bookings made under this rate plan. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%). Critical for cost of acquisition analysis and channel profitability reporting.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee amount (in property currency) charged by the channel or connectivity provider per booking or per period for distributing this rate plan on the channel. Distinct from commission (which is percentage-based). Supports total cost of acquisition calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this channel rate plan configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.

attributes.name: crs_rate_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Central Reservation System (CRS) Rate Plan ID
attributes.description: The rate plan identifier as assigned in the Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CRS. Enables traceability of rate plan configurations back to the source system.

tag_set.value: Central Reservation System (CRS) Rate Plan ID

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rate amounts on this channel rate plan. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, AED. Supports multi-currency channel distribution and rate parity analysis across international markets.

attributes.name: days_of_week_applicable
attributes.description: A 7-character binary string indicating which days of the week (Mon-Sun) this rate plan is applicable on the channel. Each position represents a day: position 1=Monday through position 7=Sunday. '1' = applicable, '0' = not applicable. Example: '1111100' = Monday through Friday only. Supports weekday/weekend rate differentiation.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this channel rate plan configuration becomes active and the rate plan is published to the channel. Defines the start of the rate loading schedule for this channel-rate plan combination.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this channel rate plan configuration expires and the rate plan is no longer published to the channel. Nullable for open-ended configurations. Supports rate loading schedule management and seasonal rate plan publishing.

attributes.name: is_package_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel rate plan is a package rate that bundles room accommodation with additional inclusions (e.g., breakfast, spa credit, parking, F&B voucher). True = package rate with inclusions; False = room-only rate. Supports package revenue attribution and channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity rules apply to this channel rate plan configuration. True = this rate plan is subject to rate parity monitoring and must match rates across applicable channels; False = exempt from parity (e.g., opaque rates, member-only rates, negotiated corporate rates). Supports rate parity compliance management.

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings made under this channel rate plan are eligible for a refund upon cancellation. True = refundable (flexible rate); False = non-refundable (NRR). Key attribute for consumer transparency and rate plan classification.

attributes.name: last_loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate plan was most recently successfully loaded or updated on the distribution channel. Supports rate loading schedule management, troubleshooting, and audit of channel rate distribution operations.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay under this rate plan on this channel. Nullable if no maximum stay restriction applies. Used in conjunction with min_los to define the eligible stay window for this channel rate plan.

attributes.name: meal_plan_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the meal plan inclusion for this channel rate plan. RO = Room Only; BB = Bed and Breakfast; HB = Half Board (breakfast + dinner); FB = Full Board (all meals); AI = All Inclusive; EP = European Plan (no meals); CP = Continental Plan (continental breakfast). Relevant for package rate plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RO|BB|HB|FB|AI|EP|CP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible to book this rate plan on this channel. A value of 1 indicates no minimum stay restriction. Length of Stay (LOS) restrictions are a key Revenue Management System (RMS) tool for yield optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about this channel rate plan configuration. Examples: rate loading exceptions, channel-specific negotiation notes, promotional campaign references, or revenue strategy rationale.

attributes.name: pms_rate_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Property Management System (PMS) Rate Plan Code
attributes.description: The rate plan code as configured in Oracle OPERA Property Management System (PMS). Used for reconciliation between CRS channel distribution and PMS rate plan setup. Ensures rate plan consistency between the CRS and PMS for accurate reservation processing.

tag_set.value: Property Management System (PMS) Rate Plan Code

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel-specific pricing adjustment is a markup (rate higher than base, e.g., to cover OTA commission) or a markdown (rate lower than base, e.g., promotional discount). NONE indicates no adjustment is applied and the base rate is published as-is.

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_unit
attributes.description: Specifies whether the rate_adjustment_value is expressed as a PERCENTAGE of the base rate or as a fixed AMOUNT in the property currency. Determines how the channel-specific rate is computed from the base rate and adjustment value.

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the rate adjustment applied to derive the channel-specific rate from the base rate. Interpretation depends on rate_adjustment_unit: if PERCENTAGE, this is the percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%); if AMOUNT, this is the absolute currency amount. Used in conjunction with rate_adjustment_type to compute the final channel rate.

attributes.name: rate_derivation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the channel-specific rate from the base rate. FLAT = fixed absolute rate amount; PERCENTAGE = percentage markup or markdown applied to a base rate; BAR_DERIVED = derived as a percentage or offset from the Best Available Rate (BAR); YIELD_MANAGED = dynamically set by the Revenue Management System (RMS); NEGOTIATED_FIXED = fixed contracted rate for corporate or wholesale agreements.

attributes.name: rate_loading_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the rate plan loading process to the channel. Loaded = successfully transmitted and active on the channel; Pending Load = queued for transmission to the channel; Load Failed = transmission error requiring remediation; Not Loaded = not yet submitted; Deactivated = previously loaded but now removed from the channel.

attributes.name: rate_parity_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rate parity group to which this channel rate plan belongs. Rate plans within the same parity group are monitored for price consistency across channels. Enables grouping of comparable rate plans for parity compliance reporting.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the rate plan as configured in the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS). Examples: BAR, NRR, LRA, CORP001, PKG-BB. This is the business identifier used across Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS for rate loading and distribution.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the rate plan as displayed in the CRS and channel interfaces. Examples: 'Best Available Rate', 'Non-Refundable Rate', 'Last Room Availability Corporate', 'Bed and Breakfast Package'.

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate plan by its commercial structure. BAR = Best Available Rate (dynamic public rate); NRR = Non-Refundable Rate (discounted, no cancellation); LRA = Last Room Availability (guaranteed availability for corporate); CORPORATE = negotiated corporate rate; PACKAGE = bundled rate with inclusions; PROMOTIONAL = limited-time promotional rate; WHOLESALE = net rate for tour operators; NEGOTIATED = contracted rate; OPAQUE = channel-opaque pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BAR|NRR|LRA|CORPORATE|PACKAGE|PROMOTIONAL|WHOLESALE|NEGOTIATED|OPAQUE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: room_type_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of room type codes to which this channel rate plan applies. If null or 'ALL', the rate plan applies to all room types at the property. Examples: 'STD,DLX,STE' or 'ALL'. Supports room-type-specific channel pricing strategies.

attributes.name: stay_date_end
attributes.description: The latest arrival date for which this channel rate plan is valid. Bookings must have an arrival date on or before this date. Nullable for open-ended rate plans. Supports seasonal and promotional rate plan management.

attributes.name: stay_date_start
attributes.description: The earliest arrival date for which this channel rate plan is valid. Bookings made under this rate plan must have an arrival date on or after this date. Supports seasonal rate plan publishing and blackout date management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this channel rate plan configuration record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

products.name: booking_source
products.description: Reference master for booking source attribution codes classifying the origin of each reservation at sub-channel granularity. Captures source code, source name, parent channel association, source category (OTA desktop, OTA mobile, GDS corporate, direct web, direct app, voice, group, wholesale), and attribution hierarchy for revenue reporting. SSOT for booking source classification used across reservation and revenue domains for channel mix analysis, cost-of-acquisition attribution, and marketing campaign effectiveness measurement.
products.reference: OPERA PMS Source Code / SynXis Source Attribution

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each booking source attribution record in the channel distribution master. Primary key for the booking_source reference master. [ROLE: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity is a reference master / code list for booking source attribution codes; per canonical-attrs-enforced rule, REFERENCE_LOOKUP role is exempt from per-role minimums. _canonical_skip_reason: booking_source is a reference master / code table classifying reservation origin at sub-channel granularity; it does not represent a party, agreement, resource, transaction, or event log.]

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Booking source is a granular attribution code that rolls up to a parent distribution channel. Many booking sources belong to one channel. Removes redundant parent_channel_code and parent_channel_name

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Booking sources may be associated with specific OTA partners for attribution and commission tracking. Many booking sources can belong to one OTA partner. Removes redundant ota_partner_code which can b

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this booking source was first activated and made live for reservation acceptance in the CRS and PMS. Used for channel performance benchmarking (measuring ramp-up period) and historical channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: api_connectivity_type
attributes.description: Technical connectivity method used to exchange availability, rates, and inventory (ARI) data between the hotel's CRS/PMS and this booking source. Determines integration complexity, latency, and update frequency for rate and inventory distribution.

attributes.name: attribution_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the booking source attribution hierarchy used for revenue reporting roll-ups. Level 1 = top-level channel (e.g., OTA), Level 2 = sub-channel (e.g., OTA Desktop), Level 3 = specific source (e.g., Expedia Desktop US). Enables hierarchical channel mix analysis from property to brand level.

attributes.name: booking_source_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the booking source record. 'active' = currently receiving reservations; 'inactive' = temporarily disabled; 'pending' = configured but not yet live; 'suspended' = paused due to contract or compliance issue; 'retired' = permanently decommissioned. Used for channel activation management in Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: booking_window_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum advance booking window in days applicable to this booking source, as configured in the CRS. Defines the furthest point in advance that a reservation can be made through this channel. Used for long-range demand forecasting and group block management.

attributes.name: booking_window_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum advance booking window in days applicable to this booking source, as configured in the CRS and RMS. Defines the earliest point before arrival that a reservation can be made through this channel. Used for demand forecasting and inventory control in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the default cancellation policy applied to reservations booked through this source, as configured in Oracle OPERA PMS. Determines refundability rules (e.g., Non-Refundable Rate (NRR), flexible cancellation). Impacts revenue recognition and overbooking strategy.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the distribution channel type indicating whether the booking originates from a direct brand channel, an indirect intermediary (OTA/GDS/Wholesale), a voice channel (call center/reservation agent), or a group/MICE channel. Used for strategic channel mix reporting and direct booking ratio KPI tracking.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the basis on which commission is calculated for this booking source: net_rate (commission on net room rate), gross_rate (commission on gross rate including taxes), flat_fee (fixed amount per booking), or per_segment (GDS segment fee per booking). Drives commission calculation logic in accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage payable to the booking source intermediary (OTA, travel agency, GDS) per confirmed reservation. Expressed as a percentage of the net room revenue. Used for cost-of-acquisition (COA) calculation, channel profitability analysis, and accounts payable commission processing in SAP S/4HANA. Null for direct/zero-commission channels.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary fee charged per booking or per GDS segment for this booking source, expressed in the property's base currency (USD). Applicable when connectivity_fee_applicable is True. Used alongside commission_rate to compute total cost of acquisition (COA) per channel.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a GDS or channel connectivity fee is charged per booking for this source, in addition to or instead of a commission. True for GDS sources with per-segment fees (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). Used for total cost-of-acquisition calculation and channel profitability reporting.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the distribution agreement or contract with this booking source partner. Null for open-ended agreements. Used for contract renewal alerts, commission rate expiry management, and channel deactivation planning.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the distribution agreement or contract with this booking source partner. Used for contract lifecycle management, commission rate validity tracking, and channel activation scheduling in SAP S/4HANA contract management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this booking source record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and reference data change management. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: crs_source_code
attributes.description: Source code as configured in Sabre SynXis CRS for this booking source. This is the operational identifier used during reservation creation and rate distribution. May differ from the internal source_code when CRS uses a legacy or partner-assigned code.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which commissions and connectivity fees for this booking source are settled. Used for multi-currency commission processing in SAP S/4HANA accounts payable and foreign exchange reconciliation.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this booking source was deactivated or retired from the CRS and PMS. Null for currently active sources. Used for channel lifecycle management, historical reporting continuity, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: gds_code
attributes.description: Standard GDS identifier code for the booking source when the channel is a Global Distribution System participant. Applicable values include Amadeus (1A), Sabre (1S), Travelport Galileo (1G), Travelport Worldspan (1P). Null for non-GDS sources. Used for GDS connectivity reconciliation and GDS segment fee billing.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Defines the geographic reach of this booking source: global (worldwide distribution), regional (specific world region), domestic (single country), or property_specific (single property only). Used for channel distribution strategy and regional channel mix analysis.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agency Code
attributes.description: IATA-assigned numeric agency code for travel agency or OTA booking sources participating in IATA-governed distribution. Used for agency commission processing, GDS segment attribution, and travel agency performance reporting. Null for non-agency sources.

tag_set.value: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agency Code

attributes.name: inventory_update_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which room inventory and rate availability are pushed or synchronized to this booking source channel. Real-time channels receive instant updates via API; others receive batch updates. Impacts overbooking risk management and rate parity compliance.

attributes.name: is_direct_channel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking source is a direct brand channel (True) or an indirect intermediary channel (False). Direct channels include brand website, brand app, call center, and walk-in. Used for direct booking ratio KPI tracking and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking against indirect channels.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking source has Last Room Availability (LRA) contractual rights, meaning the channel must be offered inventory even when only the last room is available. LRA is a common contractual obligation in corporate and GDS agreements. Impacts inventory control rules in IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: marketing_attribution_model
attributes.description: Defines the marketing attribution model applied to bookings from this source for campaign effectiveness measurement and marketing ROI (Return on Investment) reporting. Used by Salesforce CRM and marketing analytics to attribute revenue to marketing campaigns. 'none' for channels not subject to marketing attribution (e.g., GDS corporate).

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Defines the payment collection model for this booking source: merchant (OTA collects payment from guest and remits net to hotel), agency (hotel collects and pays commission to channel), net_rate (channel marks up a net rate), or direct_bill (corporate direct billing). Impacts revenue recognition, accounts receivable, and cash flow management.

attributes.name: pms_source_code
attributes.description: Source code as configured in Oracle OPERA PMS for this booking source. Used for front desk reservation attribution, daily operations reporting (DOR), and property-level channel mix analysis. May differ from CRS source code due to property-level configuration.

attributes.name: preferred_partner_tier
attributes.description: OTA or channel partner tier classification indicating the level of preferred partnership status. Preferred partners typically receive enhanced placement, lower commission rates, or co-marketing benefits. Used for OTA partnership management and channel strategy prioritization.

attributes.name: rate_parity_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking source is subject to rate parity monitoring as part of the OTA contract or channel distribution agreement. When True, the Revenue Management System (RMS) and channel manager enforce rate parity rules to prevent undercutting on this channel. Critical for OTA contract compliance.

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the rate parity obligation for this booking source: full_parity (rates must match all channels), narrow_parity (rates must match other OTAs but may differ from direct), or no_parity (no rate parity obligation). Drives rate distribution rules in Sabre SynXis CRS and IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying booking source records in PMS, CRS, and reporting tool dropdown lists and channel mix reports. Lower values appear first. Used for UI configuration in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS administration screens.

attributes.name: source_category
attributes.description: Standardized sub-channel category classifying the booking source by interface type and traveler segment. Drives cost-of-acquisition attribution, commission tier assignment, and channel mix optimization analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota_desktop|ota_mobile|gds_corporate|direct_web|direct_app|voice|group|wholesale — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the booking source within the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS). This is the operational key used in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS for source attribution on reservations. Examples: 'EXPEDIA_WEB', 'GDS_AMADEUS', 'DIRECT_APP'.

attributes.name: source_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the booking source, including its operational context, target traveler segment, and how it integrates with the distribution ecosystem. Used for onboarding documentation and channel strategy reference.

attributes.name: source_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the booking source as used in reporting dashboards, revenue management analysis, and channel mix reports. Examples: 'Expedia Desktop', 'Amadeus GDS Corporate', 'Brand Direct App'.

attributes.name: supports_best_available_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking source is eligible to receive and display the Best Available Rate (BAR) as distributed through the CRS. Channels with full rate parity obligations typically receive BAR. Used in rate distribution configuration in Sabre SynXis CRS and IDeaS G3 RMS.

attributes.name: supports_loyalty_accrual
attributes.description: Indicates whether reservations booked through this source are eligible for loyalty program points accrual. Some OTA and wholesale channels contractually exclude loyalty point earning. Used by Salesforce CRM loyalty management module to determine points posting eligibility at check-in.

attributes.name: traveler_segment
attributes.description: Primary traveler segment targeted by this booking source. Classifies whether the channel primarily serves leisure travelers, corporate travelers, group bookings, MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions), wholesale/tour operators, or Free Independent Travelers (FIT). Used for demand segmentation and revenue mix analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this booking source record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

products.name: channel_inventory_allocation
products.description: Transactional records of inventory (room nights) allocated to specific channels per property, room type, and date range, including all inventory control actions (allocations, stop-sells, close-outs, and restrictions). Captures allocation quantity, sell limit, allotment type (free-sell, allocation, stop-sell), release date, consumed vs. available units, restriction type (minimum LOS, closed to arrival, closed to departure), reason code, applied-by user, effective and lift timestamps. Supports channel-level inventory controls, allotment management, revenue management restriction actions, and prevents overselling across distribution channels. SSOT: defers to canonical channel.inventory_allocation (MVM cross-domain dedup).
products.reference: SynXis Inventory Control / IDeaS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: channel_inventory_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inventory allocation record in the channel distribution system. Primary key for the inventory_allocation data product.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan associated with this inventory allocation. Determines which pricing rules apply to the allocated inventory on this channel.

attributes.name: primary_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct, voice, etc.) to which this inventory allocation applies. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration.

attributes.name: primary_channel_room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the room type (e.g., standard king, deluxe double, suite) for which inventory is being allocated to the channel.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which inventory is being allocated. Links to the property master record in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The type of inventory control action that generated this record. CREATE indicates a new allocation was established; UPDATE modifies an existing allocation; CLOSE applies a stop-sell or close-out; REOPEN lifts a restriction; RELEASE returns unsold inventory to the pool; OVERRIDE applies a manual revenue management override.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this channel inventory allocation. Active allocations are enforced by the channel management system.

attributes.name: allocated_units
attributes.description: The total number of room nights (units) assigned to this channel for the specified stay date range and room type. Represents the allotment block size or sell limit granted to the channel.

attributes.name: allocation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS) to uniquely identify this inventory allocation action. Used for cross-system reconciliation between Sabre SynXis CRS and Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inventory allocation record. ACTIVE indicates the allocation is live and controlling channel availability; INACTIVE means it has been superseded; EXPIRED means the stay date range has passed; CANCELLED means it was manually revoked; PENDING means it is awaiting activation.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Method by which inventory is allocated to this channel for this room type. POOLED = shared inventory pool, ALLOCATED = fixed allocation, FREESALE = unlimited access, BLOCKED = no access.

attributes.name: allotment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory allotment method applied to this channel. FREE_SELL allows the channel to sell without a fixed block; ALLOCATION assigns a fixed block of rooms; STOP_SELL halts sales on the channel; CLOSE_OUT removes all availability; ON_REQUEST requires manual confirmation before booking is confirmed.

attributes.name: applied_by_user
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the revenue manager or system user who applied this inventory control action. Used for audit trail, accountability, and change management reporting.

attributes.name: available_units
attributes.description: The number of room nights currently available for sale on this channel, calculated as allocated_units minus consumed_units. Represents the real-time sellable inventory for the channel on the specified stay dates.

attributes.name: cancellation_count
attributes.description: The number of bookings cancelled on this channel allocation since the last reporting snapshot. Used to track net pickup and assess channel-level cancellation patterns for demand forecasting.

attributes.name: channel_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total room type inventory allocated to this channel. Used for allocation-based inventory management strategies.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The category of distribution channel for this allocation. OTA (Online Travel Agency), GDS (Global Distribution System), DIRECT_WEB (brand.com), VOICE (call center), GSO (Global Sales Office), WHOLESALE (tour operators/wholesalers), METASEARCH (Google, Trivago, etc.). Supports channel mix optimization analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota|gds|direct_web|voice|gso|wholesale|metasearch — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.15 for 15%) payable to the distribution channel for bookings made under this allocation. Used for cost of acquisition analysis and channel profitability reporting.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee
attributes.description: The fixed or per-transaction connectivity fee charged by the GDS or CRS for distributing inventory through this channel. Expressed in the property's local currency. Used for total cost of distribution analysis.

attributes.name: consumed_units
attributes.description: The number of allocated room nights that have been booked or consumed by the channel as of the last system update. Used to calculate remaining availability and monitor channel pickup performance.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory allocation record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to financial fields (connectivity_fee) in this allocation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent multi-currency reporting across global properties.

attributes.name: days_out
attributes.description: The number of days between the allocation action date and the stay_date_from (booking window). Used in revenue management analysis to understand how far in advance inventory controls are being applied relative to the arrival date.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this channel inventory allocation configuration expires. Null for currently active allocations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this channel inventory allocation configuration becomes effective.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory allocation action became effective and was applied to the channel. Represents the business event timestamp when the allocation, stop-sell, or restriction was activated in the CRS.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked on the first date of the stay period for this channel and room type. When TRUE, guests cannot check in on the stay_date_from date, preventing new bookings that start on that date.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_departure
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked on the stay_date_to date for this channel and room type. When TRUE, guests cannot check out on that date, preventing bookings that end on that date.

attributes.name: is_rms_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory allocation action was automatically generated by the Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) as opposed to being manually entered by a revenue manager. Supports analysis of automation adoption and RMS recommendation acceptance rates.

attributes.name: is_stop_sell
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stop-sell control has been applied to this channel for the specified stay dates and room type. When TRUE, the channel is prevented from accepting new bookings regardless of remaining available units.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability (LRA) is contractually required for this channel. When TRUE, the channel must be offered the last available room at the property, typically a contractual obligation with certain OTA or corporate accounts.

attributes.name: lift_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory allocation action was lifted, reversed, or superseded. Null if the allocation is still active. Used to track the full lifecycle of each inventory control action.

attributes.name: lra_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability is enabled for this room-type-channel combination, overriding property-level LRA settings.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: The maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay under this allocation. Enforced when restriction_type is MAX_LOS. Null indicates no maximum stay restriction is applied.

attributes.name: maximum_los_override
attributes.description: Channel-specific maximum length of stay restriction for this room type, overriding property-level defaults.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: The minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible to book under this allocation. Enforced when restriction_type is MIN_LOS. A value of 1 means no effective minimum restriction.

attributes.name: minimum_los_override
attributes.description: Channel-specific minimum length of stay requirement for this room type, overriding property-level defaults.

attributes.name: overbooking_allowance
attributes.description: The number of additional room nights above the physical inventory that this channel is permitted to sell as part of the property's overbooking strategy. A value of 0 means no overbooking is permitted on this channel.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum overbooking percentage allowed for this room type on this channel. Used for revenue management optimization.

attributes.name: pickup_count
attributes.description: The number of new bookings received on this channel allocation since the last reporting snapshot. Supports pickup reporting and demand forecasting in the Revenue Management System (RMS).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this channel when allocating inventory for this room type. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: rate_parity_enforcement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity rules are actively enforced for this room type on this channel.

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity compliance is enforced for this channel allocation. When TRUE, the allocated inventory must be offered at rates consistent with other channels per rate parity agreements. Used for OTA contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the inventory control action (e.g., HIGH_DEMAND, GROUP_BLOCK, OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION, RATE_PARITY_VIOLATION, CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE, MAINTENANCE). Used for revenue management analysis and audit reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HIGH_DEMAND|GROUP_BLOCK|OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION|RATE_PARITY_VIOLATION|CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE|MAINTENANCE|FORECAST_ADJUSTMENT|COMPETITIVE_RESPONSE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the inventory control action beyond the standardized reason_code. Captures specific business justification entered by the revenue manager or system.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which any unsold allocated inventory is released back to the general property inventory pool. After this date, the channel no longer holds exclusive rights to the allocated units, enabling the property to sell them through other channels.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: The type of booking restriction applied to this inventory allocation. MIN_LOS enforces a minimum Length of Stay (LOS); MAX_LOS enforces a maximum LOS; CLOSED_TO_ARRIVAL (CTA) prevents new arrivals on the specified date; CLOSED_TO_DEPARTURE (CTD) prevents departures; FULL_PATTERN_LENGTH requires exact stay duration; NONE means no restriction is applied.

attributes.name: sell_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of room nights the channel is permitted to sell regardless of total property availability. Acts as a cap to prevent overselling on a specific channel and supports channel mix optimization.

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: The first date of the stay period for which this inventory allocation is effective. Defines the start of the date range over which the allocated room nights apply.

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: The last date of the stay period for which this inventory allocation is effective. Defines the end of the date range over which the allocated room nights apply.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory allocation record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to the allocation for audit trail and change management purposes.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this inventory allocation record. Incremented each time the allocation is modified, enabling optimistic concurrency control and historical version tracking in the Silver layer.

products.name: rate_parity_audit
products.description: Transactional audit records capturing rate parity monitoring results across channels. Records the property, room type, stay date, rate plan, and the rates observed on each channel at a specific point in time. Flags parity violations where a channel is displaying a rate lower than the direct booking rate or contracted parity rate. Supports OTA contract compliance, parity dispute resolution, and revenue integrity management.

attributes.name: rate_parity_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate parity audit record captured during channel monitoring. Primary key for this transactional audit entity.

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OTA or distribution channel contract under which parity obligations are defined. Links to the channel contract master record for commission rates, parity clauses, and dispute resolution terms.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, etc.) on which the audited rate was observed. Links to the channel master record.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR) under which the audited rate was published. Links to the rate plan master in the Revenue Management domain.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which the rate parity audit was conducted. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard) for which the rate was observed during the parity audit.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: The number of days in advance of the stay date that the rate requires booking (advance purchase restriction). Used to ensure parity comparisons account for advance purchase rate conditions that may legitimately differ across channels.

attributes.name: audit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally referenceable business identifier for this audit record, used in OTA contract compliance disputes and parity violation correspondence. Format: RPA-YYYY-MM-DD-XXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate parity audit record. 'open' indicates a new observation; 'violation_confirmed' indicates a confirmed parity breach; 'dispute_raised' indicates a formal dispute filed with the OTA/channel; 'resolved' indicates the channel corrected the rate; 'closed' indicates no action required; 'waived' indicates the violation was contractually waived.

attributes.name: audit_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the rate observation was captured during the automated or manual parity monitoring scan. This is the principal business event timestamp for this audit record.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_type
attributes.description: The cancellation policy associated with the observed rate (refundable, non_refundable, partially_refundable). Ensures parity comparisons are made on equivalent rate conditions, as NRR rates are expected to be lower than refundable rates.

attributes.name: channel_rate_url
attributes.description: The URL or deep link to the channel page where the rate was observed at the time of the audit scan. Used as evidence in OTA parity dispute resolution and contract compliance documentation.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution channel type. OTA (Online Travel Agency) includes Booking.com and Expedia; GDS (Global Distribution System) includes Sabre and Amadeus; direct_web is the hotel's own booking engine; metasearch includes Google Hotel Ads and TripAdvisor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|direct_web|voice|metasearch|wholesaler|corporate|consortium|bedbank — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contracted_parity_rate
attributes.description: The contractually agreed parity rate threshold for this channel, rate plan, and property combination as defined in the OTA or GDS distribution agreement. May differ from the direct rate if a contracted rate floor or ceiling applies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this rate parity audit record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the observed rate, direct rate, and contracted parity rate are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures accurate cross-currency parity comparisons for international properties.

attributes.name: direct_rate
attributes.description: The rate available on the hotel's direct booking channel (own website or CRS direct) for the same room type, rate plan, stay date, and LOS at the time of the audit. Used as the parity benchmark for comparison.

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal parity dispute was raised with the OTA or distribution channel partner. Null if no dispute has been filed. Used to track SLA compliance for dispute resolution timelines.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned when a formal parity dispute is raised with the OTA or distribution channel. Populated when audit_status transitions to 'dispute_raised'. Used for tracking dispute resolution correspondence.

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the parity dispute was resolved and the channel corrected the rate or the dispute was formally closed. Null if the dispute is still open. Used to measure dispute resolution cycle time.

attributes.name: is_parity_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit record represents a confirmed rate parity violation, where the observed channel rate is lower than the direct booking rate or contracted parity rate beyond the allowable tolerance threshold. True = violation detected.

attributes.name: is_rate_inclusive
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate Inclusive of Taxes and Fees Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the observed channel rate is inclusive of taxes and fees (True) or is a net/exclusive rate (False). Critical for accurate parity comparison as some channels display gross rates while others display net rates.

tag_set.value: Rate Inclusive of Taxes and Fees Flag

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: The length of stay in nights for which the rate was observed. Rate parity monitoring may vary by LOS as some channels offer LOS-based discounts that can trigger parity violations.

attributes.name: meal_plan_code
attributes.description: The meal plan included in the observed rate (RO=Room Only, BB=Bed and Breakfast, HB=Half Board, FB=Full Board, AI=All Inclusive). Ensures parity comparisons are made on a like-for-like basis when channels bundle different meal inclusions.

attributes.name: monitoring_source
attributes.description: Identifies how the rate observation was captured. 'automated_scraper' indicates a rate shopping tool or API; 'manual_review' indicates a revenue manager manually checked; 'ota_alert' indicates the OTA itself flagged the discrepancy; 'partner_report' indicates a channel partner reported it; 'revenue_manager' indicates direct CRS/PMS review.

attributes.name: observed_rate
attributes.description: The actual room rate (in the property's local currency) observed on the audited channel at the time of the audit scan. This is the raw rate as displayed to the consumer on the channel.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric code identifying the rate plan under which the audited rate was published (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, CORP). Denormalized from the rate plan master for audit trail completeness and dispute documentation.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan under which the audited rate was published (e.g., Best Available Rate, Last Room Availability, Non-Refundable Rate). Denormalized for audit trail readability.

attributes.name: rate_shopping_tool
attributes.description: Name of the rate shopping or competitive intelligence tool used to capture the channel rate observation (e.g., OTA Insight, RateGain, Duetto, Infor EzRMS). Relevant when monitoring_source is 'automated_scraper'.

attributes.name: rate_variance
attributes.description: The absolute monetary difference between the observed channel rate and the direct booking rate (observed_rate minus direct_rate). A negative value indicates the channel is undercutting the direct rate, constituting a parity violation.

attributes.name: rate_variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage difference between the observed channel rate and the direct booking rate, calculated as (observed_rate - direct_rate) / direct_rate * 100. Used to assess the severity of a parity violation relative to the direct rate.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome of the parity dispute, including the channel's response, corrective action taken, or reason for waiving the violation. Supports audit trail and OTA contract compliance documentation.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the parity audit record was reviewed by a revenue manager or channel distribution analyst. Supports audit trail and SLA compliance tracking for parity violation response times.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or channel distribution analyst who reviewed and actioned this parity audit record. Populated for manually reviewed or escalated records.

attributes.name: screenshot_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or storage path to the screenshot or screen capture taken of the channel rate at the time of the audit. Serves as evidentiary documentation for OTA parity dispute resolution.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific arrival or stay date for which the rate was observed on the channel. Rate parity is evaluated per stay date to detect date-specific pricing discrepancies.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The allowable percentage variance between the channel rate and the direct/contracted rate before a parity violation is flagged. Defined per channel contract or property policy. Violations are only flagged when rate_variance_pct exceeds this threshold.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this rate parity audit record was last modified, such as when the audit status changed, dispute details were added, or resolution notes were updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: violation_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the rate parity violation based on the magnitude of the rate variance percentage. 'critical' typically indicates >10% variance; 'high' 5-10%; 'medium' 2-5%; 'low' <2%; 'none' for no violation. Drives escalation and dispute prioritization.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the rate parity violation. 'below_direct' means the channel rate is lower than the direct booking rate; 'below_contracted' means the channel rate is below the contracted parity rate; 'below_both' means the channel rate violates both thresholds; 'no_violation' means parity is maintained.

products.name: channel_booking
products.description: Single source of truth is reservation.reservation_booking. Transactional record of each booking received through a distribution channel, capturing channel-level booking metadata including channel identifier, booking source, OTA confirmation number, GDS segment number, booking timestamp, property, room type, rate plan, stay dates, gross booking value, channel commission amount, net revenue to property, and booking modification/cancellation flags. Primary fact table for channel contribution and cost-of-acquisition analysis. SSOT: defers to reservation.reservation_booking (MVM).reservation_booking as single source of truth] [SSOT:booking] Canonical single-source-of-truth for the 'booking' concept; other domain variants are domain-specific specializations referencing this owner. SSOT: defers to canonical reservation.reservation_booking (MVM cross-domain dedup).
products.reference: SynXis CRS Booking Record / OPERA Reservation Source

attributes.name: channel_booking_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel booking transaction record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this fact table. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Each booking transaction is attributed to a specific booking source for granular channel performance analysis. Many bookings per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source_code which can be retr

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Channel bookings result from marketing campaigns; attribution tracking requires linking bookings to originating campaigns for ROI measurement, campaign performance analysis, and marketing spend reconc

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel master record through which this booking was received (e.g., OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, CRS). Core dimension for channel mix and cost-of-acquisition analysis.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: Channel bookings use channel-specific rate plans. The channel_booking table currently has rate_plan_id pointing to channel.revenue_rate_plan (cross-domain) and rate_plan_code (STRING). Adding channel_

attributes.name: guest_group_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.guest_group_block. Business justification: Group bookings made through distribution channels (GDS, OTA, direct) must link to the master group block for rooming list reconciliation, group pickup tracking, billing consolidation to master folio,

attributes.name: guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record associated with this booking. Enables guest-level channel attribution, loyalty linkage, and lifetime value analysis. PARTY_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: inventory_room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: Channel bookings must reference the actual inventory room type sold for revenue attribution by room category, inventory consumption tracking, channel performance analysis, and commission calculation a

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Channel bookings must link to loyalty member for points accrual calculation, tier benefit application at booking time, member revenue attribution reporting, and loyalty program liability accounting. C

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property at which the booking is made. Links to the property master record for property-level channel performance analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reservation record in the PMS. Links the channel booking transaction to the operational reservation for end-to-end booking lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan applied to this booking (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate, package). Used for rate parity monitoring and revenue contribution analysis.

attributes.name: sanction_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanction_screening. Business justification: Bookings from international channels require sanctions screening of guest names against OFAC/EU/UN lists, especially for high-risk jurisdictions. Real business process: automated sanctions screening d

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate (ADR) for this booking, calculated as gross booking value divided by length of stay nights. Stored as a business attribute to support channel-level ADR benchmarking and STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring runtime calculation.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the channel booking transaction. Drives channel performance reporting, cancellation rate analysis, and no-show tracking. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: confirmed|cancelled|modified|no_show|waitlisted|tentative — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the booking was received through the distribution channel. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for booking pace analysis, lead time calculation, and channel demand pattern reporting.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the cancellation policy applicable to this booking (e.g., FREE_CANCEL_24H, NRR_NON_REFUND, FLEX_48H). Determines penalty applicability and refund eligibility for cancelled bookings.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the booking was cancelled. Populated only when is_cancelled is True. Used for cancellation lead time analysis and channel cancellation pattern reporting.

attributes.name: channel_commission_amount
attributes.description: The commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner for this booking. Represents the cost of acquisition for channel-sourced bookings. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the distribution channel category through which the booking was received. Enables channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking across channel categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|direct_web|voice|corporate|wholesaler|metasearch|travel_agent — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: check_in_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest arrival date for the stay associated with this booking. Used for stay date demand analysis, length-of-stay (LOS) calculation, and revenue period attribution.

attributes.name: check_out_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest departure date for the stay associated with this booking. Combined with check_in_date to derive length of stay (LOS) and average length of stay (ALOS) metrics.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission rate percentage applied by the distribution channel for this booking (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Used for commission structure analysis, channel cost benchmarking, and contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The per-booking connectivity or transaction fee charged by the channel technology provider (e.g., GDS segment fee, CRS transaction fee). Included in total cost-of-acquisition calculation alongside commission.

attributes.name: corporate_account_code
attributes.description: The corporate account or negotiated rate code associated with this booking, if applicable. Used for corporate channel performance analysis, negotiated rate compliance monitoring, and corporate account revenue attribution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was first created in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL reconciliation.

attributes.name: crs_booking_reference
attributes.description: The unique booking identifier assigned by the Central Reservation System (Sabre SynXis CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRS and PMS booking records.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the booking was transacted by the distribution channel (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency revenue reconciliation and FX conversion in financial reporting. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: gds_segment_number
attributes.description: The segment identifier assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) for bookings originating through GDS channels (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Used for GDS billing reconciliation and travel agent attribution.

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross value of the booking as received from the distribution channel, inclusive of all room charges before deduction of channel commissions or fees. Expressed in the booking currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: is_cancelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been cancelled (True = cancelled, False = active). Used for channel-level cancellation rate analysis and net booking volume reporting.

attributes.name: is_modified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been modified after initial confirmation (True = modified, False = original booking). Used to track modification rates by channel and assess channel data quality.

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booked rate is compliant with the rate parity agreement for this channel (True = compliant, False = parity violation detected). Critical for OTA contract compliance monitoring and channel rate parity management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was last updated in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for change data capture, incremental load processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between the booking timestamp and the check-in date. Stored as a business attribute to support lead time distribution analysis by channel, demand forecasting, and last-minute booking pattern identification.

attributes.name: length_of_stay_nights
attributes.description: The number of nights for the booked stay, derived from check-in and check-out dates. Stored as a business attribute to support LOS-based rate restriction analysis, minimum stay controls, and ALOS reporting without requiring date arithmetic at query time.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: The market segment classification code assigned to this booking (e.g., TRANS, GROUP, CORP, LEISURE, GOVT). Used for segmented revenue analysis, channel-to-segment attribution, and STR benchmarking alignment.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue retained by the property after deduction of channel commission from the gross booking value. Primary metric for channel contribution analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: number_of_guests
attributes.description: The total number of guests included in this booking. Used for occupancy analysis, per-guest revenue calculations, and channel demand pattern reporting.

attributes.name: number_of_rooms
attributes.description: The number of rooms included in this booking transaction. Typically 1 for FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings; may be greater for group or multi-room bookings received through a channel.

attributes.name: ota_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The booking confirmation number assigned by the Online Travel Agency (OTA) platform (e.g., Booking.com, Expedia). Used for reconciliation with OTA partner systems and commission invoice matching.

attributes.name: pms_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The externally-communicated confirmation number generated by the Property Management System (Oracle OPERA PMS) for this booking. Serves as the primary guest-facing booking reference. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate type applied to this booking. BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate, package, promotional, or group. Critical for rate parity monitoring and revenue strategy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BAR|LRA|NRR|corporate|package|promotional|group — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the origin from which the booking was made through the channel. Used for geographic demand analysis, international vs. domestic channel mix reporting, and targeted marketing attribution.

attributes.name: travel_agent_iata_number
attributes.description: The 8-digit IATA (International Air Transport Association) accreditation number of the travel agency that made this booking. Used for travel agent commission processing, GDS attribution, and agency performance reporting.

products.name: commission_schedule
products.description: Master and transactional records for all channel distribution costs — the single source of truth for OTA commissions, GDS segment fees, CRS transaction fees, channel manager connectivity fees, and per-booking cost accruals. Captures commission/fee structures (percentage, flat, tiered), negotiated rates per partner, applicable rate plans, effective date ranges, property scope, fee types, billing frequencies, and per-booking accrual records with amounts in local and base currency. Supports commission invoice reconciliation, AP processing, total cost-of-acquisition calculation, technology cost management, and channel profitability analysis. Encompasses all cost types previously tracked separately (connectivity fees, per-segment fees, per-transaction fees) in a unified cost management product.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission or fee schedule record in the channel distribution cost management system. Primary key for the commission_schedule data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Commission schedules are negotiated as part of OTA co-marketing campaigns; tracking which campaign drove specific commission structures is essential for marketing spend reconciliation, contract compli

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Commission schedules define the commission terms negotiated in channel contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers. Adding nullable channel_contract_id FK links commission schedules to their governi

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rate plan (BAR, LRA, NRR, package, negotiated corporate) to which this commission schedule is scoped. Null indicates the schedule applies to all rate plans for the channel partner.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Commission schedules define expense structures that must be allocated to cost centers for departmental P&L reporting, enabling accurate distribution cost analysis and budget variance tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Commission schedules define fee structures for specific distribution channels. Many commission schedules per channel (e.g., tiered by volume, rate plan, market segment). Removes redundant channel_type

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel partner (OTA, GDS, CRS, channel manager, direct booking engine) to which this commission or fee schedule applies. Links to the channel partner master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific property or hotel to which this commission schedule applies. Null or a portfolio-level sentinel value indicates the schedule applies across all properties (chain-wide agreement).

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AP vendor master record in SAP S/4HANA for the channel partner, used for invoice processing, payment execution, and vendor reconciliation. Links commission schedules to the financial AP workflow.

attributes.name: applies_to_cancellations
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is still payable when a booking is cancelled (True = commission owed on cancellations, False = commission waived on cancellations). Critical for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) commission accrual and cancellation cost management.

attributes.name: applies_to_no_shows
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is payable on no-show bookings (True = commission owed on no-shows, False = commission waived). Affects no-show revenue net-of-commission calculations and OTA contract compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized approver (e.g., VP Revenue Management, CFO) who approved this commission schedule for execution. Required for SOX financial controls compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule was formally approved for activation. Part of the SOX-compliant approval audit trail for financial commitments.

attributes.name: auto_accrual_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission and fee accruals under this schedule are automatically calculated and posted to the GL upon booking confirmation (True) or require manual accrual processing (False). Supports automated AP accrual workflows in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel partner invoices the property for commissions or fees: monthly (most common for OTA commissions), weekly, per_booking (real-time deduction), quarterly, annual (common for connectivity subscription fees). Drives AP accrual scheduling and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: booking_window_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Null indicates no maximum booking window restriction. Used in conjunction with booking_window_min_days for last-minute rate commission scoping.

attributes.name: booking_window_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Used for LOS (Length of Stay) and advance purchase rate plan commission scoping. Null indicates no minimum booking window restriction.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the commission or fee is calculated and accrued: per_booking (one charge per reservation), per_room_night (charge per occupied room night), per_segment (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction (CRS per-transaction charge), per_period (fixed charge per billing period regardless of volume). Drives accrual engine logic.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate expressed as a percentage of the applicable revenue base (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%). Applicable when fee_structure is 'percentage'. Represents the contractually agreed OTA or agent commission rate. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this commission or fee schedule becomes contractually binding and applicable to bookings. Used to determine which schedule version applies to a given booking date for accrual and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this commission or fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended agreement with no defined expiry. Used for schedule versioning and contract renewal tracking.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the flat fee or tiered threshold amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP reconciliation and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: fee_structure
attributes.description: Defines how the commission or fee is calculated: percentage (applied as a % of booking revenue or room revenue), flat (fixed monetary amount per booking or period), tiered (rate varies by volume or revenue thresholds), per_unit (fixed amount per room-night, segment, or transaction unit). Determines the accrual calculation method.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost type captured by this schedule: commission (percentage of booking revenue paid to OTA/agent), per_segment_fee (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction_fee (CRS per-booking transaction fee), connectivity_fee (channel manager or switch connectivity charge), subscription_fee (fixed periodic platform fee), override_commission (negotiated override above standard rate). Drives AP coding and cost-of-acquisition (COA) categorization.

attributes.name: flat_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary fee amount per booking, segment, transaction, or billing period, expressed in the schedule currency. Applicable when fee_structure is 'flat' or 'per_unit'. Used for GDS per-segment fees, CRS per-transaction fees, and connectivity subscription fees. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which commission and fee expenses are posted for financial reporting under USALI. Ensures correct P&L classification of distribution costs (e.g., OTA commission expense, GDS fee expense) per USALI departmental accounting.

attributes.name: los_min_nights
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) in nights required for this commission schedule to apply. Null indicates no LOS restriction. Supports commission scoping for extended-stay or minimum-stay rate plans.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment code (e.g., leisure transient, corporate, group, wholesale) to which this commission schedule is scoped. Null indicates the schedule applies across all market segments for the channel partner. Aligns with Oracle OPERA PMS market segment configuration.

attributes.name: max_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual cap on the commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period. Applicable for schedules with a commission ceiling clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: min_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual minimum commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period, regardless of the calculated percentage amount. Applicable for schedules with a commission floor clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: negotiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal team or individual (e.g., Revenue Management, Channel Distribution, Procurement) responsible for negotiating this commission schedule. Used for accountability tracking and contract ownership.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special contractual conditions, negotiation history notes, or exceptions associated with this commission schedule. Not used for structured data; intended for operational reference by Revenue Management and AP teams.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice receipt within which payment to the channel partner is due (e.g., 30 = Net 30). Used in AP aging analysis and cash flow management per SAP S/4HANA payment terms configuration.

attributes.name: rate_parity_monitored
