attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity compliance is contractually required and actively monitored for bookings under this commission schedule (True = rate parity clause in effect). Supports rate parity monitoring workflows and OTA contract compliance management.

attributes.name: revenue_base
attributes.description: Defines the revenue component on which the commission percentage is calculated: room_revenue (room charges only), total_revenue (all charges including F&B and ancillaries), net_revenue (after discounts and taxes), gross_revenue (before deductions), f_and_b_revenue (food and beverage charges only). Critical for accurate commission accrual and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission or fee schedule, used in AP reconciliation, contract references, and channel partner communications (e.g., OTA-EXP-COMM-2024, GDS-SAB-SEG-FEE).

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the commission or fee schedule, used in reporting dashboards, AP workflows, and channel profitability analysis (e.g., 'Expedia Standard OTA Commission FY2024', 'Sabre GDS Per-Segment Fee Q1 2024').

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission schedule: active (currently in force), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (approved but not yet effective), expired (past effective_until date), terminated (cancelled before expiry), draft (under negotiation, not yet approved). Drives AP processing eligibility and accrual inclusion.

attributes.name: tier_1_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 1 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: Lower volume or revenue threshold (in booking count or currency amount) that triggers the Tier 1 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_2_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 2 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: Upper volume or revenue threshold that triggers the Tier 2 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: commission_accrual
products.description: Transactional records of commission amounts accrued per booking for each distribution channel. Captures booking reference, channel, OTA partner, stay date, commission schedule applied, gross booking value, commission rate, commission amount in local and base currency, accrual date, and payment status. Feeds into finance AP for commission invoice reconciliation and channel cost-of-acquisition reporting.
products.reference: OTA Commission Accrual / USALI Channel Cost

attributes.name: commission_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission accrual record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. ROLE: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Commission accruals need to link to AR invoices for revenue recognition and reconciliation. When commissions are invoiced to OTA partners, this FK tracks the billing document. This is a standard finan

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Commission accruals are tracked by booking source for cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel attribution. Many accruals per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source_code which can be retriev

attributes.name: channel_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_booking. Business justification: Commission accruals are calculated per channel booking transaction. The commission_accrual table currently has booking_id pointing to channel.reservation_booking (cross-domain). Adding channel_boo

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel through which the booking was made (e.g., OTA, GDS, direct web, voice). Links to the channel master in the channel domain for channel mix and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: Commission rates vary by channel rate plan. The commission_accrual table has rate_plan_code (STRING) which should be normalized to channel_rate_plan via FK. This links commission accruals to the speci

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule or rate agreement applied to this accrual record. Determines the applicable commission rate tier, calculation method, and contractual terms with the OTA or GDS partner.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Commission accruals are distribution expenses requiring cost center allocation for accurate departmental financial statements, enabling proper matching of channel costs to revenue per USALI reporting

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OTA or GDS partner entity responsible for the booking. Populated when the channel type is OTA or GDS; null for direct bookings. Supports OTA partnership performance and commission reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which the commission is being accrued. Enables property-level commission cost reporting and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.reservation_booking. Business justification: Commission accruals must link directly to reservations for reconciliation, dispute resolution, cancellation-driven commission reversals, and complete audit trail from booking to financial posting. Cur

attributes.name: accrual_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the commission liability was recognized in the general ledger. Aligns with USALI period-end accrual practices and SAP S/4HANA GL posting date. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission accrual record. Drives AP (Accounts Payable) workflow in SAP S/4HANA: 'accrued' = liability recognized; 'invoiced' = OTA invoice received; 'paid' = payment disbursed; 'disputed' = under reconciliation review; 'cancelled' = booking cancelled before stay; 'reversed' = accrual reversed due to no-show or refund. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate of the booking, calculated as gross_booking_value divided by room_nights. Stored for channel performance benchmarking and to support STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring recalculation from source.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reservation was cancelled, if applicable. When populated, triggers commission accrual reversal logic per the cancellation policy terms. Null for active or completed bookings.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution channel through which the booking originated. Drives commission rate tier selection and channel mix reporting. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus); direct_web = brand.com; voice = call center; corporate = negotiated corporate account; wholesale = tour operator/wholesaler.

attributes.name: commission_amount_base
attributes.description: The commission amount converted to the company's functional base currency (typically USD) for consolidated financial reporting and USALI-compliant P&L statements. Enables cross-property and cross-currency commission cost analysis. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: commission_amount_local
attributes.description: The calculated commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner in the local transaction currency (gross_booking_value × commission_rate). Used for OTA invoice reconciliation and AP liability posting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the revenue base on which the commission rate is applied: 'room_revenue' = room charges only; 'total_revenue' = all charges including F&B and ancillary; 'net_revenue' = revenue net of taxes and fees; 'flat_fee' = fixed amount per booking regardless of revenue.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The contractual commission rate applied to the gross booking value, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Sourced from the applicable commission schedule. Used to calculate the commission amount and for rate parity and cost-of-acquisition analysis.

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission arrangement: 'standard' = default contractual rate; 'override' = manually overridden rate approved by revenue management; 'promotional' = time-limited promotional rate; 'group' = group booking commission; 'negotiated' = bilaterally negotiated rate outside standard schedule.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The GDS or channel connectivity fee charged by the distribution technology provider (e.g., Sabre SynXis transaction fee) associated with this booking, in local currency. Included in total cost-of-acquisition (CoA) reporting alongside commission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission accrual record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and SOX financial controls compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of a commission dispute with the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status is 'disputed'. Supports the channel dispute resolution workflow and AP reconciliation process.

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the local currency commission amount to the base currency at the time of accrual. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA treasury rates. Required for accurate multi-currency financial reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA GL account code to which the commission expense is posted (e.g., USALI Schedule 6 - Sales and Marketing / Distribution Costs). Ensures correct financial statement classification per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross booking value of the reservation on which commission is calculated, in the local transaction currency. Represents the full room revenue amount before any discounts or adjustments. Forms the base for commission rate application. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the commission invoice received from the OTA or GDS partner. Used for AP aging analysis, payment due date calculation, and period-end accrual reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The OTA or GDS partner's invoice reference number received for commission payment. Used to match accrued commission liabilities against received invoices in SAP S/4HANA AP for three-way reconciliation. Null until invoice is received.

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booking is eligible for commission payment (True) or is a non-commissionable booking (False), such as direct loyalty redemptions, staff rates, or complimentary stays. Drives commission accrual logic and AP posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the booking was made and commission is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency commission reconciliation and FX conversion. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: The market segment classification of the booking as defined in Oracle OPERA PMS (e.g., TRANSIENT, GROUP, CONTRACT, WHOLESALE). Used to analyze commission costs by market segment and align with USALI revenue reporting categories.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the commission payment was disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status transitions to 'paid'. Used for AP reconciliation and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the commission payment must be disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner per the commission schedule terms. Used for AP cash flow planning and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment transaction reference or bank transfer reference number from SAP S/4HANA AP when the commission is disbursed. Enables end-to-end traceability from accrual to cash payment for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for reversing a previously accrued commission. Populated when accrual_status is 'reversed' or 'cancelled'. Supports AP reconciliation and channel dispute management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cancellation|no_show|rate_correction|duplicate|dispute_resolved|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]

attributes.name: room_nights
attributes.description: The number of room nights associated with the booking for which commission is being accrued. Used to calculate CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) and to normalize commission costs across bookings of varying LOS (Length of Stay).

attributes.name: total_cost_of_acquisition
attributes.description: The total distribution cost for this booking, combining commission_amount_local and connectivity_fee_amount. Represents the all-in cost of acquiring the booking through this channel. Used for channel profitability and net RevPAR analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission accrual record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, reconciliation audit trails, and SOX financial controls. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: connectivity_fee
products.description: Master and transactional records of technology connectivity fees charged by GDS networks, channel managers, and CRS providers per booking segment or per transaction. Captures fee type (GDS segment fee, CRS transaction fee, channel manager fee), fee amount, billing frequency, applicable channel, property scope, and fee schedule effective dates. Supports total cost-of-acquisition calculation and technology cost management.
products.reference: GDS Segment Fee / CRS Transaction Fee

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each connectivity fee record in the channel distribution cost management system. Primary key for the connectivity_fee data product.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Connectivity fees from channel managers and GDS providers generate AP invoices for payment processing. Required for three-way match validation, payment scheduling, and expense recognition in financial

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Connectivity fees charged by GDS networks and channel managers are defined in channel contracts. Adding nullable channel_contract_id FK links fees to their governing contract. Remove contract_referenc

attributes.name: crs_channel_mapping_id
attributes.description: The channel identifier as configured in the Sabre SynXis CRS channel management module. Maps this fee record to the specific CRS channel configuration for booking source attribution and rate distribution cost tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Connectivity fees are charged per distribution channel for technology infrastructure. Many connectivity fees per channel (e.g., monthly recurring, per-booking, tiered). Removes redundant channel_type,

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: Connectivity fees may be specific to individual GDS connection configurations at a property (e.g., Sabre connection at Hotel X incurs specific segment fees). Many connectivity fees per GDS connection.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific property to which this connectivity fee applies when property_scope is single_property. Null when the fee applies to a portfolio, brand, region, or global scope.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Connectivity fees are paid to technology vendors (switch providers, channel managers, CRS platforms) who must be managed through procurement processes including contract management, invoice reconcilia

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the authorized approver who approved this connectivity fee schedule for activation. Required for financial controls compliance under SOX and internal audit requirements.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this connectivity fee schedule was formally approved by the authorized approver. Used for audit trail, financial controls compliance, and contract lifecycle management.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the connectivity fee is billed by the technology provider. Per-transaction and per-segment fees are charged at the time of each booking event. Monthly, quarterly, and annual fees are charged on a recurring fixed schedule regardless of transaction volume.

attributes.name: booking_segment
attributes.description: The market segment classification of bookings to which this connectivity fee applies. Transient covers FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings. Group covers MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) and group blocks. Corporate covers negotiated corporate rate bookings. Loyalty covers bookings made through the loyalty program channel.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which this connectivity fee is allocated for management accounting and OpEx (Operating Expenditure) reporting. Supports departmental cost attribution under USALI standards.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this connectivity fee schedule becomes effective and begins to be applied to qualifying transactions. Used for fee schedule versioning and historical cost-of-acquisition analysis.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this connectivity fee schedule expires and ceases to be applied. Null for open-ended fee schedules with no defined end date. Used for contract lifecycle management and fee schedule versioning.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The base monetary amount of the connectivity fee as specified in the fee schedule. For flat-rate and per-transaction fees, this is the fixed charge. For percentage-based fees, this field stores the rate value (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%). Currency is defined in the fee_currency field.

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The calculation basis for the connectivity fee. Flat rate is a fixed amount per billing period. Percentage is applied to the booking value. Tiered applies different rates based on volume thresholds. Per room night is charged for each room night booked. Per booking is charged once per reservation regardless of length of stay (LOS).

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the connectivity fee is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency property portfolios to ensure accurate cost-of-acquisition calculations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the connectivity fee as defined in the technology provider contract or fee schedule. Provides additional context beyond the fee_type classification, such as specific service scope, applicable booking conditions, or contractual notes.

attributes.name: fee_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned by the technology provider (GDS network, CRS provider, or channel manager) to uniquely identify this fee schedule or billing line item. Used for invoice reconciliation and vendor correspondence.

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the connectivity fee schedule record. Active indicates the fee is currently being applied to bookings. Inactive indicates the fee has been deactivated. Pending indicates the fee schedule is awaiting activation. Suspended indicates the fee is temporarily paused. Expired indicates the fee schedule has passed its effective end date.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the connectivity fee by its technology cost category. GDS segment fees are charged per booking segment processed through a Global Distribution System (GDS). CRS transaction fees are charged per booking processed through the Central Reservation System (CRS). Channel manager fees are charged for connectivity to OTA and direct booking channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gds_segment_fee|crs_transaction_fee|channel_manager_fee|ota_commission|connectivity_setup_fee|maintenance_fee — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA to which this connectivity fee expense is posted. Enables accurate financial reporting of technology distribution costs under USALI cost center classifications.

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the technology provider issues invoices for this connectivity fee. May differ from billing_frequency (e.g., per-transaction fees may be invoiced monthly in aggregate). Used for accounts payable planning and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_negotiated_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this connectivity fee was negotiated as part of a custom contract with the technology provider, as opposed to a standard published rate. True for negotiated fees; False for standard published fees. Supports contract performance monitoring.

attributes.name: is_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether this connectivity fee has been waived by the technology provider, typically as part of a promotional arrangement or contract concession. True if the fee is waived; False if the fee is applicable. Waived fees are retained for audit and cost-of-acquisition baseline analysis.

attributes.name: maximum_fee_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary amount charged per billing period, acting as a cap on variable or percentage-based fees. Null if no maximum cap applies. Used in contract negotiations and cost forecasting.

attributes.name: minimum_fee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum monetary amount charged per billing period regardless of transaction volume. Applicable for tiered or percentage-based fee structures where the provider guarantees a floor charge. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Operational notes or comments added by the channel distribution team regarding this connectivity fee record. May include renegotiation history, exception handling instructions, or pending contract change details.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms agreed with the technology provider for settlement of connectivity fees (e.g., Net 30 days from invoice date). Used by accounts payable in SAP S/4HANA for payment scheduling and cash flow management.

attributes.name: property_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether this connectivity fee applies to a single property, a defined portfolio of properties, a brand segment, a geographic region, or the entire global estate. Determines how the fee is allocated across the property hierarchy for cost management.

attributes.name: rate_plan_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the rate plan codes or rate plan categories (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, corporate negotiated) to which this connectivity fee applies. Null if the fee applies to all rate plans on the channel. Supports granular cost-of-acquisition analysis by rate type.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this connectivity fee record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with financial record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this connectivity fee record was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether applicable taxes (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) are charged on top of this connectivity fee. True if taxes apply; False if the fee is tax-exempt. Supports accurate total cost-of-acquisition calculation and tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate as a decimal fraction applied to the connectivity fee amount when tax_applicable is True (e.g., 0.2000 for 20% VAT). Used for total cost-of-acquisition calculation and tax liability reporting.

attributes.name: vendor_account_number
attributes.description: The accounts payable vendor account number in SAP S/4HANA (Finance AP) assigned to the technology connectivity provider. Used for invoice matching, payment processing, and financial reconciliation of connectivity costs.

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold
attributes.description: The transaction or segment volume threshold at which a tiered fee rate changes. For example, a threshold of 1000 means the fee rate changes after 1000 transactions per billing period. Null for flat-rate or non-tiered fee structures.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason explaining why the connectivity fee was waived (e.g., promotional period, volume commitment met, contract renegotiation). Populated only when is_waived is True. Required for audit trail and financial controls compliance.

products.name: channel_contract
products.description: Single source of truth is procurement.procurement_contract. Master records for commercial contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers, capturing contract type, effective and expiration dates, contracted commission rates, rate parity clauses, last-room-availability (LRA) obligations, preferred partner program terms, marketing co-op commitments, and dispute resolution terms. Distinct from commission_schedule (which captures the rate structure) — this is the legal agreement record. SSOT: defers to procurement.procurement_contract (MVM).procurement_contract as single source of truth] [SSOT:contract] Canonical single-source-of-truth for the 'contract' concept; other domain variants are domain-specific specializations referencing this owner. SSOT: defers to canonical procurement.procurement_contract (MVM cross-domain dedup).

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the channel contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct, etc.) that is party to this contract.

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: Channel contracts may reference specific GDS connection configurations, particularly for chain-level GDS agreements that are implemented at the property connection level. Many contracts per GDS connec

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Channel contracts create financial obligations requiring GL account assignment for proper revenue/expense recognition, audit trail compliance, and financial statement preparation per accounting standa

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Channel contracts create specific compliance obligations including rate parity enforcement, data processing requirements under GDPR DPAs, commission reporting, and content accuracy requirements. Real

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Channel contracts are commercial agreements signed with OTA partners, defining commission rates, rate parity obligations, and terms. Many contracts per OTA partner (e.g., master agreement, property-sp

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Channel contracts require employee ownership for accountability in contract management, renewal tracking, and performance monitoring. Standard practice in hospitality to assign contract ownership to s

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: add column procurement_contract_id (BIGINT) with FK to procurement.procurement_contract.procurement_contract_id - channel contracts should reference the master contract entity to resolve SSOT.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or portfolio of properties covered by this contract. Null if the contract applies at the brand or enterprise level.

attributes.name: bar_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel is contractually entitled to receive the Best Available Rate (BAR) as defined in the Revenue Management System. Drives rate loading rules in Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the contracted cancellation and no-show policy applicable to bookings made through this channel (e.g., '24H', '48H', 'NON_REF'). Loaded into Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the revenue base on which the commission rate is applied: net rate (after discounts), gross rate (before discounts), room revenue only, or total revenue including F&B and ancillaries.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Base commission rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.1500 = 15%) payable to the channel partner per confirmed booking under this contract. Distinct from the commission_schedule product which captures tiered or conditional rate structures.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee
attributes.description: Fixed or per-transaction fee charged by the channel or GDS for technical connectivity and distribution services. Distinct from commission which is percentage-based. Used in cost-of-acquisition (COA) analysis.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_type
attributes.description: Specifies how the connectivity fee is structured: per booking transaction, per GDS segment, annual flat fee, or monthly flat fee.

attributes.name: content_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of contractual obligations regarding property content (images, descriptions, amenities) that must be maintained on the channel platform, including minimum image counts, refresh frequency, and accuracy standards.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the contract (e.g., 'Expedia 2025 Master Distribution Agreement — Americas').

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known legal contract reference number assigned by the contracting parties or the legal department. Used for correspondence, audits, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract. Drives whether the channel is eligible to receive inventory and rates via the CRS.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial agreement by channel category. Determines applicable commission structures, rate parity obligations, and connectivity requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota_distribution|gds_participation|direct_connect|wholesale|bed_bank|metasearch|corporate_negotiated — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system of record. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values in this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a data sharing or data processing agreement governing the exchange of guest and booking data with the channel partner. Required for GDPR Article 28 compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal jurisdiction governing dispute resolution and contract interpretation.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving commercial disputes between the hotel and the channel partner.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract becomes legally binding and the channel is authorized to distribute inventory. Aligns with USALI period reporting.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract ceases to be binding. Null for evergreen contracts. Used to trigger renewal workflows and rate parity audits.

attributes.name: gdpr_dpa_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the GDPR Data Processing Agreement (DPA) executed with the channel partner. Mandatory for EU-based OTA and GDS partnerships under GDPR Article 28.

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Reference

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which commission invoices or settlement statements are issued between the hotel and the channel partner.

attributes.name: lra_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a Last Room Availability (LRA) obligation, requiring the hotel to make the last available room accessible to this channel even when inventory is restricted for other channels.

attributes.name: marketing_coop_amount
attributes.description: Annual or contract-period monetary commitment for co-operative marketing spend with the channel partner (e.g., sponsored listings, display advertising on OTA platform). Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: nrr_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract permits the hotel to offer Non-Refundable Rates (NRR) through this channel. Relevant for revenue management strategy and cancellation policy governance.

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Commercial payment model governing how the channel collects and remits payment: merchant model (channel collects from guest and remits net), agency model (hotel collects and pays commission), net rate (channel marks up a net rate), or wholesale.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance Confirmed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel partner has confirmed PCI DSS compliance as required by the contract terms for handling payment card data.

tag_set.value: Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance Confirmed Indicator

attributes.name: preferred_partner_tier
attributes.description: Tier designation within the OTA or GDS preferred partner program (e.g., Expedia Preferred Plus, Booking.com Preferred). Higher tiers typically confer better placement, lower commission rates, or co-op marketing benefits.

attributes.name: rate_parity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a rate parity obligation requiring the hotel to offer the channel the same or better rates as other distribution channels. Critical for revenue management compliance and OTA relationship governance.

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation: broad parity (match all channels including direct), narrow parity (match only other OTAs, not direct), or no parity obligation. Reflects EU regulatory distinctions post-2015 investigations.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiration_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent to renew or terminate. Drives automated contract renewal alerts.

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the contract auto-renews at expiration, requires manual renegotiation, or is a one-time non-renewable agreement.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties executed the contract. Used for legal audit trails and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date which is the scheduled end. Populated only when contract_status is 'terminated'.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this contract record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse ETL pipeline and audit compliance.

products.name: stop_sell
products.description: Transactional records of stop-sell, close-out, and restriction controls applied to specific channels, room types, and date ranges. Captures channel, property, room type, stay date range, restriction type (stop-sell, minimum LOS, closed to arrival, closed to departure), reason code, applied-by user, effective timestamp, and lift timestamp. Supports revenue management inventory control actions executed through the CRS and channel manager to optimize channel mix and protect direct booking rates.

attributes.name: stop_sell_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each channel stop-sell, close-out, or restriction control record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Stop-sell restrictions can be applied to specific booking sources within a channel for granular inventory control. While stop_sell already has channel_id for channel-level restrictions, adding nullabl

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct web, voice, etc.) to which this stop-sell restriction is applied. Links to the channel master record.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan (BAR, NRR, LRA, package, etc.) to which this restriction is scoped. Null indicates the restriction applies across all rate plans for the channel and room type combination.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this stop-sell restriction applies. Links to the property master record in the Property domain.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Double Standard) subject to the stop-sell restriction. Null indicates the restriction applies to all room types at the property.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of inventory control action recorded in this transaction. apply: restriction manually applied; lift: restriction manually removed; modify: restriction parameters changed; auto_apply: restriction applied by RMS automation rule; auto_lift: restriction lifted by RMS automation rule.

attributes.name: adr_at_apply
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the affected room type and date range at the time the restriction was applied. Provides revenue management context for the stop-sell decision and supports yield optimization analysis.

attributes.name: applied_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the revenue management or channel management user who applied this restriction. Supports accountability and audit trail for inventory control actions.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction action required managerial approval before being applied. Supports internal control workflows and SOX compliance for material inventory control decisions.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved this restriction action when approval_required is True. Null if no approval was required or if the action was system-generated.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction action was approved by the designated manager or supervisor. Null if no approval was required. Supports SOX audit trail for material inventory control decisions.

attributes.name: channel_manager_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the channel manager or connectivity platform (e.g., SiteMinder, Amadeus Central Reservations) when the restriction was transmitted to the distribution channel. Supports cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel. ota: Online Travel Agency (OTA); gds: Global Distribution System (GDS); direct: brand.com or direct booking; voice: call center or CRS voice; wholesaler: tour operator or bed bank; metasearch: Google Hotels, Trivago; corporate: negotiated corporate accounts; group: group/MICE bookings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ota|gds|direct|voice|wholesaler|metasearch|corporate|group — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this stop-sell restriction record was first captured in the system. Distinct from effective_timestamp which records when the restriction became operationally active.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the ADR and any monetary values recorded in this restriction record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency property operations.

attributes.name: days_out
attributes.description: Number of days between the date the restriction was applied and the first affected stay date (stay_date_from). Represents the booking window horizon at which the restriction was enacted, used for revenue strategy analysis.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world date and time when this restriction became active and was enforced across the channel. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transactional record, distinct from the audit creation timestamp.

attributes.name: is_all_channels
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction applies to all distribution channels simultaneously rather than a single specific channel. True when a property-wide close-out is executed across all channels; False when scoped to a specific channel.

attributes.name: is_all_room_types
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction applies to all room types at the property rather than a specific room type. True when the restriction is property-wide across all room categories.

attributes.name: is_system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction was automatically generated by the Revenue Management System (RMS) or channel manager automation rule, as opposed to being manually applied by a revenue manager.

attributes.name: lift_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for lifting the restriction. Examples: DEMAND_SOFTENED, RATE_PARITY_RESTORED, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, SCHEDULED_EXPIRY, CHANNEL_RENEGOTIATED. Null if restriction has not been lifted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEMAND_SOFTENED|RATE_PARITY_RESTORED|MANUAL_OVERRIDE|SCHEDULED_EXPIRY|CHANNEL_RENEGOTIATED|SYSTEM_AUTO — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lift_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was lifted or removed, re-opening inventory on the affected channel. Null if the restriction is still active or has not yet been lifted.

attributes.name: lifted_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the user who lifted or removed this restriction. Null if the restriction has not been lifted or was lifted automatically by the system.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment code (e.g., TRANSIENT, GROUP, CORPORATE, LEISURE, MICE) to which this restriction is scoped. Null if the restriction applies across all market segments. Aligns with USALI market segmentation standards.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay when booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is max_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible for booking on this channel during the restricted date range. Applicable when restriction_type is min_los. Null for non-LOS restriction types.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments entered by the revenue manager or channel manager regarding this restriction. May include context about competitive positioning, demand events, or channel negotiation details.

attributes.name: occupancy_at_apply
attributes.description: Property or room-type occupancy percentage at the time the restriction was applied. Provides context for the revenue management decision and supports post-hoc analysis of restriction effectiveness. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.50 = 85.50%).

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop-sell action was triggered by a rate parity breach on the affected channel. True when the restriction is applied to enforce rate parity compliance across distribution channels.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for applying the stop-sell or restriction. Examples include: HIGH_DEMAND, RATE_PARITY_BREACH, CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE, OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION, RENOVATION, ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HIGH_DEMAND|RATE_PARITY_BREACH|CHANNEL_PERFORMANCE|OVERBOOKING_PROTECTION|RENOVATION|ALLOTMENT_EXHAUSTED|SYSTEM_AUTO — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or justification for the restriction beyond the standardized reason code. Entered by the revenue manager or channel manager at the time of action.

attributes.name: restriction_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days spanned by the restriction date range (stay_date_to minus stay_date_from + 1). Supports analysis of restriction scope and revenue impact assessment.

attributes.name: restriction_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this stop-sell or restriction control action, as generated by the CRS (Sabre SynXis) or channel manager. Used for cross-system traceability and audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stop-sell or restriction control record. active: restriction is currently enforced; lifted: restriction has been removed; pending: restriction is queued for activation; cancelled: restriction was voided before activation; expired: restriction passed its scheduled end without explicit lift.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory restriction being applied to the channel. stop_sell: no new bookings accepted; closed_to_arrival (CTA): no check-ins on the stay date; closed_to_departure (CTD): no check-outs on the stay date; min_los: minimum Length of Stay (LOS) required; max_los: maximum LOS allowed; close_out: full inventory closure.

attributes.name: revpar_at_apply
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) at Apply
attributes.description: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) for the affected property or room type at the time the restriction was applied. Key revenue management KPI used to contextualize the stop-sell decision and evaluate channel mix optimization outcomes.

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) at Apply

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the beginning of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last stay date (inclusive) in the date range to which this restriction applies. Represents the end of the affected inventory window in the property calendar.

attributes.name: transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the restriction transmission to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. pending: queued for transmission; transmitted: sent to channel; confirmed: acknowledged by channel; failed: transmission error; retrying: re-attempting after failure. Critical for ensuring inventory control actions are successfully propagated.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the restriction was successfully transmitted to the distribution channel via the CRS or channel manager. Null if transmission is pending or failed. Supports SLA monitoring for inventory control propagation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this restriction record, such as a status change, date range extension, or reason code update.

products.name: metasearch_listing
products.description: Master records for property listings on metasearch platforms (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, Skyscanner). Captures listing status, bid strategy (CPC, CPA, commission-based), bid amounts by market and device, property display rank, click-through and conversion rates, cost metrics, and direct booking attribution. Supports metasearch investment optimization, bid management, and measurement of metasearch contribution to direct booking revenue.

attributes.name: metasearch_listing_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each metasearch listing record in the silver layer. Primary key for this data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a managed digital listing asset on a metasearch platform.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Metasearch listings (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago) drive traffic that converts to bookings. Each metasearch platform should have an associated booking_source code for attribution tracking. T

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Metasearch advertising (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor) is campaign-driven; each listing/bid strategy belongs to a specific marketing campaign for budget tracking, performance attribution, and ROI meas

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel record representing the metasearch platform (e.g., Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, Skyscanner) through which this listing is managed.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Metasearch advertising spend (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor) is a marketing expense requiring cost center allocation for budget tracking, ROI analysis, and departmental P&L reporting.

attributes.name: last_bid_updated_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Bid Updated By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Metasearch bid updates by employees require tracking for operational accountability and performance analysis. Essential for understanding who manages metasearch campaigns and optimizing bid strategies

tag_set.value: Last Bid Updated By Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property associated with this metasearch listing. Links the listing to the property master record for performance attribution and bid management.

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: The monetary bid amount configured for this listing under the active bid strategy. For CPC, represents the maximum cost-per-click in the listing currency. For CPA, represents the target cost-per-acquisition. For commission-based, this field is null (see commission_rate_pct). Serves as the principal quantitative fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: bid_multiplier
attributes.description: A multiplier applied to the base bid amount for specific market or device segments (e.g., 1.20 = 20% bid increase for mobile). Enables granular bid adjustment strategies without changing the base bid. Used in conjunction with bid_amount for effective bid calculation.

attributes.name: bid_strategy_type
attributes.description: The bidding model applied to this metasearch listing. CPC (Cost Per Click) charges per user click; CPA (Cost Per Acquisition) charges per completed booking; commission-based charges a percentage of booking revenue; target_ROAS optimizes for return on ad spend; manual allows direct bid amount control. Drives cost-of-acquisition modeling and channel investment decisions.

attributes.name: booking_count
attributes.description: Total number of direct bookings attributed to this metasearch listing within the reporting period. Used to calculate conversion rate, cost-per-acquisition (CPA), and metasearch contribution to direct booking revenue. Attribution follows the platform's last-click or assisted-conversion model.

attributes.name: booking_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross booking revenue (in listing currency) attributed to direct bookings generated by this metasearch listing within the reporting period. Used to calculate return on ad spend (ROAS), channel contribution to revenue, and cost-of-acquisition metrics. Aligns with USALI revenue reporting.

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: Total number of user clicks on this property listing that directed traffic to the hotel's direct booking engine or landing page within the reporting period. Used to calculate click-through rate (CTR) and cost-per-click (CPC) actuals.

attributes.name: click_through_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of clicks to impressions for this listing within the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 = 3.50% CTR). Sourced directly from platform reporting APIs to ensure consistency with platform-side optimization signals. Used to assess listing creative and bid competitiveness.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission percentage charged by the metasearch platform per completed booking when the bid strategy type is commission-based. Expressed as a percentage of gross booking value (e.g., 12.00 = 12%). Null for CPC and CPA bid strategies. Critical for cost-of-acquisition and channel contribution analysis.

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: The technical integration method used to feed rate and availability data to this metasearch listing. 'direct_api' = direct platform API integration; 'gds_feed' = rates sourced via GDS (Global Distribution System); 'crs_feed' = rates sourced via Sabre SynXis CRS; 'third_party_aggregator' = via a connectivity partner. Impacts data freshness and rate accuracy.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of bookings to clicks for this listing within the reporting period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50% conversion rate). Sourced from platform reporting. Measures the effectiveness of the direct booking engine in converting metasearch traffic. Key input for bid optimization and landing page performance analysis.

attributes.name: cpa_actual
attributes.description: The actual average cost per acquisition (CPA) realized for this listing within the reporting period, in listing currency. Calculated as total_spend divided by booking_count. Stored as a raw field sourced from platform reporting. Null for non-CPA bid strategies. Key metric for channel cost-of-acquisition benchmarking.

attributes.name: cpc_actual
attributes.description: The actual average cost per click (CPC) realized for this listing within the reporting period, in listing currency. Calculated as total_spend divided by click_count. Stored as a raw field sourced from platform reporting to avoid recalculation discrepancies. Null for non-CPC bid strategies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this metasearch listing record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and tracking the onboarding of new metasearch platform listings.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this listing record (bid_amount, daily_budget_cap, monthly_budget_cap, cpc_actual, cpa_actual). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: daily_budget_cap
attributes.description: Maximum daily spend limit configured for this metasearch listing in the listing currency. Controls total metasearch investment exposure per day. Null if no daily cap is set. Used for budget pacing and channel investment governance.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The device category for which this bid configuration applies. Metasearch platforms support device-level bid adjustments. 'all' indicates a unified bid across all devices. Enables device-level performance analysis and bid optimization for direct booking conversion.

attributes.name: direct_booking_url
attributes.description: The landing page URL to which users are directed when clicking on this metasearch listing. Points to the hotel's direct booking engine (typically Sabre SynXis CRS-powered). Used for link validation, UTM parameter tracking, and ensuring correct booking attribution.

attributes.name: display_rank
attributes.description: The average position at which this property listing is displayed on the metasearch platform results page (e.g., rank 1 = top position). Lower rank numbers indicate higher visibility. Used to assess bid competitiveness and correlate rank with click-through and conversion performance.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this listing configuration (bid strategy, bid amount, budget caps, device targeting) became active on the metasearch platform. Supports historical bid strategy analysis and change management auditing. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: The date on which this listing configuration ceases to be active. Null for currently active configurations. Enables slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking of bid strategy and configuration changes over time. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this property listing was displayed to users on the metasearch platform within the reporting period. Foundational metric for calculating click-through rate (CTR) and measuring listing visibility. Sourced from platform reporting APIs.

attributes.name: is_direct_booking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this listing is configured to drive direct bookings through the hotel's own booking engine (True) versus redirecting to an OTA or third-party booking path (False). Key flag for measuring direct booking channel contribution and loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated rate parity monitoring is enabled for this metasearch listing. When True, the system actively checks for rate disparities between this listing and the direct booking channel. Supports compliance with AHLA rate parity guidelines and OTA contract obligations.

attributes.name: last_bid_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the bid amount, bid strategy, or budget configuration for this listing was last modified. Enables audit trail of bid management changes and supports analysis of bid adjustment impact on performance metrics. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: listing_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier assigned to this property listing on the metasearch platform. Used for reconciliation with platform-side reporting APIs and bid management systems. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the metasearch listing. Controls whether the property is actively bidding and displaying on the platform. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. 'active' = live and bidding; 'paused' = temporarily stopped; 'suspended' = platform-enforced stop; 'pending_review' = awaiting platform approval; 'inactive' = deactivated; 'archived' = historical record.

attributes.name: listing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the metasearch listing placement type. 'standard' = organic/paid standard placement; 'sponsored' = premium paid placement; 'featured' = highlighted featured listing; 'free_booking_links' = Google's commission-free direct booking link program. Determines cost structure and visibility tier.

attributes.name: monthly_budget_cap
attributes.description: Maximum monthly spend limit configured for this metasearch listing in the listing currency. Governs total monthly metasearch investment for the property-platform combination. Null if no monthly cap is set. Supports channel mix optimization and CapEx/OpEx planning.

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the metasearch platform on which this listing is active. Identifies the specific metasearch engine for bid strategy configuration, performance benchmarking, and cost-of-acquisition analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Google Hotel Ads|TripAdvisor|Trivago|Kayak|Skyscanner|Wego|HotelsCombined — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rate_parity_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rates displayed on this metasearch listing are in parity with the Best Available Rate (BAR) across all channels. 'parity' = rates match; 'disparity_detected' = rates differ from direct channel; 'under_review' = parity check in progress; 'exempt' = contractual exemption applies. Critical for OTA contract compliance and direct booking channel protection.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the performance reporting period for which metrics on this record apply. Used in conjunction with reporting_period_start to define the measurement window for all performance KPIs on this listing record.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the performance reporting period for which impression, click, booking, spend, and rate metrics on this record apply. Enables time-series analysis of metasearch performance and aligns with STR benchmarking reporting cycles.

attributes.name: return_on_ad_spend
attributes.description: The ratio of booking revenue to total spend for this listing within the reporting period (e.g., 8.50 = $8.50 revenue per $1.00 spent). Sourced from platform reporting or CRS attribution data. Primary KPI for metasearch investment optimization and bid strategy evaluation.

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or audience segment this listing bid configuration targets (e.g., US, UK, DE, APAC). Enables market-level bid differentiation and performance analysis. Aligns with Sabre SynXis CRS market segmentation and IDeaS G3 RMS demand forecasting by market.

attributes.name: total_spend
attributes.description: Total monetary amount spent on this metasearch listing (in listing currency) within the reporting period, including all click charges, acquisition fees, or commission payments depending on bid strategy. Core input for cost-of-acquisition (COA) and channel ROI calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this metasearch listing record was last updated in the data platform. Supports incremental ETL processing, data freshness monitoring, and audit trail requirements for channel distribution data governance.

attributes.name: utm_campaign_code
attributes.description: The UTM campaign parameter appended to the direct booking URL for this listing, enabling attribution tracking in web analytics and CRM systems. Used to measure metasearch-sourced traffic and bookings in Salesforce CRM and digital analytics platforms.

products.name: wholesale_allotment
products.description: Master and transactional records for room allotments contracted with wholesale partners (tour operators, bed banks, travel consortia). Captures wholesaler identity, property, room type, contracted allotment block size, release period, contracted net rate, allotment consumption, and remaining availability. Distinct from OTA channel records — wholesale allotments operate on pre-contracted net rate models with release-back provisions.

attributes.name: wholesale_allotment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the wholesale allotment record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Wholesale allotments are contracted with wholesaler partners who are represented as booking sources in the attribution model. Adding booking_source_id FK links the allotment to the specific wholesaler

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Wholesale allotments are sold through targeted marketing campaigns to tour operators and travel agencies; tracking campaign attribution for wholesale block sales enables campaign ROI measurement, whol

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master wholesale contract agreement under which this allotment is governed, including commercial terms and SLA obligations.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Wholesale allotments may be distributed through specific channels (e.g., a tour operator allotment sold via a specific distribution channel). Many allotments per channel. Removes redundant channel_cod

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: Wholesale allotments may be distributed via GDS networks (e.g., tour operator allotments loaded into Sabre for travel agent booking). Many allotments per GDS connection. Removes redundant gds_code whi

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wholesale partner (tour operator, bed bank, or travel consortium) with whom this allotment is contracted.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property to which this allotment block applies, as managed in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type (e.g., Deluxe King, Standard Double) included in this wholesale allotment block.

attributes.name: allotment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this allotment block, used in communications with the wholesale partner and in the Central Reservation System (CRS) via Sabre SynXis.

attributes.name: allotment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wholesale allotment block. 'active' indicates rooms are available for the wholesaler to sell; 'released' indicates the release period has passed and unsold rooms have been returned to general inventory; 'suspended' indicates temporarily blocked by revenue management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|released|expired|cancelled|pending — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allotment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allotment commitment model. 'hard_block' means rooms are guaranteed and held regardless of demand; 'soft_block' means rooms are held but can be reclaimed by the property; 'free_sale' means the wholesaler can sell without prior confirmation; 'on_request' means each booking requires property confirmation.

attributes.name: booking_deadline_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the wholesale partner must confirm bookings against this allotment block. After this date, unconfirmed allotment rooms may be released or renegotiated.

attributes.name: cancellation_count
attributes.description: Number of reservations cancelled against this allotment block by the wholesale partner. Used to monitor wholesaler booking behaviour and assess wash factor for future allotment sizing.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage payable to the wholesale partner or intermediary on consumed allotment bookings, where applicable. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted net rate. Some wholesale models are net-rate only with no commission.

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: Technical connectivity method used by the wholesale partner to access and consume this allotment. Determines how allotment updates and booking confirmations are exchanged.

attributes.name: consumed_units
attributes.description: Number of room-nights from the allotment block that have been picked up (booked) by the wholesale partner to date. Updated in near-real-time from the CRS and PMS.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the wholesale allotment agreement becomes commercially binding. Aligns with the master contract effective date in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the wholesale allotment agreement expires and the wholesaler's right to sell rooms under this block terminates. Nullable for evergreen agreements.

attributes.name: contracted_allotment_size
attributes.description: Total number of room-nights contracted with the wholesale partner for the defined stay period and room type. This is the original block size as agreed in the wholesale contract.

attributes.name: contracted_net_rate
attributes.description: The pre-agreed net rate (exclusive of markup) payable by the wholesale partner per room per night under this allotment contract. This is the wholesale net rate model — the wholesaler adds their own markup before selling to the end consumer. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wholesale allotment record was first created in the source system or lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contracted net rate and any financial terms in this allotment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the contract currency in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: daily_allotment_size
attributes.description: Number of rooms allocated per night within the stay period. Used when the allotment is expressed as a per-night room count rather than a total room-night block.

attributes.name: is_closed_to_arrival
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked on the stay_date_from under this allotment. A Closed to Arrival (CTA) restriction prevents new check-ins on specific dates while allowing through-stays.

attributes.name: is_stop_sell
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allotment has been closed to new bookings by the revenue management team, overriding remaining availability. When True, the wholesaler cannot make new reservations against this block regardless of remaining units.

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wholesale allotment is subject to Last Room Availability (LRA) obligations, meaning the wholesaler must be offered the last available room at the contracted rate. A key commercial term in premium wholesale contracts.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this wholesale allotment record, whether from a source system update or a manual override by the revenue management team.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Revenue management market segment code assigned to bookings originating from this wholesale allotment (e.g., WHOLE, TOUR, CONSOR). Used for USALI-compliant revenue segmentation and STR benchmarking.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted for a single booking under this wholesale allotment. Used to prevent excessively long stays at contracted net rates during peak demand periods.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay for a booking to be accepted under this wholesale allotment. A Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applied at the allotment level to protect revenue during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the revenue management or channel distribution team regarding special conditions, exceptions, or commercial context for this allotment block.

attributes.name: pickup_count
attributes.description: Number of individual reservations booked against this allotment block by the wholesale partner. Distinct from consumed_units (room-nights) — a single multi-night booking increments pickup_count by 1 but consumed_units by the number of nights.

attributes.name: rack_rate
attributes.description: Published Best Available Rate (BAR) or rack rate for the room type at the property, used as the reference rate for calculating the wholesale discount depth and monitoring rate parity obligations.

attributes.name: rate_parity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allotment's contracted net rate (after wholesaler markup) is expected to comply with rate parity obligations. True means parity monitoring is active for this allotment. Used in channel distribution compliance reporting.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which unsold allotment rooms are automatically released back to general inventory, derived from stay_date_from minus release_period_days. Stored for operational scheduling and revenue management triggers.

attributes.name: release_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the arrival date by which unsold allotment rooms must be released back to the property's general inventory. A key commercial term in wholesale contracts — e.g., a 21-day release means rooms not sold 21 days before check-in revert to the hotel.

attributes.name: remaining_units
attributes.description: Number of room-nights still available for the wholesale partner to sell within this allotment block. Calculated as contracted_allotment_size minus consumed_units, maintained as a stored operational field for real-time availability checks.

attributes.name: stay_date_from
attributes.description: First date of the stay period covered by this allotment block. Defines the start of the contracted inventory window during which the wholesaler may sell rooms.

attributes.name: stay_date_to
attributes.description: Last date of the stay period covered by this allotment block. Defines the end of the contracted inventory window. Inclusive of this date.

attributes.name: wash_factor_pct
attributes.description: Historical cancellation and no-show rate expressed as a percentage of contracted allotment, used to adjust effective allotment sizing in revenue forecasting. Derived from historical performance of this wholesaler-property-room type combination.

products.name: channel_negotiated_rate
products.description: Single source of truth is revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate. Master records for corporate negotiated rate agreements (LNR — Local Negotiated Rates) loaded and managed through distribution channels. Captures corporate account identifier, negotiated rate amount, rate plan code, applicable properties, room type inclusions, blackout dates, volume commitment, TMC (Travel Management Company) association, consortia membership, and GDS loading status per channel. Lives in the channel domain because these rates are operationally managed through the channel distribution workflow — loaded to GDS, distributed via TMC channels, and tracked for production/consumption at the channel level.
