SSOT: defers to revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate (MVM).revenue_negotiated_rate as single source of truth] [SSOT:negotiated_rate] Canonical single-source-of-truth for the 'negotiated_rate' concept; other domain variants are domain-specific specializations referencing this owner. SSOT: defers to canonical revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate (MVM cross-domain dedup).
products.reference: LNR / Corporate Rate Agreement / GDS Corporate Rate

attributes.name: channel_negotiated_rate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for negotiated_rate

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates (LNR) are loaded for specific booking sources such as TMCs (Travel Management Companies) and consortia. The channel_negotiated_rate table has iata_number (STRING) which shou

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Corporate negotiated rates are governed by channel contracts with TMCs, consortia, and corporate accounts. Adding nullable channel_contract_id FK links negotiated rates to their governing contract. Re

attributes.name: channel_corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account entity that holds this negotiated rate agreement. Links to the CRM or PMS corporate account master.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (GDS, TMC, direct, OTA) through which this negotiated rate is loaded and distributed.

attributes.name: channel_tmc_corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Travel Management Company (TMC) associated with this negotiated rate agreement. TMCs manage corporate travel programs and book through GDS channels.

attributes.name: loaded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Corporate rate loading by employees requires tracking for operational accountability and audit trails. Essential for understanding who loaded negotiated rates into systems and ensuring data quality in

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this negotiated rate is applicable. A single corporate agreement may have multiple records — one per property.

attributes.name: revenue_negotiated_rate_id
attributes.description: add column revenue_negotiated_rate_id (BIGINT) with FK to revenue.revenue_negotiated_rate.revenue_negotiated_rate_id - channel negotiated rates are channel projections of the revenue master negotiated rate.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan master record associated with this negotiated rate agreement.

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance that a booking must be made to qualify for this negotiated rate. Zero indicates no advance purchase requirement.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the negotiated rate agreement. Controls whether the rate is bookable through distribution channels.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The agreed nightly room rate (ADR equivalent) for this corporate negotiated rate agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. This is the principal monetary value of the rate record.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the revenue management leader or director who approved this negotiated rate agreement for loading and distribution.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or date range expressions representing dates on which this negotiated rate is not available (e.g., peak demand periods, holidays, special events). Stored as a descriptive string; detailed blackout records managed in rate restriction tables.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation policy applicable to bookings made under this negotiated rate (e.g., 24H, 48H, NON-REF). Governs penalty and refund rules.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage commission payable to the TMC or travel agency on bookings made under this negotiated rate agreement. Expressed as a percentage of the gross booking value.

attributes.name: consortia_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the travel consortia (e.g., Virtuoso, Signature, Ensemble, Internova) through which this negotiated rate is distributed. Consortia rates are loaded separately from direct LNR agreements.

attributes.name: consortia_name
attributes.description: Full name of the travel consortia organization associated with this rate agreement (e.g., Virtuoso, Signature Travel Network).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this negotiated rate record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: crs_rate_code
attributes.description: Native rate identifier as assigned by the Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS). Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the CRS source system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the negotiated rate amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the negotiated rate agreement becomes active and bookable through distribution channels. Aligns with the contract start date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the negotiated rate agreement expires and is no longer bookable. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code identifying the hotel chain under which this rate is loaded in the GDS (e.g., HH for Hilton, MC for Marriott). Required for GDS rate distribution.

attributes.name: gds_loading_status
attributes.description: Current status of the negotiated rate's loading into the GDS (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Tracks whether the rate is live and bookable through GDS channels.

attributes.name: is_last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this negotiated rate carries Last Room Availability (LRA) status, meaning the rate must be offered as long as any room of the applicable type remains available, regardless of inventory controls.

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity obligations apply to this negotiated rate across all distribution channels. Relevant for OTA and GDS channel compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this negotiated rate record, including rate amount changes, status updates, or GDS loading status changes.

attributes.name: market_segment_code
attributes.description: Market segment classification code assigned to bookings made under this negotiated rate (e.g., CORP, GOVT, CONS). Used for revenue management segmentation and USALI reporting.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted under this negotiated rate. Null indicates no upper LOS restriction.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a booking to qualify for this negotiated rate. LOS = Length of Stay restriction applied at the channel level.

attributes.name: negotiation_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which this negotiated rate agreement was contracted. Corporate LNR agreements are typically renegotiated annually; this field supports year-over-year production analysis.

attributes.name: pms_rate_code
attributes.description: Rate code as configured in Oracle OPERA PMS for this negotiated rate. Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRS-distributed rates and PMS-posted rates.

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Hotel segment category under which this negotiated rate is classified, aligning with the property's service tier (luxury, premium, select-service, standard).

attributes.name: rate_loading_date
attributes.description: Date on which this negotiated rate was loaded into the GDS and/or CRS for distribution. Tracks operational readiness of the rate for booking.

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric rate plan code as loaded in the CRS and GDS systems (e.g., CORP01, LNR2025). Used for rate identification across distribution channels and PMS.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the negotiated rate plan as displayed in the CRS, GDS, and TMC booking tools (e.g., 'Acme Corp 2025 LNR').

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the negotiated rate type. LNR = Local Negotiated Rate, LRA = Last Room Availability, BAR = Best Available Rate, NRR = Non-Refundable Rate, consortia = travel consortia rate, government = government/per-diem rate.

attributes.name: room_type_inclusion
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or description of room type codes included under this negotiated rate agreement (e.g., 'KING,DBLQ,SUITE'). Defines which room categories the corporate rate applies to.

attributes.name: tmc_name
attributes.description: Name of the Travel Management Company (TMC) managing the corporate travel program for this negotiated rate (e.g., American Express Global Business Travel, BCD Travel, CWT).

attributes.name: volume_commitment_room_nights
attributes.description: Contractually committed number of room nights the corporate account has agreed to consume during the agreement period. Used for production tracking and rate renegotiation.

products.name: package_rate
products.description: This association product represents the distribution agreement between a distribution channel and a spa package. It captures channel-specific pricing, commission structures, booking rules, and availability controls that exist only in the context of offering a specific package through a specific channel. Each record links one distribution channel to one spa package with rate loading, promotional pricing, and channel-specific restrictions that revenue management actively maintains.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality revenue management, spa packages are actively distributed through multiple channels (OTA platforms, GDS, direct web, corporate) with channel-specific pricing, commission structures, and booking rules. Each spa package can be offered through many distribution channels simultaneously, and each channel offers many spa packages. Revenue management teams actively maintain channel-specific rates, promotional pricing, and availability controls for each channel-package combination.

attributes.name: package_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this channel-package rate configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: Package rates distributed through channels may be based on or derived from channel rate plans. Adding nullable channel_rate_plan_id FK allows linking package pricing to the underlying rate plan when a

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Package Rate - Distribution Channel Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the distribution channel through which the spa package is offered

tag_set.value: Channel Package Rate - Distribution Channel Id

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Package Rate - Spa Package Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the spa package being distributed through the channel

tag_set.value: Channel Package Rate - Spa Package Id

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_override
attributes.description: Channel-specific cancellation policy code that overrides the packages default cancellation policy. Used when channel agreements require different cancellation terms (e.g., OTAs may require more flexible cancellation than direct bookings).

attributes.name: channel_package_price
attributes.description: Channel-specific price for this spa package. May differ from rack rate due to channel agreements, commissions, or promotional strategies. This is the price displayed and charged through this specific channel.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage charged by this channel for bookings of this specific package. May override the channels default commission rate for strategic packages or promotional periods.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel-package rate configuration was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this channel-package rate configuration is active and bookings can be accepted through this channel.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: End date after which this channel-package rate configuration expires and the package is no longer bookable through this channel. Null indicates indefinite availability.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel-package combination is currently active and accepting bookings. Revenue management uses this to control package availability by channel without deleting historical rate configurations.

attributes.name: last_rate_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent rate update pushed to this channel for this package. Used for rate synchronization monitoring and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: minimum_advance_booking
attributes.description: Channel-specific minimum advance booking requirement in hours. May override the packages default minimum advance booking to accommodate channel-specific operational constraints or SLAs.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this channel-package rate configuration.

attributes.name: rate_loading_status
attributes.description: Current status of rate loading to this channel for this package. LOADED = rates successfully pushed to channel, PENDING = awaiting transmission, FAILED = transmission error, SUSPENDED = temporarily disabled, INACTIVE = not currently distributed through this channel.

products.name: ota_campaign_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between OTA partners and marketing campaigns. It captures co-operative marketing agreements where OTA partners participate in hotel-led campaigns with negotiated budget contributions, performance incentives, and content requirements. Each record links one OTA partner to one campaign with financial terms, performance tracking, and partnership-specific campaign execution details that exist only in the context of this co-marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality, OTA co-marketing campaigns are a standard operational practice where hotels negotiate participation agreements with multiple OTA partners (Expedia, Booking.com, Agoda) for seasonal promotions, new property launches, and loyalty tie-ins. Each OTA partner participates in multiple campaigns throughout the year, and each campaign involves multiple OTA partners with partner-specific budget contributions, performance targets, content requirements, and promotional placements. Marketing teams actively manage these participation agreements as distinct business entities with negotiated terms, financial tracking, and performance measurement.

attributes.name: ota_campaign_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this OTA partner's participation in a specific campaign. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ota Campaign Participation - Ota Partner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the OTA partner participating in this campaign

attributes.name: actual_booking_volume
attributes.description: Actual number of bookings generated by this OTA partner during the campaign period. Updated as campaign progresses.

attributes.name: actual_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Actual revenue generated from bookings attributed to this OTA partner during the campaign period.

attributes.name: agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the co-marketing agreement or insertion order governing this OTA partner's participation in this campaign.

attributes.name: campaign_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this OTA partner's participation in the campaign concludes. May differ from the overall campaign end date if partners have different participation windows.

attributes.name: campaign_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this OTA partner's participation in the campaign begins. May differ from the overall campaign start date if partners join at different times.

attributes.name: content_requirements
attributes.description: Campaign-specific content requirements negotiated with this OTA partner, including creative specifications, messaging guidelines, brand usage rules, and promotional placement details.

attributes.name: coop_marketing_budget
attributes.description: Total co-operative marketing budget allocated for this OTA partner's participation in this specific campaign. Represents the combined hotel and partner investment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this OTA campaign participation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: hotel_contribution_amount

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier of who last modified this participation record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this participation record was last updated.

The attribute should be decomposed into partner-specific participation records with coop_marketing_budget and partner_contribution_amount tracked for each OTA partner's participation.]

products.name: channel_wholesale_inventory_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the inventory allocation contract between room types and distribution channels. It captures channel-specific inventory controls, sell limits, rate parity enforcement, and allocation rules that exist only in the context of a specific room-type-channel pairing. Each record links one room type to one distribution channel with operational controls that govern how that room type is sold through that specific channel.. Existence Justification: In hotel revenue management operations, each room type is distributed across multiple channels (OTA, GDS, direct, wholesale) with channel-specific inventory controls, and each channel sells multiple room types with distinct allocation rules. products.name: beo_item

Enables granular event cost tracking, catering production planning, kitchen prep sheets, and post-event billing reconciliation. Also serves as the transactional record linking catalog offerings (menus, AV packages) to actual event consumption.

products.name: event_class_enrollment
products.description: Single source of truth is spa.spa_class_enrollment. This association product represents the enrollment event between an event attendee and a fitness class session. attributes.description: The price per person for banquet packages, coffee breaks, cocktail receptions, and other per-guest priced menus. Null for à la carte menus where items are individually priced.

attributes.name: preparation_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Minimum advance notice required in hours for kitchen preparation and ingredient procurement. Used in event sales quoting and reservation acceptance rules.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: The pricing category or tier of this menu, used for revenue management and market positioning.

attributes.name: print_sequence
attributes.description: Display order sequence for menu presentation in Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS, printed materials, and digital menu boards.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this menu is part of a limited-time promotional campaign (True) or a standard offering (False). Used for marketing analytics and revenue management.

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal menu (True) with limited availability based on ingredient seasonality and market demand, or a year-round menu (False).

attributes.name: service_charge_inclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu price includes service charges or gratuity (True) or these are added separately (False). Important for banquet and catering pricing transparency.

attributes.name: service_style
attributes.description: The method of food service delivery for this menu. Critical for labor planning and guest experience management.

attributes.name: setup_requirements

attributes.name: target_guest_segment
attributes.description: The primary guest segment this menu is designed for (e.g., 'Corporate Groups', 'Wedding Parties', 'Leisure Travelers', 'VIP Guests', 'MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) Attendees').

attributes.name: tax_inclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu price includes applicable taxes (True) or taxes are added at Point of Sale (POS) (False). Critical for revenue recognition and guest billing transparency.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number for menu lifecycle management and change tracking. Incremented with each menu revision to support outlet-level menu versioning.

products.name: menu_item

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: calorie_count

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: The standard cost to produce one unit of this menu item, including ingredients, labor, and direct overhead. Used for food cost percentage calculation and Gross Operating Profit (GOP) analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard price and cost price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-property operations across different countries.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: The gross profit margin percentage calculated as (standard_price - cost_price) / standard_price * 100. Key metric for menu engineering and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: is_alcoholic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu item contains alcohol. Used for age verification requirements, licensing compliance, and separate revenue tracking per USALI standards.

attributes.name: is_available_banquet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this menu item is available for banquet, catering, and group event menus. Used for Banquet Event Order (BEO) planning and MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) operations.

attributes.name: is_available_room_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether this menu item is available for in-room dining / room service orders. Some items may be outlet-only due to preparation complexity or presentation requirements.

attributes.name: is_gluten_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu item is free from gluten-containing ingredients. Critical for guests with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

attributes.name: is_halal

attributes.name: is_kosher

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this menu item is only available during specific seasons or time periods. Used for menu planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: is_signature_item

attributes.name: is_vegan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu item is suitable for vegan diets (contains no animal products or by-products). Used for dietary filtering and guest preference matching.

attributes.name: is_vegetarian
attributes.description: Indicates whether the menu item is suitable for vegetarian diets (contains no meat or fish but may contain dairy or eggs). Used for dietary filtering and guest preference matching.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the menu item distinguishing between food, beverage, modifiers (add-ons), packages, combos, or merchandise.

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code used to identify the menu item in the Point of Sale (POS) system. This is the externally-known business identifier used by staff and in reporting.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the menu item including ingredients, preparation method, and presentation style. Used for guest communication and staff training.

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: The display name of the menu item as it appears on menus and guest-facing materials.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the menu item indicating availability for sale. Active items are currently available, seasonal items are available during specific periods, inactive items are temporarily unavailable, discontinued items are permanently removed, and pending items are awaiting approval.

attributes.name: item_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the item category. Examples: appetizer, entrée, dessert, cocktail, wine, beer, non-alcoholic, side dish, condiment. Used for menu organization and sales analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this menu item record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: menu_section
attributes.description: The section or grouping on the menu where this item appears (e.g., Starters, Main Courses, Desserts, Signature Cocktails, Wine List). Used for menu layout and guest navigation.

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum age required to purchase this menu item, typically applicable to alcoholic beverages. Null for items with no age restriction. Used for Point of Sale (POS) age verification prompts.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this menu item record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: portion_size
attributes.description: The standard serving size or portion measurement for the menu item (e.g., 8 oz, 250 ml, 1 piece, serves 2). Used for consistency, cost control, and nutritional disclosure.

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: The standard time in minutes required to prepare and serve this menu item from order placement to guest delivery. Used for kitchen workflow planning and guest expectation management.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: The USALI revenue center code to which sales of this menu item are posted for financial reporting. Examples: F&B-REST (Restaurant), F&B-BAR (Bar), F&B-RMSERV (Room Service), F&B-BANQ (Banquet).

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Description of when the seasonal item is available (e.g., Summer Menu, Holiday Special, Spring 2024). Null for non-seasonal items.

attributes.name: spice_level
attributes.description: Indicates the heat or spiciness level of the menu item. Used for guest preference matching and expectation setting.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: The standard selling price of the menu item before any discounts, promotions, or service charges. This is the base price used for revenue calculation and Average Daily Rate (ADR) contribution analysis.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax classification for this menu item determining applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates. Categories vary by jurisdiction (e.g., food, alcohol, non-alcoholic beverage, prepared food, grocery).

products.name: recipe

Enables food cost percentage calculation, variance analysis, and supports procurement planning. Owned by F&B domain as the authoritative source for recipe costing.

attributes.name: ccp_details

attributes.name: chef_notes

attributes.name: cooking_instructions

attributes.name: cooking_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to cook or finish the recipe. Critical for kitchen capacity planning, guest wait time estimation, and service flow management.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts in this recipe (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: cuisine_type
attributes.description: Culinary style or regional cuisine classification (e.g., 'Italian', 'Asian Fusion', 'Contemporary American'). Supports menu diversity analysis and guest preference tracking.

attributes.name: dietary_attributes
attributes.description: Dietary classifications and attributes (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free', 'dairy-free', 'halal', 'kosher'). Supports menu filtering, guest preference matching, and inclusive dining experiences.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: haccp_hazard_analysis

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recipe record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: recipe_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the recipe as it appears on menus and in kitchen systems (e.g., 'Grilled Atlantic Salmon', 'Signature Chocolate Lava Cake').

attributes.name: nutritional_calories
attributes.description: Total calories per standard portion. Required for menu labeling compliance in many jurisdictions and supports wellness-focused guest preferences.

attributes.name: nutritional_carbohydrate_grams
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content in grams per standard portion. Supports dietary planning and menu labeling compliance.

attributes.name: nutritional_fat_grams
attributes.description: Total fat content in grams per standard portion. Required for nutritional labeling and dietary analysis.

attributes.name: nutritional_protein_grams
attributes.description: Protein content in grams per standard portion. Supports nutritional transparency and wellness program requirements.

attributes.name: nutritional_sodium_milligrams

attributes.name: portion_size_unit

attributes.name: preparation_method

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes

attributes.name: recipe_status

attributes.name: shelf_life_hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours that the prepared recipe can be safely held before service or disposal. Critical for food safety, waste management, and batch production planning.

attributes.name: skill_level_required
attributes.description: The culinary skill level required to execute this recipe consistently (basic, intermediate, advanced, expert). Used for staff assignment, training planning, and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: standard_beverage_cost_per_portion
attributes.description: The calculated cost of beverage ingredients (wine, spirits, mixers) required to produce one standard portion. Applicable to beverage recipes and cocktails. Supports beverage cost percentage tracking.

attributes.name: standard_food_cost_per_portion
attributes.description: The calculated cost of ingredients required to produce one standard portion of this recipe. Foundation for menu pricing, food cost percentage analysis, and GOP calculation per USALI standards.

attributes.name: standard_portion_size
attributes.description: The standard serving size per portion in the specified unit of measure. Critical for portion control, cost consistency, and nutritional labeling compliance.

attributes.name: storage_instructions
attributes.description: Proper storage requirements for prepared recipe or components, including temperature range, container type, and maximum hold time. Critical for food safety and quality maintenance.

attributes.name: total_recipe_cost
attributes.description: The total cost to produce the full recipe yield (all portions). Calculated as sum of all ingredient costs. Used for batch costing and procurement planning.

attributes.name: total_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes from start to finish, including preparation, cooking, and plating. Used for kitchen scheduling and service time commitments.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this recipe specification. Incremented when recipe is modified. Supports change tracking and historical cost analysis.

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The number of portions or servings this recipe produces when prepared according to standard method. Used for portion cost calculation and inventory planning.

attributes.name: yield_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the recipe yield quantity (e.g., 'portion', 'ounce', 'liter'). Standardizes recipe costing and inventory consumption tracking. attributes.description: Unique identifier for each ingredient line within a recipe. Primary key for the recipe ingredient entity.

products.name: fnb_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between F&B inventory items and vendors. It captures vendor-specific sourcing terms, pricing, lead times, and purchase history for each item-vendor combination. Each record links one inventory item to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific supply relationship, enabling multi-sourcing strategies, cost optimization, and supply continuity management.. Existence Justification: In hotel F&B operations, inventory items are routinely sourced from multiple vendors to ensure supply continuity, optimize costs, and manage risk. A single item (e.g., olive oil) may have a primary supplier, a backup supplier, and spot market vendors, each with different pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities. Conversely, each vendor supplies hundreds of different F&B items. This is an operational multi-sourcing strategy actively managed by procurement teams.

products.name: housekeeping_training_completion
products.description: Single source of truth is compliance.compliance_training_completion. This association product represents the enrollment and completion tracking between housekeeping attendants and learning courses. It captures the operational training lifecycle including enrollment, completion status, assessment scores, certification issuance, and expiry tracking. Each record links one attendant to one learning course with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific training enrollment. Supports OSHA compliance reporting, certification tracking for suite/VIP qualifications, chemical handling and bloodborne pathogen protocol compliance, and scheduling of qualified staff to appropriate assignments.. Existence Justification: In hotel housekeeping operations, attendants must complete multiple training courses throughout their employment (chemical handling, bloodborne pathogen protocols, suite service certification, VIP certification, ongoing compliance refreshers), and each course is delivered to many attendants across the property and enterprise. The business actively manages training enrollments as operational records with enrollment dates, completion tracking, assessment scores, certification expiry dates, and recertification cycles. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process called 'training completion' or 'course enrollment' that HR and housekeeping managers actively create, monitor, and use for compliance reporting and qualified staff scheduling. SSOT: defers to compliance.compliance_training_completion (MVM).compliance_training_completion as single source of truth]compliance_training_completion. [SSOT:training_completion] Domain-specific specialization of the 'training_completion' concept; canonical SSOT owner is compliance.compliance_training_completion. SSOT: defers to canonical compliance.compliance_training_completion (MVM cross-domain dedup).

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between employee and benefit_plan. It captures the employee's election of a specific benefit plan, including coverage details, contribution amounts, dependent information, and enrollment lifecycle status. Each record links one employee to one benefit_plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship. Supports ACA compliance reporting, open enrollment processing, life event changes, and total compensation analysis per USALI standards.. Existence Justification: Benefit enrollment is a core HR operational process where employees actively elect multiple benefit plans (health, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance) and each plan is elected by multiple employees. HR benefits teams manage enrollment campaigns, process elections, track coverage periods, calculate contributions, and produce regulatory reports (ACA 1095-C). The enrollment relationship has its own lifecycle (pending → active → terminated), business rules (eligibility, waiting periods, enrollment windows), and dedicated systems (Oracle HCM Cloud Benefits).

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Financial management including GL, AP, AR, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting per USALI standards and GAAP/IFRS. Manages property-level P&L, departmental accounting, capital expenditure tracking (CapEx, FF&E), and consolidated financial statements. Tracks GOP, EBITDA, NOI calculations. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA. Supports SOX financial controls for publicly traded entities.

products.name: ledger
products.description: General Ledger (GL) master entity representing the chart of accounts structure per USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) standards. Each ledger account defines an account number, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account group, normal balance indicator, and currency. Serves as the authoritative financial record backbone for all property-level and consolidated financial reporting including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, GOP, EBITDA, NOI, and GOPPAR calculations. Supports period-end financial statement generation and multi-property consolidation with intercompany elimination. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA GL module.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger / USALI Chart of Accounts

attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation (e.g., bank accounts, accounts receivable, inventory accounts). Used for internal control and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: is_statistical

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Assets and expenses have debit normal balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit normal balances. Used for transaction validation and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control testing and documentation requirements. Typically true for material accounts affecting financial statement accuracy for publicly traded hospitality companies.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category or tax line item code associated with this account for tax reporting purposes (e.g., taxable revenue, non-taxable revenue, deductible expense, non-deductible expense). Supports automated tax return preparation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code within the enterprise structure to which this journal entry belongs. Used for consolidated financial reporting and intercompany elimination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: document_number

attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to functional currency at the time of posting. Null if transaction and functional currencies are the same.

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: functional_currency_code

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry in the approval and posting workflow. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval to final posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: reference_text
attributes.description: Additional reference information or notes related to this journal entry, such as supporting documentation references, approval notes, or special instructions.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal entry, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the originating source transaction document (e.g., invoice number, payment document, POS check number) that triggered this journal entry.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code or tax jurisdiction code applicable to this journal entry, if the entry involves tax-related postings (sales tax, VAT, occupancy tax, etc.).

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction currency if different from functional currency. Used for foreign exchange tracking.

products.name: finance_budget
products.description: Annual and periodic financial budget master representing planned and forecasted financial targets at both header and line-item granularity. Each budget contains line items by GL account, cost center, profit center, and fiscal period combination. Supports approved annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and reforecasts (distinguished by budget type/version). Captures budgeted revenue (rooms, F&B, events), budgeted expenses (labor, CPOR, FF&E reserve contributions), and budgeted KPIs (ADR, OCC, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, NOI). Enables granular budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance analysis at the account, department, and property level. Supports USALI departmental budget reporting and management review. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Planning and Budgeting module. SSOT: defers to revenue.revenue_budget (MVM). [SSOT_OWNER] [SSOT MASTER for group finance.finance_budget] [SSOT:budget] Canonical single-source-of-truth for the 'budget' concept; other domain variants are domain-specific specializations referencing this owner.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Budget Planning / USALI Budget

Covers buildings, FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment), technology systems, and leasehold improvements. Tracks asset class, PIP (Property Improvement Plan) reference, CapEx approval status, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method and schedule, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and disposal status.
