attributes.name: calendar_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter number (1-4) in which the period starts. Used for calendar-based comparisons and external benchmarking.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the period starts (e.g., 2024). May differ from fiscal_year for companies with non-calendar fiscal years.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the fiscal period was closed for transaction posting. Null if period is still open. Used for financial close tracking and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fiscal period record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this fiscal period. Used for daily average calculations (e.g., Average Daily Rate, Revenue Per Available Room).

attributes.name: fiscal_period_description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive text or notes about this fiscal period, including special circumstances, adjustments, or reporting considerations.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date included in this fiscal period. Defines the end boundary for transaction posting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month number within the fiscal year (1-12). Null for non-monthly periods. Used for monthly financial close and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fiscal period. Open: period is active and transactions can be posted. Closed: period is closed for regular posting but can be reopened. Locked: period is finalized and cannot accept new transactions without special authorization. Archived: period is archived for historical reference only.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number within the fiscal year (1-4). Null for non-quarterly periods. Used for quarterly financial reporting and SEC filings.

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: The fiscal week number within the fiscal year (1-52 or 1-53). Null for non-weekly periods. Used for weekly operational and revenue reporting in hospitality operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Used for year-over-year comparisons and annual financial statement consolidation.

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (e.g., Period 13) used for year-end adjustments and accruals. True if adjustment period, False if regular operating period.

attributes.name: is_leap_year
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period falls within a leap year. True if leap year, False otherwise. Used for accurate daily average calculations.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was locked and finalized. Null if period is not yet locked. Used for audit trail and financial statement finalization.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fiscal period record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the fiscal period, typically formatted as YYYY-MM or YYYY-Pnn (e.g., 2024-01, 2024-P01). Used in financial reports and external communications.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fiscal period (e.g., January 2024, Q1 2024, FY2024-P01). Used for display in reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year (e.g., 1-12 for monthly periods, 1-4 for quarterly periods). Used for period-to-period comparisons and trend analysis.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period granularity: month (standard monthly period), quarter (quarterly period), year (annual fiscal year), week (weekly period for operational reporting), or custom (non-standard period for special reporting needs).

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: The date when a previously closed period was reopened for adjustments. Null if period has never been reopened. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for financial reporting in this period (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date included in this fiscal period. Defines the beginning of the period for transaction posting and financial reporting.

products.name: gl_batch
products.description: Master reference table for gl_batch. Referenced by gl_batch_id.

attributes.name: gl_batch_id
attributes.description: Primary key for gl_batch

attributes.name: parent_gl_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original GL batch that this batch reverses, if this is a reversal batch. Used to track the relationship between reversal entries and their original accruals. Null if this is not a reversal batch.

attributes.name: gl_reversal_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL batch that reverses this batch, if applicable. Used to track the relationship between original accrual entries and their subsequent reversals. Null if batch has not been reversed.

attributes.name: primary_reversal_gl_batch_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on gl_batch (reversal_gl_batch_id)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: FK connection added per structural fix

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period to which this GL batch applies, typically in format YYYY-MM or period number (e.g., '2024-01', 'Period 3 FY2024'). Used for period-end closing and financial reporting alignment.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL batch requires formal approval before it can be posted to the general ledger. True if approval workflow is required, False if batch can be posted without approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the GL batch for posting. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail. Null if batch has not been approved or does not require approval.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GL batch was approved for posting. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance. Null if batch has not been approved.

attributes.name: batch_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title assigned to the GL batch to identify its purpose or content (e.g., 'Monthly Accruals - January 2024', 'Payroll Posting - Week 12').

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the GL batch, typically assigned by the accounting system or finance team for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL batch: draft (being prepared), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (authorized for posting), posted (committed to the general ledger), rejected (not approved), or cancelled (voided before posting).

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GL batch based on its accounting purpose: standard (regular transactions), recurring (automated periodic entries), adjustment (correcting entries), accrual (period-end accruals), reversal (reversing prior entries), or closing (period/year-end closing entries).

attributes.name: control_total
attributes.description: Optional control total amount provided by the batch creator for validation purposes. Used to verify that the sum of batch entries matches the expected total before posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GL batch record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for tracking batch lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the GL batch amounts are denominated (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department or cost center associated with this GL batch (e.g., 'ROOMS', 'F&B', 'ADMIN'). Used for departmental accounting and GOP calculation per USALI.

attributes.name: gl_batch_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the GL batch purpose, content, or context. Provides additional information beyond the batch name for audit trail and user reference.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date or transaction date that the GL batch entries represent. May differ from posting_date when backdating or forward-dating entries for accruals or adjustments.

attributes.name: entry_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual journal entries or line items contained within this GL batch. Used for validation and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: external_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier from the source system or business process that originated this GL batch (e.g., invoice number, payroll run ID, bank statement reference). Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this GL batch belongs (e.g., 2024). Used for annual financial reporting and year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GL batch is in balance (total debits equal total credits). True if balanced, False if out of balance. Out-of-balance batches cannot be posted.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL batch is part of a recurring batch template that is automatically generated on a scheduled basis (e.g., monthly rent accruals, depreciation entries).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the GL batch. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance. Null if batch has never been modified after creation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GL batch was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes to the batch. Null if batch has never been modified after creation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments added by users regarding the GL batch. Used for additional context, special instructions, or documentation of unusual circumstances.

attributes.name: posted_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who posted the GL batch to the general ledger. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance. Null if batch has not been posted.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the GL batch was posted to the general ledger. Represents the moment the batch entries were committed to the GL. Null if batch has not been posted.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GL batch was or will be posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and impacts the accounting period in which transactions are recognized.

attributes.name: recurring_frequency
attributes.description: For recurring batches, specifies the frequency at which the batch is automatically generated: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually. Null for non-recurring batches.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation provided by the approver when rejecting a GL batch. Documents why the batch was not approved for posting. Null if batch has not been rejected.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL batch should be automatically reversed, if applicable. Commonly used for accrual entries that need to be reversed in the subsequent period.

attributes.name: source_module
attributes.description: Specific module or sub-system within the source system that generated the batch (e.g., 'Accounts Payable', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Fixed Assets', 'Payroll').

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all credit entries in the GL batch. Must equal total_debit_amount for the batch to be in balance per double-entry accounting principles.

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all debit entries in the GL batch. Must equal total_credit_amount for the batch to be in balance per double-entry accounting principles.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created or initiated the GL batch. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance and internal controls.

products.name: allocation_rule_set
products.description: Master reference table for allocation_rule_set. Referenced by allocation_rule_set_id.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Primary key for allocation_rule_set

attributes.name: allocation_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this allocation rule set record in the system.

attributes.name: allocation_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this allocation rule set for active use in financial processing.

attributes.name: allocation_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who most recently modified this allocation rule set record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: FK connection added per structural fix

attributes.name: superseded_allocation_rule_set_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on allocation_rule_set (superseded_allocation_rule_set_id)

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The business driver or metric used as the basis for allocation calculations (e.g., room nights, square footage, headcount, revenue, labor hours).

attributes.name: allocation_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which this allocation rule set is executed in the financial close process.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The calculation methodology used by this rule set to distribute costs or revenues across entities (direct assignment, step-down, reciprocal, percentage-based, driver-based, or activity-based costing).

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Fixed percentage used for allocation when the allocation method is percentage-based. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_set_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation rule set indicating whether it is actively being used in financial processing.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Reference to the approval workflow configuration that governs the review and approval process for allocations generated by this rule set.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation rule set was approved for active use.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether detailed audit trail logging is required for all allocations performed using this rule set.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and justification for this allocation rule set including regulatory requirements, management reporting needs, or operational drivers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation rule set record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which threshold amounts and allocation calculations are denominated.

attributes.name: department_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or pattern of department codes to which this allocation rule set applies. Used to scope the rule set to specific departments.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_set_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the allocation rule set including its purpose, scope, and any special considerations for its application.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation rule set ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended rule set with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this allocation rule set becomes active and applicable to financial transactions.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or reference number for this allocation rule set used for integration and reconciliation with source financial systems.

attributes.name: gl_account_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or pattern of GL account codes to which this allocation rule set applies. Used to scope the rule set to specific account ranges.

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation rule set executes automatically during the financial close process or requires manual triggering.

attributes.name: is_reciprocal_allocation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rule set supports reciprocal allocation where departments can allocate costs to each other iteratively.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation rule set record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: maximum_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount for which this allocation rule set applies. Transactions above this threshold may use different allocation logic.

attributes.name: minimum_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required for this allocation rule set to be applied. Transactions below this threshold are excluded from allocation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about this allocation rule set including implementation details, special handling instructions, or historical context.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking that determines the order of execution when multiple allocation rule sets apply to the same transaction or entity. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: property_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or pattern of property codes to which this allocation rule set applies. Used to scope the rule set to specific properties or property groups.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether allocation results from this rule set require management approval before posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: rule_set_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the allocation rule set used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: rule_set_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the allocation rule set that clearly identifies its purpose and scope.

attributes.name: rule_set_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation rule set indicating what type of financial data it allocates (cost, revenue, expense, overhead, departmental, or property-level).

attributes.name: source_entity_type
attributes.description: The type of organizational entity from which costs or revenues are being allocated (property, department, cost center, profit center, division, region, or brand).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this allocation rule set was created or integrated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Financials, custom allocation engine).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation rule set is subject to SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trail and segregation of duties.

attributes.name: target_entity_type
attributes.description: The type of organizational entity to which costs or revenues are being allocated (property, department, cost center, profit center, division, region, or brand).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this allocation rule set configuration used to track changes and maintain historical versions for audit and rollback purposes.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Purchasing and vendor management for property operations including supplier contracts, purchase orders, receiving, spend analytics, and goods receipt. Manages vendor relationships, contract compliance, procurement categories (F&B supplies, housekeeping, FF&E), and cost optimization. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA MM module. Supports both CapEx procurement (PIP projects) and OpEx purchasing.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers and vendors providing goods and services to hotel and resort properties. Captures vendor identity, classification (F&B supplier, FF&E vendor, housekeeping supplier, maintenance contractor), tax registration, payment terms, preferred currency, remittance details, diversity certification, contact persons (account managers, sales reps, escalation contacts), and SAP S/4HANA vendor master integration. Serves as the SSOT for vendor identity and vendor contacts across procurement. Includes vendor tier, risk rating, compliance status, bank/payment details, and communication preferences.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor. Primary key for the vendor master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: FK connection added per structural fix

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendors primary business address including street number and name. Used for correspondence and legal documentation.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendors address for suite, floor, building, or other secondary address information.

attributes.name: annual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total procurement spend with this vendor over the most recent 12-month period. Used for vendor segmentation, negotiation leverage analysis, and spend analytics. Expressed in the companys reporting currency.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendors bank account number for electronic payment remittance. Highly sensitive financial information requiring restricted access and encryption.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the vendors primary remittance account. Used for ACH and wire transfer payments.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number identifying the vendors bank for ACH and wire transfers in the United States.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendors primary business location.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Primary business classification of the vendor based on goods or services provided. Categories include Food and Beverage (F&B) supplier, housekeeping supplier, Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) vendor, maintenance contractor, technology provider, and professional services.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the vendor used in procurement documents and SAP S/4HANA MM module. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each supplier.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status indicating whether the vendor meets all required certifications, insurance requirements, and regulatory standards. Non-compliant vendors may be blocked from receiving new purchase orders.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current master service agreement or supply contract with the vendor. Null for vendors without formal contracts or with evergreen agreements.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current master service agreement or supply contract with the vendor. Used for contract lifecycle management and renewal tracking.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the vendors primary business location. Examples: USA (United States), CAN (Canada), GBR (United Kingdom).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing business as name if different from legal name. Used for operational communications and invoicing.

attributes.name: diversity_certification
attributes.description: Diversity certification status of the vendor. Categories include Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Women Business Enterprise (WBE), Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE), Veteran Business Enterprise (VBE), LGBTQ Business Enterprise (LGBTBE), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), HUBZone certified, or none. Used for supplier diversity reporting and corporate social responsibility initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mbe|wbe|dbe|vbe|lgbtbe|sdvosb|hubzone|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number providing unique identification for the vendor entity. Used for credit assessment and supplier risk management.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for vendors in countries using the IBAN standard. Required for SEPA payments in Europe and other international transfers.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendors current general liability insurance certificate. Vendors must maintain valid insurance coverage to remain in active status.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent vendor performance review or compliance audit. Strategic and preferred vendors are typically reviewed annually; approved vendors are reviewed every 2-3 years.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order submission to delivery at property receiving dock. Used for inventory planning and procurement scheduling.

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: Minimum purchase order value required by the vendor for order acceptance. Orders below this threshold may incur additional fees or be rejected. Expressed in the vendors preferred currency.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor master record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor or supplier organization as registered with tax authorities and used in contracts.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next vendor performance review or compliance audit. Used for vendor management workflow and compliance calendar.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was first approved and added to the procurement system. Used for vendor relationship tenure analysis and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for remitting funds to the vendor. Options include Automated Clearing House (ACH) electronic transfer, wire transfer, paper check, credit card, or procurement card.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the vendor. Defines the number of days from invoice date until payment is due. Common terms include Net 30 (payment due in 30 days) and 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise due in 30 days). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|2_10_net_30|prepayment_required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the vendors primary business location. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the vendors preferred invoicing and payment currency. Examples: USD (US Dollar), EUR (Euro), GBP (British Pound).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor contact for operational communications, purchase orders, and issue resolution.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization. Typically the account manager or sales representative assigned to the hospitality business relationship.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary vendor contact. Used for urgent procurement matters and order expediting.

attributes.name: remittance_email
attributes.description: Email address for sending electronic remittance advice and payment notifications to the vendor. Used for accounts receivable communications.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment rating for the vendor based on financial stability, compliance history, delivery performance, and business continuity factors. Critical risk vendors require executive approval for new purchase orders.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the vendors primary business location. Use standard postal abbreviations (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code for international wire transfers to vendors outside the domestic banking system. Eight or eleven character code identifying the bank and branch.

tag_set.value: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Code

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the vendor. In the US this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) for sole proprietors. Required for 1099 reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Vendor relationship tier indicating strategic importance and procurement preference. Strategic vendors receive priority treatment and volume commitments; restricted vendors require special approval for purchases.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT registration number for vendors operating in jurisdictions with value-added tax systems. Required for international procurement and tax reclaim processing.

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor in the procurement system. Active vendors can receive purchase orders; blocked vendors cannot transact pending resolution of compliance or performance issues.

products.name: vendor_performance
products.description: Periodic vendor performance evaluation records capturing on-time delivery rate, quality acceptance rate, invoice accuracy, contract compliance score, responsiveness rating, and overall vendor scorecard. Supports vendor qualification, preferred vendor designation, and contract renewal decisions. Aligned with USALI cost management standards and SAP MM vendor evaluation (ME61).

attributes.name: vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor performance evaluation record.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Vendor performance is evaluated by procurement category since performance criteria vary by category (F&B vs. FF&E vs. services). FK enables category-specific scorecards and benchmarking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who conducted or approved this vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where vendor performance is being evaluated. Supports property-level vendor scorecarding.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being evaluated in this performance record.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation was approved and published. Marks the official completion of the evaluation cycle.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days between purchase order issuance and goods receipt during the evaluation period. Measures vendor fulfillment speed.

attributes.name: contract_compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite score measuring vendor adherence to contract terms including pricing, delivery terms, payment terms, and service level agreements. Scored 0-100.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommendation for contract action based on performance evaluation results. Supports contract lifecycle management decisions.

attributes.name: cost_competitiveness_rating
attributes.description: Rating of vendor pricing competitiveness compared to market benchmarks and alternative suppliers. Typically scored 1-5 scale.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: emergency_order_support_rating
attributes.description: Rating of vendor ability to fulfill urgent or emergency purchase orders outside normal lead times. Critical for hospitality operations continuity. Typically scored 1-5 scale.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the evaluator regarding vendor performance, specific issues, or improvement recommendations.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the window for performance measurement.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period. Typically monthly or quarterly evaluation cycles.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor performance evaluation record.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices received without pricing errors, quantity discrepancies, or other billing issues during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: invoice_discrepancies_count
attributes.description: Number of invoices with pricing errors, quantity mismatches, or other billing issues during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: late_deliveries_count
attributes.description: Number of purchase orders delivered after the requested delivery date during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor performance evaluation record was last modified.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date during the evaluation period. Key metric for vendor reliability.

attributes.name: overall_vendor_score
attributes.description: Weighted composite score combining all evaluation criteria (on-time delivery, quality, invoice accuracy, contract compliance, responsiveness). Used for vendor ranking and qualification decisions. Scored 0-100.

attributes.name: payment_terms_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor adhered to agreed payment terms and did not demand early payment or deviate from contract terms.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor has achieved preferred vendor status based on performance evaluation results. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration for new purchase orders.

attributes.name: qualified_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor meets minimum qualification standards for continued business. Vendors failing qualification may be subject to contract review or termination.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of goods receipts accepted without quality defects or rejections during the evaluation period. Measures product quality consistency.

attributes.name: quality_rejections_count
attributes.description: Number of goods receipts rejected due to quality defects during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: responsiveness_rating
attributes.description: Subjective rating of vendor responsiveness to inquiries, issues, and urgent requests. Typically scored 1-5 scale.

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor meets sustainability and environmental compliance requirements during the evaluation period. Supports ESG procurement initiatives.

attributes.name: total_purchase_orders
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to this vendor during the evaluation period. Provides context for performance metrics.

attributes.name: total_spend_amount

attributes.name: primary_goods_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or authorized person who approved the goods receipt for posting. Required for segregation of duties and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property where goods are being received. Enables property-level inventory tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which goods are being received. Links to the originating procurement document.

attributes.name: receiving_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member who physically received and inspected the goods. Used for accountability and training purposes.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor delivering the goods. Used for vendor performance tracking and three-way match.

attributes.name: batch_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received materials are tracked by batch or lot number. Essential for F&B traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Shipping document number for freight shipments. Used for tracking and freight audit, especially for FF&E deliveries.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt was cancelled or reversed. Used for exception tracking and process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CapEx) or Operating Expenditure (OpEx) Indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement as capital expenditure (FF&E, PIP projects) or operating expenditure (supplies, consumables). Drives accounting treatment and financial reporting.

tag_set.value: Capital Expenditure (CapEx) or Operating Expenditure (OpEx) Indicator

attributes.name: condition_on_receipt
attributes.description: Physical condition assessment of goods upon delivery. Drives acceptance decisions, vendor performance scoring, and claims processing.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Accounting cost center to which the received goods are charged. Enables departmental expense tracking per USALI standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process timing analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction value. Supports multi-currency operations for international property portfolios.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The vendor's delivery note or packing slip reference number. Critical for three-way match and vendor reconciliation.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the delivery note or packing slip from the vendor. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: freight_charges_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and freight costs associated with this delivery. May be capitalized into inventory cost or expensed depending on accounting policy.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting the inventory or expense transaction. Aligns with USALI chart of accounts.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the goods receipt document. Unique alphanumeric code used in SAP MM for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction. Tracks progression from draft through posting to potential reversal.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Quality inspection outcome for the received goods. Determines whether goods are accepted into inventory or flagged for return/credit.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code indicating the nature of the inventory transaction. 101=GR for PO, 102=GR reversal, 161=GR for returns, 501=GR without PO, etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|102|103|105|161|501|502 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the goods receipt was posted to inventory and financial accounts. Marks the completion of the receiving transaction.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when the goods receipt is posted to the general ledger and inventory accounts. May differ from physical receipt date.

attributes.name: quality_rejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of the goods receipt was rejected due to quality issues. Triggers vendor notification and return processing.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual date when goods were physically received at the property. Used for inventory valuation and lead time analysis.

attributes.name: receiving_notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments from the receiving staff regarding delivery conditions, discrepancies, or other observations. Used for dispute resolution and vendor feedback.

attributes.name: return_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt represents a return to vendor rather than an inbound delivery. Used for reverse logistics tracking.

attributes.name: serial_number_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received items are tracked by individual serial numbers. Typical for FF&E assets and high-value equipment.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Notes regarding special handling requirements for the received goods, such as refrigeration, fragile items, hazardous materials, or security protocols.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storeroom, warehouse, or storage area within the property where goods are placed. Examples: main kitchen, housekeeping storage, central warehouse.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods require temperature-controlled storage. Critical for F&B inventory compliance with food safety regulations.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Critical for accounts payable processing and internal controls.

attributes.name: total_quantity_received
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items received in this goods receipt transaction. Used for high-level receiving volume tracking.

attributes.name: total_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all goods received in this transaction, in the property's local currency. Used for inventory valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Physical location at the property where goods were delivered and unloaded. Examples: loading dock, main entrance, kitchen entrance.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between expected value (from PO) and actual received value. Triggers investigation when exceeds tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining the cause of any variance between PO and GR. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

products.name: vendor_invoice
products.description: Vendor invoices received for goods and services procured by hotel and resort properties, modeled as header+line. Header captures invoice number, date, vendor, gross amount, tax amount, currency, payment due date, payment terms, three-way match status, and dispute details (reason, disputed amount, resolution). Lines capture material/service, quantity billed, unit price, line amount, tax code, GL account, cost center, and PO line/GR references. Supports AP processing, early payment discount capture, dispute management, and USALI-compliant cost allocation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIRO/MIR7).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification (MIRO / RBKP)

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Vendor invoices are classified by procurement category for AP analytics, accrual tracking, and category spend reporting. FK enables category-level invoice approval workflows and spend variance analysi

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who approved this invoice for payment. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt document for three-way match validation. Null if no GR exists.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Multi-property management companies track vendor invoices by profit center (property) for property-level P&L and owner reporting; required for management fee calculations and owner distribution statem

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property that received the goods or services.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is matched. Null for non-PO invoices.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor who issued this invoice.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice was approved for payment. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code for allocating the invoice expense to a specific department or operational unit within the property.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice (e.g., early payment discount, volume discount), in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is currently under dispute. True if disputed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description for the invoice dispute (e.g., pricing discrepancy, quantity mismatch, quality issue, unauthorized charges). Null if not disputed.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date the dispute was resolved. Null if dispute is still open or if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the resolution of the dispute. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The amount in dispute, in the invoice currency. Null if not disputed.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The document date used for accounting period assignment and reporting.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_date
attributes.description: The last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is eligible for an early payment discount per the payment terms. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount available if the invoice is paid within the early payment discount period (e.g., 2.00 for 2%). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice as Operating Expenditure (OpEx) or Capital Expenditure (CapEx). CapEx typically relates to Property Improvement Plan (PIP) projects and Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The primary General Ledger (GL) account code for posting this invoice. Used for Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI)-compliant cost allocation.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before tax, in the invoice currency. Sum of all line item amounts.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. Principal business event timestamp for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or notes about the invoice, typically provided by the vendor or added by Accounts Payable (AP) staff.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-known invoice number assigned by the vendor. Business identifier for the invoice document.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the Accounts Payable (AP) workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|posted|approved|paid|disputed|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type (standard invoice, credit memo, debit memo, prepayment, or recurring).

attributes.name: match_variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance amount between the invoice and the PO/GR during three-way match, in the invoice currency. Null if matched.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount payable after tax and discounts, in the invoice currency. Gross + Tax - Discount.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date the invoice was paid. Null if not yet paid.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor per the payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used or planned for paying this invoice (e.g., Automated Clearing House (ACH), wire transfer, check, credit card, virtual card).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number or transaction ID of the payment made against this invoice. Null if not yet paid.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the financial ledger in the accounting system.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: The project code for CapEx invoices related to Property Improvement Plan (PIP) projects, renovations, or capital investments. Null for OpEx invoices.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice, in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code used for calculating tax on this invoice (e.g., sales tax, VAT, GST). Determines tax rate and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or authority under which the tax is calculated (e.g., state, province, country).

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match validation between Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and invoice. Indicates whether the invoice matches the PO and GR within tolerance.

products.name: material_master
products.description: Master catalog of all materials, supplies, and goods procured for hotel and resort operations. Covers procurement categories including F&B ingredients, housekeeping consumables, FF&E items, engineering spare parts, and guest amenities. Captures material number, description, base unit of measure, procurement category, storage conditions, shelf life, minimum stock level, reorder point, and SAP material type. Serves as the SSOT for procurable items across all properties.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record. Primary key for the material catalog.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Materials are classified by procurement category for catalog management, sourcing strategy, and spend classification. FK enables hierarchical category navigation and category-specific procurement rule

attributes.name: primary_material_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the material master record. Supports accountability and audit compliance.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and usage frequency. A items are high-value/high-usage requiring tight control; C items are low-value/low-usage with relaxed management. Drives inventory policy and cycle count frequency.

attributes.name: allergen_information
attributes.description: List of allergens present in the material, critical for Food and Beverage (F&B) ingredients. Examples include dairy, gluten, nuts, shellfish, soy. Required for menu labeling and guest safety.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the material is stocked, issued, and valued. Examples include EA (each), CS (case), BX (box), KG (kilogram), LT (liter), GL (gallon), DZ (dozen). Aligns with inventory and procurement transactions.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand or trademark under which the material is marketed. Important for guest-facing amenities and Food and Beverage (F&B) ingredients where brand consistency impacts guest experience.

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CapEx) or Operating Expenditure (OpEx) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is capitalized as a fixed asset (CapEx) or expensed as an operating cost (OpEx). Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) for Property Improvement Plan (PIP) projects are typically CapEx; consumables and supplies are OpEx.

tag_set.value: Capital Expenditure (CapEx) or Operating Expenditure (OpEx) Indicator

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code indicating where the material is manufactured or sourced. Required for customs, trade compliance, and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the material master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard price. Enables multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the material is no longer available for procurement. Used for planned discontinuation and phase-out of materials.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the material master record is valid and available for procurement transactions. Supports phased rollout of new materials.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and disposal procedures per Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days from purchase order placement to goods receipt. Used for Material Requirements Planning (MRP) calculations and reorder point determination.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactures or produces the material. Used for quality tracking, warranty management, and vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Unique part number assigned by the manufacturer. Enables precise identification for ordering, quality control, and warranty claims.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the material, supply, or good. Provides human-readable identification for procurement, receiving, and inventory management.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Detailed grouping of materials within a procurement category for granular spend analysis, vendor specialization, and contract management. Enables category-level reporting and sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the material in the procurement system. External business identifier used across purchase orders, goods receipts, and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material in the catalog. Active materials are available for procurement; inactive or discontinued materials are phased out; blocked materials cannot be ordered due to quality or compliance issues.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material based on its procurement and usage purpose. Determines procurement rules, valuation methods, and inventory management policies.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper limit for inventory holding to prevent overstocking, minimize carrying costs, and reduce waste for perishable items.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered from vendors. Driven by vendor terms, packaging constraints, or economic order quantity calculations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the material master record was last updated. Tracks changes to pricing, status, vendor assignments, and other attributes.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material has a limited shelf life and requires expiration date tracking. True for Food and Beverage (F&B) ingredients, fresh produce, and time-sensitive supplies.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Method by which the material is procured. Standard is direct purchase; consignment is vendor-owned inventory; subcontracting involves external processing; stock transfer is inter-property movement.

attributes.name: purchase_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the material is ordered from vendors. May differ from base unit (e.g., purchased in cases but stocked in each). Conversion factor to base unit is maintained separately.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming goods must undergo quality inspection before acceptance. True for critical materials, Food and Beverage (F&B) ingredients, and items with quality history issues.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. Calculated based on lead time demand and safety stock requirements to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: safety_stock_level
attributes.description: Buffer inventory maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Critical for high-usage items and materials with long lead times.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the material remains usable after receipt or production. Critical for Food and Beverage (F&B) ingredients, guest amenities, and pharmaceutical supplies. Drives First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) inventory rotation.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the material for use in reports, purchase orders, and mobile applications where space is limited.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Standard cost or valuation price of the material in the base currency. Used for inventory valuation, budgeting, and variance analysis. Updated periodically based on procurement trends.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for storing the material to maintain quality and safety. Determines warehouse zone assignment and handling procedures.

attributes.name: sustainability_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material meets sustainability or environmental certification standards such as Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, organic, or eco-label certifications. Supports corporate social responsibility and guest experience programs.

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax category code for the material determining applicable sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), or goods and services tax (GST) rates. Varies by jurisdiction and material type.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius allowed for proper storage of temperature-sensitive materials. Exceeding this threshold may compromise quality or safety.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius required for proper storage of temperature-sensitive materials. Used for cold chain compliance and quality assurance.

products.name: category
products.description: Hierarchical classification taxonomy for procurement spend categories across hotel and resort operations. Defines category hierarchy (L1: F&B, Housekeeping, FF&E, Engineering, IT; L2+ sub-categories), category manager assignment, preferred vendor associations, sourcing strategy, and competitive bidding thresholds. Supports spend analytics, category management, strategic sourcing decisions, and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) analysis by category.
products.reference: USALI Procurement Category / SAP MM Material Group (T023)

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement category. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level (L1) categories. Enables multi-level category drill-down for spend analytics.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Procurement categories enforce category-specific policies: ethical sourcing policies for food/beverage, sustainability policies for supplies, diversity vendor policies for services, data privacy polic

attributes.name: primary_category_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this procurement category record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category is currently active and available for purchase order creation. False for deprecated or discontinued categories.

attributes.name: annual_spend_budget_amount
attributes.description: Planned annual procurement spend budget (in USD) for this category across all properties or at corporate level. Used for budget variance analysis and spend forecasting.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve purchase orders in this category: property (hotel GM), regional (area VP), corporate (CPO), or executive (CFO/CEO for high-value CapEx).

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum purchase order value (in USD) that can be approved at the defined authority level. Orders exceeding this amount require escalation to higher approval authority.

attributes.name: benchmarking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether spend in this category is benchmarked against industry standards (STR reports) or peer properties for cost optimization and competitive analysis.

attributes.name: bid_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum purchase order value (in USD) that triggers mandatory competitive bidding for this category. Null if no threshold applies or competitive bidding is always required.

attributes.name: budget_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether spend in this category is tracked against annual budgets with variance reporting and budget consumption alerts. True for budget-controlled categories.

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Classification of procurement category by spend type: direct (guest-facing goods), indirect (operational supplies), capital (FF&E and CapEx), or services (contracted labor and professional services).

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the procurement category for external reference and system integration. Used in SAP S/4HANA MM module for material group classification.

attributes.name: competitive_bid_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require competitive bidding process (RFP/RFQ) per procurement policy. True if competitive bidding is mandatory.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Specific regulatory or industry compliance framework applicable to this category (e.g., ISO 22000 for food safety, OSHA for workplace safety equipment, ADA for accessibility fixtures, PCI DSS for payment systems).

attributes.name: contract_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category must comply with master service agreements or corporate contracts. True if contract compliance tracking is mandatory.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method for allocating procurement spend in this category to financial reporting structures: direct_charge (to specific department), allocated (distributed across properties), cost_center, or profit_center per USALI standards.

attributes.name: cpor_tracking_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) Tracking Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is included in CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) analysis for operational efficiency benchmarking. True for categories that scale with occupancy (housekeeping, guest amenities).

tag_set.value: Cost Per Occupied Room (CPOR) Tracking Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procurement category record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the procurement category scope, including types of goods and services covered, typical use cases, and business context.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category was retired or discontinued. Null for currently active categories. Used for historical spend analysis and category lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category became active and available for use in the procurement system. Supports category lifecycle management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: emergency_procurement_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expedited emergency procurement procedures (bypassing standard approval workflows) are permitted for this category in urgent operational situations.

attributes.name: inventory_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are tracked in property inventory systems with stock levels, reorder points, and inventory valuation. True for stocked items (F&B, housekeeping supplies).

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Typical lead time in days from purchase order placement to goods receipt for this category. Used for inventory planning and procurement scheduling.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category in the taxonomy (1=top level such as F&B or FF&E, 2=sub-category, 3=detailed sub-category). Supports hierarchical spend rollup and analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_vendor_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualified vendors that must be maintained for this category to ensure supply continuity and competitive pricing. Null if no minimum is defined.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procurement category record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the procurement category (e.g., Food and Beverage Supplies, Housekeeping Linens, Furniture Fixtures and Equipment).

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category participates in a preferred vendor program with pre-negotiated pricing, terms, and service level agreements. True if preferred vendor relationships are established.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors supplying this category must hold specific quality certifications (e.g., ISO 22000 for food safety, industry-specific quality standards).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is subject to specific regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., food safety regulations, fire safety codes, ADA accessibility standards for FF&E).

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Procurement risk level for this category based on supply chain volatility, vendor concentration, regulatory exposure, and business impact: low (commodity items), medium (standard supplies), high (specialized equipment), critical (guest-facing or safety-critical).

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Procurement approach defined for this category: strategic (long-term partnerships), preferred_vendor (pre-qualified suppliers), competitive_bid (RFP/RFQ process), spot_buy (ad-hoc purchases), or contract (master service agreements).

attributes.name: spend_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Expenditure (OpEx) vs Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Classification
attributes.description: Financial classification indicating whether spend in this category is treated as operating expenditure (OpEx) or capital expenditure (CapEx) for accounting and budgeting purposes.

tag_set.value: Operating Expenditure (OpEx) vs Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Classification

attributes.name: sustainability_criteria_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category has defined sustainability or environmental compliance requirements for vendor selection and product sourcing (e.g., eco-friendly cleaning supplies, sustainable seafood).

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Tax classification for purchases in this category: taxable (standard VAT/sales tax), exempt (tax-exempt goods), zero_rated (0% tax rate), or reverse_charge (buyer remits tax). Varies by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: usali_department_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Department Code
attributes.description: USALI standard department code for financial reporting and cost allocation (e.g., ROOMS for rooms division, F&B for food and beverage, A&G for administrative and general).

tag_set.value: Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) Department Code

attributes.name: vendor_diversification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether procurement policy requires multiple qualified vendors for this category to mitigate supply chain risk and ensure competitive pricing. True for high-risk or high-spend categories.

products.name: request_for_quotation
products.description: Request for Quotation and strategic sourcing events issued to multiple vendors to solicit competitive pricing for goods and services. Captures RFQ/event number, issue date, response deadline, event type (RFQ, RFP, reverse auction, negotiation), procurement category, estimated quantity/annual spend, delivery requirements, evaluation criteria and methodology, award criteria, participating vendor list, and outcome/award decision. Supports competitive sourcing, vendor selection, category management, strategic sourcing governance, and contract negotiation workflows. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM RFQ (ME41).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Request for Quotation (ME41/ME42)

attributes.name: request_for_quotation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for request_for_quotation

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or executive who approved the issuance of this RFQ.

products.name: procurement_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a vendor and a material in the procurement catalog. It captures vendor-specific pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and sourcing preferences that exist only in the context of this vendor-material pairing. Each record links one vendor to one material with negotiated commercial terms.. Existence Justification: In hotel and resort procurement operations, materials are routinely multi-sourced from multiple vendors to mitigate supply risk, leverage competitive pricing, and ensure continuity of operations. Each vendor-material pairing has distinct commercial terms including negotiated unit prices, lead times, minimum order quantities, and contract references. The current model's single vendor_id FK in material_master cannot represent this multi-sourcing reality.

products.name: vendor_category_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and performance relationship between vendors and procurement categories in hotel and resort operations. It captures category-specific vendor qualifications, performance metrics, preferred vendor status, and contract terms that exist only in the context of a specific vendor-category pairing. Each record links one vendor to one procurement category with attributes that track qualification status, performance history, and category-specific commercial terms. This enables category management best practices including vendor panel optimization, category-specific sourcing strategies, and spend allocation decisions.. Existence Justification: In hotel and resort procurement operations, vendor category qualification is a genuine many-to-many operational relationship. A single vendor (e.g., Sysco) is qualified to supply multiple procurement categories (F&B supplies, housekeeping supplies, paper goods), and each procurement category has multiple qualified vendors forming a vendor panel. The business actively manages these qualifications with category-specific performance scores, preferred vendor designations, contract terms, and spend allocation strategies. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where procurement teams create, review, and update vendor-category qualifications as part of strategic sourcing and category management.

products.name: vendor_program_participation
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between vendor and experience_program. It captures the operational relationship where vendors deliver specific services as part of curated guest experience programs across hotel and resort properties. Each record links one vendor to one experience_program with attributes that define the vendor's role, service delivery commitments, program-specific pricing, and fulfillment responsibilities that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, experience programs (spa packages, culinary experiences, adventure programs, wellness journeys) require coordination of multiple specialized vendors to deliver the complete guest experience. A single experience program involves multiple vendors (spa operator, restaurant partner, transportation provider, activity vendors), and each vendor participates in multiple programs across different properties and guest segments. The business actively manages these vendor-program relationships with program-specific pricing, SLAs, fulfillment responsibilities, and performance tracking.

products.name: category_buyer_assignment

It captures the buyer-category responsibility matrix that drives requisition routing, vendor relationship ownership, and spend authority. Each record links one employee to one procurement category with assignment-specific attributes including role type (primary/backup), effective dates, and spend authority limits.. products.name: procurement_therapist_certification

Tracks campaign ROI, guest acquisition cost, NPS (Net Promoter Score), and GSS (Guest Satisfaction Score). Integrates with Salesforce CRM for personalized guest communications and retention programs.
