products.name: campaign_offer
products.description: Promotional offers and rate-based incentives associated with marketing campaigns, including discount codes, complimentary night offers, F&B credits, package deals, BAR override offers, and all loyalty-specific marketing promotions (bonus point offers, tier accelerator campaigns, partner earn promotions, member-exclusive rate offers, birthday offers). Captures offer code, offer type (percentage discount, flat discount, free night, upgrade, bonus points, tier accelerator, partner earn, member rate, birthday offer), discount value, eligible tier levels, bonus multiplier, qualifying activity, minimum LOS/spend threshold, blackout dates, eligible rate plans, eligible property scope, redemption limit, redemption count, offer validity window, enrollment required flag, promotion period, and linkage to parent campaign. SSOT for all marketing promotional constructs including loyalty-specific promotions. Distinct from revenue domain rate plans — this entity tracks the marketing promotional construct, not the PMS rate. Complements the loyalty domain tier structure with marketing-driven promotional constructs.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign offer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign that this offer belongs to.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the rate discount is applied. Percentage applies a percentage reduction. Fixed amount applies a currency value reduction. BAR override replaces the Best Available Rate with a specific promotional rate.

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. For percentage discounts, this is the percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). For fixed amount discounts, this is the currency amount. For BAR override, this is the override rate amount.

attributes.name: minimum_spend_amount

attributes.description: Number of unique clicks on links or calls-to-action within the campaign content. Measures engagement level.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution completed all send and delivery activities. Marks the end of the deployment process.

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: Number of conversions or desired actions completed as a result of this execution. Examples: bookings made, loyalty enrollments, event registrations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: creative_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the creative assets used in this execution. Enables A/B testing and creative performance analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this execution record. Example: USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: delivery_count
attributes.description: Number of messages successfully delivered to recipients. Excludes bounces and delivery failures.

attributes.name: execution_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this specific execution instance. Includes media spend, agency fees, content production, and technology costs.

attributes.name: execution_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for this execution instance. Typically includes campaign name, channel, and wave identifier for easy recognition by marketing teams.

attributes.name: execution_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for this execution instance. Used for operational tracking and reporting. Example: CAMP-2024-Q1-EMAIL-001.

attributes.name: execution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this campaign execution. Tracks progression from planning through completion or failure.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this campaign execution was deployed or sent. The principal business event timestamp representing when the campaign reached the audience.

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor invoice associated with this execution cost. Links to accounts payable for reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: lookback_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after execution during which conversions are attributed to this campaign. Defines the attribution time window.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this execution. Used by marketing teams to document special circumstances, issues, or observations.

attributes.name: open_count
attributes.description: Number of unique opens or views of the campaign content. Applicable to email, push notifications, and display channels.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment for this execution. Tracks financial settlement with vendors and partners.

attributes.name: revenue_attributed
attributes.description: Total revenue attributed to this campaign execution based on the attribution model. Represents the financial impact of this execution.

attributes.name: sap_cost_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA cost accounting document that records this execution expense. Used for financial reconciliation and USALI reporting.

attributes.name: scheduled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution was originally scheduled to deploy. May differ from actual execution timestamp if delays occurred.

attributes.name: send_count
attributes.description: Total number of messages or impressions sent or served in this execution. Represents actual deployment volume.

attributes.name: spend_category
attributes.description: Classification of the execution spend by type. Used for budget allocation tracking and financial reporting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: Email subject line or message headline used in this execution. Applicable to email and push notification channels.

attributes.name: tracking_capability
attributes.description: Level of tracking and attribution capability available for this execution. Full tracking includes all metrics, partial tracking has limited visibility, none indicates no tracking available.

products.name: guest_segment
products.description: Marketing-defined guest segmentation taxonomy and individual membership tracking used to target campaigns and personalize communications. Captures segment name, segment code, segment type (behavioral, demographic, geographic, RFM, loyalty tier-based, occasion-based), definition criteria, estimated segment size, last refresh date, data source (Salesforce CRM, PMS, loyalty), active flag, owning marketing team, and individual guest membership records including guest ID, membership start/end dates, membership source (rule-based, manual, ML-model), confidence score, and active flag. SSOT for both segment definitions and guest-to-segment membership associations. Enables point-in-time segment membership queries and supports campaign audience list generation. Distinct from loyalty tier — this is the marketing segmentation layer used for campaign targeting and personalization strategy.

attributes.name: guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the guest segment definition. Primary key.

attributes.name: segment_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Guest segment ownership requires clear accountability for segment definition maintenance, refresh execution, and campaign targeting decisions. Marketing analysts and managers need assigned ownership f

attributes.name: touchpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to experience.touchpoint. Business justification: Guest segments are often defined by behavior at specific touchpoints (e.g., 'mobile check-in users', 'spa bookers', 'late checkout requesters'). Enables touchpoint-based segmentation strategy, allowin

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing manager or governance authority who approved this segment for operational use. Null for draft or unapproved segments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment definition was approved for operational use. Null for draft or unapproved segments.

attributes.name: campaign_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests in this segment are eligible for marketing campaign communications (True) or excluded due to opt-out, regulatory restrictions, or business rules (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment definition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary operational system or combination of systems from which segment membership data is derived (Salesforce CRM for profiles and campaigns, OPERA PMS for booking history, loyalty system for tier status, Medallia for satisfaction scores, or multi-source for composite segments).

attributes.name: definition_criteria
attributes.description: Structured or free-text representation of the business rules and criteria used to assign guests to this segment (e.g., ADR > $300 AND stays >= 5 per year AND loyalty tier = Platinum).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition was retired or archived. Null for currently active segments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition became active and available for campaign targeting and personalization.

attributes.name: estimated_size
attributes.description: Approximate count of unique guests currently assigned to this segment, updated at each refresh cycle.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic boundary or market scope for this segment (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, USA, specific cities or regions). Null for non-geographic segments.

attributes.name: last_refresh_date
attributes.description: Date when segment membership was last recalculated and updated, enabling point-in-time segment membership queries.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_scope
attributes.description: Loyalty program tier(s) included in this segment definition (e.g., Platinum, Gold, Silver, or combinations). Null if loyalty tier is not a defining criterion. Distinct from loyalty tier master data — this is the marketing filter.

attributes.name: ml_model_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the machine learning model used to generate this segment, if applicable. Null for rule-based or manually defined segments.

attributes.name: ml_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the machine learning model used to generate this segment. Null for rule-based or manually defined segments.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing user or system that last modified this segment definition.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment definition record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_refresh_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next segment membership recalculation cycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about this segment definition, including historical changes, business rationale, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: occasion_type_scope
attributes.description: Travel occasion type(s) included in this segment: business (corporate travel), leisure (vacation), MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions), group (group bookings), FIT (Free Independent Traveler), or all occasions. Null if occasion type is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name of the marketing team or business unit responsible for defining, maintaining, and using this segment (e.g., Brand Marketing, Guest Acquisition, Loyalty Marketing, Regional Marketing).

attributes.name: personalization_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this segment for personalized guest communications and offers: high (premium personalization), medium (standard personalization), low (generic communications).

attributes.name: property_tier_scope
attributes.description: Property service tier scope for this segment: luxury (high-end resorts), premium (full-service hotels), select-service (limited amenities), or all tiers. Null if property tier is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which segment membership is recalculated and refreshed to reflect current guest behavior and attributes.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment for operational use in campaigns and reporting (e.g., LUX_FREQ, BUS_TRVL, LEISURE_FAM).

attributes.name: segment_creation_method
attributes.description: Method by which this segment was created: rule-based (business rules engine), ml_model (machine learning algorithm), manual (analyst-defined), or hybrid (combination of methods).

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment definition, including business rationale, target guest characteristics, and intended use cases for campaign targeting and personalization.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the guest segment (e.g., Luxury Frequent Travelers, Business Travelers, Leisure Families).

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition: active (in use for campaigns), inactive (paused), draft (under development), archived (retired).

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation methodology used: behavioral (booking patterns, stay frequency), demographic (age, income), geographic (region, country), RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary), loyalty tier-based (elite status), or occasion-based (business, leisure, events).

attributes.name: target_adr_max
attributes.description: Maximum Average Daily Rate threshold used in segment definition criteria for revenue-based segmentation. Null if ADR is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_adr_min
attributes.description: Minimum Average Daily Rate threshold used in segment definition criteria for revenue-based segmentation. Null if ADR is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_gss_min
attributes.description: Minimum Guest Satisfaction Score threshold used in segment definition criteria for satisfaction-based segmentation. Null if GSS is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_ltv_min
attributes.description: Minimum guest Lifetime Value threshold used in segment definition criteria for high-value guest identification. Null if LTV is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_nps_min
attributes.description: Minimum Net Promoter Score threshold used in segment definition criteria for satisfaction-based segmentation. Null if NPS is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: target_stay_frequency_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of stays per year used in segment definition criteria for frequency-based segmentation. Null if stay frequency is not a defining criterion.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing user or system that created this segment definition.

products.name: guest_communication
products.description: Transactional record of every outbound marketing communication sent to a guest, including pre-arrival emails, promotional offers, loyalty newsletters, post-stay surveys, win-back messages, and event invitations. Also serves as the master library for reusable communication templates. Captures communication date/time, channel (email, SMS, push, direct mail), subject line, delivery status (sent, delivered, bounced, unsubscribed), open timestamp, click timestamp, campaign linkage, Salesforce CRM activity ID, language/locale, and template metadata including template name, content type (promotional, transactional, loyalty, survey, event), body content, dynamic merge fields, brand/property scope, version number, approval status, and active flag. SSOT for individual guest-level communication history AND template governance in the marketing domain.

attributes.name: guest_communication_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each guest communication record. Primary key for the guest communication entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign under which this communication was sent. Links to the campaign master record.

attributes.name: cancellation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation. Business justification: Service recovery and win-back communications are triggered by cancellations. Marketing tracks cancellation-specific outreach for sentiment analysis, re-booking campaigns, and loyalty retention. Essent

attributes.name: communication_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the communication template used for this message. Links to the template library for reusable content governance.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest who received this communication. Links to the guest master record in the Guest domain.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property or brand associated with this communication. Used for property-specific or brand-specific messaging.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reservation associated with this communication, if applicable. Used for pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay communications.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The variant identifier if this communication was part of an A/B or multivariate test. Used for campaign optimization and performance analysis. Null if not part of a test.

attributes.name: body_content
attributes.description: The full text or HTML content of the communication message. Contains the complete message body including personalized merge fields and dynamic content.

attributes.name: bounce_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or message explaining why the communication bounced. Examples include invalid email address, mailbox full, spam filter rejection, or server error. Null if no bounce occurred.

attributes.name: bounced_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication bounced or failed delivery. Null if successfully delivered.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The delivery channel through which the communication was sent. Email is the primary digital channel; SMS for text messages; push for mobile app notifications; direct mail for physical correspondence; in-app for in-application messages; WhatsApp for messaging app communications.

attributes.name: clicked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the guest first clicked a link within the communication. Null if no clicks occurred or tracking not available.

attributes.name: communication_type
attributes.description: Classification of the communication content type. Promotional includes offers and campaigns; transactional includes booking confirmations and receipts; loyalty includes program updates; survey includes NPS and GSS feedback requests; event includes meeting and conference invitations; service recovery includes apology and compensation messages.

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the guest completed the desired action after receiving this communication (e.g., made a booking, redeemed an offer, completed a survey). True if conversion occurred; False otherwise.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the guest completed the conversion action attributed to this communication. Null if no conversion occurred.

attributes.name: conversion_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the conversion attributed to this communication, typically in the property's base currency. Used for calculating campaign ROI and guest acquisition cost. Null if no conversion or non-monetary conversion.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: The unique activity or task identifier in Salesforce CRM that corresponds to this communication. Used for cross-system reconciliation and guest interaction history.

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was successfully delivered to the recipient's mail server or device. Null if delivery failed or is pending.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the communication. Sent indicates the message left the system; delivered confirms receipt by the guest's mail server or device; bounced indicates delivery failure; failed indicates system error; unsubscribed indicates the guest opted out; blocked indicates spam filter rejection.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the communication was sent. Examples: en for English, es for Spanish, fr for French, de for German, zh for Chinese.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: Locale code combining language and region for localization purposes. Format: language_REGION (e.g., en_US, en_GB, es_MX, fr_CA). Used for region-specific content and formatting.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the guest first opened or viewed the communication. Tracked via pixel or read receipt. Null if not opened or tracking not available.

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: The guest's consent status for receiving this type of communication at the time of send. Opted_in indicates explicit consent; opted_out indicates withdrawal of consent; pending indicates consent requested but not confirmed; not_applicable for transactional communications that do not require opt-in.

attributes.name: personalization_fields
attributes.description: JSON or delimited string containing the dynamic merge fields and their values used to personalize this communication. Examples: guest name, loyalty tier, reservation dates, property name.

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: The email address to which the communication was sent. Captured at send time to preserve historical accuracy even if the guest's current email changes.

attributes.name: recipient_phone
attributes.description: The phone number to which the communication was sent, applicable for SMS and WhatsApp channels. Captured at send time to preserve historical accuracy.

attributes.name: reply_to_email
attributes.description: The email address to which guest replies should be directed. May differ from sender email to route responses to appropriate teams.

attributes.name: send_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this communication for send queue processing. High priority for time-sensitive transactional messages; normal for standard campaigns; low for bulk promotional sends.

attributes.name: sender_email
attributes.description: The email address from which the communication was sent. Used for reply-to and sender identification. Must comply with CAN-SPAM sender requirements.

attributes.name: sender_name
attributes.description: The display name of the sender as shown to the recipient. Examples: property name, brand name, or generic sender like 'Guest Services' or 'Reservations Team'.

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was sent from the marketing system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the communication lifecycle.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line or headline of the communication. For email, this is the email subject; for SMS, this may be the first line; for push notifications, this is the notification title.

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this communication was suppressed or not sent, if applicable. Examples: guest on do-not-contact list, invalid contact information, frequency cap exceeded, unsubscribed from category. Null if communication was sent.

attributes.name: tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether open and click tracking was enabled for this communication. True if tracking pixels and link tracking were included; False if tracking was disabled for privacy or technical reasons.

attributes.name: unsubscribed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the guest unsubscribed or opted out from this communication or communication type. Null if guest remains subscribed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication record was last modified. Updated when delivery status changes or engagement events occur.

products.name: attribution_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing a guest touchpoint interaction that contributes to a marketing attribution model — including ad impressions, clicks, landing page visits, booking engine entries, and offer redemptions. Captures event timestamp, guest/cookie/device identifier, touchpoint type, channel, campaign linkage, offer linkage, session ID, UTM source/medium/campaign/content/term, IP-based geography, device type, and conversion flag. Feeds multi-touch attribution (MTA) and last-click attribution models for campaign ROI calculation.

attributes.name: attribution_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing attribution event record.

attributes.name: booking_source_id

attributes.name: campaign_id

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional offer or rate plan associated with this attribution event, if applicable.

attributes.name: content_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific ad creative (banner, video, text ad) displayed during this touchpoint event. Used for creative performance analysis.

attributes.name: privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Attribution tracking involves cookies, device IDs, and IP addresses subject to privacy regulations. attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reservation that resulted from this attribution path, if a conversion occurred.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id

attributes.description: The advertising platform or network that served the ad or content for this touchpoint (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Bing Ads, programmatic exchange).

attributes.name: attribution_credit
attributes.description: The fractional credit assigned to this touchpoint event under the selected attribution model. Values range from 0.0000 to 1.0000, where 1.0000 represents full credit.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: The attribution model applied to this event for credit allocation (e.g., last-click, first-click, linear, time-decay, position-based multi-touch attribution).

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: The web browser used by the guest during this touchpoint event (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: conversion_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the conversion value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this touchpoint event resulted in a conversion (booking, reservation, or other defined conversion action).

attributes.name: conversion_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the conversion attributed to this touchpoint event, if a conversion occurred. Used for ROI (Return on Investment) calculation.

attributes.name: cookie_code
attributes.description: Browser cookie identifier used to track anonymous guest behavior across sessions before guest identification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this attribution event record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the device (mobile, tablet, desktop) used by the guest during this touchpoint interaction.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used by the guest during this touchpoint (desktop, mobile, tablet, other).

attributes.name: event_source_system
attributes.description: The source system or platform that captured and reported this attribution event (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, booking engine).

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: The processing status of this attribution event within the marketing analytics pipeline (captured, processed, attributed, excluded).

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the guest touchpoint interaction occurred, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: The city derived from the IP address, providing granular geographic attribution for campaign performance analysis.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code derived from the IP address, indicating the guest's geographic location at the time of the event.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: The state, province, or region derived from the IP address, providing sub-country geographic attribution.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the guest device at the time of the touchpoint event. Used for geographic attribution and fraud detection.

attributes.name: keyword
attributes.description: The search keyword or phrase that triggered this touchpoint event in paid or organic search campaigns.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The full URL of the landing page where the guest arrived during this touchpoint event.

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: The operating system of the guest device during this touchpoint event (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android).

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The full URL of the referring page that directed the guest to this touchpoint. Used for attribution analysis when UTM parameters are not present.

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the web or mobile session during which this attribution event occurred. Used to group touchpoints within a single browsing session.

attributes.name: time_to_conversion_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed between this touchpoint event and the eventual conversion, if a conversion occurred. Used for conversion lag analysis.

attributes.name: touchpoint_sequence
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this touchpoint within the guest's attribution path (1 for first touch, incrementing for each subsequent touchpoint).

attributes.name: touchpoint_type
attributes.description: The type of marketing touchpoint interaction captured in this event (e.g., ad impression, click, landing page visit, booking engine entry, offer redemption, email open).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this attribution event record was last updated in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: utm_source

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: The UTM term parameter identifying paid search keywords or targeting criteria. Part of the standard UTM tracking taxonomy.

attributes.name: lift_percentage

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the experiment record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: experiment_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the experiment that clearly communicates the test objective to stakeholders and marketing teams.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: The probability that the observed difference between variants occurred by chance. Values below the significance threshold indicate statistically significant results.

attributes.description: The planned duration of the experiment in days, based on sample size calculations and business requirements. Used for resource planning and timeline management.

attributes.name: primary_metric
attributes.description: The primary success metric used to evaluate experiment performance, such as conversion rate, click-through rate, booking rate, revenue per visitor, or guest satisfaction score.

attributes.name: sample_size_actual
attributes.description: The actual number of observations collected during the experiment. Used to assess whether sufficient data has been gathered for valid statistical inference.

attributes.name: sample_size_target
attributes.description: The target number of observations required to achieve statistical significance based on power analysis. Calculated using expected effect size, significance level, and statistical power.

attributes.name: secondary_metrics
attributes.description: Additional metrics tracked to understand broader impact of the experiment. May include engagement metrics, downstream conversion, average daily rate (ADR), or net promoter score (NPS). Stored as comma-separated list.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the experiment began running and traffic allocation started. Used to calculate experiment duration and time-based performance metrics.

attributes.name: statistical_significance_threshold
attributes.description: The p-value threshold required to declare a statistically significant result. Industry standard is typically 0.05 (95% confidence) or 0.01 (99% confidence).

attributes.name: test_variable
attributes.description: The specific element being tested in the experiment, such as email subject line, landing page layout, offer amount, creative imagery, call-to-action text, or pricing structure.

attributes.name: traffic_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total traffic allocated to this experiment. Typically ranges from 10% to 100% depending on risk tolerance and sample size requirements.

attributes.name: treatment_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of experiment traffic allocated to treatment variant(s). Sum of control and treatment allocations should equal 100% of experiment traffic.

attributes.name: treatment_variant_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the treatment variant(s) being tested against the control. May include multiple variants separated by delimiters for multivariate tests.

attributes.name: winning_variant
attributes.description: The variant that achieved statistically significant superior performance on the primary metric. Set to inconclusive if no significant difference was found, or ongoing if experiment is still running.

domains.name: experience
domains.description: Guest experience, service quality, and service recovery management including guest feedback, NPS surveys, complaint case management, GRR (Guest Recovery Rate), and satisfaction tracking. Manages service recovery workflows, amenity fulfillment, special request tracking, and GSS/CSAT scoring. Integrates with Medallia as the primary experience analytics platform and Salesforce CRM for case management. Supports SALT programs.

products.name: guest_feedback
products.description: Core transactional record of guest feedback submissions captured across all touchpoints including post-stay surveys, in-stay pulse checks, real-time feedback, and NPS survey responses. Sourced primarily from Medallia and integrated with OPERA PMS stay data. Captures NPS scores (0-10 with promoter/passive/detractor classification), GSS (Guest Satisfaction Score), CSAT ratings, verbatim comments, sentiment indicators, survey type discriminator (NPS, CSAT, pulse, general), response channel (email, SMS, kiosk, app), stay reference, property, and submission timestamp. Serves as the single authoritative source for all guest voice data including NPS responses in the experience domain. Drives SALT program reporting and trend analysis by property, segment, and time period.

products.name: nps_survey
products.description: Master definition record for NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey instruments and campaign programs administered to guests. Manages survey design templates, question sets, distribution logic and cadence, target guest segments, trigger conditions (post-checkout, post-event, post-F&B visit, post-spa), response collection windows, and program ownership. Tracks promoter/passive/detractor classification thresholds, survey versioning, active/inactive status, and SALT (Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking) program linkage. This is the survey INSTRUMENT and CAMPAIGN definition — individual guest responses are captured in guest_feedback with survey_type=NPS. Supports A/B testing of survey formats and channel optimization for response rate improvement.

products.name: program_treatment_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion relationship between experience programs and spa treatments. It captures which treatments are included in which experience programs, along with sequencing, quantities, upgrade eligibility, and temporal availability. Each record links one experience program to one treatment with attributes that exist only in the context of this program-treatment pairing.. Existence Justification: In hospitality operations, experience programs (wellness retreats, romance packages, SALT programs) are curated bundles that include multiple spa treatments, and each treatment can be included in multiple different programs. The business actively manages these inclusions with specific rules about sequencing, quantities, upgrade eligibility, and seasonal availability. This is an operational product composition relationship, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: program_fitness_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion relationship between experience programs and fitness classes. It captures which fitness classes are included in which experience programs, along with the number of sessions guests receive, booking requirements, and selection flexibility. Each record links one experience program to one fitness class with attributes that define the terms of inclusion.. Existence Justification: In travel hospitality operations, experience programs are curated packages that bundle multiple amenities and services, including fitness classes. A single experience program (e.g., 'Wellness Journey' or 'VIP Welcome Package') includes multiple fitness class types (yoga, pilates, HIIT) to give guests variety and choice. Conversely, a popular fitness class like 'Morning Yoga' can be included in multiple experience programs (Wellness Journey, SALT Recovery Program, Anniversary Package) with different terms for each program. Program managers actively configure and manage these inclusions, specifying how many sessions are included, booking rules, and guest selection flexibility for each program-class pairing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the intake form record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_medications
attributes.description: Free-text list of medications currently being taken by the guest. Important for identifying potential interactions with spa treatments or products.

attributes.name: data_privacy_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has acknowledged the spa data privacy policy and understands how their personal and health information will be used and protected.

attributes.name: data_privacy_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the guest acknowledged the data privacy policy. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance documentation.

attributes.name: form_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the intake form expires and must be renewed. Typically 6-12 months from completion date to ensure health information remains current.

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the intake form, typically formatted as IF- followed by numeric sequence. Used for guest communication and record retrieval.

attributes.name: form_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intake form. Tracks progression from guest completion through therapist review and approval.

attributes.name: has_allergies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has disclosed any allergies to products, ingredients, or environmental factors. Critical for preventing allergic reactions during treatment.

attributes.name: has_cardiovascular_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has disclosed any cardiovascular conditions such as hypertension, heart disease, or circulatory disorders. Critical for treatment safety assessment.

attributes.name: has_previous_spa_experience
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has received spa treatments before. Helps therapist adjust communication and service delivery approach.

attributes.name: has_recent_surgery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has undergone surgery within the past 6-12 months. Important for identifying treatment contraindications and areas to avoid.

attributes.name: has_skin_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has disclosed any skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, rashes, or sensitivities. Important for product selection and treatment modifications.

attributes.name: is_pregnant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest is currently pregnant. Critical for treatment contraindications and liability management.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the language in which the intake form was completed. Supports multilingual guest experience.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the intake form record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: photography_consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has consented to photography or videography during their spa visit for marketing or promotional purposes.

attributes.name: pregnancy_trimester
attributes.description: Current trimester of pregnancy if guest is pregnant. Used to determine appropriate treatment modifications and contraindications.

attributes.name: pressure_preference
attributes.description: Guest preference for massage pressure intensity. Guides therapist in delivering personalized treatment experience.

attributes.name: previous_spa_experience_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of guest previous spa experiences, preferences, or concerns based on past treatments. Supports personalized service delivery.

attributes.name: skin_condition_details
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific skin conditions disclosed by the guest. Guides therapist in selecting appropriate products and techniques.

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the guest submitted the intake form. Used for channel analytics and process improvement.

attributes.name: surgery_details
attributes.description: Free-text description of recent surgeries including type, date, and location on body. Helps therapist identify areas requiring special care or avoidance.

attributes.name: therapist_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the therapist completed their review of the intake form. Creates audit trail for quality assurance and compliance.

attributes.name: therapist_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a licensed therapist has reviewed and approved the intake form prior to treatment. Required workflow step for quality assurance and liability management.

attributes.name: treatment_consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided informed consent to receive the spa treatment. Required for legal liability protection and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: treatment_consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the guest provided treatment consent. Creates audit trail for legal and compliance purposes.

products.name: charge
products.description: Transactional record of all spa revenue charges posted to guest folios or point-of-sale systems. Captures charge reference number, appointment reference, guest reference, reservation reference, property reference, charge date, charge type (treatment, retail, membership, day pass, gratuity, cancellation fee), treatment or product reference, quantity, unit price, discount amount, tax amount, total charge amount, currency, revenue center, posting status (posted, voided, adjusted), PMS folio reference, and POS transaction reference. SSOT for spa revenue recognition and USALI departmental reporting.

attributes.name: charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spa charge transaction. Primary key for the spa charge record.

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spa appointment associated with this charge. Links the charge to the scheduled service.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Spa charges posted to guest folios or billed to external accounts need to link to AR invoices for consolidated billing and receivables management. This FK enables integration between spa POS and finan

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Spa charges must be allocated to departmental cost centers for USALI-compliant financial reporting and departmental P&L analysis. Essential for spa department performance measurement, budget variance

attributes.name: fnb_pos_check_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.pos_check. Business justification: Spa charges bundle with F&B purchases in integrated resort POS. Guest charges spa treatment and restaurant meal to room on same transaction. Enables cross-department revenue analysis and unified guest

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Spa charges post to specific GL accounts in the ledger for financial statement preparation and audit trail. Required for revenue recognition, GL reconciliation, and SOX-compliant financial reporting i

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Spa charges require direct loyalty member link for points accrual on spa spend, tier-based spa pricing discounts, and member-only spa promotions. Critical for revenue attribution and loyalty program l

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spa package or bundle if this charge is part of a multi-service offering. Links to spa package catalog.

attributes.name: primary_charge_employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the staff member who posted the charge transaction. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_original_charge_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original spa charge record if this is an adjustment or reversal. Links corrected charges to their source transactions.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail product sold, if charge_type is retail. Links to the spa retail product catalog.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest who received the spa service or purchased the product. Links to the guest master record.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Spa charges contribute to profit center P&L for segment reporting, management fee calculations, and owner distributions. Required for spa profit center GOP, EBITDA reporting, and incentive management

attributes.name: property_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific spa facility, treatment room, or amenity area where the service was provided. Supports facility utilization analytics.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the spa charge was incurred. Enables multi-property revenue tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel reservation associated with this spa charge, if applicable. Used for folio posting and guest stay tracking.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: Spa charges reference rate plans when posted with negotiated rates, package inclusions, or loyalty discounts. Business process: spa charge posting with rate plan discounts ensures accurate revenue rec

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room. Business justification: Spa charges are posted directly to guest room folios. Revenue accounting, folio management, and PMS integration require room linkage for charge routing, a fundamental billing process in hotel spa oper

attributes.name: service_recovery_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to experience.service_recovery_action. Business justification: Service recovery often involves spa charge adjustments, waivers, or complimentary treatments. Finance systems must link recovery actions to specific charge records for GL reconciliation, cost center a

attributes.name: therapist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spa therapist or service provider who delivered the treatment. Used for commission tracking and performance reporting.

attributes.name: treatment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spa treatment or service provided, if charge_type is treatment. Links to the spa treatment catalog.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason for charge adjustment if posting_status is adjusted. Captures service recovery, pricing corrections, or billing disputes.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation if charge_type is cancellation_fee. Captures guest no-show, late cancellation, or policy violation details.

attributes.name: charge_date
attributes.description: Business date when the spa charge was incurred. Used for revenue recognition and daily operations reporting.

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number for the spa charge transaction, used for guest communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: charge_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the spa charge transaction was posted to the system. Principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the spa charge indicating the nature of the transaction: treatment (spa service), retail (product sale), membership (club fee), day_pass (facility access), gratuity (tip), or cancellation_fee (no-show penalty).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the spa charge record was first created in the system. Record audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the charge amount. Supports multi-currency operations across global properties.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this charge, including promotional discounts, loyalty rewards, or package inclusions. Reduces the gross charge amount.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Promotional or loyalty discount code applied to this charge. Used for marketing campaign tracking and discount reconciliation.

attributes.name: folio_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the guest folio in the PMS where this charge was posted. Links spa revenue to guest account for billing and settlement.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for revenue recognition. Maps spa charges to the appropriate GL account per USALI chart of accounts.

attributes.name: gratuity_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether gratuity is included in the total charge amount. True if gratuity is pre-included, false if gratuity is separate or not applied.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the spa charge record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the spa charge. May include special instructions, adjustments, or guest requests.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method of payment for the spa charge: room_charge (posted to folio), credit_card (direct payment), cash, gift_card, loyalty_points (redemption), or comp (complimentary).

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the charge transaction: posted (successfully recorded), voided (cancelled before settlement), adjusted (modified after posting), pending (awaiting approval), or reversed (corrected after settlement).

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units or services included in this charge line. Typically 1 for treatments, may be greater than 1 for retail products.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: USALI revenue center code for the spa department or facility where the charge was incurred. Used for departmental P&L reporting.

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Mandatory service charge or facility fee applied to the spa charge, separate from gratuity. Common in resort and luxury properties.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax applied to this charge, including sales tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount of the spa charge including all adjustments, taxes, and fees. Net amount posted to guest folio or POS transaction.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit or service before discounts and taxes. Base rate for the treatment or product.

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the charge was voided, if applicable. Supports audit trail and financial reconciliation.

products.name: retail_transaction

Supports spa retail revenue tracking, inventory depletion, and guest purchase history.

attributes.name: retail_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spa retail transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id

attributes.name: attribution_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.attribution_event. Business justification: Retail purchases are conversion events that may be influenced by marketing touchpoints. Tracks attribution for retail revenue, measures marketing impact on retail sales, and enables retail marketing R

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Retail purchases can be influenced by marketing campaigns (product promotions, loyalty offers, seasonal retail campaigns). Tracks campaign impact on retail revenue, measures promotional effectiveness,

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_offer. Business justification: Retail purchases may use promotional offer codes (product discounts, bundle offers, loyalty promotions). Tracks offer impact on retail revenue, measures promotional effectiveness, and enables retail o

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.corporate_account. Business justification: Corporate spa retail purchases (bulk wellness products, gift sets for employee programs, MICE amenity packages) require direct billing to corporate accounts. Essential for corporate wellness program i

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Retail sales revenue must be tracked by cost center for departmental performance reporting and USALI schedule preparation. Required for spa retail department P&L, inventory cost allocation, and retail

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who processed the retail transaction.

attributes.name: fnb_pos_check_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.pos_check. Business justification: Spa retail purchases (skincare products, wellness items) frequently combine with F&B transactions in unified guest billing sessions. Resort POS systems track cross-department purchases for total guest

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Retail sales post to inventory and revenue GL accounts for financial statement preparation. Essential for retail COGS calculation, inventory valuation, revenue recognition, and GL account reconciliati

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Retail purchases at spa boutiques earn loyalty points and qualify for member pricing. Essential for points accrual calculation, member purchase history analysis, and personalized spa retail offers bas

attributes.name: primary_original_transaction_retail_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original retail transaction ID if this transaction is a refund or exchange.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest or member who made the purchase.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Retail revenue contributes to spa profit center performance metrics for segment reporting and management evaluation. Essential for spa retail profitability analysis, profit center GOP contribution, an

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the retail transaction occurred.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest reservation if the retail purchase was charged to a room or associated with a stay.

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room. Business justification: Retail purchases at spa by hotel guests are posted to room folios. Point-of-sale systems and guest accounting require room linkage for charge-to-room transactions, standard practice in resort retail o

attributes.name: service_recovery_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to experience.service_recovery_action. Business justification: Complimentary spa retail products (skincare, aromatherapy) are common service recovery gestures. Retail systems must link recovery transactions to originating service case for inventory cost allocatio

attributes.name: spa_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to spa.spa_facility. Business justification: retail_transaction.outlet_id represents the spa retail outlet where the transaction occurred. In the spa domain context, retail outlets are part of spa facilities (spa_facility has retail_area_flag at

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this retail transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction, including promotional discounts, employee discounts, and member discounts.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Promotional or discount code applied to the transaction, if any.

attributes.name: guest_email
attributes.description: Email address of the guest for digital receipt delivery and marketing communications.

attributes.name: guest_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the guest who made the purchase.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items or products included in this retail transaction.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the guest for this retail purchase.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the guest as payment or partial payment for this transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this retail transaction record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the cashier or system regarding the transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for the transaction (e.g., credit card, cash, room charge, gift card, loyalty points redemption). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|room_charge|gift_card|loyalty_points|mobile_payment|bank_transfer — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or authorization code from the payment processor for credit card or electronic payments. Masked or tokenized for security.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or workstation where the transaction was processed.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Printed receipt number provided to the guest as proof of purchase.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for refunded or voided transactions, if applicable.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the retail transaction was initiated (e.g., in-person at spa shop, online store, mobile app, phone order).

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Service charge or gratuity amount added to the transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before discounts, taxes, and fees are applied.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the transaction, including sales tax, value-added tax, and other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount of the transaction after all discounts, taxes, and service charges have been applied. Net amount due from guest.

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all products sold in this transaction, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date when the retail transaction occurred. Business event date for revenue recognition and reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the retail transaction, typically generated by the Point of Sale (POS) system. Externally visible transaction reference.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the retail transaction indicating whether it was successfully completed, voided, refunded, or cancelled.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the retail transaction was completed at the Point of Sale (POS) terminal.

products.name: retail_inventory
products.description: Operational inventory record tracking spa retail product stock levels at each property outlet. Captures product reference, facility reference, current stock quantity, reserved quantity, available quantity, last physical count date, last physical count quantity, variance quantity, reorder triggered flag, reorder quantity, and last replenishment date. Enables spa managers to maintain optimal retail stock levels and trigger procurement requests.

attributes.name: retail_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail inventory record. Primary key for the retail inventory product.

attributes.name: adjustment_retail_inventory_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on retail_inventory (adjustment_retail_inventory_id)

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Retail spa products (skincare, aromatherapy oils) should reference material master for standardized product data, vendor sourcing, pricing, and procurement specifications. Eliminates data duplication

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the spa facility is located. Enables property-level inventory aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: retail_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail product master record. Identifies the specific spa retail product (skincare, wellness items, accessories) being tracked in inventory.

attributes.name: spa_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spa facility or outlet where this retail inventory is maintained. Links to the spa facility master data.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier or vendor for this retail product. Used for procurement planning and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of product available for immediate sale. Calculated as current stock quantity minus reserved quantity.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer batch or lot number for product traceability. Used for quality control, recalls, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and inventory history analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for unit cost and retail price. Enables multi-currency inventory management for international properties.

attributes.name: current_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The current on-hand quantity of the retail product at this facility. Represents the total physical inventory available including reserved items.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the product expires or should no longer be sold. Critical for skincare, wellness supplements, and perishable spa products. Null for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the inventory record. Indicates whether the product is actively sold, discontinued, held for quality review, or subject to recall.

attributes.name: inventory_value
attributes.description: The total value of current stock at unit cost. Calculated as current stock quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reporting and asset valuation.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: The date when the last physical inventory count was performed for this product at this facility. Used to track inventory audit compliance and accuracy.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity counted during the last physical inventory audit. Used to calculate variance and adjust system inventory records.

attributes.name: last_replenishment_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent inventory replenishment was received for this product. Used to track replenishment frequency and supplier performance.

attributes.name: last_replenishment_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity received in the most recent replenishment delivery. Used for replenishment pattern analysis and order optimization.

attributes.name: last_sale_date
attributes.description: The date when this product was last sold at this facility. Used to identify slow-moving inventory and optimize product mix.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory record was last modified. Used for data synchronization, audit trails, and change tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between placing a replenishment order and receiving the product. Used to calculate reorder points and safety stock levels.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The maximum inventory quantity that should be maintained for this product at this facility. Used to prevent overstocking and optimize storage space.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum stock level threshold that triggers a replenishment order. When available quantity falls below this level, procurement is initiated.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: The standard quantity to order when replenishing this product. Based on lead time, demand forecast, and optimal order economics.

attributes.name: reorder_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reorder point has been reached and a replenishment request should be generated. True when available quantity is at or below reorder point.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of product reserved for pending guest purchases or spa treatment packages but not yet fulfilled. Reduces available quantity for new sales.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The physical storage location within the spa facility where this inventory is kept. Examples include retail display area, back room storage, or secure cabinet.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the retail product. Used for inventory valuation, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation, and margin analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit in which the retail product is counted and sold. Used for inventory tracking and Point of Sale (POS) transactions.

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: The current selling price per unit of the retail product. Used for Point of Sale (POS) transactions and revenue calculation.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between system inventory quantity and physical count quantity. Positive values indicate overage, negative values indicate shortage. Used for shrinkage analysis and inventory accuracy metrics.

products.name: membership
products.description: Spa and wellness membership master record for guests enrolled in property-level spa membership programs. Captures membership number, guest reference, property reference, membership tier (basic, premium, elite, unlimited), membership type (monthly, annual, corporate), enrollment date, expiry date, monthly fee, annual fee, included treatment credits, included fitness access, included guest passes, auto-renewal flag, payment method on file, membership status (active, suspended, cancelled, expired), and cancellation reason. Distinct from loyalty.member which manages the hotel-wide loyalty program.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spa and wellness membership record. Primary key.

attributes.name: attribution_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.attribution_event. Business justification: Membership enrollments are key conversion events requiring attribution to marketing touchpoints. Essential for understanding membership acquisition journey, calculating acquisition costs by channel, a

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Membership enrollments are frequently the result of acquisition campaigns (membership drives, enrollment promotions, referral campaigns). Critical for measuring membership marketing ROI, tracking acqu

attributes.name: campaign_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_offer. Business justification: Membership enrollments often use promotional offers (waived enrollment fees, discounted rates, first-month-free promotions). Essential for offer performance tracking, measuring membership acquisition

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account sponsoring this membership. Populated only for corporate membership types where an employer or organization pays for employee memberships. Null for individual memberships.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Spa memberships sold through distribution partners (OTA wellness packages, corporate channels, travel agent networks) require channel attribution for commission calculation and membership acquisition

attributes.name: guest_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.guest_segment. Business justification: Memberships are often targeted to specific guest segments (local residents, frequent travelers, wellness enthusiasts). Essential for segment-based membership strategies, acquisition targeting, and mea

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Membership fees post to deferred/recurring revenue GL accounts for subscription revenue recognition. Essential for deferred revenue liability tracking, recurring revenue amortization, and ASC 606 comp

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Spa memberships are often bundled with hotel loyalty elite status, offering integrated benefits and cross-program recognition. Supports combined membership management, loyalty elite spa privileges, an

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Spa memberships are marketed to specific segments (local residents, hotel guests, corporate accounts). Business process: membership revenue forecasting, segment performance analysis, and strategic pla

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest enrolled in this spa membership. Links to the guest master record.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Membership revenue is allocated to spa profit center for recurring revenue tracking and segment profitability. Required for membership program ROI analysis, profit center recurring revenue metrics, an

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this spa membership is valid. Spa memberships are typically property-specific rather than chain-wide.

attributes.name: renewed_membership_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on membership (renewed_membership_id)

attributes.name: annual_fee
attributes.description: Total annual membership fee. For annual memberships this is the upfront payment amount. For monthly memberships this represents the total annual cost (monthly fee times 12). Zero for complimentary memberships.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the membership is set to automatically renew at the end of the current term. True if auto-renewal is enabled and payment will be processed automatically, False if the membership will expire without manual renewal.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the membership was cancelled. Null if membership has never been cancelled. Marks the effective end of the membership relationship.

attributes.name: cancellation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional details about the membership cancellation. May include guest feedback, retention offers made, or special circumstances. Used for qualitative analysis of member churn.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for membership cancellation. Member request indicates voluntary cancellation by the guest. Payment failure indicates cancellation due to non-payment. Relocation indicates member moved away from property area. Dissatisfaction indicates service quality issues. Health reasons indicates medical inability to use facilities. Cost concerns indicates financial reasons. Used for retention analysis and program improvement.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Length of the membership contract commitment in months. Common values are 1 for month-to-month, 12 for annual contracts, 24 or 36 for multi-year commitments. Null for lifetime or indefinite memberships.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

products.name: program_treatment
products.description: This association product represents the structured inclusion of spa treatments within multi-day wellness programs at destination spa and resort properties. It captures the therapeutic sequencing, scheduling, and delivery specifications for each treatment within a program. Each record links one wellness program to one treatment with attributes that define when, how often, and under what therapeutic context the treatment is delivered as part of the structured wellness experience.. Existence Justification: In destination spa and wellness resort operations, wellness programs are structured multi-day therapeutic experiences that include multiple carefully sequenced treatments, and individual treatments are reused across different wellness programs with varying therapeutic contexts. The business actively manages the inclusion, sequencing, and delivery specifications of treatments within programs - this is not a simple reference but a core operational entity managed by wellness directors and medical supervisors for program design, guest scheduling, and therapeutic outcome tracking.

attributes.name: frequency_per_week

[Moved from wellness_program: This STRING field currently stores a comma-separated list of treatments in wellness_program. This denormalized representation should be replaced by the structured program_treatment association, which allows proper relational querying, scheduling, and therapeutic sequencing with granular attributes per treatment inclusion.]
